"I am not aware that you suckled me, and you did not inform me." So he ('Uqbah) rode to Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Al-Madinah and put the matter before him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "How can you continue (to be her husband) after what you have been told?" 'Uqbah (May Allah be pleased with him) therefore divorced her and she married another man.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سروعة -كسر السين المهملة ونصبها- عقبة بن الحارث رضي الله عنه أنه تزوج ابنة لأبي إهاب بن عزيز، فأتته امرأة فقالت: إنى قد أرضعت عقبة والتى قد تزوج بها، فقال لها عقبة: ما أعلم أنك أرضعتني ولا أخبرتني فركب إلى رسول الله ﷺ بالمدينة فسأله فقال رسول الله ﷺ: “كيف، وقد قيل؟!” ففارقها عقبة ونكحت زوجاً غيره”. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 592

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الورع وترك الشبهات
chapter.englishTitle: Leading an Abstemious Life and refraining from the Doubtful

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hasan bin 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I have retained these words of Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "Leave what causes you doubt and turn to what does not cause you doubt."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Hasan bin 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I have retained these words of Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "Leave what causes you doubt and turn to what does not cause you doubt."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن الحسن بن على رضي الله عنهما، قال: حفظت من رسول الله ﷺ: "دع ما يريبك إلى ما لا يريبك" ((رواه الترمذى وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 593

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الورع وترك الشبهات
chapter.englishTitle: Leading an Abstemious Life and refraining from the Doubtful

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) had a slave who brought him his earnings and Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) would eat from it. One day he brought him something and when Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) had eaten some of it, the slave asked him whether he knew where he had got that (food) from, Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) asked what it was, and he replied: I acted as a soothsayer for a man in the pre-Islamic period, and not being good at it, I deceived him; today he met me and he rewarded me for that soothsaying what you have eaten. Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) put his hand in his mouth and vomited up all that he had eaten.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) had a slave who brought him his earnings and Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) would eat from it. One day he brought him something and when Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) had eaten some of it, the slave asked him whether he knew where he had got that (food) from, Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) asked what it was, and he replied: I acted as a soothsayer for a man in the pre-Islamic period, and not being good at it, I deceived him; today he met me and he rewarded me for that soothsaying what you have eaten. Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) put his hand in his mouth and vomited up all that he had eaten.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها، قالت: كان لأبي بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه غلام يخرج له الخراج وكان أبو بكر يأكل من خراجه فجاء يوماً بشئ، فأكل منه أبو بكر، فقال له الغلام: تدرى ما هذا؟ فقال أبو بكر: ما هو؟ قال: كنت تكهنت لإنسان فى الجاهلية وما أحسن الكهانة إلا أني خدعته فلقيني، فأعطاني بذلك هذا الذى أكلت منه، فأدخل أبو بكر يده فقاء كل شئ فى بطنه” ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 594

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الورع وترك الشبهات
chapter.englishTitle: Leading an Abstemious Life and refraining from the Doubtful

hadiths.englishRaw:
Nafi' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) fixed the payment amounting to four thousand dirhams for each of the early Emigrants, but for his son, he fixed only three thousand five hundred. He was asked: "He is also an (early) Emigrant, why have you fixed a lesser sum for him?" He said: "It was his father who took him along with him. He is not like one who emigrated by himself."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Nafi' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) fixed the payment amounting to four thousand dirhams for each of the early Emigrants, but for his son, he fixed only three thousand five hundred. He was asked: "He is also an (early) Emigrant, why have you fixed a lesser sum for him?" He said: "It was his father who took him along with him. He is not like one who emigrated by himself."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن نافع أن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه كان فرض للمهاجرين الأولين أربعة آلاف وفرض لابنه ثلاثة آلاف وخمسمائة، فقيل له: هو من المهاجرين فلم نقصته؟ فقال: إنما هاجر به أبوه، يقول: ليس هو كمن هاجر بنفسه” ((رواه البخاري))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 595

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الورع وترك الشبهات
chapter.englishTitle: Leading an Abstemious Life and refraining from the Doubtful

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Atiyyah bin 'Urwah As-Sa'di (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one will attain complete righteousness until he abandons (certain) unobjectionable (but doubtful) things so as to remain on his guard against something objectionable."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Atiyyah bin 'Urwah As-Sa'di (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one will attain complete righteousness until he abandons (certain) unobjectionable (but doubtful) things so as to remain on his guard against something objectionable."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عطية بن عروة السعدى الصحابي رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "لا يبلغ العبد أن يكون من المتقين حتى يدع مالا بأس به حذرا لما به بأس".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 596

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب العزلة عند فساد الناس والزمان أو الخوف من فتنة فى الدين ووقوع فى حرام وشبهات ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Seclusion at times of corruption committed by the people of the World

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah loves a slave who is pious, free of all wants and the unnoticed."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah loves a slave who is pious, free of all wants and the unnoticed."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ: يقول: “إن الله يحب العبد التقي الغني الخفي” ((رواه مسلم)). والمراد: بـ “الغني” غني النفس، كما سبق فى الحديث الصحيح.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 597

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب العزلة عند فساد الناس والزمان أو الخوف من فتنة فى الدين ووقوع فى حرام وشبهات ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Seclusion at times of corruption committed by the people of the World

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Someone asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Who is the best man?" He ﷺ answered, "A believer who strives in the Cause of Allah with his life and his wealth." The man asked: "Who is the next?" He said, "One who retires into a narrow valley and worships his Rubb."

Another narration is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "One who fears Allah and safeguards people against his own mischief."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Someone asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Who is the best man?" He ﷺ answered, "A believer who strives in the Cause of Allah with his life and his wealth." The man asked: "Who is the next?" He said, "One who retires into a narrow valley and worships his Rubb."

Another narration is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "One who fears Allah and safeguards people against his own mischief."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدرى رضي الله عنه قال: قال رجل: أى الناس أفضل يا رسول الله؟ قال: "مؤمن مجاهد بنفسه وماله فى سبيل الله" قال:  ثم من؟ قال: " رجل معتزل فى شعب من الشعاب يعبد ربه" وفى رواية: "يتقي الله، ويدع الناس من شره" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 598

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب العزلة عند فساد الناس والزمان أو الخوف من فتنة فى الدين ووقوع فى حرام وشبهات ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Seclusion at times of corruption committed by the people of the World

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best possession of a Muslim will be a herd of sheep with which he retires to the top of a mountain or places where rain is expected to fall (pastures) so as to safeguard with his faith from tribulation."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best possession of a Muslim will be a herd of sheep with which he retires to the top of a mountain or places where rain is expected to fall (pastures) so as to safeguard with his faith from tribulation."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "يوشك أن يكون خير مال المسلم غنم يتتبع بها شعف الجبال، ومواقع القطر، يفر بدينه من الفتن" ((رواه البخاري)). وشعف الجبال :أعلاها

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 599

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب العزلة عند فساد الناس والزمان أو الخوف من فتنة فى الدين ووقوع فى حرام وشبهات ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Seclusion at times of corruption committed by the people of the World

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every Prophet has tended sheep". He was asked: "And did you?" He replied, "Yes, I tended them for a few carats for the Makkans."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every Prophet has tended sheep". He was asked: "And did you?" He replied, "Yes, I tended them for a few carats for the Makkans."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "ما بعث الله نبياً إلا رعى الغنم” فقال أصحابه: أنت؟ قال: كنت أرعاها على قراريط لأهل مكة”. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 600

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب العزلة عند فساد الناس والزمان أو الخوف من فتنة فى الدين ووقوع فى حرام وشبهات ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Seclusion at times of corruption committed by the people of the World

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of people is a man who is holding his horse's rein in the way of Allah (in Jihad) and is galloping towards the place wherever he hears a call for war or detects a note of danger; he goes on proceeding, seeking martyrdom or death wherever it is expected. And a man who retires with some sheep in a mountainside or a valley. He performs Salat regularly and pays the Zakat, continues worshipping his Rubb, till death overtakes him. He does not interfere in the affairs of the people except for betterment."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of people is a man who is holding his horse's rein in the way of Allah (in Jihad) and is galloping towards the place wherever he hears a call for war or detects a note of danger; he goes on proceeding, seeking martyrdom or death wherever it is expected. And a man who retires with some sheep in a mountainside or a valley. He performs Salat regularly and pays the Zakat, continues worshipping his Rubb, till death overtakes him. He does not interfere in the affairs of the people except for betterment."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن رسول الله ﷺ أنه قال: “من خير معاش الناس  رجل ممسك عنان فرسه فى سبيل الله، يطير على متنه، كلما سمع هيعه أو فزعة، طار عليه يبتغى القتل، أو الموت مظانه، أو رجل فى غنيمة فى رأس شعفة من هذه الشعف، أو بطن واد من هذه الأودية يقيم الصلاة، ويؤتى الزكاة، ويعبد ربه حتى يأتيه اليقين، ليس من الناس إلا فى خير” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 601

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Iyad bin Himar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah has revealed to me that you should humble yourselves to one another. One should neither hold himself above another nor transgress against another."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Iyad bin Himar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah has revealed to me that you should humble yourselves to one another. One should neither hold himself above another nor transgress against another."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عياض بن حمار رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “إن الله أوحى إلي أن تواضعوا حتى لا يفخر أحد على أحد، ولا يبغي أحد على أحد” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 602

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Wealth does not diminish by giving Sadaqah (charity). Allah augments the honour of one who forgives; and one who serves another seeking the pleasure of Allah, Allah will exalt him in ranks."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Wealth does not diminish by giving Sadaqah (charity). Allah augments the honour of one who forgives; and one who serves another seeking the pleasure of Allah, Allah will exalt him in ranks."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: “ما نقصت صدقة من مال، و ما زادالله عبداً بعفو إلا عزاً، وما تواضع أحد لله إلا رفعه الله” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 603

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) passed by some children and greeted them (by saying As-salamu 'alaikum to them). Then he said:
 The Prophet ﷺ used to do the same.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) passed by some children and greeted them (by saying As-salamu 'alaikum to them). Then he said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ used to do the same.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أنه مر على صبيان فسلم عليهم وقال: كان النبي ﷺ يفعله. ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 604

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A slave-girl of Al-Madinah would take hold of the hand of the Prophet ﷺ and take him wherever she desired.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A slave-girl of Al-Madinah would take hold of the hand of the Prophet ﷺ and take him wherever she desired.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عنه قال: إن كانت الأمة من إماء المدينة لتأخذ بيد النبي ﷺ، فتنطلق به حيث شاءت. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 605

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Aswad bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) was asked: "What did Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do inside his house?" She answered: "He used to keep himself busy helping members of his family, and when it was the time for Salat (the prayer), he would get up for prayer."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Aswad bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) was asked: "What did Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do inside his house?" She answered: "He used to keep himself busy helping members of his family, and when it was the time for Salat (the prayer), he would get up for prayer."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن الأسود بن يزيد قال: سئلت عائشة رضي الله عنها: ما كان النبي ﷺ يصنع فى بيته؟ قالت: كان يكون فى مهنة أهله -يعنى: خدمة أهله- فإذا حضرت الصلاة، خرج إلى الصلاة” ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 606

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Tamim bin Usaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I came to Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was delivering a Khutbah and said: "O Messenger of Allah, a stranger (meaning himself) has come to inquire about his Deen. He is quite ignorant about his Deen." Messenger of Allah ﷺ interrupted his Khutbah and turned to me. Then a chair was brought for him and he sat on it. He started instructing me what Allah had taught him. Then he resumed his Khutbah and completed it.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Tamim bin Usaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I came to Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was delivering a Khutbah and said: "O Messenger of Allah, a stranger (meaning himself) has come to inquire about his Deen. He is quite ignorant about his Deen." Messenger of Allah ﷺ interrupted his Khutbah and turned to me. Then a chair was brought for him and he sat on it. He started instructing me what Allah had taught him. Then he resumed his Khutbah and completed it.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي رفاعة تميم بن أسيد رضي الله عنه قال: انتهيت إلى رسول الله ﷺ وهو يخطب، فقلت: يا رسول الله رجل غريب جاء يسأل عن دينه لا يدرى ما دينه؟ فأقبل علي رسول الله ﷺ، وترك خطبته حتى انتهى إلى فأتى بكرسي، فقعد عليه وجعل يعلمني مما علمه الله ثم أتى خطبته فأتم آخرها”. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 607

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished eating his food, he would lick his three fingers (i.e., the forefinger, the middle finger and the thumb). He ﷺ said, "If anyone of you drops a morsel, he should remove anything harmful from it and then eat it. He should not leave it for Shaitan." He commanded us to clean out the dish saying, "You do not know in what portion of your food the blessing lies."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished eating his food, he would lick his three fingers (i.e., the forefinger, the middle finger and the thumb). He ﷺ said, "If anyone of you drops a morsel, he should remove anything harmful from it and then eat it. He should not leave it for Shaitan." He commanded us to clean out the dish saying, "You do not know in what portion of your food the blessing lies."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ كان إذا أكل طعاماً لعق أصابعه الثلاث قال: وقال: “إذا سقطت لقمة أحدكم، فليمط عنها الأذى، وليأكلها، ولا يدعها للشيطان” وأمر أن تسلت القصعة قال: فإنكم لا تدرون فى أى طعامكم البركة” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 608

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Every Prophet has tended sheep." He was asked: "And did you?" He replied: "Yes, I tended them for a few carats for the Makkans."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Every Prophet has tended sheep." He was asked: "And did you?" He replied: "Yes, I tended them for a few carats for the Makkans."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: “ما بعث  الله نبياً إلا رعى الغنم” قال أصحابه: وأنت؟ فقال: نعم كنت أرعاها على قراريط لأهل مكة” ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 609

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said: "If I am invited to a meal consisting of a sheep's foot or shoulder, I would respond and I would accept as a gift a shoulder or a foot of a sheep."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said: "If I am invited to a meal consisting of a sheep's foot or shoulder, I would respond and I would accept as a gift a shoulder or a foot of a sheep."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن النبي ﷺ  قال: لو دعيت إلى كراع أو ذراع لأجبت ولو أهدى إلى ذراع أو كراع لقبلت”. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 610

chapter.arabicTitle: باب التواضع وخفض الجناح للمؤمنين
chapter.englishTitle: Modesty and Courtesy towards the Believers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a she-camel called Al-'Adba' which would not allow any other camel to surpass her. A bedouin came riding his camel which outstripped it. The Muslims were much grieved at this. Messenger of Allah ﷺ perceived it and said, "It is Allah's Way that he lowers whatever raises itself in the world."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a she-camel called Al-'Adba' which would not allow any other camel to surpass her. A bedouin came riding his camel which outstripped it. The Muslims were much grieved at this. Messenger of Allah ﷺ perceived it and said, "It is Allah's Way that he lowers whatever raises itself in the world."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: كانت ناقة رسول الله ﷺ: العضباء لا تسبق، أو لا تكاد تسبق فجاء أعرابي على قعود له، فسبقها، فشق ذلك على المسلمين حتى عرفه، النبي ﷺ  فقال: “حق على الله أن لا يرتفع شئ من الدنيا إلا وضعه” ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 611

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who has, in his heart, an ant's weight of arrogance will not enter Jannah." Someone said: "A man likes to wear beautiful clothes and shoes?" Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah is Beautiful, He loves beauty. Arrogance means ridiculing and rejecting the Truth and despising people."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who has, in his heart, an ant's weight of arrogance will not enter Jannah." Someone said: "A man likes to wear beautiful clothes and shoes?" Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah is Beautiful, He loves beauty. Arrogance means ridiculing and rejecting the Truth and despising people."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه عن النبى ﷺ قال: “لا يدخل الجنة من كان في قلبه مثقال ذرة  من كبر” فقال رجل” إن الرجل يحب أن يكون ثوبه حسناً ونعله حسناً؟ قال: “إن الله جميل يحب الجمال الكبر بطر الحق وغمط الناس” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 612

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salamah bin Al-Akwa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man ate in the presence of Messenger of Allah ﷺ with his left hand. He ﷺ said, "Eat with your right hand." He said: "I cannot." Thereupon he (the Prophet ﷺ) said, "May you never be able to do that." It was arrogance that prevented him from doing it, and he could not raise it (the right hand) up to his mouth afterwards.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Salamah bin Al-Akwa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man ate in the presence of Messenger of Allah ﷺ with his left hand. He ﷺ said, "Eat with your right hand." He said: "I cannot." Thereupon he (the Prophet ﷺ) said, "May you never be able to do that." It was arrogance that prevented him from doing it, and he could not raise it (the right hand) up to his mouth afterwards.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سلمه بن الأكوع رضي الله عنه أن رجلاً أكل عند رسول الله ﷺ بشماله، فقال: “كل بيمينك” قال: لا أستطيع! قال: “لا اتسطعت” ما منعه إلا الكبر. قال: فما رفعه إلى فيه”. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 613

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
Harithah bin Wahab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Shall I not inform you about the inmates of Hell? It is every violent, impertinent and proud person."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Harithah bin Wahab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Shall I not inform you about the inmates of Hell? It is every violent, impertinent and proud person."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن حارثة بن وهب رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: ألا أخبركم بأهل النار؟: كل عتل جواظ مستكبر” ((متفق عليه)). وتقدم شرحه في باب ضعفة المسلمين.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 614

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "There was a dispute between Hell and Jannah, and Hell said: 'The haughty and proud are in me.' The Jannah said: 'In me are the weak and the humble.' Thereupon Allah, the Exalted, judged between them saying: 'You the Jannah are My Mercy, and through you I shall show mercy to those whom I wish.' (And addressing the Hell) He said: 'You are My punishment to punish whom I wish amongst My slaves, and each one of you will have its fill."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "There was a dispute between Hell and Jannah, and Hell said: 'The haughty and proud are in me.' The Jannah said: 'In me are the weak and the humble.' Thereupon Allah, the Exalted, judged between them saying: 'You the Jannah are My Mercy, and through you I shall show mercy to those whom I wish.' (And addressing the Hell) He said: 'You are My punishment to punish whom I wish amongst My slaves, and each one of you will have its fill."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى سعيد رضي الله عنه، عن النبى ﷺ قال: “احتجت الجنة والنار، فقالت النار: في الجبارون والمتكبرون، وقالت الجنة: في ضعفاء الناس ومساكينهم. فقضى الله بينهما: إنك الجنة رحمتي، أرحم بك من أشاء، وإنك النار عذابي أعذب بك من أشاء ولكليكما علي ملؤها” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 615

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at him who trails his lower garment out of pride."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at him who trails his lower garment out of pride."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: “لا ينظر الله يوم القيامة إلى من جر إزاره بطراً” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 616

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There are three (types of) people to whom Allah will not speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them, nor look at them, and they will have a painful punishment. These are: An aged man who commits Zina (illicit sexual act), a ruler who lies, and a proud poor person."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There are three (types of) people to whom Allah will not speak on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them, nor look at them, and they will have a painful punishment. These are: An aged man who commits Zina (illicit sexual act), a ruler who lies, and a proud poor person."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “ثلاثة لا يكلمهم الله يوم القيامة، ولايزكيهم، ولا ينظر إليهم ، ولهم عذاب أليم: شيخ زان وملك كذاب، وعائل مستكبر” ((رواه مسلم))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 617

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'Honour is My Izar and Pride is My Cloak. Whoever vies with Me regarding one of them, shall be tormented."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'Honour is My Izar and Pride is My Cloak. Whoever vies with Me regarding one of them, shall be tormented."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “قال الله عز وجل: العز إزاري والكبرياء ردائي، فمن ينازعني في واحد منهما فقد عذبته” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 618

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "While a man was walking, dressed in clothes admiring himself, his hair combed, walking haughtily when Allah caused the earth to swallow him. Now he will continue to go down in it (as a punishment) until the Day of Resurrection."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "While a man was walking, dressed in clothes admiring himself, his hair combed, walking haughtily when Allah caused the earth to swallow him. Now he will continue to go down in it (as a punishment) until the Day of Resurrection."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال:"بينما رجل يمشى في حلة تعجبه نفسه، مرجل رأسه، يختال في مشيته، إذ خسف الله به، فهو يتجلجل في الأرض إلى يوم القيامة” ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 619

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الكبر والإعجاب
chapter.englishTitle: Condemnation of Pride and Self-Conceit

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salamah bin Al-Akwa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Man continues to display haughtiness and arrogance until he is recorded among the arrogant and will be therefore afflicted with what afflicts them."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Salamah bin Al-Akwa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Man continues to display haughtiness and arrogance until he is recorded among the arrogant and will be therefore afflicted with what afflicts them."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سلمه بن الأكوع رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “لا يزال الرجل يذهب بنفسه حتى يكتب في الجبارين، فيصيبه ما أصابهم” رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 620

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the best of all the people in behaviour.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the best of all the people in behaviour.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ أحسن الناس خلقاً ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 621

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I never felt any piece of velvet or silk softer than the palm of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, nor did I smell any fragrance more pleasant than the smell of Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I served him for ten years, and he never said 'Uff' (an expression of disgust) to me. He never said 'why did you do that?' for something I had done, nor did he ever say 'why did you not do such and such' for something I had not done.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I never felt any piece of velvet or silk softer than the palm of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, nor did I smell any fragrance more pleasant than the smell of Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I served him for ten years, and he never said 'Uff' (an expression of disgust) to me. He never said 'why did you do that?' for something I had done, nor did he ever say 'why did you not do such and such' for something I had not done.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: ما مسست ديباجاً ولاحريراً ألين من كف رسول الله ﷺ، ولا شممت رائحة قط أطيب من رائحة رسول الله ﷺ ولقد خدمت رسول الله ﷺ عشر سنين، فما قال لي قط :أف، ولا قال لشئ فعلته: لم فعلته؟ ولا لشئ لم أفعله: ألا فعلت كذا؟ ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 622

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sa'b bin Jaththamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I presented a wild ass to Messenger of Allah ﷺ as a gift but he returned it to me. When he perceived signs of despair on my face, he said, "I have declined to accept it because I am in the state of Ihram."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sa'b bin Jaththamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I presented a wild ass to Messenger of Allah ﷺ as a gift but he returned it to me. When he perceived signs of despair on my face, he said, "I have declined to accept it because I am in the state of Ihram."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن الصعب بن جثامة رضي الله عنه قال: أهديت رسول الله ﷺ حماراً وحشياً فرده علي، فلما رأى ما في وجهي قال: “إنا لم نرده عليك إلا لأنا حرم” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 623

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Nawwas bin Sam'an (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ about virtue and sin, and he said, "Virtue is noble behaviour, and sin is that which creates doubt and you do not like people to know about it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Nawwas bin Sam'an (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ about virtue and sin, and he said, "Virtue is noble behaviour, and sin is that which creates doubt and you do not like people to know about it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن النواس بن سمعان رضي الله عنه قال: سألت رسول الله ﷺ عن البر والإثم فقال: “البر حسن الخلق، والإثم: ما حاك في نفسك وكرهت أن يطلع عليه الناس” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 624

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'as (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not indulge in loose talk nor did he like to listen to it. He used to say, "The best of you is the best among you in conduct."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'as (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not indulge in loose talk nor did he like to listen to it. He used to say, "The best of you is the best among you in conduct."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما قال: لم يكن رسول الله ﷺ فاحشاً ولا متفحشاً. وكان يقول: “إن من خياركم أحسنكم أخلاقاً” ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 625

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abud-Darda (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Nothing will be heavier on the Day of Resurrection in the Scale of the believer than good manners. Allah hates one who utters foul or coarse language."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abud-Darda (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Nothing will be heavier on the Day of Resurrection in the Scale of the believer than good manners. Allah hates one who utters foul or coarse language."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى الدرداء رضي الله عنه: أن النبى ﷺ قال: “ما من شئ أثقل في ميزان المؤمن يوم القيامة من حسن الخلق، وإن الله يبغض الفاحش البذي” ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 626

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the deed which will be foremost to lead a man to Jannah. He replied, "Fear of Allah and the good conduct." Then he was asked about indulgence which will admit a man to Hell (Fire) and he answered, "The tongue and the genitals."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the deed which will be foremost to lead a man to Jannah. He replied, "Fear of Allah and the good conduct." Then he was asked about indulgence which will admit a man to Hell (Fire) and he answered, "The tongue and the genitals."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سئل رسول الله ﷺ عن أكثر ما يدخل الناس الجنة؟ قال: “تقوى الله وحسن الخلق” وسئل عن أكثر ما يدخل الناس النار، قال: “الفم والفرج”. ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 627

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The most perfect man in his faith among the believers is the one whose behaviour is most excellent; and the best of you are those who are the best to their wives."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The most perfect man in his faith among the believers is the one whose behaviour is most excellent; and the best of you are those who are the best to their wives."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال رسول الله ﷺ: “أكمل المؤمنين إيماناً أحسنهم خلقاً وخياركم خياركم لنسائهم”. ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 628

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "A believer will attain by his good behaviour the rank of one who prays during the night and observes fasting during the day."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "A believer will attain by his good behaviour the rank of one who prays during the night and observes fasting during the day."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها، قالت: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: “ إن المؤمن ليدرك بحسن خلقه درجة الصائم القائم” ((رواه أبو داود)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 629

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I guarantee a house in Jannah for one who gives up arguing, even if he is in the right; and I guarantee a home in the middle of Jannah for one who abandons lying even for the sake of fun; and I guarantee a house in the highest part of Jannah for one who has good manners."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah Al-Bahili (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I guarantee a house in Jannah for one who gives up arguing, even if he is in the right; and I guarantee a home in the middle of Jannah for one who abandons lying even for the sake of fun; and I guarantee a house in the highest part of Jannah for one who has good manners."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى أمامه الباهلى رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “أنا زعيم ببيت في ربض الجنة لمن ترك المراء، وإن كان محقاً، وببيت في وسط الجنة لمن ترك الكذب، وإن كان مازحاً، وببيت في أعلى الجنة لمن حسن خلقه” ((حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 630

chapter.arabicTitle: باب حسن الخلق
chapter.englishTitle: Good Conduct

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The dearest and nearest among you to me on the Day of Resurrection will be one who is the best of you in manners; and the most abhorrent among you to me and the farthest of you from me will be the pompous, the garrulous, and Al-Mutafaihiqun." The Companions asked him: "O Messenger of Allah! We know about the pompous and the garrulous, but we do not know who Al-Mutafaihiqun are." He replied: "The arrogant people."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The dearest and nearest among you to me on the Day of Resurrection will be one who is the best of you in manners; and the most abhorrent among you to me and the farthest of you from me will be the pompous, the garrulous, and Al-Mutafaihiqun." The Companions asked him: "O Messenger of Allah! We know about the pompous and the garrulous, but we do not know who Al-Mutafaihiqun are." He replied: "The arrogant people."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: “إن من أحبكم إلي، وأقربكم منى مجلساً يوم القيامة أحاسنكم أخلاقاً، وإن أبغضكم إلي وأبعدكم مني يوم القيامة، الثرثارون والمتشدقون والمتفيهقون” قالوا: يا رسول الله قد علمنا “الثرثارون والمتشدون” فما المتفيهقون؟ قال: “المتكبرون” ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)). "الثرثار": هو كثير الكلام تكلفاً. "والمتشدق": المتطاول على الناس بكلامه، ويتكلم بملء فيه تصافحاً وتعظيماً لكلامه؛ “والمتفيهق” :أصله من الفهق، وهو الامتلاء، وهو الذى يملأ فمه بالكلام، ويتوسع فيه ويغرب به تكبراً واتفاعاً، وإظهاراً للفضيلة على غيره.وروى الترمذي عن عبد الله بن المبارك رحمه الله في تفسير حسن الخلق قال: هو طلاقة الوجه، وبذل المعروف، وكف الأذى.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 631

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Ashaj Abdul-Qais (May Allah be pleased with him), "You possess two qualities that Allah loves. These are clemency and tolerance."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Ashaj Abdul-Qais (May Allah be pleased with him), "You possess two qualities that Allah loves. These are clemency and tolerance."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ لأشج عبد القيس: “إن فيك خصلتين يحبهما الله: الحلم والأناة”. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 632

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah is Forbearer and loves forbearance in all matters."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah is Forbearer and loves forbearance in all matters."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “ إن الله رفيق يحب الرفق في الأمر كله” ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 633

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah is Forbearer and He loves forbearance, and rewards for forbearance while He does not reward severity, and does not give for any thing besides it (forbearance)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah is Forbearer and He loves forbearance, and rewards for forbearance while He does not reward severity, and does not give for any thing besides it (forbearance)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها أن النبى ﷺ قال: " إن الله رفيق يحب الرفق، ويعطى على الرفق ما لا يعطى على العنف ومالا يعطى على ما سواه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 634

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whenever forbearance is added to something, it adorns it; and whenever it is withdrawn from something, it leaves it defective."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whenever forbearance is added to something, it adorns it; and whenever it is withdrawn from something, it leaves it defective."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها أن النبى ﷺ قال: “إن الرفق لا يكون في شئ إلا زانه، ولا ينزع من شئ إلا شانه” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 635

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A bedouin urinated in the mosque and some people rushed to beat him up. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Leave him alone and pour a bucket of water over it. You have been sent to make things easy and not to make them difficult."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A bedouin urinated in the mosque and some people rushed to beat him up. The Prophet ﷺ said: "Leave him alone and pour a bucket of water over it. You have been sent to make things easy and not to make them difficult."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: بال أعرابى في المسجد فقام الناس إليه ليقعوا فيه، فقال النبى ﷺ: “دعوه وأريقوا على بوله  سجلاً من ماء، أو ذنوباً من ماء، فإنما بعثتم ميسرين ولم تبعثوا معسرين” ((رواه البخارى)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 636

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Make things easy and do not make them difficult, cheer the people up by conveying glad tidings to them and do not repulse (them)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Make things easy and do not make them difficult, cheer the people up by conveying glad tidings to them and do not repulse (them)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه عن النبى ﷺ قال: “يسروا ولا تعسروا وبشروا ولا تنفروا ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 637

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jarir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who is deprived of forbearance and gentleness is, in fact, deprived of all good."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jarir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who is deprived of forbearance and gentleness is, in fact, deprived of all good."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جرير بن عبد الله رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: “من يحرم الرفق يحرم الخير كله” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 638

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man asked the Prophet ﷺ to give him advice, and he ﷺ said, "Do not get angry." The man repeated that several times and he ﷺ replied (every time), "Do not get angry."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man asked the Prophet ﷺ to give him advice, and he ﷺ said, "Do not get angry." The man repeated that several times and he ﷺ replied (every time), "Do not get angry."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رجلاً قال للنبى ﷺ: أوصنى قال: “لا تغضب” فردد مراراً، قال: “لا تغضب”. ((رواه البخارى)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 639

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Ya'la Shaddad bin 'Aus (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily Allah has prescribed Ihsan (kindness) for everything. So when you kill, you must make the killing in the best manner; when you slaughter, make your slaughter in the best manner. Let one of you sharpen his knife and give ease to his animal (in order to reduce his pain)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Ya'la Shaddad bin 'Aus (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily Allah has prescribed Ihsan (kindness) for everything. So when you kill, you must make the killing in the best manner; when you slaughter, make your slaughter in the best manner. Let one of you sharpen his knife and give ease to his animal (in order to reduce his pain)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى يعلى شداد بن أوس رضي الله عنه، عن رسول الله ﷺ قال: “إن الله كتب الإحسان على كل شئ، فإذا قتلتم فأحسنوا القتلة وإذا ذبحتم فأحسنوا الذبحة، وليحد أحدكم شفرته وليرح ذبيحته” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 640

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 Whenever the Prophet ﷺ was given a choice between two matters, he would (always) choose the easier as long as it was not sinful to do so; but if it was sinful he was most strict in avoiding it. He never took revenge upon anybody for his own sake; but when Allah's Legal Bindings were outraged, he would take revenge for Allah's sake.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
Whenever the Prophet ﷺ was given a choice between two matters, he would (always) choose the easier as long as it was not sinful to do so; but if it was sinful he was most strict in avoiding it. He never took revenge upon anybody for his own sake; but when Allah's Legal Bindings were outraged, he would take revenge for Allah's sake.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: ما خير رسول الله ﷺ بين أمرين قط إلا أخذ أيسرهما، ما لم يكن إثماً، فإن كان إثماً، كان أبعد الناس منه، وما انتقم رسول الله ﷺ لنفسه في شئ قط، إلا أن تنتهك حرمة الله، فينتقم لله تعالى. ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 641

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحلم والأناة والرفق
chapter.englishTitle: Clemency, Tolerance and Gentleness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Shall I not tell you whom the (Hell) Fire is forbidden to touch? It is forbidden to touch a man who is always accessible, having polite and tender nature."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Shall I not tell you whom the (Hell) Fire is forbidden to touch? It is forbidden to touch a man who is always accessible, having polite and tender nature."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “ألا أخبركم بمن يحرم على النار -أو بمن تحرم عليه النار؟- تحرم على كل قريب هين لين سهل”. ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 642

chapter.arabicTitle: باب العفو والإعراض عن الجاهلين
chapter.englishTitle: Forgiveness of the Ignorant

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 I asked the Prophet ﷺ "Have you ever experienced a day harder than the day of the battle of Uhud?" He replied, "Indeed, I experienced them (dangers) at the hands of your people (i.e., the disbelievers from amongst the Quraish tribe). The hardest treatment I met from them was on the Day of 'Aqabah when I went to Ibn 'Abd Yalil bin 'Abd Kulal (who was one of the chiefs of Ta'if) with the purpose of inviting him to Islam, but he made no response (to my call). So I departed with deep distress. I did not recover until I arrived at Qarn ath-Tha'alib. There, I raised my head and saw a cloud which had cast its shadow on me. I saw in it Jibril (Gabriel) ﷺ who called me and said: 'Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, heard what your people said to you and the response they made to you. And He has sent you the angel in charge of the mountains to order him to do to them what you wish.' Then the angel of the mountains called me, greeted me and said: 'O Muhammad, Allah listened to what your people had said to you. I am the angel of the mountains, and my Rubb has sent me to you so that you may give me your orders. (I will carry out your orders). If you wish I will bring together the two mountains that stand opposite to each other at the extremities of Makkah to crush them in between."' But Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I rather hope that Allah will raise from among their descendants people as will worship Allah the One, and will not ascribe partners to Him (in worship)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
I asked the Prophet ﷺ "Have you ever experienced a day harder than the day of the battle of Uhud?" He replied, "Indeed, I experienced them (dangers) at the hands of your people (i.e., the disbelievers from amongst the Quraish tribe). The hardest treatment I met from them was on the Day of 'Aqabah when I went to Ibn 'Abd Yalil bin 'Abd Kulal (who was one of the chiefs of Ta'if) with the purpose of inviting him to Islam, but he made no response (to my call). So I departed with deep distress. I did not recover until I arrived at Qarn ath-Tha'alib. There, I raised my head and saw a cloud which had cast its shadow on me. I saw in it Jibril (Gabriel) ﷺ who called me and said: 'Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, heard what your people said to you and the response they made to you. And He has sent you the angel in charge of the mountains to order him to do to them what you wish.' Then the angel of the mountains called me, greeted me and said: 'O Muhammad, Allah listened to what your people had said to you. I am the angel of the mountains, and my Rubb has sent me to you so that you may give me your orders. (I will carry out your orders). If you wish I will bring together the two mountains that stand opposite to each other at the extremities of Makkah to crush them in between."' But Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I rather hope that Allah will raise from among their descendants people as will worship Allah the One, and will not ascribe partners to Him (in worship)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أنها قالت للنبى ﷺ: هل أتى عليك يوم كان أشد من يوم أحد؟ قال: “لقد لقيت من قومك، وكان أشد ما لقيته منهم يوم العقبة، إذ عرضت نفسي على ابن عبد ياليل بن عبد كلال فلم يجبنى إلى ما أردت، فانطلقت وأنا مهموم على وجهى، فلم أستفق إلا وأنا بقرن الثعالب، فرفعت رأسى، فإذا أنا بسحابة قد أظلتنى، فنظرت فإذا فيها جبريل عليه السلام، فنادانى فقال: إن الله تعالى قد سمع قول قومك لك، وما ردوا عليك، وقد بعث إليك ملك الجبال لتأمره بما شئت فيهم فنادانى ملك الجبال، فسلم على ثم قال: يا محمد إن الله قد سمع قول قومك لك، وأنا ملك الجبال، وقد بعثنى ربى إليك لتأمرنى بأمرك،فما شئت: إن شئت أطبقت عليهم الأخشبين” فقال النبى ﷺ: "بل أرجو أن يخرج من أصلابهم من يعبد الله وحده لا يشرك به شيئاً". ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 643

chapter.arabicTitle: باب العفو والإعراض عن الجاهلين
chapter.englishTitle: Forgiveness of the Ignorant

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ never hit anything with his hand neither a servant nor a woman but of course, he did fight in the Cause of Allah. He never took revenge upon anyone for the wrong done to him, but of course, he exacted retribution for the sake of Allah in case the Injunctions of Allah about unlawful acts were violated.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ never hit anything with his hand neither a servant nor a woman but of course, he did fight in the Cause of Allah. He never took revenge upon anyone for the wrong done to him, but of course, he exacted retribution for the sake of Allah in case the Injunctions of Allah about unlawful acts were violated.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها قالت: ما ضرب رسول الله ﷺ شيئاً قط بيده، ولا امرأة ولا خادماً، إلا أن يجاهد في سبيل الله، وما نيل منه شئ قط فينتقم من صاحبه، إلا أن ينتهك شئ من محارم الله تعالى، فينتقم لله تعالى. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 644

chapter.arabicTitle: باب العفو والإعراض عن الجاهلين
chapter.englishTitle: Forgiveness of the Ignorant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I was walking with Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was wearing a Najrani cloak with a very thick border when a bedouin happened to meet him. He took hold of the side of his cloak and drew it violently. I noticed that the violence of jerk had bruised the neck of Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The bedouin said: "O Muhammad! Give me out of Allah's wealth that you possess." Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to him and smiled and directed that he should be given something.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I was walking with Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was wearing a Najrani cloak with a very thick border when a bedouin happened to meet him. He took hold of the side of his cloak and drew it violently. I noticed that the violence of jerk had bruised the neck of Messenger of Allah ﷺ. The bedouin said: "O Muhammad! Give me out of Allah's wealth that you possess." Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to him and smiled and directed that he should be given something.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: كنت أمشى مع رسول الله ﷺ، وعليه برد نجرانى غليظ الحاشية، فأدركه أعرابى، فجبذه بردائه جبذة شديدة، فنظرت إلى صفحة عاتق النبى ﷺ، وقد أثرت بها حاشية البرد من شدة فضحك، ثم قال: يا محمد مر لى من مال الله الذى عندك، فالتفت إليه فضحك ثم أمر له بعطاء. ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 645

chapter.arabicTitle: باب العفو والإعراض عن الجاهلين
chapter.englishTitle: Forgiveness of the Ignorant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I can see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ look like one of the Prophets of Allah whose people beat and made him bleed while he was wiping the blood from his face and supplicating: "O Allah, forgive my people because they know not."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I can see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ look like one of the Prophets of Allah whose people beat and made him bleed while he was wiping the blood from his face and supplicating: "O Allah, forgive my people because they know not."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: كأنى أنظر إلى رسول الله ﷺ يحكى نبياً من الأنبياء، صلوات الله وسلامه عليهم، ضربه قومه فأدموه وهو يمسح الدم عن وجهه، ويقول: “اللهم اغفر لقومى فإنهم لا يعملون” ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 646

chapter.arabicTitle: باب العفو والإعراض عن الجاهلين
chapter.englishTitle: Forgiveness of the Ignorant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The strong man is not the one who wrestles, but the strong man is in fact the one who controls himself in a fit of rage."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The strong man is not the one who wrestles, but the strong man is in fact the one who controls himself in a fit of rage."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: ليس الشديد بالصرعة، إنما الشديد الذى يملك نفسه عند الغضب” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 647

chapter.arabicTitle: باب احتمال الأذى
chapter.englishTitle: Endurance of Afflictions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man said to Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "I have relatives with whom I try to maintain good relationship but they sever relations with me; whom I treat kindly but they treat me badly, with whom I am gentle but they are rough to me." He ﷺ replied, "If you are as you have said, then it is as though you are feeding them hot ashes and you will not be without a supporter against them from Allah, as long as you do so."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man said to Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "I have relatives with whom I try to maintain good relationship but they sever relations with me; whom I treat kindly but they treat me badly, with whom I am gentle but they are rough to me." He ﷺ replied, "If you are as you have said, then it is as though you are feeding them hot ashes and you will not be without a supporter against them from Allah, as long as you do so."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رجلاً قال: يا رسول الله إن لى قرابة أصلهم ويقطعونى، وأحسن إليهم ويسيئون إلى، وأحلم عنهم ويجهلون على! فقال: “لئن كنت كما قلت فكأنما تسفهم المل ولا يزال معك من الله تعالى ظهير عليهم ما دمت على ذلك” ((رواه مسلم)) وقد سبق شرحه في “باب صلة الأرحام”.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 648

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الغضب إذا انتهكت حرمات الشرع والانتصار لدين الله تعالى
chapter.englishTitle: Indignation against the Transgression of Divine Laws

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Mas'ud 'Uqbah bin 'Amr Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "I join the morning Salat late because of so-and-so who leads it and prolongs it." (Abu Mas'ud said): I have never seen the Prophet ﷺ so angry while giving a speech as he was on that day. He ﷺ said, "Some of you create hatred among the people against faith. Whoever leads Salat (the prayer), should make it brief because the congregation includes old men and youngsters and those who have some urgent work to do."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Mas'ud 'Uqbah bin 'Amr Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "I join the morning Salat late because of so-and-so who leads it and prolongs it." (Abu Mas'ud said): I have never seen the Prophet ﷺ so angry while giving a speech as he was on that day. He ﷺ said, "Some of you create hatred among the people against faith. Whoever leads Salat (the prayer), should make it brief because the congregation includes old men and youngsters and those who have some urgent work to do."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى مسعود عقبة بن عمرو البدرى رضي الله عنه قال: جاء رجل إلى النبى ﷺ، فقال: إنى لأتأخر عن صلاة الصبح من أجل فلان مما يطيل بنا! فما رأيت النبى ﷺ غضب في موعظة قط أشد مما غضب يومئذ، فقال: “يا أيها الناس: إن منكم منفرين، فأيكم أم الناس فليوجز، فإن من ورائه الكبير والصغير وذا الحاجة” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 649

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الغضب إذا انتهكت حرمات الشرع والانتصار لدين الله تعالى
chapter.englishTitle: Indignation against the Transgression of Divine Laws

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned once from a journey, and saw a curtain which I had hung along a platform with some pictures on it. The colour of his face changed. He tore it up and said, "O 'Aishah, the most tormented people on the Day of Resurrection are those who contend with Allah in terms of creation."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned once from a journey, and saw a curtain which I had hung along a platform with some pictures on it. The colour of his face changed. He tore it up and said, "O 'Aishah, the most tormented people on the Day of Resurrection are those who contend with Allah in terms of creation."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قدم رسول الله ﷺ من سفر وقد سترت سهوة لى بقرام فيه تماثيل، فلما رآه رسول الله ﷺ هتكه وتلون وجهه وقال: “يا عائشة: أشد الناس عذابا عند الله يوم القيامة الذين يضاهون بخلق الله” ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 650

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الغضب إذا انتهكت حرمات الشرع والانتصار لدين الله تعالى
chapter.englishTitle: Indignation against the Transgression of Divine Laws

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Quraish were much worried about the case of a Makhzumiyah woman who had committed theft and wondered who should intercede for her with Messenger of Allah ﷺ (so that she would not get punished for her crime). Some said Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) was his beloved and so he may dare do so. So Usamah(May Allah be pleased with him) spoke to him about that matter and the Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Do you intercede when one of the legal punishments ordained by Allah has been voilated?" Then he got up and addressed the people saying, "The people before you were ruined because when a noble person amongst them committed theft, they would leave him, but if a weak person amongst them committed theft, they would execute the legal punishment on him. By Allah, were Fatimah, the daughter of Muhammad, to commit the theft, I would have cut off her hand."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Quraish were much worried about the case of a Makhzumiyah woman who had committed theft and wondered who should intercede for her with Messenger of Allah ﷺ (so that she would not get punished for her crime). Some said Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) was his beloved and so he may dare do so. So Usamah(May Allah be pleased with him) spoke to him about that matter and the Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Do you intercede when one of the legal punishments ordained by Allah has been voilated?" Then he got up and addressed the people saying, "The people before you were ruined because when a noble person amongst them committed theft, they would leave him, but if a weak person amongst them committed theft, they would execute the legal punishment on him. By Allah, were Fatimah, the daughter of Muhammad, to commit the theft, I would have cut off her hand."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها أن قريشاً أهمهم شأن المرأة المخزومية التى سرقت فقالوا: من يكلم فيها رسول الله ﷺ؟ فقالوا: من يجترئ عليه إلا أسامة بن زيد حب رسول الله ﷺ؟ فكلمة أسامة، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: “أتشفع في حد من حدود الله تعالى؟!” ثم قام فاختطب ثم قال: “إنما أهلك من قبلكم أنهم كانوا إذا سرق فيهم الشريف تركوه، وإذا سرق فيهم الضعيف أقاموا عليه الحد! وايم الله، لو أن فاطمة بنت محمد سرقت لقطعت يدها” ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 651

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الغضب إذا انتهكت حرمات الشرع والانتصار لدين الله تعالى
chapter.englishTitle: Indignation against the Transgression of Divine Laws

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ noticed spittle in the mosque in the direction of the Qiblah. The signs of disgust were perceived on his face. Then, he stood up and scraped it away with his own hand and said, "When you stand in Salat, you hold communion with your Rubb and He is between you and the Qiblah. Let no one therefore cast out his spittle in that direction, but only to his left or under his foot." Then he caught hold a corner of his sheet, spat into it and folded it up and said, "Or he should do like this."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ noticed spittle in the mosque in the direction of the Qiblah. The signs of disgust were perceived on his face. Then, he stood up and scraped it away with his own hand and said, "When you stand in Salat, you hold communion with your Rubb and He is between you and the Qiblah. Let no one therefore cast out his spittle in that direction, but only to his left or under his foot." Then he caught hold a corner of his sheet, spat into it and folded it up and said, "Or he should do like this."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن النبى ﷺ رأى نخامة في القبلة، فشق ذلك عليه حتى رؤى في وجهه، فقام فحكه بيده فقال: “إن أحدكم إذا قام في صلاته فإنه يناجى ربه، وإن ربه بينه وبين القبلة، فلا يبزقن أحدكم في القبلة، ولكن عن يساره، أو تحت قدمه” ثم أخذ طرف ردائه فبصق فيه، ثم رد بعضه على بعض فقال: “أو يفعل هكذا” ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 652

chapter.arabicTitle: باب أمر ولاة الأمور بالرفق برعاياهم ونصيحتهم والشفقة والنهى عن غشهم والتشديد عليهم وإهمال مصالحهم والغفلة عنهم وعن حوائجهم
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Rulers to show Kindness to their Subjects

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your wards. The ruler is a guardian and responsible for his subjects; the man is a guardian and responsible for his family; the woman is a guardian and is responsible for her husbands house and his offspring; and so all of you are guardians and are responsible for your wards."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your wards. The ruler is a guardian and responsible for his subjects; the man is a guardian and responsible for his family; the woman is a guardian and is responsible for her husbands house and his offspring; and so all of you are guardians and are responsible for your wards."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: “كلكم راع، وكلكم مسئول عن رعيته: الإمام راع ومسؤول عن رعيته، والرجل راع في أهله ومسؤول عن رعيته، والمرأة راعية في بيت زوجها ومسؤولة عن رعيتها، والخادم راع في مال سيده ومسؤول عن رعيته وكلكم راع ومسؤول عن رعيته” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 653

chapter.arabicTitle: باب أمر ولاة الأمور بالرفق برعاياهم ونصيحتهم والشفقة والنهى عن غشهم والتشديد عليهم وإهمال مصالحهم والغفلة عنهم وعن حوائجهم
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Rulers to show Kindness to their Subjects

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Ya'la Ma'qil bin Yasar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Any slave whom Allah makes him in charge of subjects and he dies while he is not sincere to them, Allah will make Jannah unlawful for him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

Another narration is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who does not look after his subjects with goodwill and sincerity, will be deprived of the fragrance of Jannah."

A narration in Muslim is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A ruler who, having control over the affairs of the Muslims, does not strive diligently for their betterment and does not serve them sincerely, will not enter Jannah with them."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Ya'la Ma'qil bin Yasar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Any slave whom Allah makes him in charge of subjects and he dies while he is not sincere to them, Allah will make Jannah unlawful for him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

Another narration is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who does not look after his subjects with goodwill and sincerity, will be deprived of the fragrance of Jannah."

A narration in Muslim is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A ruler who, having control over the affairs of the Muslims, does not strive diligently for their betterment and does not serve them sincerely, will not enter Jannah with them."
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى يعلى معقل بن يسار رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ: يقول: “ما من عبد يستر عليه الله رعية، يموت يوم يموت وهو غاش لرعيته، إلا حرم الله عليه الجنة” ((متفق عليه)) ((وفي رواية: "فلم يحطها بنصحه لم يجد رائحة الجنة"))وفي رواية لمسلم: "ما من أمير يلى أمور المسلمين، ثم لا يجهد لهم وينصح لهم، إلا لم يدخل معهم الجنة".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 654

chapter.arabicTitle: باب أمر ولاة الأمور بالرفق برعاياهم ونصيحتهم والشفقة والنهى عن غشهم والتشديد عليهم وإهمال مصالحهم والغفلة عنهم وعن حوائجهم
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Rulers to show Kindness to their Subjects

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 I heard the the Messenger of Allah ﷺ supplicating in my house: "O Allah! Treat harshly those who rule over my Ummah with harshness, and treat gently those who rule over my Ummah with gentleness."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the the Messenger of Allah ﷺ supplicating in my house: "O Allah! Treat harshly those who rule over my Ummah with harshness, and treat gently those who rule over my Ummah with gentleness."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول في بيتى هذا: “اللهم من ولى من أمر أمتى شيئاً فشق عليهم، فاشقق عليه ومن ولى  من أمر أمتى شيئاً، فرفق بهم، فارفق به” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 655

chapter.arabicTitle: باب أمر ولاة الأمور بالرفق برعاياهم ونصيحتهم والشفقة والنهى عن غشهم والتشديد عليهم وإهمال مصالحهم والغفلة عنهم وعن حوائجهم
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Rulers to show Kindness to their Subjects

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The Banu Isra'il were ruled by the Prophets. When one Prophet died, another succeeded him. There will be no Prophet after me. Caliphs will come after me, and they will be many." The Companions said: "O Messenger of Allah, what do you command us to do?" He said, "Fulfill the pledge of allegiance to which is sworn first (then swear allegiance to the others). Concede to them their due rights and ask Allah that which is due to you. Allah will call them to account in respect of the subjects whom He had entrusted to them."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The Banu Isra'il were ruled by the Prophets. When one Prophet died, another succeeded him. There will be no Prophet after me. Caliphs will come after me, and they will be many." The Companions said: "O Messenger of Allah, what do you command us to do?" He said, "Fulfill the pledge of allegiance to which is sworn first (then swear allegiance to the others). Concede to them their due rights and ask Allah that which is due to you. Allah will call them to account in respect of the subjects whom He had entrusted to them."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "كانت بنو إسرائيل تسوسهم الأنبياء، كلما هلك نبى خلفه نبى، وإنه لا نبى بعدى وسيكون بعدى خلفاء فيكثرون” قالوا: يا رسول الله فما تأمرنا؟ قال: "أوفوا ببيعة الأول فالأول، ثم أعطوهم حقهم، واسألوا الله الذى لكم ، فإن الله سائلهم عما استرعاهم” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 656

chapter.arabicTitle: باب أمر ولاة الأمور بالرفق برعاياهم ونصيحتهم والشفقة والنهى عن غشهم والتشديد عليهم وإهمال مصالحهم والغفلة عنهم وعن حوائجهم
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Rulers to show Kindness to their Subjects

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aidh bin 'Amr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I visited 'Ubaidullah bin Ziyad and said to him: "Dear son, I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'The worst of rulers are those who treat their subjects harshly. Beware, lest you should be one of them."'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aidh bin 'Amr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I visited 'Ubaidullah bin Ziyad and said to him: "Dear son, I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'The worst of rulers are those who treat their subjects harshly. Beware, lest you should be one of them."'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائذ بن عمرو رضي الله عنه أنه دخل على عبيد الله بن زياد، فقال له: أى بنى، إنى سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: “إن شر الرعاء الحطمة” فإياك  أن تكون منهم. ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 657

chapter.arabicTitle: باب أمر ولاة الأمور بالرفق برعاياهم ونصيحتهم والشفقة والنهى عن غشهم والتشديد عليهم وإهمال مصالحهم والغفلة عنهم وعن حوائجهم
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Rulers to show Kindness to their Subjects

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Maryam Al-Azdi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I said to Mu'awiyah (bin Abu Sufyan) (May Allah be pleased with them): I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "If Allah invests to someone the affairs of the Muslims and he (i.e., the ruler) ignores their rights, denies their access to him and neglects their needs, Allah will not answer his prayer or realize his hopes and will act towards him with indifference on the Day of Resurrection." So Mu'awiyah appointed a person to keep a vigil on the necessities of the people and to fulfill them.

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Maryam Al-Azdi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I said to Mu'awiyah (bin Abu Sufyan) (May Allah be pleased with them): I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "If Allah invests to someone the affairs of the Muslims and he (i.e., the ruler) ignores their rights, denies their access to him and neglects their needs, Allah will not answer his prayer or realize his hopes and will act towards him with indifference on the Day of Resurrection." So Mu'awiyah appointed a person to keep a vigil on the necessities of the people and to fulfill them.

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى مريم الأزدى رضي الله عنه أنه قال لمعاوية رضي الله عنه سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: “من ولاه الله شيئاً من أمور المسلمين، فاحتجب دون حاجتهم وخلتهم وفقرهم، احتجب الله دون حاجته وخلته وفقره يوم القيامة” فجعل معاوية رجلا على حوائج الناس. ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 658

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الوالى العادل
chapter.englishTitle: The Just Ruler

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Seven are (the persons) whom Allah will give protection with His Shade* on the Day when there will be no shade except His Shade (i.e., on the Day of Resurrection), and they are: A just ruler; a youth who grew up with the worship of Allah; a person whose heart is attached to the mosque; two persons who love and meet each other and depart from each other for the sake of Allah; a man whom a beautiful and high ranking woman seduces (for illicit relation), but he (rejects this offer by saying): 'I fear Allah'; a person who gives a charity and conceals it (to such an extent) that the left hand might not know what the right has given; and a person who remembers Allah in solitude and his eyes well up."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

* The Shade of Allah to which this Hadith refers to is the shade of His Throne.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
