hadiths.arabic: عن أنس رضى الله عنه قال: حضرت الصلاة، فقام من كان قريب الدار إلى أهله، وبقى قوم فأتى رسول الله ﷺ بمخضب من حجارة، فصغر المخضب أن يبسط فيه كفه، فتوضأ القوم كلهم. قالوا: كم كنتم؟ قال: ثمانين وزيادة.  . وفى : أن النبي ﷺ دعا بإناء من ماء، فأتى بقدح رحراح فيه شئ من ماء، فوضع أصابعه فيه. قال أنس : فجعلت أنظر إلى الماء ينبع من بين أصابعه ‎، فحزرت من توضأ ما بين السبعين إلى الثمانين. وفى : أن النبي ﷺ دعا بإناء من ماء، فأتى بقدح رحراح فيه شئ من ماء، فوضع أصابعه فيه. قال أنس : فجعلت أنظر إلى الماء ينبع من بين أصابعه ‎، فحزرت من توضأ ما بين السبعين إلى الثمانين.
references: Book of Etiquette of Eating, Hadith 773

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 774

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الشرب من جميع الأواني الطاهرة غير الذهب والفضة وجواز الكرع - وهو الشرب بالفم من النهر وغيره- بغير إناء ولا يد وتحريم استعمال إناء الذهب والفضة في الشرب والأكل والطهارة وسائر وجوه الاستعمال
chapter.englishTitle: Permissibility of Drinking Water from all Types of Clean Vessels Except Those of Gold and Silver

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ visited us and we brought water for him in a brass vessel for his ablution and he performed ablution.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ visited us and we brought water for him in a brass vessel for his ablution and he performed ablution.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن زيد رضى الله عنه قال: أتانا النبي ﷺ، فأخرجنا له ماء في نور من صفر فتوضأ.
references: Book of Etiquette of Eating, Hadith 774

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 775

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الشرب من جميع الأواني الطاهرة غير الذهب والفضة وجواز الكرع - وهو الشرب بالفم من النهر وغيره- بغير إناء ولا يد وتحريم استعمال إناء الذهب والفضة في الشرب والأكل والطهارة وسائر وجوه الاستعمال
chapter.englishTitle: Permissibility of Drinking Water from all Types of Clean Vessels Except Those of Gold and Silver

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited the house of a man of the Ansar with one of his Companions and said to him, "If you have some water in the water-skin left over from last night, give it to us for drinking; otherwise, we shall drink from some stream directly."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited the house of a man of the Ansar with one of his Companions and said to him, "If you have some water in the water-skin left over from last night, give it to us for drinking; otherwise, we shall drink from some stream directly."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ دخل على رجل من الأنصار، ومعه صاحب له، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: "إن كان عندك ماء بات هذه الليلة في سنة وإلا كرعنا" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Eating, Hadith 775

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 776

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الشرب من جميع الأواني الطاهرة غير الذهب والفضة وجواز الكرع - وهو الشرب بالفم من النهر وغيره- بغير إناء ولا يد وتحريم استعمال إناء الذهب والفضة في الشرب والأكل والطهارة وسائر وجوه الاستعمال
chapter.englishTitle: Permissibility of Drinking Water from all Types of Clean Vessels Except Those of Gold and Silver

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ prohibited us from wearing brocade or silk and drinking out of gold or silver vessels and said, "These are meant for them (disbelievers) in this world and for you in the Hereafter."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ prohibited us from wearing brocade or silk and drinking out of gold or silver vessels and said, "These are meant for them (disbelievers) in this world and for you in the Hereafter."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن حذيفة رضى الله عنه قال: إن النبي ﷺ نهانا عن الحرير والديباج والشرب في آنية الذهب والفضة، وقال: "هي لهم في الدنيا، وهى لكم في الآخرة"  .
references: Book of Etiquette of Eating, Hadith 776

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 777

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الشرب من جميع الأواني الطاهرة غير الذهب والفضة وجواز الكرع - وهو الشرب بالفم من النهر وغيره- بغير إناء ولا يد وتحريم استعمال إناء الذهب والفضة في الشرب والأكل والطهارة وسائر وجوه الاستعمال
chapter.englishTitle: Permissibility of Drinking Water from all Types of Clean Vessels Except Those of Gold and Silver

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who drinks from the vessel of silver kindles the Fire (of Hell) in his belly."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

A narration in Muslim is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Surely, he who eats or drinks in gold and silver vessels fills his belly with Hell-fire."
hadiths.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who drinks from the vessel of silver kindles the Fire (of Hell) in his belly."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

A narration in Muslim is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Surely, he who eats or drinks in gold and silver vessels fills his belly with Hell-fire."
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم سلمة رضى الله عنها أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "الذي يشرب في آنية الفضة إنما يجرجر في بطنه نار جهنم"  . وفى : "إن الذي يأكل أو يشرب في آنية الفضة والذهب"  وفى رواية له: " من شرب في إناءٍ من ذهب أو فضة فإنما يجرجر في بطنه ناراً من جهنم.
references: Book of Etiquette of Eating, Hadith 777

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 778

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Put on white clothes because they are the best; and use them for shrouding your dead."

[At- Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Put on white clothes because they are the best; and use them for shrouding your dead."

[At- Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضى الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: إلبسوا من ثيابكم البياض؛ فإنها من خير ثيابكم، وكفنوا فيها موتاكم" .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 779

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Wear white clothes because they are the purest and they are closest to modesty; and shroud the dead in it."

[An- Nasa'i and Al-Hakim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Wear white clothes because they are the purest and they are closest to modesty; and shroud the dead in it."

[An- Nasa'i and Al-Hakim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سمرة رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ :"إلبسوا البياض؛ فإنها أطهر وأطيب، وكفنوا فيها موتاكم" .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 780

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ was of medium stature. I saw him wearing a red mantle. I have never seen anything more graceful than that.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ was of medium stature. I saw him wearing a red mantle. I have never seen anything more graceful than that.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن البراء رضى الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ مربوعاً ولقد رأيته في حلةٍ حمراء ما رأيت شيئاً قط أحسن منه .  .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 781

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I saw the Prophet ﷺ by Al-Abtah valley in Makkah, in a red tent made from tanned skin. Bilal brought him ablution water. Then Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out wearing a red mantle; and I can still remember looking at whiteness of his shanks. So he made his ablution, and Bilal ﷺ pronounced the call for prayer (Adhan). I kept following the movement of his (Bilal's) face to the right and to the left when he recited: 'Come to the prayer; come to the success.' Then a spear was fixed (as a Sutrah) in front of Messenger of Allah ﷺ who then stepped forward and led the prayer. Dogs and donkeys passed in front of him (beyond the spear) and no one prevented them from doing so.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Juhaifah Wahb bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw the Prophet ﷺ by Al-Abtah valley in Makkah, in a red tent made from tanned skin. Bilal brought him ablution water. Then Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out wearing a red mantle; and I can still remember looking at whiteness of his shanks. So he made his ablution, and Bilal ﷺ pronounced the call for prayer (Adhan). I kept following the movement of his (Bilal's) face to the right and to the left when he recited: 'Come to the prayer; come to the success.' Then a spear was fixed (as a Sutrah) in front of Messenger of Allah ﷺ who then stepped forward and led the prayer. Dogs and donkeys passed in front of him (beyond the spear) and no one prevented them from doing so.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى جحيفة وهب بن عبد الله رضى الله عنه قال: رأيت النبي ﷺ بمكة وهو بالأبطح في قبة له حمراء من آدم، فخرج بلال بوضوئه، فمن ناضح ونائل، فخرج النبي ﷺ وعليه حلة حمراء، كأني أنظر إلى بياض ساقيه، فتوضأ وأذن بلال، فجعلت أتتبع فاه ههنا وههنا، يقول يمينا وشمالاً: حي على الصلاة، حي على الفلاح، ثم ركزت له عنزة، فتقدم فصلى يمر بين يديه الكلب والحمار لا يمنع. .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 782

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Rimthah Rifa'ah At-Taimi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ wearing two green garments.

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Rimthah Rifa'ah At-Taimi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ wearing two green garments.

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى رمثة رفاعة التيمى رضى الله عنه قال: رأيت رسول الله ﷺ وعليه ثوبان أخضران. .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 783

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah on the day of its conquest and he was wearing a black turban.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah on the day of its conquest and he was wearing a black turban.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضى الله عنه ، أن رسول الله ﷺ دخل يم فتح مكة وعليه عمامة سوداء. .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 784

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id 'Amr bin Huraith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 As if I am seeing Messenger of Allah ﷺ wearing a black turban and both ends of it are falling over his shoulders.

[Muslim]
.

Another narration is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ was delivering a Khutbah wearing a black turban.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id 'Amr bin Huraith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
As if I am seeing Messenger of Allah ﷺ wearing a black turban and both ends of it are falling over his shoulders.

[Muslim]
.

Another narration is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ was delivering a Khutbah wearing a black turban.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى سعيد عمرو بن حريث رضى الله عنه قال: كأني انظر إلى رسول الله ﷺ وعليه عمامة سوداء، قد أرخى طرفيها بين كتفيه. . وفى رواية له : أن رسول الله ﷺ خطب الناس، وعليه عمامة سوداء. وفى رواية له : أن رسول الله ﷺ خطب الناس، وعليه عمامة سوداء.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 785

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The body of Messenger of Allah ﷺ was shrouded in three white Yemeni cotton garments, among which was neither a gown nor a turban.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The body of Messenger of Allah ﷺ was shrouded in three white Yemeni cotton garments, among which was neither a gown nor a turban.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضى الله عنها قالت: كفن رسول الله ﷺ في ثلاثة أثواب بيض سحولية من كرسف، ليس فيها قميص ولا عمامة.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 786

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 One morning Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out wearing a black blanket made of camel's or sheep's black hair with patterns of camels' bags upon it.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
One morning Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out wearing a black blanket made of camel's or sheep's black hair with patterns of camels' bags upon it.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: - وعنها قالت: خرج رسول الله ﷺ ذات غداة، وعليه مرط مرحل من شعر أسود. .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 787

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الثوب الأبيض وجواز الأحمر والأخضر والأصفر والأسود وجوازه من قطن وكتان وشعر وصوف وغيرها إلا الحرير
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Wearing White Clothes and the Permissibility of Wearing Red, Green, Yellow and Black Clothes Made from Cotton and Linen but not Silk

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I was with Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a journey one night, and he asked me, "Do you have any water with you?" I said, "Yes." So he dismounted from his riding camel and walked away (to answer the call of nature) until he disappeared in the darkness. When he returned, I poured out some water from a vessel and he washed his face. He was wearing a long woollen cloak and could not take out his forearms from his sleeves, so he brought them out from below the cloak and then washed them, and then passed his (wet) hands over his head. I stretched out my hand to take off his Khuff (leather socks), but he said, "Leave them. I put them on after performing Wudu'," and he passed his (wet) hands over them.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

Another narration is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ was wearing a Syrian cloak with tight sleeves.

Another narration is: This incident took place during the battle of Tabuk.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I was with Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a journey one night, and he asked me, "Do you have any water with you?" I said, "Yes." So he dismounted from his riding camel and walked away (to answer the call of nature) until he disappeared in the darkness. When he returned, I poured out some water from a vessel and he washed his face. He was wearing a long woollen cloak and could not take out his forearms from his sleeves, so he brought them out from below the cloak and then washed them, and then passed his (wet) hands over his head. I stretched out my hand to take off his Khuff (leather socks), but he said, "Leave them. I put them on after performing Wudu'," and he passed his (wet) hands over them.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

Another narration is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ was wearing a Syrian cloak with tight sleeves.

Another narration is: This incident took place during the battle of Tabuk.
hadiths.arabic: وعن المغيرة بن شعبة رضى الله عنه قال: كنت مع رسول الله  ﷺ ذات ليلة في مسير، فقال لي: "أمعك ماء" ؟ قلت: نعم، فنزل عن راحلته فمشى حتى توارى في سواد الليل ثم جاء فأفرغت علي من الإداواة، فغسل وجهه وعليه جبة من صوف،فلم يستطع أن يخرج ذراعيه منها حتى أخرجهما من أسفل الجبة، فغسل ذراعيه ومسح برأسه، ثم أهويت لأنزع خفيه فقال:"دعهما فإني أدخلتهما طاهرتين" ومسح عليهما.  . وفى رواية:وعليه جبة شامية ضيقة الكمين. وفى رواية: أن هذه القضية كانت في غزوة تبوك. وفى رواية:وعليه جبة شامية ضيقة الكمين. وفى رواية: أن هذه القضية كانت في غزوة تبوك.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 788

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب القميص
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of the Qamees

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 Out of all garments Messenger of Allah ﷺ liked Qamees the best.

[At-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
Out of all garments Messenger of Allah ﷺ liked Qamees the best.

[At-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أم سلمة رضى الله عنها قالت: كان أحب الثياب إلى رسول الله ﷺ القميص. .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 789

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Asma' bint Yazid (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Qamees sleeves of Messenger of Allah ﷺ reached down to his wrists.

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Asma' bint Yazid (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Qamees sleeves of Messenger of Allah ﷺ reached down to his wrists.

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أسماء بنت يزيد الأنصارية رضى الله عنها قالت: كان كم قميص رسول الله ﷺ إلى الرسغ ، .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 790

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever allows his lower garment to drag out of vanity will find that Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection." On this Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) submitted: "O Messenger of Allah! My lower garment keeps sliding down though I take care to pull it and wrap it." Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You are not of those who do it out of vanity."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever allows his lower garment to drag out of vanity will find that Allah will not look at him on the Day of Resurrection." On this Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) submitted: "O Messenger of Allah! My lower garment keeps sliding down though I take care to pull it and wrap it." Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You are not of those who do it out of vanity."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما أن النبي ﷺ قال: "من جر ثوبه خيلاء لم ينظر الله إليه يوم القيامة" فقال أبو بكر: يا رسول الله إن إزاري يسترخي إلى أن أتعاهده، فقال له رسول الله ﷺ: "إنك لست ممن يفعله خيلاء".	.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 791

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at him who trails his lower garment out of pride."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at him who trails his lower garment out of pride."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "لا ينظر الله يوم القيامة إلى من جر إزاره بطراً"  .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 792

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "What is below the ankles of a lower garment is condemned to the Fire (Hell)."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "What is below the ankles of a lower garment is condemned to the Fire (Hell)."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "ما أسفل من الكعبين من الإزار ففي النار" .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 793

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "There are three to whom Allah will neither speak on the Day of Resurrection nor will look at them nor purify them (i.e., of their sins), and they will be severely tormented." When he repeated this (statement) thrice, Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "They are doomed and destroyed! (But) who are they, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said, "One whose lower garment trails, one who boasts of kindness shown to another; and one who promotes sale of his business by taking false oaths."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "There are three to whom Allah will neither speak on the Day of Resurrection nor will look at them nor purify them (i.e., of their sins), and they will be severely tormented." When he repeated this (statement) thrice, Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "They are doomed and destroyed! (But) who are they, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said, "One whose lower garment trails, one who boasts of kindness shown to another; and one who promotes sale of his business by taking false oaths."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى ذر رضى الله عنه عن النبي  ﷺ قال: "ثلاثة لا يكلمهم الله يوم القيامة، ولا ينظر إليهم ، ولا يزكيهم، ولهم عذاب أليم" قال: فقرأها رسول الله ﷺ ثلاث مرار. قال أبو ذر : خابوا وخسروا ‍ من هم يا رسول  الله ؟ قال: "المسبل، والمنان، والمنفق سلعته بالحلف الكاذب" . وفى رواية له: "المسبل إزاره"

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 794

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at one who trails his lower garment, Qamees or turban arrogantly."

[Abu Dawud and An- Nasa'i]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at one who trails his lower garment, Qamees or turban arrogantly."

[Abu Dawud and An- Nasa'i]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما ، عن النبي ﷺ قال: "الإسبال من الإزار، والقميص، والعمامة؛ من جر شيئاً خيلاء لم ينظر الله إليه يوم القيامة" .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 795

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Juraiy Jabir bin Sulaim (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I noticed a man whose opinion was followed by every body, and no one acted contrary to what he said. I asked who he was, and I was informed that he was Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I said to him twice: "Alaikas- salam ya Rasul-Allah (may Allah render you safe)." He said, "Do not say: 'Alaikas-salamu.' This is the salutation to the dead (in Jahiliyyah times). Say, instead: 'As-salamu 'alaika (may Allah render you safe)."' I asked: "Are you Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "(Yes) I am the Messenger of Allah, Who will remove your affliction when you are in trouble and call to Him, Who will cause food to grow for you when you are famine-stricken and call to Him, and Who will restore to you your lost riding beast in the desert when you call upon Him." I said to him: "Give me instructions (to act upon)." He (ﷺ said, "Do not abuse anyone." (Since then I have never abused anyone, neither a freeman, nor a slave, nor a camel, nor a sheep). He ﷺ continued, "Do not hold in contempt even an insignificant act of goodness, because even talking to your brother with a cheerful countenance is an act of goodness. Hold up your lower garment half way to the leg, and at least above the ankles; for trailing it is arrogance, and Allah dislikes pride. And if a man imputes to you of bad things he knows you possess, do not impute to him bad things that you know he has for he will assume the evil consequences of his abuse."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Juraiy Jabir bin Sulaim (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I noticed a man whose opinion was followed by every body, and no one acted contrary to what he said. I asked who he was, and I was informed that he was Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I said to him twice: "Alaikas- salam ya Rasul-Allah (may Allah render you safe)." He said, "Do not say: 'Alaikas-salamu.' This is the salutation to the dead (in Jahiliyyah times). Say, instead: 'As-salamu 'alaika (may Allah render you safe)."' I asked: "Are you Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "(Yes) I am the Messenger of Allah, Who will remove your affliction when you are in trouble and call to Him, Who will cause food to grow for you when you are famine-stricken and call to Him, and Who will restore to you your lost riding beast in the desert when you call upon Him." I said to him: "Give me instructions (to act upon)." He (ﷺ said, "Do not abuse anyone." (Since then I have never abused anyone, neither a freeman, nor a slave, nor a camel, nor a sheep). He ﷺ continued, "Do not hold in contempt even an insignificant act of goodness, because even talking to your brother with a cheerful countenance is an act of goodness. Hold up your lower garment half way to the leg, and at least above the ankles; for trailing it is arrogance, and Allah dislikes pride. And if a man imputes to you of bad things he knows you possess, do not impute to him bad things that you know he has for he will assume the evil consequences of his abuse."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى جرى جابر بن سليم رضى الله عنه قال: رأيت رجلا يصدر الناس عن رأيه ؛ لا يقول شيئاً إلا صدروا عنه؛ قلت: من هذا قالوا: رسول الله ﷺ.قلت: عليك السلام يا رسول الله - مرتين- قال: "لا تقل عليك السلام، عليك السلام تحية الموتى -قلت : السلام عليك" قال: قلت: أنت رسول الله ؟ قال: "أنا رسول الله إذا أصابك ضر فدعوته كشفه عنك،وإذا أصابك عام سنة فدعوته أنبتها لك، وإذا كنت بأرض قفر أو فلاة، فضلت راحلتك، فدعوته ردها عليك" قال: قلت: اعهد إلى. قال: "لا تسبن أحداً" قال: فما سببت بعده حراً، ولا عبداً، ولا بعيراً، ولا شاة "ولا تحقرن من المعروف شيئاً، وأن تكلم أخاك وأنت منبسط إليه وجهك؛ إن ذلك من المعروف. وارفع إزارك إلى نصف الساق، فإن أبيت فإلى الكعبين، وإياك وإسبال الإزار فإنها من المخيلة وإن الله لا يحب المخيلة، وإن امرؤا شتمك وعيرك، بما يعلم فيك فلا تعيره بما تعلم فيه، فإنما وبال ذلك عليه" .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 796

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a man who was performing Salat while his lower garment was trailing, "Go and perform your Wudu' again." That man went and came back having performed it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said (again), "Go and perform your Wudu'." Someone present said to Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "O Messenger of Allah! You ask him to perform his Wudu' and then you kept silent (without saying the reason for it)." He ﷺ said, "He performed Salat while his lower garment was below his ankels. Allah does not accept the Salat of a man who trails his lower garment."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a man who was performing Salat while his lower garment was trailing, "Go and perform your Wudu' again." That man went and came back having performed it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said (again), "Go and perform your Wudu'." Someone present said to Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "O Messenger of Allah! You ask him to perform his Wudu' and then you kept silent (without saying the reason for it)." He ﷺ said, "He performed Salat while his lower garment was below his ankels. Allah does not accept the Salat of a man who trails his lower garment."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه قال: بينما رجل يصلى مسبل إزاره، قال له رسول الله ﷺ: "اذهب فتوضأ" فذهب فتوضأ، ثم جاء فقال :" اذهب فتوضأ" فقال رجل يا رسول الله ما لك أمرته أن يتوضأ ثم سكت عنه؟ قال: "إنه كان يصلى وهو مسبل إزاره، وإن الله لا يقبل صلاة رجل مسبل".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 797

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Qais bin Bishr At-Taghlibi reported that his father, who attended the company of 'Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) told him:
 There was a man in Damascus who was a Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He was called Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah. He was a lonesome person and would rarely spend some time in the company of people. He would spend most of his time in performing Salat and when he finished, he would engage himself in Tasbih (Subhan-Allah) and Takbir (Allahu Akbar), till he would go home. He passed by us one day when we were sitting with Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him). The latter said to him: "Tell us something which will benefit for us and will not harm you." He said: "Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a detachment. When they returned, one of them came to the assemblage in which Messenger of Allah ﷺ was present and said to his neighbour during the conversation: 'I wish you had seen us when we encountered the enemy. So-and-so (a believer) took up his spear, struck and said: Take this from me and I am the Ghifari boy. Now what do you think of this?' The neighbour said: 'I think that he lost his reward because of boasting.' He said: 'I see no harm in it.' They began to exchange arguments till Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard them and said, 'Subhan-Allah (Allah is free from every imperfection). He would be rewarded (in the Hereafter) and praised (in this world)'. I noticed that Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) felt a great pleasure at this remark and, raising his head began to repeat: "Have you heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ say this!" Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah (May Allah be pleased with him) continued responding till I asked Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) not to annoy him.

Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah (May Allah be pleased with him) happened to pass by us another day and Abud-Darda' said to him: "Tell us something which will benefit us and will not harm you." He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ told us, 'He who spends to purchase a horse (for Jihad) is like one who extends his hand for spending out of charity without withholding it."'

He passed by us another day and Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) said to him: "Tell us something which might benefit us, and will not harm you." He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ once said, 'Khuraim Al-Usaidi is an excellent man were it not of his long hair and his lower garment which is hanging down.' When Khuraim heard about what the Prophet had said about him, he trimmed his long hair up to his ears with a knife and raised his lower garment half way on his shanks."

On another occasion he passed by us and Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) said to him: "Tell us something that will benefit us and will not harm you." He said that he heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, while coming back from an expedition: "You are returning to your brothers, so set your saddles and clothes in order so that you look tidy and graceful. Allah hates untidiness."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Qais bin Bishr At-Taghlibi reported that his father, who attended the company of 'Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) told him:
hadiths.body:
There was a man in Damascus who was a Companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He was called Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah. He was a lonesome person and would rarely spend some time in the company of people. He would spend most of his time in performing Salat and when he finished, he would engage himself in Tasbih (Subhan-Allah) and Takbir (Allahu Akbar), till he would go home. He passed by us one day when we were sitting with Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him). The latter said to him: "Tell us something which will benefit for us and will not harm you." He said: "Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a detachment. When they returned, one of them came to the assemblage in which Messenger of Allah ﷺ was present and said to his neighbour during the conversation: 'I wish you had seen us when we encountered the enemy. So-and-so (a believer) took up his spear, struck and said: Take this from me and I am the Ghifari boy. Now what do you think of this?' The neighbour said: 'I think that he lost his reward because of boasting.' He said: 'I see no harm in it.' They began to exchange arguments till Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard them and said, 'Subhan-Allah (Allah is free from every imperfection). He would be rewarded (in the Hereafter) and praised (in this world)'. I noticed that Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) felt a great pleasure at this remark and, raising his head began to repeat: "Have you heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ say this!" Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah (May Allah be pleased with him) continued responding till I asked Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) not to annoy him.

Ibn Al-Hanzaliyyah (May Allah be pleased with him) happened to pass by us another day and Abud-Darda' said to him: "Tell us something which will benefit us and will not harm you." He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ told us, 'He who spends to purchase a horse (for Jihad) is like one who extends his hand for spending out of charity without withholding it."'

He passed by us another day and Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) said to him: "Tell us something which might benefit us, and will not harm you." He said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ once said, 'Khuraim Al-Usaidi is an excellent man were it not of his long hair and his lower garment which is hanging down.' When Khuraim heard about what the Prophet had said about him, he trimmed his long hair up to his ears with a knife and raised his lower garment half way on his shanks."

On another occasion he passed by us and Abud-Darda' (May Allah be pleased with him) said to him: "Tell us something that will benefit us and will not harm you." He said that he heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, while coming back from an expedition: "You are returning to your brothers, so set your saddles and clothes in order so that you look tidy and graceful. Allah hates untidiness."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن قيس بن بشر التغلبى قال: أخبرني أبى - وكان جليساً لأبى الدرداء-قال: كان بدمشق رجل من أصحاب النبي ﷺ يقال له سهل بن الحنظلية، وكان رجلاً متوحداً قلما يجالس الناس، إنما هو في صلاة ، فإذا فرغ فإنما هو تسبيح وتكبير حتى يأتى أهله، فمر بنا ونحن عند أبى الدرداء فقال أبو الدرداء: كلمةً تنفعنا ولا تضرك. قال: بعث رسول الله ﷺ سرية فقدمت ، فجاء رجل منهم فجلس في المجلس الذي يجلس فيه رسول الله ﷺ ، فقال لرجل إلى جنبه: لو رأيتنا حين التقينا نحن والعدو،فحمل فلان وطعن، فقال: خذها منى،وأنا الغلام الغفارى، كيف ترى في قوله؟ قال: ما أراه إلا قد بطل أجره. فسمع بذلك آخر فقال: ما أرى بذلك بأساً ، فتنازعا حتى سمع رسول الله ﷺ فقال: "سبحان الله؟لا بأس أن يؤجر ويحمد" فرأيت أبا الدرداء سر بذلك، وجعل يرفع رأسه إليه ويقول: أنت سمعت ذلك من رسول الله ﷺ ‍‍‍‍‍‍؟ فيقول: نعم. فما زال يعيد عليه حتى إني لأقول ليبركن على ركبتيه. قال: فمر بنا يوماً آخر، فقال له الدرداء: كلمة تنفعنا ولا تضرك، قال: قال لنا رسول الله ﷺ: "المنفق على الخير كالباسط يده بالصدقة ولا يقبضها".ثم مر بنا يوماً آخر، فقال له أبو الدرداء: كلمة تنفعنا ولا تضرك، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: :"نعم الرجل خريم الأسدى ‍! لولا طول جمته وإسبال إزاره !: فبلغ خريما، فجعل، فأخذ شفرة فقطع بها جمته إلى أذنيه ، ورفع إزاره إلى أنصاف ساقية. ثم مر بنا يوماً آخر فقال له أبو الدرداء: كلمةً تنفعنا ولا تضرك، قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "إنكم قادمون على إخوانكم، فأصلحوا رحالكم، وأصلحوا لباسكم حتى تكونوا كأنكم شامة في الناس، فإن الله لا يحب الفحش ولا التفحش".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 798

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The lower garment of a believer should be half way below the knees. He is guilty of no sin if they are up to the ankles. That which is below the ankles is in the Fire (of Hell). Allah will not look at one who allows his lower garment to trail out of vanity.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The lower garment of a believer should be half way below the knees. He is guilty of no sin if they are up to the ankles. That which is below the ankles is in the Fire (of Hell). Allah will not look at one who allows his lower garment to trail out of vanity.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى سعيد الخدرى رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "إزارة المسلم إلى نصف الساق، ولا حرج -أو لا جناح- فيما بينه وبين الكعبين، فما كان أسفل من الكعبين فهو في النار، ومن جر إزاره بطرا لم ينظر الله إليه". .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 799

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 My lower garment was trailing as I passed by Messenger of Allah ﷺ so he said, "Raise your lower garment, Abdullah." I lifted it up and he told me to raise it higher. I complied with his orders and as I was still trying to find the best place (for it), one of the people asked where it should reach and he ﷺ replied, "Half way down the knees."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
My lower garment was trailing as I passed by Messenger of Allah ﷺ so he said, "Raise your lower garment, Abdullah." I lifted it up and he told me to raise it higher. I complied with his orders and as I was still trying to find the best place (for it), one of the people asked where it should reach and he ﷺ replied, "Half way down the knees."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما قال: مررت على رسول الله ﷺ وفى إزاري استرخاء، فقال: "يا عبد الله، ارفع إزارك" فرفعت ثم قال: "زد"، فزدت، فما زلت أتحراها بعد. فقال بعض القوم: إلى أين ؟ فقال: إلى أنصاف الساقين". .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 800

chapter.arabicTitle: باب صفة طول القميص والكم والإزار وطرف العمامة وتحريم إسبال شئ من ذلك على سبيل الخيلاء وكراهته من غير خيلاء
chapter.englishTitle: The Description of the Length of the Qamees' Sleeves, the End of the Turban, and Prohibition of Wearing Long Garments Out of Pride and Undesirability of Wearing Them Without Pride

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at the one who trails his lower garment out of arrogance." Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) asked: "What should women do with the hem of their clothes?" He ﷺ said, "They might lower them a hand's span." She said: "But their feet would still remain exposed." He said, "Let them lower those equal to arm's length but not more than that."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will not look at the one who trails his lower garment out of arrogance." Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) asked: "What should women do with the hem of their clothes?" He ﷺ said, "They might lower them a hand's span." She said: "But their feet would still remain exposed." He said, "Let them lower those equal to arm's length but not more than that."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: من جر ثوبه خيلاء لم ينظر الله إليه يوم القيامة" فقالت أم سلمة: فكيف تصنع النساء بذيولهن، قال: "يرخين شبراً" قالت: ِإذاً تنكشف أقدامهن. قال: "فيرخينه ذراعاً لا يزدن". .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 801

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب ترك الترفع في اللباس تواضعاً
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Giving Up Elegant Clothes Out of Humility

hadiths.englishRaw:
Mu`adh bin Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever gives up wearing elegant and expensive garments out of humbleness, when he can do so, Allah will call him on the Day of Resurrection and before all the creations, He will give him the choice to wear whichever garment of Iman he would like to wear."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Mu`adh bin Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever gives up wearing elegant and expensive garments out of humbleness, when he can do so, Allah will call him on the Day of Resurrection and before all the creations, He will give him the choice to wear whichever garment of Iman he would like to wear."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن معاذ بن أنس رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: " من ترك اللباس تواضعاً لله، وهو يقدر عليه، دعاه الله يوم القيامة على رؤوس الخلائق حتى يخيره من أي حلل الإيمان شاء يلبسها" .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 802

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب التوسط في اللباس ولا يقتصر على ما يزري به لغير حاجة ولا مقصود شرعي
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Adopting Moderation in Dress

hadiths.englishRaw:
`Amr bin Shu`aib on the authority of his father and grandfather reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah loves to see the sign of His Bounties on his slave."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: `Amr bin Shu`aib on the authority of his father and grandfather reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah loves to see the sign of His Bounties on his slave."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عمرو بن شعيب عن أبيه عن جده رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "إن الله يحب أن يرى أثر نعمته على عبده" .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 803

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم لباس الحرير على الرجال وتحريم جلوسهم عليه واستنادهم إليه وجواز لبسه للنساء
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Wearing Silk for Men and its Permissibility for Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
`Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not wear silk (clothes). For whoever wears (them) in this life will be deprived of them in the Hereafter."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: `Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not wear silk (clothes). For whoever wears (them) in this life will be deprived of them in the Hereafter."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عمر بن الخطاب رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : " لا تلبسوا الحرير؛ فإن من لبسه في الدنيا لم يلبسه في الآخرة"  .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 804

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم لباس الحرير على الرجال وتحريم جلوسهم عليه واستنادهم إليه وجواز لبسه للنساء
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Wearing Silk for Men and its Permissibility for Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Silk (clothes) are worn only by him who has no share in the Hereafter."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Silk (clothes) are worn only by him who has no share in the Hereafter."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "إنما يلبس الحرير من لا خلاق له"   وفى رواية للبخاري: "من لا خلاق له في الآخرة"

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 805

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم لباس الحرير على الرجال وتحريم جلوسهم عليه واستنادهم إليه وجواز لبسه للنساء
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Wearing Silk for Men and its Permissibility for Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who wears silk clothes in this life shall not wear them in the Hereafter."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who wears silk clothes in this life shall not wear them in the Hereafter."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "من لبس الحرير في الدنيا لم يلبسه في الآخرة"  .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 806

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم لباس الحرير على الرجال وتحريم جلوسهم عليه واستنادهم إليه وجواز لبسه للنساء
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Wearing Silk for Men and its Permissibility for Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ holding a piece of gold in his left hand and a silk (cloth) in his right hand. Then he said, "These two are forbidden for the males of my Ummah."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ holding a piece of gold in his left hand and a silk (cloth) in his right hand. Then he said, "These two are forbidden for the males of my Ummah."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن على رضى الله عنه قال: رأيت رسول الله ﷺ أخذ حريراً، فجعله في يمينه، وذهباً فجعله في شماله، ثم قال: "إن هذين حرام على ذكور أمتي"..

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 807

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم لباس الحرير على الرجال وتحريم جلوسهم عليه واستنادهم إليه وجواز لبسه للنساء
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Wearing Silk for Men and its Permissibility for Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Wearing of silk and gold has been made unlawful for males and lawful for the females of my Ummah."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Wearing of silk and gold has been made unlawful for males and lawful for the females of my Ummah."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى موسى الأشعرى رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "حرم لباس الحرير والذهب على ذكور أمتي ،وأحل لإناثهم" .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 808

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم لباس الحرير على الرجال وتحريم جلوسهم عليه واستنادهم إليه وجواز لبسه للنساء
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Wearing Silk for Men and its Permissibility for Women

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ prohibited us from eating or drinking in gold or silver utensils and from wearing silk and brocade, or sitting on (anything made from) them.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ prohibited us from eating or drinking in gold or silver utensils and from wearing silk and brocade, or sitting on (anything made from) them.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن حذيفة رضى الله عنه قال: نهانا النبي ﷺ أن نشرب في آنية الذهب والفضة، وأن نأكل فيها، وعن لبس الحرير والديباج،وأن نجلس عليه. .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 809

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز لبس الحرير لمن به حكة
chapter.englishTitle: The Lawfulness of Wearing Silk if One is Suffering from an Itch

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted Zubair and `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf (May Allah be pleased with them) to wear silk because they were suffering from an itch.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ permitted Zubair and `Abdur-Rahman bin `Auf (May Allah be pleased with them) to wear silk because they were suffering from an itch.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أنس رضى الله عنه قال: رخص رسول الله ، ﷺ، للزبير وعبد الرحمن بن عوف رضى الله عنهما في لبس الحرير لحكة بهما. .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 810

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهى عن افتراش جلود النمور والركوب عليها
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Using the Skin of the Leopard

hadiths.englishRaw:
Mu`awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not ride on saddles made from silk or leopard's skin."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Mu`awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not ride on saddles made from silk or leopard's skin."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن معاوية رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تركبوا الخز ولا النمار". حديث حسن، .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 811

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهى عن افتراش جلود النمور والركوب عليها
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Using the Skin of the Leopard

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abul-Malih on the authority of his father reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the use of the skins of wild animals.

[Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi and An- Nasa'i]
.

Another narration in At-Tirmidhi is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the use of the skins of wild animals in making Firash (i.e., something to sit on or lie down on, such as cushions, pillows, covers, spreads, saddles, etc.).
hadiths.narrator: Abul-Malih on the authority of his father reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the use of the skins of wild animals.

[Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi and An- Nasa'i]
.

Another narration in At-Tirmidhi is: Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the use of the skins of wild animals in making Firash (i.e., something to sit on or lie down on, such as cushions, pillows, covers, spreads, saddles, etc.).
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى المليح عن أبيه ، رضى الله عنه ، أن رسول الله ﷺ نهى عن جلود السباع.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 812

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقول إذا لبس ثوباً جديداً أو نعلاً أو نحوه
chapter.englishTitle: The Supplication When Wearing a New Outfit or Shoes

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 When Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a new garment, he would name it. For instance, a turban or shirt or cloak and would supplicate: "Allahumma lakal-hamdu, Anta kasautanihi, as`aluka khairahu wa khaira ma suni`a lahu, wa a`udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni`a lahu (O Allah, all the praise is for You that You have given it to me to put on. I ask You its goodness and the goodness of the purpose for which it was made, and I seek Your Protection from its evil and the evil of the purpose for which it was made).''

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi].
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa`id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
When Messenger of Allah ﷺ wore a new garment, he would name it. For instance, a turban or shirt or cloak and would supplicate: "Allahumma lakal-hamdu, Anta kasautanihi, as`aluka khairahu wa khaira ma suni`a lahu, wa a`udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni`a lahu (O Allah, all the praise is for You that You have given it to me to put on. I ask You its goodness and the goodness of the purpose for which it was made, and I seek Your Protection from its evil and the evil of the purpose for which it was made).''

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi].
hadiths.arabic: عن أبى سعيد الخدرى رضى الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ  إذا استجد ثوباً سماه باسمه -عمامة،  أو قميصاً، أو رداء -يقول: " اللهم لك الحمد أنت كسوتنيه، أسألك خيره وخير ما صنع له، وأعوذ بك من شره وشر ما صنع له" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذى وقال:حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 813

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله عند النوم
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said at the time of Sleeping

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Whenever Messenger of Allah ﷺ went to bed, he would lie down on his right side and recite: "Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika, wa fawwadtu amri ilaika, wa 'alja'tu zahri ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika, la malja'a wa la manja illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta, wa nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalta [O Allah! I have submitted myself to You, I have turned my face to You, committed my affairs to You, and depend on You for protection out of desire for You and out of fear of You (expecting Your reward and fearing Your punishment). There is no refuge and no place of safety from You but with You. I believed in the Book You have revealed, and in the Prophet You have sent (i.e., Muhammad ﷺ).]"

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Whenever Messenger of Allah ﷺ went to bed, he would lie down on his right side and recite: "Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilaika, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilaika, wa fawwadtu amri ilaika, wa 'alja'tu zahri ilaika, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika, la malja'a wa la manja illa ilaika. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalta, wa nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalta [O Allah! I have submitted myself to You, I have turned my face to You, committed my affairs to You, and depend on You for protection out of desire for You and out of fear of You (expecting Your reward and fearing Your punishment). There is no refuge and no place of safety from You but with You. I believed in the Book You have revealed, and in the Prophet You have sent (i.e., Muhammad ﷺ).]"

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن البراء بن عازب رضى الله عنهما قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ ِإذا أوى إلى فراشه نام على شقه الأيمن، ثم قال: " اللهم أسلمت نفسي إليك، ووجهت وجهي إليك، وفوضت أمري إليك، وألجأت ظهري إليك، رغبة ورهبة إليك، لا ملجأ ولا منجى منك إلا إليك. آمنت بكتابك الذي أنزلت . ونبيك الذي أرسلت". (1).
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 813

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 814

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله عند النوم
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said at the time of Sleeping

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ directed me thus: "Whenever you go to bed, perform Wudu' as you do for Salat then (before sleeping) recite: 'O Allah! I have submitted myself to You, I have turned myself to You, committed my affairs to You and sought Your refuge for protection out of desire for You and fear of You (expecting Your reward and fearing Your punishment). There is no refuge and no place of safety from You but with You. I believe in the Book You have revealed and in the Prophet ﷺ You have sent."' Messenger of Allah ﷺ added: "If anyone recites these words and dies during the night, he will die on the true Deen, and if he remains alive till the morning, he will obtain good. And make this supplication your last words (before sleeping)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ directed me thus: "Whenever you go to bed, perform Wudu' as you do for Salat then (before sleeping) recite: 'O Allah! I have submitted myself to You, I have turned myself to You, committed my affairs to You and sought Your refuge for protection out of desire for You and fear of You (expecting Your reward and fearing Your punishment). There is no refuge and no place of safety from You but with You. I believe in the Book You have revealed and in the Prophet ﷺ You have sent."' Messenger of Allah ﷺ added: "If anyone recites these words and dies during the night, he will die on the true Deen, and if he remains alive till the morning, he will obtain good. And make this supplication your last words (before sleeping)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال لي رسول الله ﷺ : "إذا أتيت مضجعك فتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة، ثم اضطجع على شقك الأيمن ، وقل ... " وذكر نحوهن وفيه: " واجعلهن آخر ما تقول"  .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 814

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 815

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله عند النوم
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said at the time of Sleeping

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ used to offer eleven Rak'ah of optional Salat (prayers) in the latter part of night. When it was about dawn, he would offer two short Rak'ah and then would lie down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin (one who calls for prayer) would come to inform him that the congregation had gathered (for prayer).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ used to offer eleven Rak'ah of optional Salat (prayers) in the latter part of night. When it was about dawn, he would offer two short Rak'ah and then would lie down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin (one who calls for prayer) would come to inform him that the congregation had gathered (for prayer).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضى الله عنها قالت: كان النبي ﷺ يصلى من الليل إحدى عشرا ركعة، فإذا طلع الفجر صلى ركعتين خفيفتين ، ثم اضطجع على شقه الأيمن حتى يجئ المؤذن فيؤذنه .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 815

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 816

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله عند النوم
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said at the time of Sleeping

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Whenever the Prophet ﷺ lay down for sleep at night, he would place his (right) hand under his (right) cheek and supplicate: "Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya 
[O Allah, with Your Name will I die and live (wake up)]
." And when he woke up, he would supplicate: "Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilaihin-nushur (All praise is due to Allah, Who has brought us back to life after He has caused us to die, and to Him is the return)."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Whenever the Prophet ﷺ lay down for sleep at night, he would place his (right) hand under his (right) cheek and supplicate: "Allahumma bismika amutu wa ahya 
[O Allah, with Your Name will I die and live (wake up)]
." And when he woke up, he would supplicate: "Al-hamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilaihin-nushur (All praise is due to Allah, Who has brought us back to life after He has caused us to die, and to Him is the return)."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
boldSegments: [O Allah, with Your Name will I die and live (wake up)]
hadiths.arabic: وعن حذيفة رضى الله عنه قال:كان النبي ﷺ إذا أخذ مضجعه من الليل وضع يده تحت خده، ثم يقول: "اللهم باسمك أموت وأحيا" وإذا استيقظ قال: "الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 816

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 817

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله عند النوم
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said at the time of Sleeping

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ya'ish bin Tikhfah Al-Ghifari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 My father said: I was lying down on my belly in the mosque when someone shook me with his foot and said, "Lying down this way is disapproved by Allah." I looked up and saw that it was Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ya'ish bin Tikhfah Al-Ghifari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
My father said: I was lying down on my belly in the mosque when someone shook me with his foot and said, "Lying down this way is disapproved by Allah." I looked up and saw that it was Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن يعيش بن طخفة الغفارى رضى الله عنه قال: قال أبى: بينما أنا مضطجع في المسجد على بطني إذا رجل يحركني برجله فقال: "إن هذه ضجعة يبغضها الله" قال: فنظرت ، فإذا رسول الله ﷺ. .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 817

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 818

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله عند النوم
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be said at the time of Sleeping

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever sits in a place where he does not remember Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), he will suffer loss and incur displeasure of Allah; and whoever lies down (to sleep) in a place where he does not remember Allah, he will suffer sorrow and incur displeasure of Allah."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever sits in a place where he does not remember Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala), he will suffer loss and incur displeasure of Allah; and whoever lies down (to sleep) in a place where he does not remember Allah, he will suffer sorrow and incur displeasure of Allah."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه ، عن رسول الله ﷺ قال: " من قعد مقعداً لم يذكر الله تعالى فيه،كانت عليه من الله تعالى ترة، ومن اضطجع مضجعاً لا يذكر الله تعالى فيه، كانت عليه من الله ترة" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 818

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 819

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الاستلقاء على القفا ووضع إحدى الرجلين على الأخرى إذا لم يخف انكشاف العورة وجواز القعود متربعاً ومحتبياً
chapter.englishTitle: Manners of Lying down on one's back and placing one leg upon the Other

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ lying down on his back in the mosque, placing one leg on the other.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ lying down on his back in the mosque, placing one leg on the other.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عبد الله بن زيد رضى الله عنه أنه رأى رسول الله ﷺ مستلقياً في المسجد، واضعاً إحدى رجليه على الأخرى.  .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 819

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 820

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الاستلقاء على القفا ووضع إحدى الرجلين على الأخرى إذا لم يخف انكشاف العورة وجواز القعود متربعاً ومحتبياً
chapter.englishTitle: Manners of Lying down on one's back and placing one leg upon the Other

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 After the Fajr (dawn) prayer the Prophet ﷺ used to sit crossed legged in the same place in which he had prayed till the sun shone brightly.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
After the Fajr (dawn) prayer the Prophet ﷺ used to sit crossed legged in the same place in which he had prayed till the sun shone brightly.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر بن سمرة رضى الله عنه قال: كان النبي ﷺ إذا صلى الفجر تربع في مجلسه حتى تطلع الشمس حسناء. حديث صحيح، .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 820

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 821

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الاستلقاء على القفا ووضع إحدى الرجلين على الأخرى إذا لم يخف انكشاف العورة وجواز القعود متربعاً ومحتبياً
chapter.englishTitle: Manners of Lying down on one's back and placing one leg upon the Other

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ sitting in the compound of the Holy Ka'bah, with the thighs against the stomach and arms around his legs.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ sitting in the compound of the Holy Ka'bah, with the thighs against the stomach and arms around his legs.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما قال: رأيت رسول الله ﷺ بفناء الكعبة محتبياً بيديه هكذا. ووصف بيديه الاحتباء، وهو القرفصاء. .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 821

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 822

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الاستلقاء على القفا ووضع إحدى الرجلين على الأخرى إذا لم يخف انكشاف العورة وجواز القعود متربعاً ومحتبياً
chapter.englishTitle: Manners of Lying down on one's back and placing one leg upon the Other

hadiths.englishRaw:
Qailah bint Makhramah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 I saw the Prophet ﷺ seated with his arms enfolding his legs; and when I saw him in such a state of humble guise I trembled with fear due to the awe (he showed in that posture).

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Qailah bint Makhramah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw the Prophet ﷺ seated with his arms enfolding his legs; and when I saw him in such a state of humble guise I trembled with fear due to the awe (he showed in that posture).

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن قيلة بنت مخرمة رضى الله عنها قالت: رأيت النبي ﷺ وهو قاعد القرفصاء، فلما رأيت رسول الله ﷺ المتخشع في الجلسة أرعدت من الفرق.  .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 822

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 823

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز الاستلقاء على القفا ووضع إحدى الرجلين على الأخرى إذا لم يخف انكشاف العورة وجواز القعود متربعاً ومحتبياً
chapter.englishTitle: Manners of Lying down on one's back and placing one leg upon the Other

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ash-Sharid bin Suwaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me when I was sitting with my left hand behind my back and leaning on my palm. On seeing me in this posture he said, "Do you sit like those upon whom the Wrath of Allah has descended?"

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ash-Sharid bin Suwaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me when I was sitting with my left hand behind my back and leaning on my palm. On seeing me in this posture he said, "Do you sit like those upon whom the Wrath of Allah has descended?"

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن الشريد بن سويد رضى الله عنه قال: مر بي رسول الله ﷺ وأنا جالس هكذا، وقد وضعت يدي اليسرى خلف ظهري، واتكأت على إلية يدي فقال: "أتقعد قعدة المغضوب عليهم؟!" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 823

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 824

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not ask someone to give up his seat in order to take it, but make accommodation wide and sit at ease." It was Ibn 'Umar's habit that if a person left his seat for him, he would not take it.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not ask someone to give up his seat in order to take it, but make accommodation wide and sit at ease." It was Ibn 'Umar's habit that if a person left his seat for him, he would not take it.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "لا يقمن أحدكم من مجلسه ثم يجلس فيه، ولكن توسعوا وتفسحوا" وكان ابن عمر إذا قام له رجل من مجلسه لم يجلس فيه.
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 824

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 825

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If someone leaves his seat (for one reason or another) and returns to it, he is better entitled to it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If someone leaves his seat (for one reason or another) and returns to it, he is better entitled to it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "إذا قام أحدكم من مجلس، ثم رجع إليه، فهو أحق به"
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 825

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 826

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Whenever we came to the gathering of the Prophet, we would sit down at the end (of the assembly).

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Whenever we came to the gathering of the Prophet, we would sit down at the end (of the assembly).

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر بن سمرة رضى الله عنهما قال: كنا إذا أتينا النبي ﷺ جلس أحدنا حيث ينتهي.
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 826

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 827

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salman Al-Farisi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a man takes a bath on Friday, purifies himself thoroughly, uses oil and perfume which is available in the house, sets forth for the mosque, does not (forcibly) sit between two persons, offers the prayer that is prescribed for him and listens to the Imam silently, his sins between this Friday and the previous Friday will be forgiven."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Salman Al-Farisi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a man takes a bath on Friday, purifies himself thoroughly, uses oil and perfume which is available in the house, sets forth for the mosque, does not (forcibly) sit between two persons, offers the prayer that is prescribed for him and listens to the Imam silently, his sins between this Friday and the previous Friday will be forgiven."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى عبد الله سلمان الفارسي رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "لا يغتسل رجل يوم الجمعة، ويتطهر ما استطاع من طهر، ويدهن من دهنه، أو يمس من طيب بيته، ثم يخرج فلا يفرق بين اثنين، ثم يصلى ما كتب له، ثم ينصت إذا تكلم الإمام، إلا غفر له ما بينه وبين الجمعة الأخرى" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 827

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 828

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his father and grandfather reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not permissible for a person to sit between two people without their permission."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his father and grandfather reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not permissible for a person to sit between two people without their permission."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عمرو بن شعيب عن أبيه عن جده رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "لا يحل لرجل أن يفرق بين اثنين إلا بإذنهما" . وفى رواية لأبى داود: "لا يجلس بين رجلين إلا بإذنهما".
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 828

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 829

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Whosoever takes seat in the midst of an assembly has been cursed by Messenger of Allah ﷺ The Messenger of Allah curses the one who sits in the middle of people's circle.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Hudhaifah bin Al-Yaman (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Whosoever takes seat in the midst of an assembly has been cursed by Messenger of Allah ﷺ The Messenger of Allah curses the one who sits in the middle of people's circle.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن حذيفة بن اليمان رضى الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ لعن من جلس وسط الحلقة.  وروى الترمذى عن أبى مجلز: أن رجلا قعد وسط الحلقة، فقال حذيفة: ملعون على لسان محمد ﷺ -من جلس وسط الحلقة. وروى الترمذى عن أبى مجلز: أن رجلا قعد وسط الحلقة، فقال حذيفة: ملعون على لسان محمد ﷺ -من جلس وسط الحلقة.
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 829

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 830

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying "The best assemblies are those in which people make room for one another."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying "The best assemblies are those in which people make room for one another."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى سعيد الخدرى رضى الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "خير المجالس أوسعها". .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 830

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 831

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever sits in a gathering and indulges in useless talk and before getting up supplicates: 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaika (O Allah, You are free from every imperfection; praise be to You. I testify that there is no true god except You; I ask Your Pardon and turn to You in repentance),' he will be forgiven for (the sins he may have intentionally or unintentionally committed) in that assembly."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever sits in a gathering and indulges in useless talk and before getting up supplicates: 'Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaika (O Allah, You are free from every imperfection; praise be to You. I testify that there is no true god except You; I ask Your Pardon and turn to You in repentance),' he will be forgiven for (the sins he may have intentionally or unintentionally committed) in that assembly."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ "من جلس في مجلس، فكثر فيه لغطه فقال قبل أن يقوم من مجلسه ذلك: سبحانك اللهم وبحمدك، أشهد أن لا إله إلا أنت، أستغفرك وأتوب إليك، إلا غفر له ما كان في مجلسه ذلك" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 831

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 832

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Barzah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Towards the end of his life, Messenger of Allah ﷺ would supplicate before leaving an assembly thus: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaika (O Allah, You are free from every imperfection; all praise is for You. I testify that there is no true god except You, I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance).'' A man once said to him: "O Messenger of Allah! You have spoken such words as you have never uttered before.'' He said, "It is an expiation of that which goes on in the assembly.''

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Barzah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Towards the end of his life, Messenger of Allah ﷺ would supplicate before leaving an assembly thus: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaika (O Allah, You are free from every imperfection; all praise is for You. I testify that there is no true god except You, I ask Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance).'' A man once said to him: "O Messenger of Allah! You have spoken such words as you have never uttered before.'' He said, "It is an expiation of that which goes on in the assembly.''

[Abu Dawud]
.
