hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى برزة رضى الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ يقول بآخرة إذا أراد أن يقوم من المجلس: "سبحانك الله وبحمدك، أشهد أن لا إله إلا أنت، أستغفرك وأتوب إليك" فقال رجل: يا رسول الله، إنك لتقول قولاً ما كنت تقوله فيما مضى؟ قال: "ذلك كفارة لما يكون في المجلس" (3).
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 832

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 833

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ seldom left a gathering without supplicating in these terms: "Allahumma-qsim lana min khashyatika ma tahulu bihi bainana wa baina ma'sika, wa min ta'atika ma tuballighuna bihi jannataka, wa minal-yaqini ma tuhawwinu 'alaina masa-'ibad-dunya. Allahumma matti'na biasma'ina, wa absarina, wa quwwatina ma ahyaitana, waj'alhul-waritha minna, waj'al tharana 'ala man zalamana, wansurna 'ala man 'adana, wa la taj'al musibatana fi dinina, wa la taj'alid-dunya akbara hammina, wa la mablagha 'ilmina, wa la tusallit 'alaina man-la yarhamuna, (O Allah, apportion to us such fear as should serve as a barrier between us and acts of disobedience; and such obedience as will take us to Your Jannah; and such as will make easy for us to bear in the calamities of this world. O Allah! let us enjoy our hearing, our sight and our power as long as You keep us alive and make our heirs from our own offspring, and make our revenge restricted to those who oppress us, and support us against those who are hostile to us let no misfortune afflict our Deen; let not worldly affairs be our principal concern, or the ultimate limit of our knowledge, and let not those rule over us who do not show mercy to us)."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ seldom left a gathering without supplicating in these terms: "Allahumma-qsim lana min khashyatika ma tahulu bihi bainana wa baina ma'sika, wa min ta'atika ma tuballighuna bihi jannataka, wa minal-yaqini ma tuhawwinu 'alaina masa-'ibad-dunya. Allahumma matti'na biasma'ina, wa absarina, wa quwwatina ma ahyaitana, waj'alhul-waritha minna, waj'al tharana 'ala man zalamana, wansurna 'ala man 'adana, wa la taj'al musibatana fi dinina, wa la taj'alid-dunya akbara hammina, wa la mablagha 'ilmina, wa la tusallit 'alaina man-la yarhamuna, (O Allah, apportion to us such fear as should serve as a barrier between us and acts of disobedience; and such obedience as will take us to Your Jannah; and such as will make easy for us to bear in the calamities of this world. O Allah! let us enjoy our hearing, our sight and our power as long as You keep us alive and make our heirs from our own offspring, and make our revenge restricted to those who oppress us, and support us against those who are hostile to us let no misfortune afflict our Deen; let not worldly affairs be our principal concern, or the ultimate limit of our knowledge, and let not those rule over us who do not show mercy to us)."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما قال: قلما كان رسول الله ﷺ يقوم من مجلس حتى يدعو بهؤلاء الدعوات: "اللهم اقسم لنا من خشيتك ما تحول به بيننا وبين معاصيك، ومن طاعتك ما تبلغنا به جنتك، ومن اليقين ما تهون به علينا مصائب الدنيا. اللهم متعنا بأسماعنا، وأبصارنا، وقوتنا ما أحييتنا،واجعله الوارث منا، واجعل ثأرنا على من ظلمنا، وانصرنا على من عادانا، ولا تجعل مصيبتنا في ديننا، ولا تجعل الدنيا أكبر همنا، ولا مبلغ علمنا، ولا تسلط علينا من لا يرحمنا" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 833

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 834

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Those people who leave a gathering in which they have not remembered Allah, will conclude it as if it has foul odour similar to that of a rotten carcass of a donkey. And it will be a cause of grief to them."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Those people who leave a gathering in which they have not remembered Allah, will conclude it as if it has foul odour similar to that of a rotten carcass of a donkey. And it will be a cause of grief to them."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "ما من قوم يقومون من مجلس لا يذكرون الله تعالى فيه، إلا قاموا عن مثل جيفة حمار، وكان لهم حسرة"
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 834

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 835

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whenever a group of people sit in a gathering in which they do not remember Allah the Exalted, nor supplicate to elevate the rank of their Prophet, such a gathering will be a cause of grief to them. If Allah wills, He will punish them, and if He wills He will forgive them."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whenever a group of people sit in a gathering in which they do not remember Allah the Exalted, nor supplicate to elevate the rank of their Prophet, such a gathering will be a cause of grief to them. If Allah wills, He will punish them, and if He wills He will forgive them."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "ما جلس قوم مجلساً لم يذكروا الله تعالى فيه، ولم يصلوا على نبيهم فيه، إلا كان عليهم ترة؛ فإن شاء عذبهم، وإن شاء غفر لهم" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 835

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 836

chapter.arabicTitle: باب في آداب المجلس والجليس
chapter.englishTitle: Etiquette of Attending company and sitting with Companions

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone sits in a gathering where he does not remember Allah, he will bring grief upon himself (on the Day of Resurrection), and he who lies down in a place where he does not remember Allah, will bring grief upon himself (on the Day of Resurrection)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone sits in a gathering where he does not remember Allah, he will bring grief upon himself (on the Day of Resurrection), and he who lies down in a place where he does not remember Allah, will bring grief upon himself (on the Day of Resurrection)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "من قعد مقعداً لم يذكر الله تعالى فيه كانت عليه من الله ترة، ومن اضطجع مضجعاً لم يذكر الله فيه كانت عليه من الله ترة" . (4).
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 836

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 837

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرؤيا وما يتعلق بها
chapter.englishTitle: Visions in Dream and matters relating to them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "All that is left from Prophethood is the glad tidings." He was asked what the glad tidings were, and he said, "The good dream."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "All that is left from Prophethood is the glad tidings." He was asked what the glad tidings were, and he said, "The good dream."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى هريرة رضى الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "لم يبق من النبوة إلا المبشرات" قالوا: وما المبشرات؟ قال: "الرؤيا الصالحة" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 837

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 838

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرؤيا وما يتعلق بها
chapter.englishTitle: Visions in Dream and matters relating to them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "When the time draws near (i.e., near the end of the world), the dream of a believer can hardly be false; and the dream of a believer represents one part from forty-six parts of Prophethood."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

One narration says: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The most truthful of you in their speech are those who see the truest visions."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "When the time draws near (i.e., near the end of the world), the dream of a believer can hardly be false; and the dream of a believer represents one part from forty-six parts of Prophethood."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

One narration says: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The most truthful of you in their speech are those who see the truest visions."
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن النبي ﷺ قال: "إذا اقترب الزمان لم تكد رؤيا المؤمن تكذب، ورؤيا المؤمن جزء من ستة وأربعين جزءاً من النبوة" . ((وفى رواية: "أصدقكم رؤيا أصدقكم حديثاً")).
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 838

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 839

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرؤيا وما يتعلق بها
chapter.englishTitle: Visions in Dream and matters relating to them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who sees me in his dream will see me in his wakefulness (or he ﷺ may have said it is as though he has seen me in a state of wakefulness), for Satan does not appear in my form."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who sees me in his dream will see me in his wakefulness (or he ﷺ may have said it is as though he has seen me in a state of wakefulness), for Satan does not appear in my form."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "من رآني في المنام فسيراني في اليقظة -أو كأنما رآني في اليقظة- لا يتمثل الشيطان بي" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 839

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 840

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرؤيا وما يتعلق بها
chapter.englishTitle: Visions in Dream and matters relating to them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "When one of you sees a dream that he likes, then it is from Allah. He should praise Allah for it and relate it to (others)."

Another narration adds: Messenger of Allahﷺ said, "He should not report it except to those whom he loves. And if he sees one which he dislikes, then it is from the Satan. He should seek refuge in Allah against its evil and should not mention it to anyone. Then it will not harm him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "When one of you sees a dream that he likes, then it is from Allah. He should praise Allah for it and relate it to (others)."

Another narration adds: Messenger of Allahﷺ said, "He should not report it except to those whom he loves. And if he sees one which he dislikes, then it is from the Satan. He should seek refuge in Allah against its evil and should not mention it to anyone. Then it will not harm him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى سعيد الخدرى رضى الله عنه انه سمع النبي ﷺ، يقول: "إذا رأى أحدكم رؤيا يحبها، فإنما هي من الله تعالى، فليحمد الله عليها، وليحدث بها -وفى رواية، فلا يحدث بها إلا من يحب- وإذا رأى غير ذلك مما يكره، فإنما هي من الشيطان، فليستعذ من شرها، ولا يذكرها لأحد، فإنها لا تضره"
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 840

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 841

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرؤيا وما يتعلق بها
chapter.englishTitle: Visions in Dream and matters relating to them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "A good vision (dream) is from Allah and a bad dream is from the Satan. He who sees something in a dream that he dislikes, should blow thrice on his left, must seek Allah's Refuge from the evil of the Satan (i.e., by saying: A'udhu billahi minash-Shaitanir-Rajim). Then it will not harm him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "A good vision (dream) is from Allah and a bad dream is from the Satan. He who sees something in a dream that he dislikes, should blow thrice on his left, must seek Allah's Refuge from the evil of the Satan (i.e., by saying: A'udhu billahi minash-Shaitanir-Rajim). Then it will not harm him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى قتادة رضى الله عنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ: "الرؤيا الصالحة -وفى رواية: الرؤيا الحسنة- من الله، والحلم من الشيطان، فمن رأى شيئاً يكره فلينفث عن شماله ثلاثاً، وليتعوذ من الشيطان فإنها لا تضره"  (5).
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 841

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 842

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرؤيا وما يتعلق بها
chapter.englishTitle: Visions in Dream and matters relating to them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you sees a bad dream let him blow three times on his left, seek refuge in Allah from the Satan three times (i.e., by saying: A'udhu billahi minash-Shaitanir-Rajim) and change the side on which he was lying."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you sees a bad dream let him blow three times on his left, seek refuge in Allah from the Satan three times (i.e., by saying: A'udhu billahi minash-Shaitanir-Rajim) and change the side on which he was lying."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضى الله عنه عن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "إذا رأى أحدكم الرؤيا يكرهها، فليبصق عن يساره ثلاثاً، وليستعذ بالله من الشيطان ثلاثاً، وليتحول عن جنبه الذي كان عليه"
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 842

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 843

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الرؤيا وما يتعلق بها
chapter.englishTitle: Visions in Dream and matters relating to them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Of the worst lies are: to claim a false father, or to pretend to have seen what one has not seen (tell a false dream), or to attribute to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ what he has not said."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Of the worst lies are: to claim a false father, or to pretend to have seen what one has not seen (tell a false dream), or to attribute to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ what he has not said."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبى الأسقع واثلة بن الأسقع رضى الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "إن من أعظم الفرى أن يدعى الرجل إلى غير أبيه، أو يرى عينيه ما لم تر، أو يقول على رسول الله ﷺ ما لم يقل" .
references: Book of Etiquette of Sleeping, Lying and Sitting etc, Hadith 843

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 844

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السلام والأمر بإفشائه
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Promoting Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'as (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Which act in Islam is the best?" He ﷺ replied, "To give food, and to greet everyone, whether you know or you do not."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'as (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Which act in Islam is the best?" He ﷺ replied, "To give food, and to greet everyone, whether you know or you do not."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما أن رجلا سأل رسول الله ﷺ: أي الإسلام خير؟ قال: "تطعم الطعام، وتقرأ السلام على من عرفت ومن لم تعرف". ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 845

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السلام والأمر بإفشائه
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Promoting Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "When Allah created Adam ﷺ, He said to him: 'Go and greet that company of angels who are sitting there - and then listen to what they are going to say in reply to your greetings because that will be your greeting and your off-spring's.' Adam ﷺ said to the angels: 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may you be safe from evil).' They replied: 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah (may you be safe from evil, and Mercy of Allah be upon you).' Thus adding in reply to him: 'wa Rahmatullah (and Mercy of Allah)' to his greeting."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "When Allah created Adam ﷺ, He said to him: 'Go and greet that company of angels who are sitting there - and then listen to what they are going to say in reply to your greetings because that will be your greeting and your off-spring's.' Adam ﷺ said to the angels: 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may you be safe from evil).' They replied: 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah (may you be safe from evil, and Mercy of Allah be upon you).' Thus adding in reply to him: 'wa Rahmatullah (and Mercy of Allah)' to his greeting."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: لما خلق الله تعالى آدم عليه السلام قال: اذهب فسلم على أولئك -نفر من الملائكة جلوس- فاستمع ما يحيونك، فإنه تحيتك وتحية ذريتك. فقال: السلام عليكم فقالوا: السلام عليك ورحمة الله، فزادوه: ورحمة الله" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 846

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السلام والأمر بإفشائه
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Promoting Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to do seven things: to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (of a dead believer), to invoke the Mercy of Allah upon one who sneezes (i.e., by saying to him: Yarhamuk- Allah), to support the weak, to help the oppressed, to promote the greeting of 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum', and to help those who swear to do something to keep their oaths.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Bara' bin 'Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to do seven things: to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (of a dead believer), to invoke the Mercy of Allah upon one who sneezes (i.e., by saying to him: Yarhamuk- Allah), to support the weak, to help the oppressed, to promote the greeting of 'As-Salamu 'Alaikum', and to help those who swear to do something to keep their oaths.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي عمارة البراء بن عازب رضي الله عنهما قال: أمرنا رسول الله ﷺ بسبع: بعيادة المريض، واتباع الجنائز، وتشميت العاطس، ونصر الضعيف، وعون المظلوم، وإفشاء السلام وإبرار المقسم. ((متفق عليه هذا لفظ إحدى روايات البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 847

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السلام والأمر بإفشائه
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Promoting Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "By Him in Whose Hand is my life! You will not enter Jannah until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I inform you of something which, if you do, you will love one another? Promote greetings amongst yourselves."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "By Him in Whose Hand is my life! You will not enter Jannah until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I inform you of something which, if you do, you will love one another? Promote greetings amongst yourselves."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تدخلوا الجنة حتى تؤمنوا ولا تؤمنوا حتى تحابوا أولا أدلكم على شيء إذا فعلتموه تحاببتم؟ أفشوا السلام بينكم" ((رواه مسلم )).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 848

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السلام والأمر بإفشائه
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Promoting Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Salam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "O people, exchange greetings of peace (i.e., say: As-Salamu 'Alaikum to one another), feed people, strengthen the ties of kinship, and be in prayer when others are asleep, you will enter Jannah in peace."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Salam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "O people, exchange greetings of peace (i.e., say: As-Salamu 'Alaikum to one another), feed people, strengthen the ties of kinship, and be in prayer when others are asleep, you will enter Jannah in peace."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي يوسف عبد الله بن سلام رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "يا أيها الناس أفشوا السلام، وأطعموا الطعام، وصلوا الأرحام وصلوا والناس نيام، تدخلوا الجنة بسلام" ((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 849

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السلام والأمر بإفشائه
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Promoting Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
At-Tufail bin Ubayy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I used to visit 'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) in the morning and accompany him to the market. 'Abdullah offered greetings of peace to every one he met on the way, be they sellers of petty goods, traders or poor people. One day when I came to him, he asked me to accompany him to the market. I said to him: "What is the point of your going to the market when you do not sell, nor ask about articles, nor offer a price for them, nor sit down with any company of people. Let us sit down here and talk." He replied: "O Abu Batn (belly)! (Tufail had a large belly), we go to the market to greet everyone we meet."

[Malik]
.
hadiths.narrator: At-Tufail bin Ubayy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I used to visit 'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) in the morning and accompany him to the market. 'Abdullah offered greetings of peace to every one he met on the way, be they sellers of petty goods, traders or poor people. One day when I came to him, he asked me to accompany him to the market. I said to him: "What is the point of your going to the market when you do not sell, nor ask about articles, nor offer a price for them, nor sit down with any company of people. Let us sit down here and talk." He replied: "O Abu Batn (belly)! (Tufail had a large belly), we go to the market to greet everyone we meet."

[Malik]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن الطفيل بن أبي بن كعب أنه كان يأتي عبد الله بن عمر، فيغدو معه إلى السوق، قال: فإذا غدونا إلى السوق، لم يمر عبد الله على سقاط ولا صاحب بيعة، ولا مسكين، ولا أحد إلا سلم عليه، قال الطفيل، فجئت عبد الله بن عمر يومًا، فاستتبعني إلى السوق فقلت له: ما تصنع بالسوق، وأنت لا تقف على البيع ولا تسأل عن السلع، ولا تسوم بها، ولا تجلس في مجالس السوق؟ وأقول: اجلس بنا هاهنا نتحدث، فقال يا أبا بطن- وكان الطفيل ذا بطن- إنما نغدو من أجل السلام فنسلم على من لقيناه. ((رواه مالك في الموطأ بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 850

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كيفية السلام
chapter.englishTitle: Words to be Used for Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Imran bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may you be safe from evil). Messenger of Allah ﷺ responded to his greeting and the man sat down. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Ten (meaning the man had earned the merit of ten good acts)." Another one came and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah (may you be safe from evil, and Mercy of Allah be upon you)." Messenger of Allah ﷺ responded to his greeting and the man sat down. Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Twenty." A third one came and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (may you be safe from evil, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings be upon you)." Messenger of Allah ﷺ responded to his greeting and the man sat down. Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Thirty."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Imran bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may you be safe from evil). Messenger of Allah ﷺ responded to his greeting and the man sat down. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Ten (meaning the man had earned the merit of ten good acts)." Another one came and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullah (may you be safe from evil, and Mercy of Allah be upon you)." Messenger of Allah ﷺ responded to his greeting and the man sat down. Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Twenty." A third one came and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (may you be safe from evil, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings be upon you)." Messenger of Allah ﷺ responded to his greeting and the man sat down. Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Thirty."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عمران بن الحصين رضي الله عنهما قال: جاء رجل إلى النبي ﷺ فقال: السلام عليكم، فرد عليه ثم جلس، فقال النبي ﷺ: “عشر” ثم جاء آخر، فقال: السلام عليكم ورحمة الله، فرد عليه فجلس، فقال: "عشرون" ثم جاء آخر، فقال: السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، فرد عليه فجلس، فقال: “ثلاثون” ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 851

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كيفية السلام
chapter.englishTitle: Words to be Used for Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "This is Jibril (Gabriel) who is conveying you greetings of peace." I responded: "Wa 'Alaihis-Salamu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (may he be safe from evil, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings be upon him)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "This is Jibril (Gabriel) who is conveying you greetings of peace." I responded: "Wa 'Alaihis-Salamu wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu (may he be safe from evil, and the Mercy of Allah and His Blessings be upon him)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنه قالت: قال لي رسول الله ﷺ: “هذا جبريل يقرأ عليك السلام" قالت: قلت: "وعليه السلام ورحمة الله وبركاته" ((متفق عليه))وهكذا وقع في بعض روايات الصحيحين: "وبركاته" وفي بعضها بحذفها وزيادة الثقة مقبولة

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 852

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كيفية السلام
chapter.englishTitle: Words to be Used for Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported the Prophet ﷺ used to repeat his words thrice so that the meaning thereof would be fully understood, and whenever he came upon a gathering of people, he would greet them. He would repeat Salam thrice.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.body:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported the Prophet ﷺ used to repeat his words thrice so that the meaning thereof would be fully understood, and whenever he came upon a gathering of people, he would greet them. He would repeat Salam thrice.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ، كان إذا تكلم بكلمة أعادها ثلاثًا حتى تفهم عنه، وإذا أتى على قوم فسلم عليهم سلم عليهم ثلاثًا. ((رواه البخاري))وهذا محمول على ما إذا كان الجمع كثيرًا.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 853

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كيفية السلام
chapter.englishTitle: Words to be Used for Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Miqdad (May Allah be pleased with him) reported in course of a long Hadith:
 We used to reserve for the Prophet ﷺ his share of the milk, and he would come at night and offer greetings in such a manner as did not disturb those asleep and was heard only by those who were awake. In fact, the Prophet ﷺ came and offered greetings as usual.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Miqdad (May Allah be pleased with him) reported in course of a long Hadith:
hadiths.body:
We used to reserve for the Prophet ﷺ his share of the milk, and he would come at night and offer greetings in such a manner as did not disturb those asleep and was heard only by those who were awake. In fact, the Prophet ﷺ came and offered greetings as usual.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن المقداد رضي الله عنه في حديثه الطويل قال: كنا نرفع للنبي ﷺ نصيبه من اللبن، فيجيء من الليل، فيسلم تسليمًا لا يوقظ نائمًا، ويسمع اليقظان، فجاء النبي ﷺ فسلم كما كان يُسلم. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 854

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كيفية السلام
chapter.englishTitle: Words to be Used for Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Asma' bint Yazid (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed through the mosque one day and there was a group of women (about ten of them) sitting in the mosque. He raised his hand to offer greetings.

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Asma' bint Yazid (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed through the mosque one day and there was a group of women (about ten of them) sitting in the mosque. He raised his hand to offer greetings.

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أسماء بنت يزيد رضي الله عنه عنها أن رسول الله ﷺ، مر في المسجد يومًا، وعصبة من النساء قعود، فألوى بيده بالتسليم. ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).وعن أبي أمامة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "إن أولى الناس بالله من بدأهم بالسلام" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد جيد، ورواه الترمذي بنحوه وقال: حديث حسن، وقد ذكر بعده)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 855

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كيفية السلام
chapter.englishTitle: Words to be Used for Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Abu Umamah:

The Prophet ﷺ said: Those who are nearest to Allah are they who are first to give a salutation.

[Abu Dawud] And At- Tirmidhi narrated its meaning and classified it as Hasan.
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Abu Umamah:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said: Those who are nearest to Allah are they who are first to give a salutation.

[Abu Dawud] And At- Tirmidhi narrated its meaning and classified it as Hasan.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أمامة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ:  "إن أولى الناس بالله من بدأهم بالسلام" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد جيد، ورواه الترمذي بنحوه وقال: حديث حسن، وقد ذكر بعده)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 856

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كيفية السلام
chapter.englishTitle: Words to be Used for Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Juraiy Al-Hujaimi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "Alaikas-Salamu ya Rasulallah! (Upon you be peace, O Messenger of Allah)!" He said, "Do not say: 'Alaikas-Salamu (Upon you be peace).' This is the Salam to the dead."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Juraiy Al-Hujaimi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "Alaikas-Salamu ya Rasulallah! (Upon you be peace, O Messenger of Allah)!" He said, "Do not say: 'Alaikas-Salamu (Upon you be peace).' This is the Salam to the dead."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي جري الهجيمي رضي الله عنه قال: أتيت رسول الله ﷺ فقلت: عليك السلام يا رسول الله قال: "لا تقل عليك السلام؛ فإن عليك السلام تحية الموتى". ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح. وقد سبق بطوله)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 857

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كيفية السلام
chapter.englishTitle: Words to be Used for Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'A rider should greet a pedestrian; a pedestrian should greet one who is sitting; and a small group should greet a large group (of people).''

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

The narration in Al-Bukhari adds: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The young should greet the elderly.''
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'A rider should greet a pedestrian; a pedestrian should greet one who is sitting; and a small group should greet a large group (of people).''

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

The narration in Al-Bukhari adds: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The young should greet the elderly.''
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "يسلم الراكب على الماشي، والماشي على القاعد، والقليل على الكثير” ((متفق عليه))  وفي رواية للبخاري: "والصغير على الكبير"

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 858

chapter.arabicTitle: باب آداب السلام
chapter.englishTitle: The Etiquette of Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Umamah Sudaiy bin `Ajlan Al-Bahili (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The person nearest to Allah is one who is the first to offer greeting."

[Abu Dawud]
.

The narration in At-Tirmidhi is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: "O Messenger of Allah! When two persons meet, who should greet the other first?'' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The person nearest to Allah (i.e., one who is more obedient and therefore closer to Allah will say: As-Salam first."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah Sudaiy bin `Ajlan Al-Bahili (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The person nearest to Allah is one who is the first to offer greeting."

[Abu Dawud]
.

The narration in At-Tirmidhi is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: "O Messenger of Allah! When two persons meet, who should greet the other first?'' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The person nearest to Allah (i.e., one who is more obedient and therefore closer to Allah will say: As-Salam first."
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أمامة صُدي بن عجلان الباهلي رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “إن أولى الناس بالله من بدأهم بالسلام" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد جيد)). ورواه الترمذي عن أبي أمامة رضي الله عنه: قيل: يا رسول الله، الرجلان يلتقيان، أيهما يبدأ بالسلام؟ قال: "أولاهما بالله تعالى" قال الترمذي : حديث حسن.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 859

chapter.arabicTitle: باب آداب السلام
chapter.englishTitle: The Etiquette of Offering Greetings

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported in the Hadith in respect of the person who was at fault in performing his Salat (prayer):
 He came to the Prophet ﷺ and greeted him. The Prophet ﷺ responded to the greeting and said, "Go back and repeat your Salat because you have not performed the Salat (properly).'' He again performed Salat as he had prayed before and came to the Prophet ﷺ and greeted him. The Prophet ﷺ responded to the greetings (and repeated his words to him). This act of repeating (the Salat and the Salam) was done thrice.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported in the Hadith in respect of the person who was at fault in performing his Salat (prayer):
hadiths.body:
He came to the Prophet ﷺ and greeted him. The Prophet ﷺ responded to the greeting and said, "Go back and repeat your Salat because you have not performed the Salat (properly).'' He again performed Salat as he had prayed before and came to the Prophet ﷺ and greeted him. The Prophet ﷺ responded to the greetings (and repeated his words to him). This act of repeating (the Salat and the Salam) was done thrice.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه في حديث المسيء صلاته أنه جاء فصلى، ثم جاء النبي ﷺ، فسلم عليه، فرد عليه السلام، فقال: "ارجع فصلِ، فإنك لم تصلِ" فرجع فصلى، ثم جاء فسلم على النبي ﷺ، حتى فعل ذلك ثلاث مرات” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 860

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب إعادة السلام على من تكرر لقاؤه على قرب بأن دخل ثم خرج ثم دخل في الحال، أو حال بينهما شجرة ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Greeting the Acquaintance Repeatedly

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you meets a brother (in Faith) he should greet him. Then if a tree or a wall or a stone intervenes between them and then he meets him again, he should greet him."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you meets a brother (in Faith) he should greet him. Then if a tree or a wall or a stone intervenes between them and then he meets him again, he should greet him."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن رسول الله ﷺ، قال: "إذا لقي أحدكم أخاه، فليسلم عليه، فإن حالت بينهما شجرة، أو جدار، أو حجر، ثم لقيه، فليسلم عليه" ((رواه أبو داود)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 861

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب إعادة السلام على من تكرر لقاؤه على قرب بأن دخل ثم خرج ثم دخل في الحال، أو حال بينهما شجرة ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Greeting the Acquaintance Repeatedly

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "Dear son, when you enter your house, say As- Salamu 'Alaikum to your family, for it will be a blessing both to you and to your family."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "Dear son, when you enter your house, say As- Salamu 'Alaikum to your family, for it will be a blessing both to you and to your family."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال لي رسول الله ﷺ : "يا بُني، إذا دخلت على أهلك، فسلم، يكن بركة عليك، وعلى أهل بيتك" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 862

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب السلام إذا دخل بيته
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Greeting Upon Entering the House

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that he passed by some children and greeted them. Then he said:
 "Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do the same."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that he passed by some children and greeted them. Then he said:
hadiths.body:
"Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do the same."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه أنه مر على صبيان، فسلم عليهم، وقال: كان رسول الله ﷺ يفعله” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 863

chapter.arabicTitle: باب السلام على الصبيان
chapter.englishTitle: Greeting Children

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sahl bin Sa`d (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 There was a woman among us who would put beet root in a pot and add to it some ground barley. She used to cook them together. On returning from the Friday prayer, we would greet her and she would offer it to us.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sahl bin Sa`d (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
There was a woman among us who would put beet root in a pot and add to it some ground barley. She used to cook them together. On returning from the Friday prayer, we would greet her and she would offer it to us.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن سهل بن سعد رضي الله عنه قال: كانت فينا امرأة -وفي رواية: كانت لنا عجوز- تأخذ من أصول السلق فتطرحه في القدر، وتكركر حبات من شعير، فإذا صلينا الجمعة، وانصرفنا، نُسلم عليها، فتقدمه إلينا" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 864

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سلام الرجل على زوجته والمرأة من محارمه وعلى أجنبية وأجنبيات لا يخاف الفتنة بهن وسلامهن بهذا الشرط
chapter.englishTitle: A man sayinig salam to his wife or a mahram woman or non-mahrmam woman or women not fearing tribulation by them and giving them salam with this condition

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Hani (May Allah be pleased with her), the daughter of Abu Talib reported:
 I went to the Prophet ﷺ on the day of the conquest of Makkah. He was taking a bath and Fatimah was screening him with a cloth. I greeted him. And she mentioned the rest of the Hadith.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Hani (May Allah be pleased with her), the daughter of Abu Talib reported:
hadiths.body:
I went to the Prophet ﷺ on the day of the conquest of Makkah. He was taking a bath and Fatimah was screening him with a cloth. I greeted him. And she mentioned the rest of the Hadith.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم هانئ فاختة بنت أبي طالب رضي الله عنه قالت: أتيت النبي ﷺ يوم الفتح وهو يغتسل، وفاطمة تستره بثوب، فسلمت، وذكرت الحديث” ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 865

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سلام الرجل على زوجته والمرأة من محارمه وعلى أجنبية وأجنبيات لا يخاف الفتنة بهن وسلامهن بهذا الشرط
chapter.englishTitle: A man sayinig salam to his wife or a mahram woman or non-mahrmam woman or women not fearing tribulation by them and giving them salam with this condition

hadiths.englishRaw:
Asma bint Yazid (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ passed by us when we were with a party of women, and he greeted us.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Asma bint Yazid (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ passed by us when we were with a party of women, and he greeted us.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أسماء بنت يزيد رضي الله عنه قالت: مر علينا النبي ﷺ في نسوة فسلم علينا. ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن، وهذا لفظ أبي داود، ولفظ الترمذي: أن رسول الله ﷺ مر في المسجد يومًا، وعصبة من النساء قعود، فألوى بيده بالتسليم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 866

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سلام الرجل على زوجته والمرأة من محارمه وعلى أجنبية وأجنبيات لا يخاف الفتنة بهن وسلامهن بهذا الشرط
chapter.englishTitle: A man sayinig salam to his wife or a mahram woman or non-mahrmam woman or women not fearing tribulation by them and giving them salam with this condition

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not greet the Jews and the Christians before they greet you; and when you meet any one of them on the road, force him to go to the narrowest part of it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not greet the Jews and the Christians before they greet you; and when you meet any one of them on the road, force him to go to the narrowest part of it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: " لا تبدءوا اليهود ولا النصارى بالسلام، فإذا لقيتم أحدهم في طريق فاضطروه إلى أضيقه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 867

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم ابتدائنا الكافر بالسلام وكيفية الرد عليهم واستحباب السلام على أهل مجلس فيهم مسلمون وكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Greeting Non-Muslims and the Prohibition of Taking Initiative in Doing So

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the people of the Book greet you (i.e., by saying 'As-Samu 'Alaikum,' meaning death be upon you), you should respond with: 'Wa 'alaikum' 
[The same on you (i.e., and death will be upon you, for no one will escape death)]
."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the people of the Book greet you (i.e., by saying 'As-Samu 'Alaikum,' meaning death be upon you), you should respond with: 'Wa 'alaikum' 
[The same on you (i.e., and death will be upon you, for no one will escape death)]
."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
boldSegments: [The same on you (i.e., and death will be upon you, for no one will escape death)]
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "إذا سلم عليكم أهل الكتاب فقولوا: وعليكم” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 868

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم ابتدائنا الكافر بالسلام وكيفية الرد عليهم واستحباب السلام على أهل مجلس فيهم مسلمون وكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Greeting Non-Muslims and the Prohibition of Taking Initiative in Doing So

hadiths.englishRaw:
Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ passed by a mixed company of people which included Muslims, polytheists and Jews, and he gave them the greeting (i.e., saying As- Salamu 'Alaikum).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ passed by a mixed company of people which included Muslims, polytheists and Jews, and he gave them the greeting (i.e., saying As- Salamu 'Alaikum).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أسامة رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ مر على مجلس فيه أخلاط من المسلمين والمشركين -عبدة الأوثان واليهود- فسلم عليهم النبي ﷺ" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 869

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم ابتدائنا الكافر بالسلام وكيفية الرد عليهم واستحباب السلام على أهل مجلس فيهم مسلمون وكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Greeting Non-Muslims and the Prohibition of Taking Initiative in Doing So

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you arrives in a gathering, he should offer Salam to those who are already there, and he should also do so when he intends to depart. The first act of greeting is not more meritorious than the last.''

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you arrives in a gathering, he should offer Salam to those who are already there, and he should also do so when he intends to depart. The first act of greeting is not more meritorious than the last.''

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "إذا انتهى أحدكم إلى المجلس فليسلم، فإذا أراد أن يقوم فليسلم، فليست الأولى بأحق من الآخرة" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن")).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 870

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب السلام إذا قام من المجلس وفارق جلساءه أو جليسه
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Greeting Upon Arrival and Departure

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Permission is to be sought thrice. If it is accorded, you may enter; otherwise, go back."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Permission is to be sought thrice. If it is accorded, you may enter; otherwise, go back."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسي الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : “ الاستئذان ثلاث، فإن أذن لك وإلا فارجع" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 871

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الاستئذان وآدابه
chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter (Someone's House) and Manners Relating to It

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Seeking permission to enter (somebody's house) has been prescribed in order to restrain the eyes (from looking at something we are not supposed to look at)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Seeking permission to enter (somebody's house) has been prescribed in order to restrain the eyes (from looking at something we are not supposed to look at)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سهل بن سعد قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ  : "إنما جعل الاستئذان من أجل البصر" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 872

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الاستئذان وآدابه
chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter (Someone's House) and Manners Relating to It

hadiths.englishRaw:
Rib'i bin Hirash (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man of Banu 'Amir tribe has told us that he had asked the Prophet ﷺ for permission to enter when he was at home. He said: "May I enter?" Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the servant, "Go out and instruct him about the manner of seeking permission. Tell him to say: As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may you be safe from evil). May I come in?" The man heard this and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may you be safe from evil). May I come in?" The Prophet ﷺ then accorded permission to him and he entered in.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Rib'i bin Hirash (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man of Banu 'Amir tribe has told us that he had asked the Prophet ﷺ for permission to enter when he was at home. He said: "May I enter?" Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the servant, "Go out and instruct him about the manner of seeking permission. Tell him to say: As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may you be safe from evil). May I come in?" The man heard this and said: "As-Salamu 'Alaikum (may you be safe from evil). May I come in?" The Prophet ﷺ then accorded permission to him and he entered in.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ربعي بن حراش قال: حدثنا رجل من بني عامر استأذن علي النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  وهو في بيت، فقال: أألج؟ فقال رسول الله ﷺ  لخادمه: "أخرج إلي هذا وعلمه الاستئذان، فقل له: قل: السلام عليكم، أأدخل؟” فسمعه الرجل فقال: السلام عليكم، أأدخل؟ فأذن له النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم ، فدخل. ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 873

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الاستئذان وآدابه
chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter (Someone's House) and Manners Relating to It

hadiths.englishRaw:
Kildah bin Al-Hanbal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I visited the Prophet ﷺ and I entered his house without seeking permission. So he said, "Go back and say: 'As-Salamu 'alaikum (may you be safe from evil). May I come in?"'

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Kildah bin Al-Hanbal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I visited the Prophet ﷺ and I entered his house without seeking permission. So he said, "Go back and say: 'As-Salamu 'alaikum (may you be safe from evil). May I come in?"'

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن كلدة بن الحنبل رضي الله عنه قال: أتيت النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم ، فدخلت عليه ولم أسلم، فقال النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم : "ارجع فقل السلام عليكم أأدخل؟" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 874

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الاستئذان وآدابه
chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter (Someone's House) and Manners Relating to It

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported in the course of his famous Hadith pertaining to Al-Isra' (the Ascension) that Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then Jibril (Gabriel) ascended along with me to the nearest heaven and requested for the gate to be opened. He was asked:
 `Who is there?' He replied: `Jibril.' He was asked: `Who is with you?' He said: `Muhammad.' Then he ascended to the second heaven and requested for the opening of the gate. He was asked: `Who is there?' He said: `Jibril.' He was asked: `Who is with you?' He replied: `Muhammad.' In the same way he ascended to the third, fourth and all the heavens (i.e., until the seventh). At all of the gates he was asked: `Who is there?' He replied: Jibril.'''

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported in the course of his famous Hadith pertaining to Al-Isra' (the Ascension) that Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then Jibril (Gabriel) ascended along with me to the nearest heaven and requested for the gate to be opened. He was asked:
hadiths.body:
`Who is there?' He replied: `Jibril.' He was asked: `Who is with you?' He said: `Muhammad.' Then he ascended to the second heaven and requested for the opening of the gate. He was asked: `Who is there?' He said: `Jibril.' He was asked: `Who is with you?' He replied: `Muhammad.' In the same way he ascended to the third, fourth and all the heavens (i.e., until the seventh). At all of the gates he was asked: `Who is there?' He replied: Jibril.'''

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه في حديثه المشهور في الإسراء قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "ثم صعد بي جبريل إلي السماء الدنيا فاستفتح، فقيل: من هذا؟ قال: جبريل، قيل:ومن معك؟ قال: محمد. ثم صعد إلي السماء الثانية والثالثة والرابعة وسائرهن، ويقال في باب كل سماء: من هذا؟ فيقول: جبريل" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 875

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان أن السُّنة إذا قيل للمستأذن من أنت أن يقول: فلان فيسمي نفسه بما يعرف به من اسم أو كنية وكراهة قوله "أنا" ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter by Stating One's Name

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I stepped out one night and saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ walking by himself. I began to walk in the moonlit night. He turned round and saw me and asked, "Who is there?" I replied: "Abu Dharr."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I stepped out one night and saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ walking by himself. I began to walk in the moonlit night. He turned round and saw me and asked, "Who is there?" I replied: "Abu Dharr."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه قال: خرجت ليلة من الليالي، فإذا رسول الله ﷺ  يمشي وحده، فجعلت أمشي في ظل القمر، فالتفت فرآني فقال: "من هذا؟" فقلت: أبو ذر، ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 876

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان أن السُّنة إذا قيل للمستأذن من أنت أن يقول: فلان فيسمي نفسه بما يعرف به من اسم أو كنية وكراهة قوله "أنا" ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter by Stating One's Name

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Hani (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 I went to the Prophet ﷺ who was taking a bath while Fatimah was screening him. He asked, "Who is there?" I replied: "I am Umm Hani."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Hani (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
I went to the Prophet ﷺ who was taking a bath while Fatimah was screening him. He asked, "Who is there?" I replied: "I am Umm Hani."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم هانيء رضي الله عنها قالت: أتيت النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  وهو يغتسل وفاطمة تستره فقال " من هذه؟" فقلت: أنا أهم هانيء. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 877

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان أن السُّنة إذا قيل للمستأذن من أنت أن يقول: فلان فيسمي نفسه بما يعرف به من اسم أو كنية وكراهة قوله "أنا" ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter by Stating One's Name

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I went to the Prophet ﷺ and knocked at the door (to seek permission). He asked, "Who is there?" I said: "I". He repeated, " I, I?!" as if he disliked it.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I went to the Prophet ﷺ and knocked at the door (to seek permission). He asked, "Who is there?" I said: "I". He repeated, " I, I?!" as if he disliked it.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: أتيت النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  فدققت الباب، فقال "من ذا؟" فقلت: أنا، فقال: "أنا أنا؟!" كـنه كرهها ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 878

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان أن السُّنة إذا قيل للمستأذن من أنت أن يقول: فلان فيسمي نفسه بما يعرف به من اسم أو كنية وكراهة قوله "أنا" ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Seeking Permission to Enter by Stating One's Name

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah likes sneezing and dislikes yawning. When any one of you sneezes and says `Al-hamdu lillah (praise be to Allah)', it becomes obligatory upon every Muslim who hears him to respond with `Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you)'. Yawning is from the devil. When one of you feels like yawning, he should restrain it as much as possible, for the devil laughs when one of you yawns."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah likes sneezing and dislikes yawning. When any one of you sneezes and says `Al-hamdu lillah (praise be to Allah)', it becomes obligatory upon every Muslim who hears him to respond with `Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you)'. Yawning is from the devil. When one of you feels like yawning, he should restrain it as much as possible, for the devil laughs when one of you yawns."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  قال: "إن الله يحب العطاس، ويكره التثاؤب، فإذا عطس أحدكم وحمد الله تعالي كان حقاً علي كل مسلم سمعه أن يقول له:يرحمك الله، وأما التثاؤب فإنما هو من الشيطان، فإذا تثاءب أحدكم فليرده ما استطاع، فإن أحدكم إذا تثاءب ضحك منه الشيطان" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 879

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تشميت العاطس إذا حمد الله تعالى وكراهة تشميته إذا لم يحمد الله تعالى و بيان آداب التشميت و العطاس والتثاؤب
chapter.englishTitle: Saying "Al-Hamdulillah" When Sneezing, Its Reply, and Manners Relating to Sneezing and Yawning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "When one of you sneezes he should say: 'Al-hamdu lillah (praise be to Allah),' and his brother or his companion should say to him: 'Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you).' When he says this he should reply: 'Yahdikum-ullah wa yuslihu balakum (may Allah guide you and render sound your state of affairs)."'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "When one of you sneezes he should say: 'Al-hamdu lillah (praise be to Allah),' and his brother or his companion should say to him: 'Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you).' When he says this he should reply: 'Yahdikum-ullah wa yuslihu balakum (may Allah guide you and render sound your state of affairs)."'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  قال: "إذا عطس أحدكم فليقل: الحمد لله؛ وليقل له أخوه أو أصحابه: يرحمك الله، فإذا قال له: يرحمك الله، فليقل: يهديكم الله ويصلح بالكم" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 880

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تشميت العاطس إذا حمد الله تعالى وكراهة تشميته إذا لم يحمد الله تعالى و بيان آداب التشميت و العطاس والتثاؤب
chapter.englishTitle: Saying "Al-Hamdulillah" When Sneezing, Its Reply, and Manners Relating to Sneezing and Yawning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you sneezes and praises Allah (i.e., says Al-hamdu lillah), you should invoke Allah's Mercy upon him (i.e., say Yarhamuk-Allah), but if he does not praise Allah, you should not make a response." 
[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you sneezes and praises Allah (i.e., says Al-hamdu lillah), you should invoke Allah's Mercy upon him (i.e., say Yarhamuk-Allah), but if he does not praise Allah, you should not make a response." 
[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسي رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "إذا عطس أحدكم فحمد الله فشمتوه، فإن لم يحمد الله فلا تشمتوه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 881

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تشميت العاطس إذا حمد الله تعالى وكراهة تشميته إذا لم يحمد الله تعالى و بيان آداب التشميت و العطاس والتثاؤب
chapter.englishTitle: Saying "Al-Hamdulillah" When Sneezing, Its Reply, and Manners Relating to Sneezing and Yawning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 When two men sneezed in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, he responded to one with "Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you)" and did not respond to the other. The latter said to him: "You invoked a blessing on this man but did not do so in my case." The Prophet ﷺ replied, "He praised Allah (i.e., he said 'Al-hamdu lillah') but you did not."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
When two men sneezed in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ, he responded to one with "Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah have mercy on you)" and did not respond to the other. The latter said to him: "You invoked a blessing on this man but did not do so in my case." The Prophet ﷺ replied, "He praised Allah (i.e., he said 'Al-hamdu lillah') but you did not."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: عطس رجلان عند النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم ، فشمت أحدهما ولم يشمت الآخر، فقال الذي لم يشمته: عطس فلان فشمته، وعطست فلم تشمتني؟ فقال: "هذا حمد الله، وإنك لم تحمد الله" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 882

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تشميت العاطس إذا حمد الله تعالى وكراهة تشميته إذا لم يحمد الله تعالى و بيان آداب التشميت و العطاس والتثاؤب
chapter.englishTitle: Saying "Al-Hamdulillah" When Sneezing, Its Reply, and Manners Relating to Sneezing and Yawning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sneezed, he would cover his mouth with his hand or a piece of cloth, suppressing the sound this way.

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sneezed, he would cover his mouth with his hand or a piece of cloth, suppressing the sound this way.

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ  إذا عطس وضع يده أو ثوبه علي فيه، وخفض -أو غض- بها صوته. شك الراوي. ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 883

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تشميت العاطس إذا حمد الله تعالى وكراهة تشميته إذا لم يحمد الله تعالى و بيان آداب التشميت و العطاس والتثاؤب
chapter.englishTitle: Saying "Al-Hamdulillah" When Sneezing, Its Reply, and Manners Relating to Sneezing and Yawning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Jews used to intentionally sneeze in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ hoping that he would say to them: 'Yarhamukum-ullah (may Allah have mercy on you),' but he would respond with: "Yahdikum-ullahu wa yuslihu balakum (may Allah guide you and render sound your state of affairs)."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Jews used to intentionally sneeze in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ hoping that he would say to them: 'Yarhamukum-ullah (may Allah have mercy on you),' but he would respond with: "Yahdikum-ullahu wa yuslihu balakum (may Allah guide you and render sound your state of affairs)."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبو موسي رضي الله عنه قال: كان اليهود يتعاطسون عند رسول الله ﷺ  يرجون أن يقول لهم: يرحمكم الله، فيقول: ""يهديكم الله ويصلح بالكم" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 884

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تشميت العاطس إذا حمد الله تعالى وكراهة تشميته إذا لم يحمد الله تعالى و بيان آداب التشميت و العطاس والتثاؤب
chapter.englishTitle: Saying "Al-Hamdulillah" When Sneezing, Its Reply, and Manners Relating to Sneezing and Yawning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one yawns, he should put his hand over his mouth, otherwise the devil will enter."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one yawns, he should put his hand over his mouth, otherwise the devil will enter."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "إذا تثاءب أحدكم فليمسك بيده علي فيه، فإن الشيطان يدخل" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 885

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تشميت العاطس إذا حمد الله تعالى وكراهة تشميته إذا لم يحمد الله تعالى و بيان آداب التشميت و العطاس والتثاؤب
chapter.englishTitle: Saying "Al-Hamdulillah" When Sneezing, Its Reply, and Manners Relating to Sneezing and Yawning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Khattab Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I asked Anas: "Did the Companions of Messenger of Allah ﷺ use to shake hands?'' He said: "Yes.''

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Khattab Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I asked Anas: "Did the Companions of Messenger of Allah ﷺ use to shake hands?'' He said: "Yes.''

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي الخطاب قتادة قال: قلت لأنس: أكانت المصافحة في أصحاب رسول الله ﷺ ؟ قال: نعم" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 886

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب المصافحة عند اللقاء وبشاشة الوجه وتقبيل يد الرجل الصالح وتقبيل ولده شفقة ومعانقة القادم من سفر وكراهية الانحناء
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Shaking Hands When Greeting Someone

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 When the people of Yemen came, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The people of Yemen have visited you. They are the first to introduce the tradition of handshaking."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
When the people of Yemen came, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The people of Yemen have visited you. They are the first to introduce the tradition of handshaking."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: لما جاء أهل اليمن قال رسول الله ﷺ : “قد جاءكم أهل اليمن، وهم أول من جاء بالمصافحة" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 887

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب المصافحة عند اللقاء وبشاشة الوجه وتقبيل يد الرجل الصالح وتقبيل ولده شفقة ومعانقة القادم من سفر وكراهية الانحناء
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Shaking Hands When Greeting Someone

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Two Muslims will not meet and shake hands without having their sins forgiven (by Allah ) before they depart."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Two Muslims will not meet and shake hands without having their sins forgiven (by Allah ) before they depart."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن البراء رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "ما من مسلمين يلتقيان فيتصافحان إلا غفر لهما قبل أن يفترقا" ((رواه أبو داود)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 888

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب المصافحة عند اللقاء وبشاشة الوجه وتقبيل يد الرجل الصالح وتقبيل ولده شفقة ومعانقة القادم من سفر وكراهية الانحناء
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Shaking Hands When Greeting Someone

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man asked: "O Messenger of Allah! When a man meets a brother or a friend, should he bow to him?" He said, "No." The man asked whether he should embrace and kiss him? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "No." He asked whether he should hold his hand and shake it? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Yes."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man asked: "O Messenger of Allah! When a man meets a brother or a friend, should he bow to him?" He said, "No." The man asked whether he should embrace and kiss him? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "No." He asked whether he should hold his hand and shake it? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Yes."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رجل: يا رسول الله، الرجل منا يلقي أخاه أو صديقه، أينحني له قال: "لا" قال: أفيلتزمه ويقبله؟فال: "لا" قال: فيأخذ بيده ويصافحه؟ قال:"نعم" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 889

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب المصافحة عند اللقاء وبشاشة الوجه وتقبيل يد الرجل الصالح وتقبيل ولده شفقة ومعانقة القادم من سفر وكراهية الانحناء
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Shaking Hands When Greeting Someone

hadiths.englishRaw:
Safwan bin 'Assal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A Jew asked his companion to take him to the Prophet ﷺ, and when they came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, they asked him about the nine clear signs (given to Prophet Musa). Safwan narrated the long Hadith which concludes: They kissed the hands and feet of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "We testify that you are a Prophet."

[At-Tirmidhi]
 (Unapproved Hadith).
hadiths.narrator: Safwan bin 'Assal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A Jew asked his companion to take him to the Prophet ﷺ, and when they came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, they asked him about the nine clear signs (given to Prophet Musa). Safwan narrated the long Hadith which concludes: They kissed the hands and feet of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: "We testify that you are a Prophet."

[At-Tirmidhi]
 (Unapproved Hadith).
hadiths.arabic: وعن صفوان بن عسال رضي الله عنه قال: قال يهودي لصاحبه: اذهب بنا إلي هذا النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلم فأتيا رسول الله ﷺ ، فسألاه عن تسع آيات بينات؛ فذكر الحديث إلي قوله: فقبلا يده ورجله، وقالا: نشهد أنك نبي. ((رواه الترمذي وغيره بأسانيد صحيحة)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 890

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب المصافحة عند اللقاء وبشاشة الوجه وتقبيل يد الرجل الصالح وتقبيل ولده شفقة ومعانقة القادم من سفر وكراهية الانحناء
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Shaking Hands When Greeting Someone

hadiths.englishRaw:
In a narration of Ibn Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) at the end of the narration of the Hadith ) he said:
 "We came near the Prophet ﷺ and kissed his hand."

[Abu Dawud]
hadiths.narrator: In a narration of Ibn Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) at the end of the narration of the Hadith ) he said:
hadiths.body:
"We came near the Prophet ﷺ and kissed his hand."

[Abu Dawud]
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهما، قصة قال فيها: فدنونا من النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  فقبلنا يده" ((رواه أبو داود)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 891

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب المصافحة عند اللقاء وبشاشة الوجه وتقبيل يد الرجل الصالح وتقبيل ولده شفقة ومعانقة القادم من سفر وكراهية الانحناء
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Shaking Hands When Greeting Someone

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 Zaid bin Harithah came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was in my house. Zaid knocked at the door. The Prophet ﷺ rose to receive him, trailing his garment. He embraced and kissed him.

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
Zaid bin Harithah came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was in my house. Zaid knocked at the door. The Prophet ﷺ rose to receive him, trailing his garment. He embraced and kissed him.

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قدم زيد بن حارثة المدينة ورسول الله ﷺ  في بيتي، فأتاه فقرع الباب، فقام إليه النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  يجر ثوبه، فاعتنقه وقبله" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 892

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب المصافحة عند اللقاء وبشاشة الوجه وتقبيل يد الرجل الصالح وتقبيل ولده شفقة ومعانقة القادم من سفر وكراهية الانحناء
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Shaking Hands When Greeting Someone

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "Do not belittle any good deed, even your meeting with your brother (Muslim) with a cheerful face."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "Do not belittle any good deed, even your meeting with your brother (Muslim) with a cheerful face."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي ذر، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال لي رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تحقرن من المعروف شيئاً، ولو أن تلقي أخاك بوجه طليق" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 893

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب المصافحة عند اللقاء وبشاشة الوجه وتقبيل يد الرجل الصالح وتقبيل ولده شفقة ومعانقة القادم من سفر وكراهية الانحناء
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Shaking Hands When Greeting Someone

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ kissed his grandson Hasan bin 'Ali in the presence of Aqra' bin Habis. Thereupon Aqra' remarked: "I have ten children and I have never kissed any one of them." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cast a glance upon him and said, "He who does not show mercy to others, will not be shown mercy."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ kissed his grandson Hasan bin 'Ali in the presence of Aqra' bin Habis. Thereupon Aqra' remarked: "I have ten children and I have never kissed any one of them." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cast a glance upon him and said, "He who does not show mercy to others, will not be shown mercy."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قبل النبي،ﷺى الله عليه وسلم ﷺ  الحسن بن على، رضي الله عنهما، فقال الأقرع بن حابس: إن لي عشرة من الولد ما قبلت منهم أحداً. فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "من لا يرحم لا يرحم!" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 894

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عيادة المريض
chapter.englishTitle: Visiting the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Bara' bin `Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 Messenger of Allah ﷺ has ordered us to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (of a dead believer), respond to the sneezer (i.e., by saying to him: Yarhamuk-Allah after he says: Al-hamdu lillah), to help those who vow to fulfill it, to help the oppressed, to accept the invitation extended by the inviter; and to promote greetings (i.e., saying As-Salamu `Alaikum).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Bara' bin `Azib (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
Messenger of Allah ﷺ has ordered us to visit the sick, to follow the funeral (of a dead believer), respond to the sneezer (i.e., by saying to him: Yarhamuk-Allah after he says: Al-hamdu lillah), to help those who vow to fulfill it, to help the oppressed, to accept the invitation extended by the inviter; and to promote greetings (i.e., saying As-Salamu `Alaikum).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن البراء بن عازب رضي الله عنهما قال: أمرنا رسول الله ﷺ  بعيادة المريض، واتباع الجنازة، وتشميت العاطس، وإبرار المقسم، ونصر المظلوم، وإجابة الداعى، وإفشاء السلام” ((متفق عليه))
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 894

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 895

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عيادة المريض
chapter.englishTitle: Visiting the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every Muslim has five rights over another Muslim (i.e., he has to perform five duties for another Muslim): to return the greetings, to visit the sick, to accompany funeral processions, to accept an invitation, to respond to the sneezer 
[i.e., to say: 'Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah bestow His Mercy on you),' when the sneezer praises Allah]
."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every Muslim has five rights over another Muslim (i.e., he has to perform five duties for another Muslim): to return the greetings, to visit the sick, to accompany funeral processions, to accept an invitation, to respond to the sneezer 
[i.e., to say: 'Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah bestow His Mercy on you),' when the sneezer praises Allah]
."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
boldSegments: [i.e., to say: 'Yarhamuk-Allah (may Allah bestow His Mercy on you),' when the sneezer praises Allah]
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "حق المسلم علي المسلم خمس: رد السلام، وعيادة المريض، واتباع الجنائز، وإجابة الدعوة، وتشميت العاطس” ((متفق عليه)) .
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 895

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 896

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عيادة المريض
chapter.englishTitle: Visiting the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah, the Exalted, and Glorious will say on the Day of Resurrection: 'O son of Adam, I was ill but you did not visit Me.' He would say: 'O my Rubb, how could I visit you and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' Thereupon He would say: 'Did you not know that such and such a slave of Mine was ill but you did not visit him? Did you not realize that if you had visited him (you would have known that I was aware of your visit to him, for which I would reward you) you would have found Me with him? O son of Adam, I asked food from you but you did not feed Me.' He would submit: 'My Rubb, how could I feed You and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' He would say: 'Did you not know that such and such a slave of Mine asked you for food but you did not feed him? Did you not realize that if you had fed him, you would certainly have found (its reward) with Me? O son of Adam, I asked water from you but you did not give it to Me.' He would say: 'My Rubb, how could I give You (water) and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' Thereupon He would say: 'Such and such a slave of Mine asked you for water to drink but you did not give it to him. Did you not realize that if you had given him to drink you would have found (its reward) with Me?"'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah, the Exalted, and Glorious will say on the Day of Resurrection: 'O son of Adam, I was ill but you did not visit Me.' He would say: 'O my Rubb, how could I visit you and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' Thereupon He would say: 'Did you not know that such and such a slave of Mine was ill but you did not visit him? Did you not realize that if you had visited him (you would have known that I was aware of your visit to him, for which I would reward you) you would have found Me with him? O son of Adam, I asked food from you but you did not feed Me.' He would submit: 'My Rubb, how could I feed You and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' He would say: 'Did you not know that such and such a slave of Mine asked you for food but you did not feed him? Did you not realize that if you had fed him, you would certainly have found (its reward) with Me? O son of Adam, I asked water from you but you did not give it to Me.' He would say: 'My Rubb, how could I give You (water) and You are the Rubb of the worlds?' Thereupon He would say: 'Such and such a slave of Mine asked you for water to drink but you did not give it to him. Did you not realize that if you had given him to drink you would have found (its reward) with Me?"'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قالك قال رسول الله ﷺ : "عن الله عزو جل يقول يوم القيامة: "يا ابن آدم مرضت فلم تعدني! قال: يا رب كيف أعودك وأنت رب العالمين؟! قال: أما علمت أن عبدي فلاناً مرض فلم تعده؟ أما علمت أنك لو عدته لوجدتني عنده؟ يا ابن آدم استطعمتك فلم تطعمني! قال: يا رب كيف أطعمك وأنت رب العالمين؟! قال: أما علمت أنه استطعمك عبدي فلان فلم تطعمه، أما علمت أنك لو أطعمته لوجدت ذلك عندي؟ يا ابن آدم استسقيتك فلم تسقني! قال: يارب كيف أسقيك وأنت رب العالمين؟! قال: استسقاك عبدي فلان فلم تسقه! أما علمت أنك لو سقيته لوجدت ذلك عندي؟" ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 896

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 897

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عيادة المريض
chapter.englishTitle: Visiting the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Visit the sick, feed the hungry, and (arrange for the) release of the captive.''

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Visit the sick, feed the hungry, and (arrange for the) release of the captive.''

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسي الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ ، “ عودوا المريض، وأطعموا الجائع، وفكوا العاني" ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 897

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 898
