chapter.arabicTitle: باب عيادة المريض
chapter.englishTitle: Visiting the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Thauban (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who visits his brother in Faith, will remain engaged in picking the fresh fruits from the garden of Jannah till he returns."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Thauban (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who visits his brother in Faith, will remain engaged in picking the fresh fruits from the garden of Jannah till he returns."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ثوبان، رضي الله عنه، عن النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم ، قال: "إن المسلم إذا عاد أخاه المسلم لم يزل في خرفة الجنة حتي يرجع" قيل: يا رسول الله وما خرفة الجنة؟ قال: "جناها” ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 898

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 899

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عيادة المريض
chapter.englishTitle: Visiting the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When a Muslim visits a sick Muslim at dawn, seventy thousand angels keep on praying for him till dusk. If he visits him in the evening, seventy thousand angels keep on praying for him till the morning; and he will have (his share of) reaped fruits in Jannah."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When a Muslim visits a sick Muslim at dawn, seventy thousand angels keep on praying for him till dusk. If he visits him in the evening, seventy thousand angels keep on praying for him till the morning; and he will have (his share of) reaped fruits in Jannah."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن علي رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "ما من مسلم يعود مسلماً غدوة إلا صلى  عليه سبعون ألف ملك حتي يمسي، وإن عاده عشية إلا صلى  عليه سبعون ألف ملك حتي يصبح، وكان له خريف في الجنة” ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
hadiths.notes: \u003cp\u003eCommentary (Darussalam): Both, this Hadith and the preceding one, lay stress on the virtue of visiting a sick person so as to obtain the Divine reward. The Hadith mentions \u0026quot;dawn\u0026quot; and \u0026quot;evening\u0026quot; to mean at all times, and not necessarily at those particular times.\u003c/p\u003e
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 899

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 900

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عيادة المريض
chapter.englishTitle: Visiting the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:

A young Jewish boy used to serve the Prophet ﷺ and he became sick. So the Prophet ﷺ went to visit him. He sat near his head and asked him to embrace Islam. The boy looked at his father, who was sitting there; the latter told him to obey Abu-l-Qasim (i.e., the Messenger of Allah ﷺ) and the boy embraced Islam. The Prophet ﷺ came out saying: "Praises be to Allah Who saved the boy from the Hell-fire."

[Al-Bukhari]
hadiths.narrator: Narrated Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A young Jewish boy used to serve the Prophet ﷺ and he became sick. So the Prophet ﷺ went to visit him. He sat near his head and asked him to embrace Islam. The boy looked at his father, who was sitting there; the latter told him to obey Abu-l-Qasim (i.e., the Messenger of Allah ﷺ) and the boy embraced Islam. The Prophet ﷺ came out saying: "Praises be to Allah Who saved the boy from the Hell-fire."

[Al-Bukhari]
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَنَسٍ رضى الله عنه قَالَ كَانَ غُلاَمٌ يَهُودِيٌّ يَخْدُمُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَمَرِضَ، فَأَتَاهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَعُودُهُ، فَقَعَدَ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ " أَسْلِمْ ". فَنَظَرَ إِلَى أَبِيهِ وَهْوَ عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَطِعْ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ. فَأَسْلَمَ، فَخَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَهْوَ يَقُولُ " الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَنْقَذَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ". ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 900

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 901

chapter.arabicTitle: باب عيادة المريض
chapter.englishTitle: Visiting the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
'A'isha (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:

When any person fell ill with a disease or he had any ailment or he had any injury, the Prophet ﷺ placed his forefinger upon the ground and then lifted it (Sufyan bin `Uyainah, the narrator, demonstrated this with his forefinger) by reciting the name of Allah. (and said): "The dust of our ground with the saliva of any one of us would serve as a means whereby our illness would be cured with the sanction of Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'A'isha (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
When any person fell ill with a disease or he had any ailment or he had any injury, the Prophet ﷺ placed his forefinger upon the ground and then lifted it (Sufyan bin `Uyainah, the narrator, demonstrated this with his forefinger) by reciting the name of Allah. (and said): "The dust of our ground with the saliva of any one of us would serve as a means whereby our illness would be cured with the sanction of Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى الإِنْسَانُ الشَّىْءَ مِنْهُ أَوْ كَانَتْ بِهِ قَرْحَةٌ أَوْ جَرْحٌ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِإِصْبَعِهِ هَكَذَا وَوَضَعَ سُفْيَانُ سَبَّابَتَهُ بِالأَرْضِ ثُمَّ رَفَعَهَا " بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا لِيُشْفَى بِهِ سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا " ((متفق عليه))
hadiths.notes: \u003cp\u003eTransliteration of duaa: Bismil-lahi, turbatu ardina, biriqati ba`dina, yushfa bihi saqimuni, bi \u0026#39;idhni Rabbina\u003c/p\u003e
hadiths.notesArabic: \u003cp\u003eبِاسْمِ اللَّهِ تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا لِيُشْفَى بِهِ سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا\u003c/p\u003e
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 901

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 902

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 When the Prophet ﷺ visited any ailing member of his family, he would touch the sick person with his right hand and would supplicate: "Allahumma Rabban-nasi, adhhibil-ba'sa, washfi, Antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifaan la yughadiru saqaman 
[O Allah! the Rubb of mankind! Remove this disease and cure (him or her)! You are the Great Curer. There is no cure but through You, which leaves behind no disease]
."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
When the Prophet ﷺ visited any ailing member of his family, he would touch the sick person with his right hand and would supplicate: "Allahumma Rabban-nasi, adhhibil-ba'sa, washfi, Antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifaan la yughadiru saqaman 
[O Allah! the Rubb of mankind! Remove this disease and cure (him or her)! You are the Great Curer. There is no cure but through You, which leaves behind no disease]
."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
boldSegments: [O Allah! the Rubb of mankind! Remove this disease and cure (him or her)! You are the Great Curer. There is no cure but through You, which leaves behind no disease]
hadiths.arabic: وعنها أن النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  كان يعود بعض أهله يمسح بيده اليمني ويقول: "أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءٌ لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا” ((متفق عليه))
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 902

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 903

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I said to Thabit (May Allah had Mercy upon him) Should I not perform Ruqyah (i.e., recite supplication or Quranic Ayat and blow) over you, such supplication as was practised by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said: "Please do so." Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) supplicated: "Allahumma Rabban-nasi, mudh-hibal-ba'si, ishfi Antash-Shafi, la shafiya illa Anta, shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman 
[O Allah! the Rubb of mankind! Take away this disease and cure (him or her). You are the Curer. There is no cure except through You. Cure (him or her), a cure that leaves no disease]
."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I said to Thabit (May Allah had Mercy upon him) Should I not perform Ruqyah (i.e., recite supplication or Quranic Ayat and blow) over you, such supplication as was practised by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said: "Please do so." Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) supplicated: "Allahumma Rabban-nasi, mudh-hibal-ba'si, ishfi Antash-Shafi, la shafiya illa Anta, shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman 
[O Allah! the Rubb of mankind! Take away this disease and cure (him or her). You are the Curer. There is no cure except through You. Cure (him or her), a cure that leaves no disease]
."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
boldSegments: [O Allah! the Rubb of mankind! Take away this disease and cure (him or her). You are the Curer. There is no cure except through You. Cure (him or her), a cure that leaves no disease]
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس، رضي الله عنه أنه قال لثابت رحمه الله: ألا أرقيك برقية رسول الله ﷺ ؟ قال: بلى، قال: اللهم رب الناس، مذهب البأس، اشف أنت الشافي، لا شافي إلا أنت، شفاءً لا يغادر سقماً” ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 903

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 904

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited me during my illness and supplicated, "O Allah! Cure Sa'd. O Allah! Cure Sa'd. O' Allah! Cure Sa'd."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited me during my illness and supplicated, "O Allah! Cure Sa'd. O Allah! Cure Sa'd. O' Allah! Cure Sa'd."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سعد بن أبي وقاص، رضي الله عنه قال: عادني رسول الله ﷺ  فقال: "اللهم اشف سعداً، اللهم اشف سعداً، اللهم اشف سعداً" ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 904

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 905

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu 'Abdullah bin Abul-'as (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a pain I had in my body. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Place your hand where you feel pain and say: 'Bismillah (With the Name of Allah)' three times; and then repeat seven times: 'A'udhu bi'izzatillahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa 'uhadhiru (I seek refuge with Allah and with His Power from the evil that afflicts me and that which I apprehend)."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu 'Abdullah bin Abul-'as (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I complained to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a pain I had in my body. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Place your hand where you feel pain and say: 'Bismillah (With the Name of Allah)' three times; and then repeat seven times: 'A'udhu bi'izzatillahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa 'uhadhiru (I seek refuge with Allah and with His Power from the evil that afflicts me and that which I apprehend)."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي عبد الله عثمان بن أبي العاص رضي الله عنه أنه شكي إلي رسول الله ﷺ  وجعاً يجده في جسده فقال رسول الله ﷺ  "ضع يدك علي الذي تألم من جسدك وقل: بسم الله -ثلاثاً- وقل سبع مرات: أعوذ بعزة الله وقدرته من شر ما أجد وأحاذر” ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 905

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 906

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who visits a sick person who is not on the point of death and supplicates seven times: As'alullahal-'Azima Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azimi, an yashfiyaka (I beseech Allah the Great, the Rubb of the Great Throne, to heal you), Allah will certainly heal him from that sickness."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who visits a sick person who is not on the point of death and supplicates seven times: As'alullahal-'Azima Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azimi, an yashfiyaka (I beseech Allah the Great, the Rubb of the Great Throne, to heal you), Allah will certainly heal him from that sickness."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس، رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي،ﷺى الله عليه وسلم ﷺ ، قال: "من عاد مريضاً لم يحضره أجله، فقال عنده سبع مرات: أسأل الله العظيم رب العرش العظيم أن يشفيك: إلا عافاه الله من ذلك المرض" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن، وقال الحاكم: حديث صحيح علي شرط البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 906

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 907

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ visited a bedouin who was sick. Whenever he visited an ailing person, he would say, "La ba'sa, tahurun in sha' Allah 
[No harm, (it will be a) purification (from sins), if Allah wills]
."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ visited a bedouin who was sick. Whenever he visited an ailing person, he would say, "La ba'sa, tahurun in sha' Allah 
[No harm, (it will be a) purification (from sins), if Allah wills]
."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
boldSegments: [No harm, (it will be a) purification (from sins), if Allah wills]
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلم ﷺ ، دخل علي أعرأبي يعوده وكان إذا دخل علي من يعوده قال: "لا بأس، طهور إن شاء الله" ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 907

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 908

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Jibril (Gabriel) came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Muhammad ﷺ! Do you feel sick?" He ﷺ said, "Yes." Jibril supplicated thus (i.e., he performed Ruqyah): "Bismillahi arqika, min kulli shay'in yu'dhika, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni hasidi, Allahu yashfika, bismillahi arqika. 
[With the Name of Allah. I recite over you (to cleanse you) from all that troubles you, and from every harmful mischief and from the evil of the eyes of an envier. Allah will cure you; and with the Name of Allah, I recite over you]
."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Jibril (Gabriel) came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Muhammad ﷺ! Do you feel sick?" He ﷺ said, "Yes." Jibril supplicated thus (i.e., he performed Ruqyah): "Bismillahi arqika, min kulli shay'in yu'dhika, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni hasidi, Allahu yashfika, bismillahi arqika. 
[With the Name of Allah. I recite over you (to cleanse you) from all that troubles you, and from every harmful mischief and from the evil of the eyes of an envier. Allah will cure you; and with the Name of Allah, I recite over you]
."

[Muslim]
.

hadiths.arabic: وعن أبيسعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه أن جبريل أتي النبي،ﷺى الله عليه وسلم ﷺ ، فقال: يا محمد اشتكيت؟ قال: "نعم" قال: بسم الله أرقيك ، من كل شيء يؤذيك، ومن شر كل نفس أو عين حاسد، الله يشفيك، بسم الله أرقيك” ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 908

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 909

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a person says: 'La ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar (There is no true god except Allah and Allah is Greatest)', his Rubb responds to him and affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, and I am the Greatest.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu Wahdahu la sharika Lahu (There is no true god except Allah, the One, He has no partner).' Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I. I have no partner.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu Lahul mulku wa Lahul-hamdu (the sovereignty belongs to Him and all the praise is due to Him).' He (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, Mine is the praise and to Me belongs the sovereignty.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Billah (There is no true god except Allah, and there is no might and power but with Allah).' He (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, and there is no might and power but with Me."' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ added, "He who recites this during his illness and dies, will not be touched by the Fire (Hell)."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri and Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a person says: 'La ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar (There is no true god except Allah and Allah is Greatest)', his Rubb responds to him and affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, and I am the Greatest.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu Wahdahu la sharika Lahu (There is no true god except Allah, the One, He has no partner).' Allah (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I. I have no partner.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu Lahul mulku wa Lahul-hamdu (the sovereignty belongs to Him and all the praise is due to Him).' He (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, Mine is the praise and to Me belongs the sovereignty.' When he says: 'La ilaha illallahu wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Billah (There is no true god except Allah, and there is no might and power but with Allah).' He (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) affirms: '(Yes!) There is no true god except I, and there is no might and power but with Me."' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ added, "He who recites this during his illness and dies, will not be touched by the Fire (Hell)."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري وأبي هريرة، رضي الله عنهما، أنهما شهدا علي رسول الله ، ﷺ ، أنه قال: "من قال: لا إله إلا الله والله اكبر، صدقه ربه، فقال: لا إله إلا أنا وأنا أكبر. وإذا قال: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، قال: يقول: لا إله إلا أنا وحدي لا شريك لي. وإذا قال: لا إله إلا الله له الملك وله الحمد، قال: لا إله إلا أنا لي الملك ولي الحمد. وإذا قال: لا إله إلا الله ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله، قال: لا إله إلا أنا ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بي" وكان يقول: "من قالها في مرضه ثم مات لم تطعمه النار" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن))
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 909

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 910

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يدعي به للمريض
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication for the Sick

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn `Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 When `Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) came out after visiting the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during his last illness, the people asked: "How is Messenger of Allah ﷺ, O Abul-Hasan?'' He replied: "Praise be to Allah, he ﷺ is feeling better.''

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn `Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
When `Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) came out after visiting the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during his last illness, the people asked: "How is Messenger of Allah ﷺ, O Abul-Hasan?'' He replied: "Praise be to Allah, he ﷺ is feeling better.''

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عباس، رضي الله عنهما، أن علي بن أبي طالب، رضي الله عنه خرج من عند رسول الله ﷺ ، في وجعه الذي توفي فيه فقال الناس: يا أبا الحسن كيف أصبح رسول الله ﷺ ؟ قال: أصبح بحمد الله بارئاً" ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 910

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 911

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب سؤال أهل المريض عن حاله
chapter.englishTitle: Recommendation of Inquiring the Family Members of the Patient about his Condition

hadiths.englishRaw:
`Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 While the Prophet ﷺ was reclining against me (during his last illness) I heard him saying: "Allahumma-ghfir li, warhamni, wa alhiqni bir Rafiqil-A`la (O Allah, forgive me, bestow Your Mercy on me and let me join with the exalted companions.''

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: `Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
While the Prophet ﷺ was reclining against me (during his last illness) I heard him saying: "Allahumma-ghfir li, warhamni, wa alhiqni bir Rafiqil-A`la (O Allah, forgive me, bestow Your Mercy on me and let me join with the exalted companions.''

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: سمعت النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  وهو مستند إلي يقول: اللهم اغفر لي وارحمني وألحقني بالرفيق الأعلى" ((متفق عليه)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 911

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 912

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله من آيس من حياته
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication when one is disappointed about his Life

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was at the point of death. He had a drinking bowl with water in it. He would dip his hand into the bowl, and wipe his face. Then he would supplicate, "O Allah! Help me over pangs and agony of death."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was at the point of death. He had a drinking bowl with water in it. He would dip his hand into the bowl, and wipe his face. Then he would supplicate, "O Allah! Help me over pangs and agony of death."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها قالت: رأيت رسول الله ﷺ  وهو بالموت عنده قدح فيه ماء وهو يدخل يده في القدح، ثم يمسح وجهه بالماء، ثم يقول: "اللهم أعني علي غمرات الموت وسكرات الموت" ((رواه الترمذي)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 912

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 913

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله من آيس من حياته
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication when one is disappointed about his Life

hadiths.englishRaw:
`Imran bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 A woman belonging to the Juhainah tribe came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ after having conceived from Zina. She submitted: "O Messenger of Allah! I am liable to Hadd (punishment ordained by Allah), so execute it.'' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ called her guardian and said, "Treat her well and bring her to me after delivery.'' He acted accordingly. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded to tie her clothes firmly around her and then stoned her to death. He ﷺ then offered funeral prayer for her.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: `Imran bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
A woman belonging to the Juhainah tribe came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ after having conceived from Zina. She submitted: "O Messenger of Allah! I am liable to Hadd (punishment ordained by Allah), so execute it.'' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ called her guardian and said, "Treat her well and bring her to me after delivery.'' He acted accordingly. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded to tie her clothes firmly around her and then stoned her to death. He ﷺ then offered funeral prayer for her.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عمران بن الحصين رضي الله عنهما أن امراة من جهينة أتت النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  وهي حبلي من الزنا، فقالت: يا رسول الله، أصبت حداً فأقمه علي ، فدعا رسول الله ﷺ  وليها، فقال: "أحسن إليها فإذا وضعت فأتني بها” ففعل، فأمر بها النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم ، فشدت عليها ثيابها، ثم أمر بها فرجمت، ثم صلى  عليها" ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 913

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 914

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب وصية أهل المريض ومن يخدمه بالإحسان إليه والصبر على من يشق من أمره
chapter.englishTitle: Instructing the Patient's family to be kind to him - Consoling the Patients and showing kindness to one Facing Death SentenceInstructing the Patient's family to be kind to him - Consoling the Patients and showing kindness to one Facing Death Sentence

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas`ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I visited the Prophet ({ﷺ) while he was suffering. I said: "(O Messenger of Allah!) You suffer too much.'' He said, "Yes, I suffer as much as two men of you.''

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas`ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I visited the Prophet ({ﷺ) while he was suffering. I said: "(O Messenger of Allah!) You suffer too much.'' He said, "Yes, I suffer as much as two men of you.''

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن بن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: دخلت علي النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  وهو يوعك، فمسسته، فقلت: إنك لتوعك وعكاً شديداً فقال: "إني أوعك كما يوعك رجلان منكم" ((متفق عليه))
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 914

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 915

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز قول المريض: أنا وجع أو شديد الوجع أو موعوك، أو وارأساه ونحو ذلك، وبيان أنه لا كراهة في ذلك إذا لم يكن علي التسخط وإظهار الجزع
chapter.englishTitle: Permissibility of expressing feelings of agony in Serious Illness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to visit me when I had a severe pain. I said: "I am suffering from such trouble as you are observing. I am a wealthy man and the only heir of mine is my daughter." (Then Sa'd narrated the whole incident).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to visit me when I had a severe pain. I said: "I am suffering from such trouble as you are observing. I am a wealthy man and the only heir of mine is my daughter." (Then Sa'd narrated the whole incident).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سعد بن أبي وقاص رضي الله عنه قال: جاءني رسول الله ﷺ  يعودني من وجع اشتد بي، فقلت: بلغ بي ما ترى، وأنا ذو مال، ولايرثني إلا ابنتي، وذكر الحديث" ((متفق عليه)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 915

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 916

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز قول المريض: أنا وجع أو شديد الوجع أو موعوك، أو وارأساه ونحو ذلك، وبيان أنه لا كراهة في ذلك إذا لم يكن علي التسخط وإظهار الجزع
chapter.englishTitle: Permissibility of expressing feelings of agony in Serious Illness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Qasim bin Muhammad reported 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 "Oh, my head." (It was hurting due to pain.) Thereupon the Prophet ﷺ said, "Rather it is I who says: 'Oh, my headache."' (Then Al-Qasim narrated the complete narration).

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Qasim bin Muhammad reported 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
"Oh, my head." (It was hurting due to pain.) Thereupon the Prophet ﷺ said, "Rather it is I who says: 'Oh, my headache."' (Then Al-Qasim narrated the complete narration).

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن القاسم بن محمد قال: قالت عائشة رضي الله عنها: وا رأساه فقال النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم : "بل أنا وا رأساه" وذكر الحديث" ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 916

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 917

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز قول المريض: أنا وجع أو شديد الوجع أو موعوك، أو وارأساه ونحو ذلك، وبيان أنه لا كراهة في ذلك إذا لم يكن علي التسخط وإظهار الجزع
chapter.englishTitle: Permissibility of expressing feelings of agony in Serious Illness

hadiths.englishRaw:
Mu`adh bin Jabal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He whose last words are: `La ilaha illallah' (There is no true god except Allah) will enter Jannah.''

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Mu`adh bin Jabal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He whose last words are: `La ilaha illallah' (There is no true god except Allah) will enter Jannah.''

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن معاذ رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ  : "من كان آخر كلامه لا إله إلا الله دخل الجنة" ((رواه أبو داود والحاكم وقال: صحيح الإسناد)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 917

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 918

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تلقين المحتضر لا إله إلا الله
chapter.englishTitle: Helping a dying Person to Pronounce 'La Ilaha Illahllah'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Exhort your dying men to recite: 'La ilaha illallah' (There is no true god except Allah)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Exhort your dying men to recite: 'La ilaha illallah' (There is no true god except Allah)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ  : “لقنوا موتاكم لا إله إلا الله" ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 918

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 919

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تلقين المحتضر لا إله إلا الله
chapter.englishTitle: Helping a dying Person to Pronounce 'La Ilaha Illahllah'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) when his eyes were open soon after he died. He closed them (the eyes) for him and said, "When the soul is taken away, the sight follows it." Some members of his family began to weep. He ﷺ said: "Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for the angels say 'amin' to what you say." Then he said, "O Allah! Forgive Abu Salamah, raise his rank among those who are rightly-guided and grant him a successor from his descendants who remain behind. Grant him pardon and us, too. O Rubb of the worlds. Make his grave spacious for him and give him light in it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) when his eyes were open soon after he died. He closed them (the eyes) for him and said, "When the soul is taken away, the sight follows it." Some members of his family began to weep. He ﷺ said: "Do not supplicate for yourselves anything but good, for the angels say 'amin' to what you say." Then he said, "O Allah! Forgive Abu Salamah, raise his rank among those who are rightly-guided and grant him a successor from his descendants who remain behind. Grant him pardon and us, too. O Rubb of the worlds. Make his grave spacious for him and give him light in it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت: دخل رسول الله ﷺ  علي أبي سلمه وقد شق بصره فأغمضه، ثم قال: "إن الروح إذا قبض، تبعه البصر" فضج ناس من أهله، فقال: "لا تدعو علي أنفسكم إلا بخير فإن الملائكة يؤمنون علي ما تقولون” ثم قال: “اللهم اغفر لأبي سلمه، وارفع درجته في المهديين،واخلفه في عقبه في الغابرين، واغفر لنا وله يا رب العالمين، وافسح له في قبره، ونور له فيه" ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 919

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 920

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقوله بعد تغميض الميت
chapter.englishTitle: Supplication to be made soon after a Person's Death

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her):
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you visit a sick or a dying person, you should utter good words because the angels say `Amin' at what you say.'' She added: When Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) died, I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, Abu Salamah has died." He ﷺ directed me to supplicate thus: "Allahummaghfir li wa lahu, wa a`qibni minhu `uqba hasanatan [O Allah, forgive me and him, and bestow upon me a better future (give me a better substitute)]." So I supplicated as he directed, and Allah gave me a man who was better for me than Abu Salamah (i.e., the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ). (The Prophet ﷺ married Umm Salamah afterwards.)

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her):
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you visit a sick or a dying person, you should utter good words because the angels say `Amin' at what you say.'' She added: When Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) died, I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah, Abu Salamah has died." He ﷺ directed me to supplicate thus: "Allahummaghfir li wa lahu, wa a`qibni minhu `uqba hasanatan [O Allah, forgive me and him, and bestow upon me a better future (give me a better substitute)]." So I supplicated as he directed, and Allah gave me a man who was better for me than Abu Salamah (i.e., the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ). (The Prophet ﷺ married Umm Salamah afterwards.)

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: -عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "إذا حضرتم المريض، أو الميت، فقولوا خيرا، فإن الملائكة يؤمنون علي ما تقولون، قالت: فلما مات أبو سلمة، أتيت النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  فقلت: يا رسول الله، إن أبا سلمة قد مات، قال: “قولي: اللهم اغفر لي وله، واعقبني منه عقبة حسنة" فقلت: فأعقبني الله من هو خير لي منه: محمداً ﷺ ."
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 920

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 921

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقال عند الميت وما يقول من مات له ميت
chapter.englishTitle: Good Words to be Uttered before a dying Person and his Family

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When a person suffers from a calamity and utters: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un. Allahumma ujurni fi musibati, wakhluf li khairan minha (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. O Allah! Compensate me in my affliction, recompense my loss and give me something better in exchange for it), then Allah surely compensates him with reward and better substitute." Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: When Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) died, I repeated the same supplication as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had commanded me (to do). So Allah bestowed upon me a better substitute than him (I was married to Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ).

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When a person suffers from a calamity and utters: 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un. Allahumma ujurni fi musibati, wakhluf li khairan minha (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return. O Allah! Compensate me in my affliction, recompense my loss and give me something better in exchange for it), then Allah surely compensates him with reward and better substitute." Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: When Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with him) died, I repeated the same supplication as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had commanded me (to do). So Allah bestowed upon me a better substitute than him (I was married to Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ).

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها قالت: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول:"ما من عبد تصيبه مصيبه، فيقول إن لله وإنا إليه راجعون: اللهم آجرني في مصيبتي، واخلف لي خيرا منها، إلا آجره الله تعالي في مصيبته واخلف له خيراً منها. قالت: فلما توفي أبو سلمة، قلت كما أمرني رسول الله ﷺ  ، فاخلف الله خيراص منه رسول الله ﷺ “ ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 921

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 922

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقال عند الميت وما يقول من مات له ميت
chapter.englishTitle: Good Words to be Uttered before a dying Person and his Family

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a man's child dies, Allah, the Exalted, asks His angels, 'Have you taken out the life of the child of My slave?' and they reply in the affirmative. He (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) then asks, 'Have you taken the fruit of his heart?' and they reply in the affirmative. Thereupon He asks, 'What did my slave say?' They say: 'He praised You and said: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return).' Allah says: 'Build a house for my slave in Jannah and name it Baitul-Hamd (the House of Praise)."'

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a man's child dies, Allah, the Exalted, asks His angels, 'Have you taken out the life of the child of My slave?' and they reply in the affirmative. He (Subhanahu-wa-Taala) then asks, 'Have you taken the fruit of his heart?' and they reply in the affirmative. Thereupon He asks, 'What did my slave say?' They say: 'He praised You and said: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un (We belong to Allah and to Him we shall return).' Allah says: 'Build a house for my slave in Jannah and name it Baitul-Hamd (the House of Praise)."'

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسي رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: إذا مات ولد العبد، قال الله تعالي لملائكته: قبضتم ولد عبدي، فيقولون: نعم، فيقول: قبضتم ثمرة فؤاده، فيقولون: نعم. فيقول: ماذا قال عبدي، فيقولون: حمدك واسترجع، فيقول الله تعالى: ابنوا لعبدي بيتاً في الجنة، وسموه بيت الحمد" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 922

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 923

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقال عند الميت وما يقول من مات له ميت
chapter.englishTitle: Good Words to be Uttered before a dying Person and his Family

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I have no reward except Jannah for a believing slave of Mine who shows patience and anticipates My reward when I take away his favourite one from the inhabitants of the world."'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I have no reward except Jannah for a believing slave of Mine who shows patience and anticipates My reward when I take away his favourite one from the inhabitants of the world."'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: يقول الله تعالى: ما لعبدي المؤمن عندي جزاء إذا قبضت صفيه من أهل الدنيا، ثم احتسبه إلا الجنه" ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 923

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 924

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقال عند الميت وما يقول من مات له ميت
chapter.englishTitle: Good Words to be Uttered before a dying Person and his Family

hadiths.englishRaw:
Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 A daughter of the Prophet ﷺ sent a message to him that her son was at his last breath, and requested him to come to her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent back the informer saying: "To Allah belongs what He takes and what He gives, and everything has a limited period (in this world). So ask her to endure patiently, and expect the reward of Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
A daughter of the Prophet ﷺ sent a message to him that her son was at his last breath, and requested him to come to her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent back the informer saying: "To Allah belongs what He takes and what He gives, and everything has a limited period (in this world). So ask her to endure patiently, and expect the reward of Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما قال: أرسلت إحدي بنات النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  إليه تدعوه وتخبره أن صبياً لها -أو ابناً- في الموت فقال للرسول: ارجع إليها فأخبرها أن لله تعالي ما أخذ وله ما أعطى، وكل شئ عنده بأجل مسمى، فمرها، فلتصبر ولتحتسب” وذكر تمام الحديث" ((متفق عليه)) .
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 924

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 925

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقال عند الميت وما يقول من مات له ميت
chapter.englishTitle: Good Words to be Uttered before a dying Person and his Family

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ began to weep. When his Companions saw this, their tears also started flowing. He ﷺ said, "Do you not hear, Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but punishes or bestows mercy for the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ began to weep. When his Companions saw this, their tears also started flowing. He ﷺ said, "Do you not hear, Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but punishes or bestows mercy for the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ  عاد سعد بن عباده ومعه عبد الرحمن بن عوف، وسعد بن أبي وقاص، وعبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنهم، فبكي رسول الله ﷺ ، فلما رأي القوم بكاء رسول الله ﷺ  ، بكوا ؛ فقال: “ألا تسمعون؟ إن الله لا يعذب بدمع العين، ولا بحزن القلب، ولكن بهذا أو يرحم" وأشار إلا لسانه" ((متفق عليه)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 925

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 926

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز البكاء علي الميت بغير ندب ولا نياحة
chapter.englishTitle: The Ruling of crying and wailing over a Dead Person

hadiths.englishRaw:
Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A grandson (child of the daughter) of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was presented to him while the child was at his last breath. Tears began to flow from the eyes of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Sa'd said to him: "What is this, O Messenger of Allah?" He ﷺ said, "It is mercy which Allah has placed in the hearts of his salves. Allah bestows His Mercy on the merciful among His slaves."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Usamah bin Zaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A grandson (child of the daughter) of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was presented to him while the child was at his last breath. Tears began to flow from the eyes of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Sa'd said to him: "What is this, O Messenger of Allah?" He ﷺ said, "It is mercy which Allah has placed in the hearts of his salves. Allah bestows His Mercy on the merciful among His slaves."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أسامة بن زيد رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ  رفع إليه ابن ابنته وهو في الموت، ففاض عينا رسول الله ﷺ  فقال له سعد: ما هذا يا رسول الله؟! قال: "هذه رحمة جعلها الله تعالي في قلوب عباده الرحماء" ((متفق عليه)) .
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 926

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 927

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز البكاء علي الميت بغير ندب ولا نياحة
chapter.englishTitle: The Ruling of crying and wailing over a Dead Person

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to his son Ibrahim (May Allah be pleased with him) when he was breathing his last. The eyes of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ began shedding tears. 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf (May Allah be pleased with him) said, "O Messenger of Allah, you too weep?" He ﷺ said, "O Ibn 'Auf! It is mercy." Then he began to weep and said, "The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Rubb. O Ibrahim! Indeed we are grieved by your departure."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to his son Ibrahim (May Allah be pleased with him) when he was breathing his last. The eyes of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ began shedding tears. 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf (May Allah be pleased with him) said, "O Messenger of Allah, you too weep?" He ﷺ said, "O Ibn 'Auf! It is mercy." Then he began to weep and said, "The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Rubb. O Ibrahim! Indeed we are grieved by your departure."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  دخل علي ابنه إبراهيم رضي الله عنه وهو يجود بنفسه فجعلت عينا رسول الله ﷺ  تذرفان . فقال له عبد الرحمن بن عوف: وأنت يا رسول الله ؟! فقال: “يا ابن عوف إنها رحمة” ثم أتبعها بأخرى، فقال:”إن العين تدمع والقلب يحزن ، ولا نقول إلا ما يرضي ربنا، وإنا بفراقك يا إبراهيم لمحزونون". ((رواه البخاري، وروي مسلم بعضه)). والأحاديث في الباب كثيرة في الصحيح مشهورة والله أعلم.
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 927

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 928

chapter.arabicTitle: باب جواز البكاء علي الميت بغير ندب ولا نياحة
chapter.englishTitle: The Ruling of crying and wailing over a Dead Person

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Rafi` Aslam (May Allah be pleased with him), the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who washes a dead body and conceals what he notices of physical defects, he will be forgiven forty times.''

[Al-Hakim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Rafi` Aslam (May Allah be pleased with him), the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who washes a dead body and conceals what he notices of physical defects, he will be forgiven forty times.''

[Al-Hakim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي رافع أسلم مولي رسول الله ﷺ  أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: " من غسل ميتاً فكتم عليه ، غفر الله له أربعين مرة" ((رواه الحاكم وقال صحيح علي شرط مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 928

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 929

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الكف عن ما يري من الميت من مكروه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Disclosing the Physical defects of the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever follows the funeral procession and offers the funeral prayer for it, will get a reward equal to one Qirat, and whoever attends it till burial, will get a reward equal to two Qirat.'' It was asked, "What are two Qirat?'' He ﷺ replied, "Equal to two huge mountains."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever follows the funeral procession and offers the funeral prayer for it, will get a reward equal to one Qirat, and whoever attends it till burial, will get a reward equal to two Qirat.'' It was asked, "What are two Qirat?'' He ﷺ replied, "Equal to two huge mountains."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : “من شهد الجنازة حتي يصلى  عليها، فله قيراط ، ومن شهدها حتي تدفن، فله قيراطان" قيل: وما القيراطان؟ قال: “مثل الجبلين العظيمين” ((متفق عليه)) .
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 929

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 930

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الصلاة علي الميت وتشييعه وحضور دفنه وكراهة اتباع النساء الجنائز
chapter.englishTitle: Participation in Funeral Prayer and Procession and the dislike of Women Participating in the Funeral Procession

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whosoever attends the funeral of a Muslim believing and hoping for the reward from Allah and remains with it until the prayer is offered over it and the burial is completed, he will return with a reward of two Qirat; each Qirat is equivalent to Mount Uhud; and whosoever offers his prayer over it and returns before its burial, he will come back with one Qirat."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whosoever attends the funeral of a Muslim believing and hoping for the reward from Allah and remains with it until the prayer is offered over it and the burial is completed, he will return with a reward of two Qirat; each Qirat is equivalent to Mount Uhud; and whosoever offers his prayer over it and returns before its burial, he will come back with one Qirat."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "من اتبع جنازة مسلم إيماناً واحتساباً، وكان معه حتي يصلى  عليها ويفرغ من دفنها، فإنه يرجع من الأجر بقيراطين كل قيراط مثل أحدٍ، ومن صلى  عليها، ثم رجع قبل أن تدفن ، فإنه يرجع بقيراط” ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 930

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 931

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الصلاة علي الميت وتشييعه وحضور دفنه وكراهة اتباع النساء الجنائز
chapter.englishTitle: Participation in Funeral Prayer and Procession and the dislike of Women Participating in the Funeral Procession

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Atiyyah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 We (womenfolk) were prohibited from accompanying a funeral procession, but we were not compelled (not to do so).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Atiyyah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
We (womenfolk) were prohibited from accompanying a funeral procession, but we were not compelled (not to do so).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم عطية رضي الله عنها قالت: نهينا عن اتباع الجنائز، ولم يعزم علينا" ((متفق عليه)) . "ومعناه " ولم يشدد في النهي كما يشدد في المحرمات.
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 931

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 932

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الصلاة علي الميت وتشييعه وحضور دفنه وكراهة اتباع النساء الجنائز
chapter.englishTitle: Participation in Funeral Prayer and Procession and the dislike of Women Participating in the Funeral Procession

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a group of Muslims numbering a hundred perform funeral prayer over a dead person, and all of them ask Allah's forgiveness for him, their prayer for him will be accepted."

[Muslim]
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a group of Muslims numbering a hundred perform funeral prayer over a dead person, and all of them ask Allah's forgiveness for him, their prayer for him will be accepted."

[Muslim]
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها، قالت: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "ما من ميت يصلي عليه أمة من المسلمين يبلغون مائة كلهم يشفعون له إلا شفعوا فيه" (رواه مسلم).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 932

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 933

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تكثير المصلين على الجنازة وجعل صفوفهم ثلاثة فأكثر
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Participation in Funeral Prayers in Large Numbers and Formation of Three Rows or More

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a Muslim dies and forty people, who do not associate anything with Allah in worship, participate in the funeral prayer over him, Allah will accept their intercession for him."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a Muslim dies and forty people, who do not associate anything with Allah in worship, participate in the funeral prayer over him, Allah will accept their intercession for him."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباسٍ رضي الله عنهما ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رسول الله يقول : « مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَمُوتُ ، فَيقومُ عَلَى جَنَازَتِهِ أرْبَعُونَ رَجُلاً لا يُشْرِكُونَ بِاللهِ شَيْئاً ، إِلا شَفَّعَهُمُ اللهُ فِيهِ » . رواه مسلم .
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 933

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 934

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تكثير المصلين على الجنازة وجعل صفوفهم ثلاثة فأكثر
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Participation in Funeral Prayers in Large Numbers and Formation of Three Rows or More

hadiths.englishRaw:
Marthad bin 'Abdullah Al-Yazni reported:
 When Malik bin Hubairah (May Allah be pleased with him) offered a funeral prayer and found a small number of participants, he would divide them into three rows and would say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If three rows of men offer funeral prayer over anyone, his entry into Jannah will become certain."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Marthad bin 'Abdullah Al-Yazni reported:
hadiths.body:
When Malik bin Hubairah (May Allah be pleased with him) offered a funeral prayer and found a small number of participants, he would divide them into three rows and would say that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If three rows of men offer funeral prayer over anyone, his entry into Jannah will become certain."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن مرثد بن عبد الله اليزني قال: كان مالك بن هبيرة رضي الله عنه إذا صلى  علي الجنازة ، فتقال الناس عليها، جزأهم عليها ثلاثة أجزاء، ثم قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : “من صلى  عليه ثلاثة صفوف، فقد أوجب “ ((رواه أبو دواد، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 934

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 935

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب تكثير المصلين على الجنازة وجعل صفوفهم ثلاثة فأكثر
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Participation in Funeral Prayers in Large Numbers and Formation of Three Rows or More

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu 'Abdur-Rahman 'Auf bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered a funeral prayer and I memorized his supplication. He ﷺ prayed: "Allahummaghfir lahu, warhamhu, wa 'afihi, wa'fu 'anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi' mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-baradi, wa naqqihi minal-khataya, kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danasi, wa abdilhu daran khairan min darihi, wa ahlan khairan min ahlihi, wa zawjan khairan min zawjihi, wa adkhilhul-Jannata, wa a'idh-hu min 'adhabil- qabri, wa min 'adhabin-nar 
[if the dead person is a woman, one should change the ending of certain words in this supplication from hu to ha]
 (O Allah! Forgive him, bestow mercy upon him, pardon him, accord him a noble provision and make his grave spacious, wash him with water, snow and hail, purify him from sins as You have purified the white garment from soiling, give him a better abode in place of his present one, and a better family in exchange of his present one, and a better spouse in place of his present wife; admit him to Jannah and protect from the trial in the grave and punishment in the Hell)." (After hearing this supplication of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu' Abdur-Rahman 'Auf bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I wished I had been that dead man.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu 'Abdur-Rahman 'Auf bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ offered a funeral prayer and I memorized his supplication. He ﷺ prayed: "Allahummaghfir lahu, warhamhu, wa 'afihi, wa'fu 'anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi' mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-baradi, wa naqqihi minal-khataya, kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danasi, wa abdilhu daran khairan min darihi, wa ahlan khairan min ahlihi, wa zawjan khairan min zawjihi, wa adkhilhul-Jannata, wa a'idh-hu min 'adhabil- qabri, wa min 'adhabin-nar 
[if the dead person is a woman, one should change the ending of certain words in this supplication from hu to ha]
 (O Allah! Forgive him, bestow mercy upon him, pardon him, accord him a noble provision and make his grave spacious, wash him with water, snow and hail, purify him from sins as You have purified the white garment from soiling, give him a better abode in place of his present one, and a better family in exchange of his present one, and a better spouse in place of his present wife; admit him to Jannah and protect from the trial in the grave and punishment in the Hell)." (After hearing this supplication of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abu' Abdur-Rahman 'Auf bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I wished I had been that dead man.

[Muslim]
.
boldSegments: [if the dead person is a woman, one should change the ending of certain words in this supplication from hu to ha]
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي عبد الرحمن بن عوف بن مالك رضي الله عنه قال: صلى  رسول الله ﷺ  علي جنازة، فحفظت من دعائه وهو يقول: "اللهم اغفر له، وارحمه، وعافه، واعف عنه، وأكرم نزله، ووسع مدخله واغسله بالماء والثلج والبرد ونقه من الخطايا، كما نقيت الثوب الأبيض من الدنس، وأبدله داراً خيراً من داره، وأهلاً خيراً من أهله، وزوجاً خيراً من زوجه، وأدخله الجنة، وأعذه من عذاب القبر، ومن عذاب النار” حتي تمنين أن أكون ذلك الميت. ((رواه مسلم)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 935

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 936

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقرأ في صلاة الجنازة
chapter.englishTitle: Supplications in Funeral Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah, Abu Qatadah, and Abu Ibrahim Al-Ash-hali (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ offered a funeral prayer and said: "Allahummaghfir lihaiyina wa maiyitina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina. Allahumma man ahyaiytahu minna, fa'ahyihi 'alal-Islam, wa man tawaffaiytahu minna, fatawaffahu 'alal-Iman. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu, wa la taftinna ba'dahu (O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, our present and our absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, whosoever of us You keep alive, keep him alive (faithful) to Islam, and whosoever of us You cause to die, let him die having Iman. O Allah, do not deprive us of our reward (for being patient) and do not subject us to trials after his death."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah, Abu Qatadah, and Abu Ibrahim Al-Ash-hali (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ offered a funeral prayer and said: "Allahummaghfir lihaiyina wa maiyitina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dhakarina wa unthana, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina. Allahumma man ahyaiytahu minna, fa'ahyihi 'alal-Islam, wa man tawaffaiytahu minna, fatawaffahu 'alal-Iman. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu, wa la taftinna ba'dahu (O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, our present and our absent, our young and our old, our male and our female. O Allah, whosoever of us You keep alive, keep him alive (faithful) to Islam, and whosoever of us You cause to die, let him die having Iman. O Allah, do not deprive us of our reward (for being patient) and do not subject us to trials after his death."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة وأبي قتادة، وأبي إبراهيم الأشهلي عن أبيه -وأبوه صحابي- رضي الله عنهم، عن النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  أنه صلى  علي جنازة فقال:"اللهم اغفر لحينا وميتنا، وصغيرنا وكبيرنا، وذكرنا وأنثانا، وشاهدنا وغائبنا. اللهم من أحييته منا، فأحيه علي الإسلام، ومن توفيته منا، فتوفه علي الإيمان؛ اللهم لا تحرمنا أجره، ولا تفتنا بعده" ((رواه الترمذي)) من رواية أبي هريرة وأبو هريرة صحيح والأشهلي، ورواه أبو داود من رواية أبي هريرة وأبي قتادة. قال الحاكم: حديث أبي هريرة صحيح علي شرط البخاري ومسلم، قال الترمذي: قال البخاري: أصح روايات هذا الحديث رواية الأشهلي. قال البخاري: وأصح شيء في الباب حديث عوف بن مالك.
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 936

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 937

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقرأ في صلاة الجنازة
chapter.englishTitle: Supplications in Funeral Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "When you pray over the dead, make a sincere supplication for him."

[Abu Dawud and Ibn Majah]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "When you pray over the dead, make a sincere supplication for him."

[Abu Dawud and Ibn Majah]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: “إذا صليتم علي الميت، فأخلصوا له الدعاء" ((رواه أبو داود)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 937

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 938

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقرأ في صلاة الجنازة
chapter.englishTitle: Supplications in Funeral Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ supplicated in course of funeral prayer: "Allahumma Anta Rabbuha, wa Anta khalaqtaha, wa Anta hadaytaha lil-Islam, wa Anta qabadta ruhaha, wa Anta a'lamu bisirriha wa 'alaniyyatiha, ji'naka shufa'a'a lahu 
[if the dead person is a man, or laha if the dead person is a woman]
, faghfir lahu 
[or laha, if it is a woman]
 (O Allah, You are its Rubb; You created it; You guided it to Islam; You have taken its life back and You know best its insight and outer condition. We have come as intercessors, so forgive him)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ supplicated in course of funeral prayer: "Allahumma Anta Rabbuha, wa Anta khalaqtaha, wa Anta hadaytaha lil-Islam, wa Anta qabadta ruhaha, wa Anta a'lamu bisirriha wa 'alaniyyatiha, ji'naka shufa'a'a lahu 
[if the dead person is a man, or laha if the dead person is a woman]
, faghfir lahu 
[or laha, if it is a woman]
 (O Allah, You are its Rubb; You created it; You guided it to Islam; You have taken its life back and You know best its insight and outer condition. We have come as intercessors, so forgive him)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
boldSegments: [if the dead person is a man, or laha if the dead person is a woman]
[or laha, if it is a woman]
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  في الصلاة علي الجنازة: “اللهم أنت ربها، وأنت خلقتها، وأنت هديتها للإسلام، وأنت قبضت روحها، وأنت أعلم بسرها وعلانيتها، جئناك شفعاء له، فاغفر له” ((رواه أبو داود)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 938

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 939

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقرأ في صلاة الجنازة
chapter.englishTitle: Supplications in Funeral Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led the funeral prayer of a Muslim man in our presence, and I heard him saying "Allahumma inna 
[name of the dead person]
 fi dhimmatika wa habli jiwarika, faqihi fitnatal- qabri; wa 'adhaban-Nari, wa Anta ahlul-wafa'i wal-hamdi; Allahumma faghfir lahu warhamhu, innaka Antal-Ghafur-ur-Rahim 
[If the dead person is a woman, one can change hu in some words here with ha]
 
[O Allah, (so-and-so son of so-and-so) is in Your Protection and inside the surroundings of Your Refuge. Safeguard him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Hell. You keep Your Promise and You deserve to be praised. O Allah! Forgive him and be merciful to him. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful]
."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led the funeral prayer of a Muslim man in our presence, and I heard him saying "Allahumma inna 
[name of the dead person]
 fi dhimmatika wa habli jiwarika, faqihi fitnatal- qabri; wa 'adhaban-Nari, wa Anta ahlul-wafa'i wal-hamdi; Allahumma faghfir lahu warhamhu, innaka Antal-Ghafur-ur-Rahim 
[If the dead person is a woman, one can change hu in some words here with ha]
 
[O Allah, (so-and-so son of so-and-so) is in Your Protection and inside the surroundings of Your Refuge. Safeguard him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Hell. You keep Your Promise and You deserve to be praised. O Allah! Forgive him and be merciful to him. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful]
."

[Abu Dawud]
.
boldSegments: [If the dead person is a woman, one can change hu in some words here with ha]

[O Allah, (so-and-so son of so-and-so) is in Your Protection and inside the surroundings of Your Refuge. Safeguard him from the trial of the grave and the punishment of the Hell. You keep Your Promise and You deserve to be praised. O Allah! Forgive him and be merciful to him. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful]
hadiths.arabic: وعن واثلة بن الأسقع رضي الله عنه قال: صلى  بنا رسول الله ﷺ  علي رجل من المسلمين، فسمعته يقول: "اللهم إن فلان ابن فلان في ذمتك وحبل جوارك، فقه فتنة القبر، وعذاب النار، وأنت أهل الوفاء والحمد؛ اللهم اغفر له وارحمه، إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم" ((رواه أبو داود)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 939

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 940

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقرأ في صلاة الجنازة
chapter.englishTitle: Supplications in Funeral Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 While offering the funeral prayer of one of his daughters, he recited four Takbir, and after the fourth Takbir he continued standing for a time equal to an interval between two Takbir, praying for her and seeking Allah's forgiveness for her." Then he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do so."

Another narration is: He (Abdullah) recited four Takbir and remained standing in prayer for some time till we thought that he would recite the fifth Takbir. Then he gave Salam on the right and on the left. When he turned aside, we asked him about it. He replied: "I would add nothing to what I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ doing," or he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do so."

[Al-Hakim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
While offering the funeral prayer of one of his daughters, he recited four Takbir, and after the fourth Takbir he continued standing for a time equal to an interval between two Takbir, praying for her and seeking Allah's forgiveness for her." Then he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do so."

Another narration is: He (Abdullah) recited four Takbir and remained standing in prayer for some time till we thought that he would recite the fifth Takbir. Then he gave Salam on the right and on the left. When he turned aside, we asked him about it. He replied: "I would add nothing to what I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ doing," or he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to do so."

[Al-Hakim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن أبي أوفي رضي الله عنهما أنه كبر علي جنازة ابنة له أربع تكبيرات، فقام بعد الرابعة كقدر ما بين التكبيرتين يستغفر لها ويدعو، ثم قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ  يصنع هكذا. وفي رواية:  كبر أربعاً، فمكث ساعة حتي ظننت أنه سيكبر خمساً، ثم سلم عن يمينه وعن شماله. فلما انصرف قلنا له: ما هذا؟ فقال: إني لا أزيدكم علي ما رأيت رسول الله ﷺ  يصنع، أو: هكذا صنع رسول الله ﷺ   ((رواه الحاكم وقال: حديث صحيح)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 940

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 941

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يقرأ في صلاة الجنازة
chapter.englishTitle: Supplications in Funeral Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "Hurry up with the dead body (for its burial), for if it is pious, you are speeding it to goodness and if it is otherwise, you are laying an evil off your necks."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "Hurry up with the dead body (for its burial), for if it is pious, you are speeding it to goodness and if it is otherwise, you are laying an evil off your necks."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  قال: "أسرعوا بالجنازة، فإن تك صالحة، فخير تقدمونها إليه، وإن تك سوي ذلك، فشر تضعونه عن رقابكم" ((متفق عليه)).  ((وفي رواية لمسلم: "فخير تقدمونها عليه)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 941

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 942

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الإسراع بالجنازة
chapter.englishTitle: Haste in Burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "When a dead body is placed on a bier and men carry it on their shoulders, if he was a pious man, it (corpse) says: 'Take me in haste.' But if he was not righteous, it says to its bearers: 'Woe to it. Where are you taking it?' Everything except man hears its voice. Had a human being heard its voice, he would have surely fallen into swoon."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "When a dead body is placed on a bier and men carry it on their shoulders, if he was a pious man, it (corpse) says: 'Take me in haste.' But if he was not righteous, it says to its bearers: 'Woe to it. Where are you taking it?' Everything except man hears its voice. Had a human being heard its voice, he would have surely fallen into swoon."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه قال: كان النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  يقول: "إذا وضعت الجنازة، فاحتملها الرجال علي أعناقهم، فإن كانت صالحة، قال: قدموني، وإن كانت غير صالحة، قالت لأهلها: يا ويلها أين تذهبون بها؟ يسمع صوتها كل شيء إلا الأنسان، ولو سمع الأنسان لصعق” ((رواه البخاري)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 942

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 943

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الإسراع بالجنازة
chapter.englishTitle: Haste in Burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The soul of the deceased believer remains pending on account of the debt till it (the debt) is repayed."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The soul of the deceased believer remains pending on account of the debt till it (the debt) is repayed."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه، عن النبي ﷺى الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم الله عليه وسلم  قال: "نفس المؤمن معلقة بدينه حتي يقضي عنه" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 943

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 944

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تعجيل قضاء الدين عن الميت والمبادرة إلى تجهيزه إلا أن يموت فجأة فيترك حتي يتيقن موته
chapter.englishTitle: About Speedy Repayment of the Debts of a Deceased Person and Preparation of Burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hussain bin Wahwah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 When Talhah bin Al-Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) fell ill, the Prophet ﷺ came to visit him and said, "Verily, I think that Talhah is about to die. So inform me when he is dead and make haste (in burying him). Indeed, it is improper for the corpse of a Muslim to be kept lying unburied among his family members."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Hussain bin Wahwah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
When Talhah bin Al-Bara' (May Allah be pleased with him) fell ill, the Prophet ﷺ came to visit him and said, "Verily, I think that Talhah is about to die. So inform me when he is dead and make haste (in burying him). Indeed, it is improper for the corpse of a Muslim to be kept lying unburied among his family members."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن حصين بن وحوح رضي الله عنه أن طلحة بن البراء رضي الله عنه مرض، فأتاه النبي ﷺ الله عليه وسلمى الله عليه وسلم  الله عليه وسلم  يعوده فقال: إني لا أري طلحة إلا قد حدث فيه الموت فآذوني به وعجلوا به، فإنه لا ينبغي لجيفة مسلم أن تحبس بين ظهراني أهله" ((رواه أبو داود)).
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 944

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 945

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تعجيل قضاء الدين عن الميت والمبادرة إلى تجهيزه إلا أن يموت فجأة فيترك حتي يتيقن موته
chapter.englishTitle: About Speedy Repayment of the Debts of a Deceased Person and Preparation of Burial

hadiths.englishRaw:
`Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 We were accompanying a funeral procession in Baqi` Al-Gharqad (graveyard in Al-Madinah) when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ proceeded towards us and sat down. We sat around him. He had a small stick in his hand. He was bending down his head and scraping the ground with the stick. He said, "There is none among you but has a place assigned for him either in the Jannah or in the Hell." The Companions said: "O Messenger of Allah, should we not depend upon what has been written for us (and give up doing good deeds)?'' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Carry on doing good deeds. Every one will find it easy to do such deeds (as will lead him to his destined place) for which he has been created."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: `Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
We were accompanying a funeral procession in Baqi` Al-Gharqad (graveyard in Al-Madinah) when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ proceeded towards us and sat down. We sat around him. He had a small stick in his hand. He was bending down his head and scraping the ground with the stick. He said, "There is none among you but has a place assigned for him either in the Jannah or in the Hell." The Companions said: "O Messenger of Allah, should we not depend upon what has been written for us (and give up doing good deeds)?'' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Carry on doing good deeds. Every one will find it easy to do such deeds (as will lead him to his destined place) for which he has been created."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن علي رضي الله عنه قال: كنا في جنازة في بقيع الغرقد فأتانا رسول الله ﷺ  فقعد، وقعدنا حوله ومعه مخصرة فنكس وجعل ينكت بمخصرته، ثم قال: ما منكم من أحد إلا وقد كتب مقعده من النار ومقعده من الجنة” فقالوا: يا رسول الله أفلا نتكل علي كتابنا؟ فقال: "اعملوا فكل ميسر لما خلق له" وذكر تمام الحديث. ((متفق عليه))
references: Book of Visiting the Sick, Hadith 945
