hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I performed along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ two Rak'ah of optional prayers before Zuhr and two after the Zuhr (noon prayer), and two after the Friday prayer, and two after the Maghrib (evening) prayer, and two after the 'Isha' (night) prayer."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، قال: صليت مع رسول الله ﷺ، ركعتين قبل الظهر وركعتين بعدها، وركعتين بعد الجمعة، وركعتين بعد المغرب، وركعتين بعد العشاء" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1099

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السنن الراتبة مع الفرائض وبيان أقلها وأكملها وما بينهما
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Optional Prayers (Sunnah Mu'akkadah) along with the Obligatory Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Mughaffal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is a Salat (prayer) between every Adhan and Iqamah; there is a Salat between every Adhan and Iqamah." (While saying the same for the) third time (he ﷺ added), "It is for him who desires (to perform it)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is a Salat (prayer) between every Adhan and Iqamah; there is a Salat between every Adhan and Iqamah." (While saying the same for the) third time (he ﷺ added), "It is for him who desires (to perform it)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن مغفل، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "بين كل أذانين صلاة، بين كل أذانين صلاة، بين كل أذانين صلاة" وقال في الثالثة: "لمن شاء" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1100

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السنن الراتبة مع الفرائض وبيان أقلها وأكملها وما بينهما
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Optional Prayers (Sunnah Mu'akkadah) along with the Obligatory Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ never omitted four Rak'ah prayer before the Zuhr prayer and two Rak'ah prayers before dawn (Fajr) prayer.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ never omitted four Rak'ah prayer before the Zuhr prayer and two Rak'ah prayers before dawn (Fajr) prayer.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها، أن النبي ﷺ كان لا يدع أربعًا قبل الظهر، وركعتين قبل الغداة ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1101

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تأكيد ركعتي سنة الصبح:
chapter.englishTitle: Emphasis on Performing two Rak'ah Sunnah before Dawn (Fajr) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ did not attach more importance to any Nawafil prayer than the two Rak'ah of prayer before dawn (Fajr) prayer.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ did not attach more importance to any Nawafil prayer than the two Rak'ah of prayer before dawn (Fajr) prayer.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها قالت: لم يكن النبي، ﷺ على شيء من النوافل أشد تعاهدًا منه على ركعتي الفجر". ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1102

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تأكيد ركعتي سنة الصبح:
chapter.englishTitle: Emphasis on Performing two Rak'ah Sunnah before Dawn (Fajr) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The two Rak'ah before the dawn (Fajr) prayer are better than this world and all it contains."

[Muslim]

Another narration goes: "The two Rak'ah before the dawn (Fajr) prayer are dearer to me than the whole world."
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The two Rak'ah before the dawn (Fajr) prayer are better than this world and all it contains."

[Muslim]

Another narration goes: "The two Rak'ah before the dawn (Fajr) prayer are dearer to me than the whole world."
hadiths.arabic: وعنها عن النبي ﷺ قال: "ركعتا الفجر خير من الدنيا وما فيها" ((رواه مسلم)). وفي رواية لهما لأحب إلي من الدنيا جميعًا.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1103

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تأكيد ركعتي سنة الصبح:
chapter.englishTitle: Emphasis on Performing two Rak'ah Sunnah before Dawn (Fajr) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu 'Abdullah Bilal bin Rabah (May Allah be pleased with him) the Mu'adhdhin of Messenger of Allah ﷺ reported:
 I went to inform the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the time of the dawn (Fajr) prayer, and 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) kept me busy and began to ask me about something till the day grew bright. Then I got up and informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ of the time of Salat. I informed him again but he did not came out immediately to lead As- Salat. When he came out, he led As-Salat. I said to him: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) kept me busy and thus diverted my attention by asking about something and the morning grew bright. You also came out late. Upon that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I was engaged in performing two Rak'ah of Fajr prayer." Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him)said: "O Messenger of Allah! You delayed As-Salat so long as the morning grew bright." He ﷺ replied, "Even if the morning had become brighter than it had, I would have performed two Rak'ah of prayer in an excellent manner."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu 'Abdullah Bilal bin Rabah (May Allah be pleased with him) the Mu'adhdhin of Messenger of Allah ﷺ reported:
hadiths.body:
I went to inform the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the time of the dawn (Fajr) prayer, and 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) kept me busy and began to ask me about something till the day grew bright. Then I got up and informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ of the time of Salat. I informed him again but he did not came out immediately to lead As- Salat. When he came out, he led As-Salat. I said to him: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) kept me busy and thus diverted my attention by asking about something and the morning grew bright. You also came out late. Upon that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I was engaged in performing two Rak'ah of Fajr prayer." Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him)said: "O Messenger of Allah! You delayed As-Salat so long as the morning grew bright." He ﷺ replied, "Even if the morning had become brighter than it had, I would have performed two Rak'ah of prayer in an excellent manner."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي عبد الله بلال بن رباح، رضي الله عنه مؤذن رسول الله ﷺ أنه أتى رسول الله ﷺ ليؤذنه بصلاة الغداة، فشغلت عائشة بلالا بأمر سألته عنه، حتى أصبح جدا فقام بلال فآذنه بالصلاة، وتابع أذانه، فلم يخرج رسول الله ﷺ فلما خرج صلى بالناس، فأخبره أن عائشة شغلته بأمر سألته عنه حتى أصبح جدا، وأنه أبطأ عليه بالخروج، فقال -يعني النبي ﷺ -: "إني كنت ركعت ركعتي الفجر" فقال: يا رسول الله إنك أصبحت جدا؟ فقال: "لو أصبحت أكثر مما أصبحت، لركعتهما وأحسنتهما، وأجملتهما". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1104

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تأكيد ركعتي سنة الصبح:
chapter.englishTitle: Emphasis on Performing two Rak'ah Sunnah before Dawn (Fajr) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ used to perform two Rak'ah short prayer between the Adhan (call to prayer) and the Iqamah of the dawn (Fajr) prayers.

[Al- Bukhari and Muslim]

In another narration, 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform two supererogatory Rak'ah prayer of Fajr and make them so short in duration that I used to think whether he ﷺ had recited Surat Al-Fatihah (in it) or not.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

In the narration of Muslim, 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to hear the Adhan (of Fajr prayer) he would perform two supererogatory Rak'ah prayer and would make them short.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ used to perform two Rak'ah short prayer between the Adhan (call to prayer) and the Iqamah of the dawn (Fajr) prayers.

[Al- Bukhari and Muslim]

In another narration, 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform two supererogatory Rak'ah prayer of Fajr and make them so short in duration that I used to think whether he ﷺ had recited Surat Al-Fatihah (in it) or not.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

In the narration of Muslim, 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to hear the Adhan (of Fajr prayer) he would perform two supererogatory Rak'ah prayer and would make them short.
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن رسول الله ﷺ، كان يصلي ركعتين خفيفتين بين النداء والإقامة من صلاة الصبح". ((متفق عليه))  وفي رواية لهما: يصلي ركعتي الفجر، إذا سمع الأذان فيخففهما حتى أقول هل قرأ فيهمابأم القرآن!. وفي رواية لمسلم: كان يصلى ركعتيي الفجر إذا سمع الأذان ويخففهما.وفي رواية: إذا طلع الفجر.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1105

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تخفيف ركعتي الفجر وبيان ما يقرأ فيهما، وبيان وقتهما.
chapter.englishTitle: Briefness to be Adopted in Performing the two Rak'ah Sunnah before Fajr Prayer, their time and the Surah to recite in them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hafsah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform two short Rak'ah prayer when it was dawn and the Mu'adhdhin had called Adhan (for the Fajr prayer).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Hafsah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform two short Rak'ah prayer when it was dawn and the Mu'adhdhin had called Adhan (for the Fajr prayer).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن حفصة رضي الله عنها أن رسول الله ﷺ كان إذا أذن المؤذن للصبح، وبدا الصبح صلى ركعتين خفيفتين. ((متفق عليه)). وفي رواية لمسلم: كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا طلع الفجر لا يصلى إلا ركعتين خفيفتين.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1106

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تخفيف ركعتي الفجر وبيان ما يقرأ فيهما، وبيان وقتهما.
chapter.englishTitle: Briefness to be Adopted in Performing the two Rak'ah Sunnah before Fajr Prayer, their time and the Surah to recite in them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform his optional night prayers at night, two Rak'ah followed by two Rak'ah, and at the end he would conclude with an odd Rak'ah (Witr). Then he would perform two Rak'ah prayer before the dawn (Fajr) prayer after hearing the Adhan, and he would make them so brief as if he could hear the Iqamah being called.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform his optional night prayers at night, two Rak'ah followed by two Rak'ah, and at the end he would conclude with an odd Rak'ah (Witr). Then he would perform two Rak'ah prayer before the dawn (Fajr) prayer after hearing the Adhan, and he would make them so brief as if he could hear the Iqamah being called.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ يصلي من الليل مثنى مثنى، ويوتر بركعة من آخر الليل، ويصلي الركعتين قبل صلاة الغداة، وكأن الأذان بأذنيه". ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1107

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تخفيف ركعتي الفجر وبيان ما يقرأ فيهما، وبيان وقتهما.
chapter.englishTitle: Briefness to be Adopted in Performing the two Rak'ah Sunnah before Fajr Prayer, their time and the Surah to recite in them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite during the two Rak'ah of Fajr prayer: "Say (O Muslims): We believe in Allah and that which has been sent down to us..." (2:136) which is in Surat Al-Baqarah in the first Rak'ah and the Verse: "We believe in Allah, and bear witness that we are Muslims (i.e., we submit to Allah." (3:52) in the second Rak'ah.

According to another narration, he ﷺ recited from Surat Al-'Imran the Verses: "Come to a word which is just between us and you..." (3:64).

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to recite during the two Rak'ah of Fajr prayer: "Say (O Muslims): We believe in Allah and that which has been sent down to us..." (2:136) which is in Surat Al-Baqarah in the first Rak'ah and the Verse: "We believe in Allah, and bear witness that we are Muslims (i.e., we submit to Allah." (3:52) in the second Rak'ah.

According to another narration, he ﷺ recited from Surat Al-'Imran the Verses: "Come to a word which is just between us and you..." (3:64).

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ، كان يقرأ في ركعتي الفجر في الأولى منهما: {قولوا آمنا بالله وما أنزل إلينا} الآية التي في البقرة، وفي الآخرة منهما: {آمنا بالله واشهد بأنا مسلمون}. وفي رواية: في الآخرة التي في آل عمران: {تعالوا إلى كلمة سواء بيننا وبينكم}. ((رواهما مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1108

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تخفيف ركعتي الفجر وبيان ما يقرأ فيهما، وبيان وقتهما.
chapter.englishTitle: Briefness to be Adopted in Performing the two Rak'ah Sunnah before Fajr Prayer, their time and the Surah to recite in them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited in the two supererogatory Rak'ah of the Fajr prayer Surat Al-Kafirun (No. 109) 
[in the first Rak'ah]
, and Surat Al-Ikhlas (No. 112) 
[in the second Rak'ah]
.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited in the two supererogatory Rak'ah of the Fajr prayer Surat Al-Kafirun (No. 109) 
[in the first Rak'ah]
, and Surat Al-Ikhlas (No. 112) 
[in the second Rak'ah]
.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ، قرأ في ركعتي الفجر: {قل يا أيها الكافرون} و{قل هو الله أحد} ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1109

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تخفيف ركعتي الفجر وبيان ما يقرأ فيهما، وبيان وقتهما.
chapter.englishTitle: Briefness to be Adopted in Performing the two Rak'ah Sunnah before Fajr Prayer, their time and the Surah to recite in them

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I observed the Prophet ﷺ for one month reciting in the two supererogatory Rak'ah of the Fajr prayer Surat Al-Kafirun (No. 109) 
[in the first Rak'ah]
, and Surat Al-Ikhlas (No. 112) 
[in the second Rak'ah]
.

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I observed the Prophet ﷺ for one month reciting in the two supererogatory Rak'ah of the Fajr prayer Surat Al-Kafirun (No. 109) 
[in the first Rak'ah]
, and Surat Al-Ikhlas (No. 112) 
[in the second Rak'ah]
.

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، قال رمقت النبي ﷺ شهرًا يقرأ في الركعتين قبل الفجر: {قل يا أيها الكافرون}، و: {قل هو الله أحد}. ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1110

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تخفيف ركعتي الفجر وبيان ما يقرأ فيهما، وبيان وقتهما.
chapter.englishTitle: Briefness to be Adopted in Performing the two Rak'ah Sunnah before Fajr Prayer, their time and the Surah to recite in them

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 When the Prophet ﷺ had performed two Rak'ah before the Fajr prayer, he would lie down on his right side.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
When the Prophet ﷺ had performed two Rak'ah before the Fajr prayer, he would lie down on his right side.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: كان النبي ﷺ إذا صلى ركعتي الفجر، اضطجع على شقه الأيمن. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1111

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الاضطجاع بعد ركعتي الفجر على جنبه الأيمن والحث عليه سواء كان تهجد بالليل أم لا.
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Lying down on one's right side after the Sunnah of Fajr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 When the Prophet ﷺ finished the 'Isha prayer, he would perform eleven Rak'ah before the Fajr prayer, concluding each two Rak'ah with Taslim (i.e., saying As-Salamu 'Alaikum) and observing the Witr (odd) at the end. When the Mu'adhdhin finished proclaiming Adhan for the Fajr prayer and it was dawn, he would rise and perform two short Rak'ah, and then would lie down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin came to (inform) him about Iqamah.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
When the Prophet ﷺ finished the 'Isha prayer, he would perform eleven Rak'ah before the Fajr prayer, concluding each two Rak'ah with Taslim (i.e., saying As-Salamu 'Alaikum) and observing the Witr (odd) at the end. When the Mu'adhdhin finished proclaiming Adhan for the Fajr prayer and it was dawn, he would rise and perform two short Rak'ah, and then would lie down on his right side till the Mu'adhdhin came to (inform) him about Iqamah.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها قالت: كان النبي ﷺ يصلي فيما بين أن يفرغ من صلاة العشاء إلى الفجر إحدى عشرة ركعة يسلم بين كل ركعتين، ويوتر بواحدة، فإذا سكت المؤذن من صلاة الفجر، وتبين له الفجر وجاء المؤذن، قام فركع ركعتين خفيفتين، ثم اضطجع على شقه الأيمن هكذا حتى يأتيه المؤذن للإقامة". ((رواه مسلم)). (15)

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1112

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الاضطجاع بعد ركعتي الفجر على جنبه الأيمن والحث عليه سواء كان تهجد بالليل أم لا.
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Lying down on one's right side after the Sunnah of Fajr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When anyone of you has performed two of Sunnah before the Fajr prayer, he should lie down on his right side."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When anyone of you has performed two of Sunnah before the Fajr prayer, he should lie down on his right side."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "إذا صلى أحدكم ركعتي الفجر، فليضطجع على يمينه". ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي بأسانيد صحيحة. قال الترمذي: حديث حسن صحيح.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1113

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب الاضطجاع بعد ركعتي الفجر على جنبه الأيمن والحث عليه سواء كان تهجد بالليل أم لا.
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Lying down on one's right side after the Sunnah of Fajr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I performed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ two Rak'ah before and two after Zuhr prayers.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I performed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ two Rak'ah before and two after Zuhr prayers.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: صليت مع رسول الله ﷺ ركعتين قبل الظهر، وركعتين بعدها. ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1114

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة الظهر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of Zuhr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ never omitted four Rak'ah supererogatory prayer before Zuhr prayers.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ never omitted four Rak'ah supererogatory prayer before Zuhr prayers.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن النبي ﷺ كان لا يدع أربعًا قبل الظهر. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1115

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة الظهر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of Zuhr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 Whenever the Prophet ﷺ stayed in my house, he would perform four Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer) before Zuhr prayer. Then he would go out and lead Salat. He ﷺ would then come back and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer). He would lead the Maghrib prayer and come back and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer). When he ﷺ had led the 'Isha' prayer, he would enter the house and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer).

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
Whenever the Prophet ﷺ stayed in my house, he would perform four Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer) before Zuhr prayer. Then he would go out and lead Salat. He ﷺ would then come back and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer). He would lead the Maghrib prayer and come back and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer). When he ﷺ had led the 'Isha' prayer, he would enter the house and perform two Rak'ah (supererogatory prayer).

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنها قالت: كان النبي ﷺ يصلي في بيتي قبل الظهر أربعًا، ثم يخرج فيصلي بالناس، ثم يدخل فيصلي ركعتين، وكان يصلي بالناس المغرب ثم يدخل بيتي فيصلي ركعتين، ويصلي بالناس العشاء، ويدخل بيتي، فيصلي ركعتين. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1116

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة الظهر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of Zuhr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Habibah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever observes the practice of performing four Rak'ah before Zuhr prayer and four after the Zuhr prayer, Allah will shield him against the Fire (of Hell).

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Habibah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever observes the practice of performing four Rak'ah before Zuhr prayer and four after the Zuhr prayer, Allah will shield him against the Fire (of Hell).

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم حبيبة رضي الله عنها قالت: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "من حافظ على أربع ركعات قبل الظهر وأربع بعدها، حرمه الله على النار". ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي)). وقال حديث حسن صحيح.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1117

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة الظهر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of Zuhr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin As-Sa'ib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform four Rak'ah prayer after the declining of the sun before Zuhr prayer and would say, "This is an hour at which the gates of heaven are opened, and I like that my good deeds should rise to heaven at that time."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin As-Sa'ib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform four Rak'ah prayer after the declining of the sun before Zuhr prayer and would say, "This is an hour at which the gates of heaven are opened, and I like that my good deeds should rise to heaven at that time."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن السائب، رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ كان يصلى أربعًا بعد أن تزول الشمس قبل الظهر، وقال "إنها ساعة تفتح فيها أبواب السماء، فأحب أن يصعد لي فيها عمل صالح" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1118

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة الظهر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of Zuhr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 If the Prophet ﷺ could not perform four Rak'ah before Zuhr prayer, he would perform them after it (i.e., after the obligatory prayer).

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
If the Prophet ﷺ could not perform four Rak'ah before Zuhr prayer, he would perform them after it (i.e., after the obligatory prayer).

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن النبي ﷺ كان إذا لم يصلِ أربعًا قبل الظهر، صلاهن بعدها. ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1119

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة الظهر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of Zuhr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ used to perform four Rak'ah before the 'Asr prayer, separating them with Taslim (i.e., offering blessings) on the favourite angels who are near Allah's proximity and the Muslims and the believers who come after them.

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ used to perform four Rak'ah before the 'Asr prayer, separating them with Taslim (i.e., offering blessings) on the favourite angels who are near Allah's proximity and the Muslims and the believers who come after them.

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن علي بن أبي طالب، رضي الله عنه قال كان النبي ﷺ يصلي قلب العصر أربع ركعات يفصل بينهن بالتسليم على الملائكة المقربين ومن تبعهم من المسلمين والمؤمنين. رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1120

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة العصر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of the 'Asr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "May Allah have mercy on a man who performs four Rak'ah before the 'Asr prayer."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "May Allah have mercy on a man who performs four Rak'ah before the 'Asr prayer."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي ﷺ، قال: "رحم الله امرءًا صلى قبل العصر أربعًا". ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1121

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة العصر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of the 'Asr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ used to perform two Rak'ah before the 'Asr prayer.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ used to perform two Rak'ah before the 'Asr prayer.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ كان يصلي قبل العصر ركعتين." ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1122

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة العصر:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of the 'Asr Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Mughaffal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Perform two Rak'ah before Maghrib prayer." He ﷺ repeated it twice; when repeating it for the third time he added: "He who may so wish."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Mughaffal (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Perform two Rak'ah before Maghrib prayer." He ﷺ repeated it twice; when repeating it for the third time he added: "He who may so wish."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن مغفل، رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "صلوا قبل المغرب" قال في الثالثة: "لمن شاء" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1123
hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I saw the principal Companions of Messenger of Allah ﷺ rushing to the pillars (of the mosque) to perform two Rak'ah prayers behind them before the Maghrib prayer.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw the principal Companions of Messenger of Allah ﷺ rushing to the pillars (of the mosque) to perform two Rak'ah prayers behind them before the Maghrib prayer.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: - وعن أنس، رضي الله عنه قال: لقد رأيت كبار أصحاب رسول الله ﷺ يبتدرون السواري عند المغرب. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1124
hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 In the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we used to perform two Rak'ah (optional prayer) after sunset before the Maghrib prayer. It was asked: "Did Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform them?" He replied: "He saw us performing it, but he neither ordered us to perform them nor did he forbid us from doing so."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
In the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, we used to perform two Rak'ah (optional prayer) after sunset before the Maghrib prayer. It was asked: "Did Messenger of Allah ﷺ perform them?" He replied: "He saw us performing it, but he neither ordered us to perform them nor did he forbid us from doing so."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: كنا نصلي على عهد رسول الله ﷺ ركعتين بعد غروب الشمس قبل المغرب، فقيل: أكان رسول الله ﷺ صلاها؟ قال: كان يرانا نصليهما فلم يأمرنا ولم ينهنا". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1125
hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 When we were in Al-Madinah, the moment the Mu'adhdhin finished the Adhan of the Maghrib prayer, the people hastened to the pillars of the mosque and performed two Rak'ah prayer behind them. A stranger coming into the mosque would think that the obligatory prayer had already been performed because of the number of people performing them.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
When we were in Al-Madinah, the moment the Mu'adhdhin finished the Adhan of the Maghrib prayer, the people hastened to the pillars of the mosque and performed two Rak'ah prayer behind them. A stranger coming into the mosque would think that the obligatory prayer had already been performed because of the number of people performing them.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: كنا بالمدينة فإذا أذن المؤذن لصلاة المغرب ابتدروا السواري، فركعوا ركعتين، حتى إن الرجل الغريب ليدخل المسجد فيحسب أن الصلاة قد صليت من كثرة من يصليهما. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1126
hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone of you performs the Friday prayer, he should perform four Rak'ah (Sunnah) after it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone of you performs the Friday prayer, he should perform four Rak'ah (Sunnah) after it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "إذا صلى أحدكم الجمعة، فليصلِ بعدها أربعًا". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1127

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة الجمعة:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ would not perform any Salat (in the mosque) after the Friday prayer till he had returned to his house. He would then perform two Rak'ah there.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ would not perform any Salat (in the mosque) after the Friday prayer till he had returned to his house. He would then perform two Rak'ah there.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، أن النبي ﷺ كان لا يصلي بعد الجمعة حتى ينصرف، فيصلي ركعتين في بيته. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1128

chapter.arabicTitle: باب سنة الجمعة:
chapter.englishTitle: Sunnah of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Zaid bin Thabit (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "O people! perform your (voluntary) Salat (prayers) in your homes because the best Salat of a man is the one he performs at home, except the obligatory Salat."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Zaid bin Thabit (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "O people! perform your (voluntary) Salat (prayers) in your homes because the best Salat of a man is the one he performs at home, except the obligatory Salat."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن زيد بن ثابت رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ قال: "صلوا أيها الناس في بيوتكم، فإن الصلاة صلاة المرء في بيته إلا المكتوبة". ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1129

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب جعل النوافل في البيت سواء الراتبة وغيرها، والأمر بالتحول للنافلة من موضع الفريضة أو الفصل بينهما بكلام
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of offering Nawfil (Voluntary or Optional) Prayers at Home

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Observe part of the 
[Nawafil (voluntary)]
 Salat (prayers) in your homes. Do not turn your homes into graves."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Observe part of the 
[Nawafil (voluntary)]
 Salat (prayers) in your homes. Do not turn your homes into graves."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما عن النبي ﷺ قال: اجلعوا من صلاتكم في بيوتكم، ولا تتخذوها قبورًا". ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1130

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب جعل النوافل في البيت سواء الراتبة وغيرها، والأمر بالتحول للنافلة من موضع الفريضة أو الفصل بينهما بكلام
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of offering Nawfil (Voluntary or Optional) Prayers at Home

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you have finished your (Fard) Salat (prayer) in the mosque, you should observe some of your (Sunnah and Nawafil) Salat at home; Allah will bless your homes because of your Salat (in your homes)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you have finished your (Fard) Salat (prayer) in the mosque, you should observe some of your (Sunnah and Nawafil) Salat at home; Allah will bless your homes because of your Salat (in your homes)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "إذا قضى أحدكم صلاته في مسجده، فليجعل لبيته نصيبًا من صلاته، فإن الله جاعل في بيته صلاته خيرًا". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1131

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب جعل النوافل في البيت سواء الراتبة وغيرها، والأمر بالتحول للنافلة من موضع الفريضة أو الفصل بينهما بكلام
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of offering Nawfil (Voluntary or Optional) Prayers at Home

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Umar bin 'Ata reported that Nafi' bin Jubair sent him to Sa'ib bin Ukht Namir to ask him about something that Mu'awiyah had seen him doing in Salat (prayer). He said:
 "Yes, I performed the Friday prayer along with him in the enclosure (Maqsurah), and when the Imam concluded the Salat with Taslim, I stood up in my place and performed the Sunnah prayer. When Mu'awiyah went home, he sent for me (and when I came) he said: "Never do again what you have done. When you have observed the Friday prayer, you must not start another Sunnah prayer till you have spoken to some one or have shifted your place; because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered us not to follow up the congregational Salat with any other Salat until we have talked (to some one) or moved from the place."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Umar bin 'Ata reported that Nafi' bin Jubair sent him to Sa'ib bin Ukht Namir to ask him about something that Mu'awiyah had seen him doing in Salat (prayer). He said:
hadiths.body:
"Yes, I performed the Friday prayer along with him in the enclosure (Maqsurah), and when the Imam concluded the Salat with Taslim, I stood up in my place and performed the Sunnah prayer. When Mu'awiyah went home, he sent for me (and when I came) he said: "Never do again what you have done. When you have observed the Friday prayer, you must not start another Sunnah prayer till you have spoken to some one or have shifted your place; because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered us not to follow up the congregational Salat with any other Salat until we have talked (to some one) or moved from the place."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عمر بن عطاء أن نافع بن جبير أرسله إلى السائب ابن أخت نمر يسأله عن شيء رآه منه معاوية في الصلاة فقال: نعم صليت معه الجمعة في المقصورة، فلما سلم الإمام، قمت في مقامي، فصليت فلما دخل أرسل إلي فقال: لا تعد لما فعلت: إذا صليت الجمعة فلا تصلها بصلاة حتى تتكلم أو تخرج، فإن رسول الله ﷺ أمرنا بذلك أن لا نوصل صلاة بصلاة حتى نتكلم أو نخرج. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1132

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب جعل النوافل في البيت سواء الراتبة وغيرها، والأمر بالتحول للنافلة من موضع الفريضة أو الفصل بينهما بكلام
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of offering Nawfil (Voluntary or Optional) Prayers at Home

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ali (bin Abu Talib) (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Witr prayer is not obligatory as the prescribed Salat (prayers), but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ observed it as his regular practice (Sunnah). He ﷺ said, "Allah is Witr (single, odd) and loves what is Witr. So perform Witr prayer. O followers of Qur'an, observe Witr (prayer)."

[At-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali (bin Abu Talib) (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Witr prayer is not obligatory as the prescribed Salat (prayers), but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ observed it as his regular practice (Sunnah). He ﷺ said, "Allah is Witr (single, odd) and loves what is Witr. So perform Witr prayer. O followers of Qur'an, observe Witr (prayer)."

[At-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن علي رضي الله عنه قال: الوتر ليس بختم كصلاة المكتوبة ولكن سن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "إن الله وتر يحب الوتر، فأوتروا يا أهل القرآن". ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي)). وقال: حديث حسن.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1133

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة الوتر وبيان أنه سنة مؤكدة وبيان وقته:
chapter.englishTitle: Witr Prayer, its Time and Ruling

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ observed Witr prayer in every part of night at the beginning, middle and at the last part. He ﷺ, however, would finish his Witr prayer before dawn.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ observed Witr prayer in every part of night at the beginning, middle and at the last part. He ﷺ, however, would finish his Witr prayer before dawn.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: من كل الليل قد أوتر رسول الله ﷺ: من أول الليل ومن أوسطه، ومن آخره. وانتهى وتره إلى السحر. ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1134

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة الوتر وبيان أنه سنة مؤكدة وبيان وقته:
chapter.englishTitle: Witr Prayer, its Time and Ruling

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Make Witr prayer the last of your Salat at night."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Make Witr prayer the last of your Salat at night."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي ﷺ: " اجعلوا آخر صلاتكم بالليل وترًا". ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1135

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة الوتر وبيان أنه سنة مؤكدة وبيان وقته:
chapter.englishTitle: Witr Prayer, its Time and Ruling

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Perform Witr prayer before dawn."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Perform Witr prayer before dawn."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ قال: "أوتروا قبل أن تصبحوا". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1136

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة الوتر وبيان أنه سنة مؤكدة وبيان وقته:
chapter.englishTitle: Witr Prayer, its Time and Ruling

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ used to perform his voluntary prayer at night (i.e., Tahajjud prayer) while she was sleeping in front of him; and when the Witr prayer was yet to be observed, he would awaken her to perform her Witr prayer.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ used to perform his voluntary prayer at night (i.e., Tahajjud prayer) while she was sleeping in front of him; and when the Witr prayer was yet to be observed, he would awaken her to perform her Witr prayer.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن النبي ﷺ كان يصلي بالليل، وهي معترضة بين يديه، فإذا بقي الوتر، أيقظها فأوترت. ((رواه مسلم)). وفي رواية له: فإذا بقي الوتر قال: "قومي فأوتري يا عائشة"

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1137

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة الوتر وبيان أنه سنة مؤكدة وبيان وقته:
chapter.englishTitle: Witr Prayer, its Time and Ruling

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Hasten to perform the Witr prayer before dawn."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Hasten to perform the Witr prayer before dawn."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن النبي ﷺ قال: "بادروا الصبح بالوتر" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي)). وقال: حديث حسن صحيح.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1138

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة الوتر وبيان أنه سنة مؤكدة وبيان وقته:
chapter.englishTitle: Witr Prayer, its Time and Ruling

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who apprehends that he may not get up in the later part of the night, should observe the Witr prayer in the first part of it; and he who is certain to get up in the last part of it, he should observe Witr at the end of the night, because Salat at the end of the night is attended (by the angels), and that is better."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who apprehends that he may not get up in the later part of the night, should observe the Witr prayer in the first part of it; and he who is certain to get up in the last part of it, he should observe Witr at the end of the night, because Salat at the end of the night is attended (by the angels), and that is better."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من خاف أن لا يقوم الليل فليوتر أوله، ومن طمع أن يقوم آخره، فليوتر آخر الليل، فإن صلاة آخر الليل مشهودة، وذلك أفضل". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1139

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة الوتر وبيان أنه سنة مؤكدة وبيان وقته:
chapter.englishTitle: Witr Prayer, its Time and Ruling

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 My Khalil (the Messenger of Allah ﷺ) directed me to fast three days of each month, and to observe two Rak'ah Duha (optional prayer) at forenoon, and to perform the Witr prayer before going to bed.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
My Khalil (the Messenger of Allah ﷺ) directed me to fast three days of each month, and to observe two Rak'ah Duha (optional prayer) at forenoon, and to perform the Witr prayer before going to bed.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: أوصاني خليلي ﷺ بصيام ثلاثة أيام من كل شهر، وركعتي الضحى، وأن أوتر قبل أن أرقد" . ((متفق عليه))  والإيتار قبل النوم إنما يستحب لمن لا يثق باستيقاظ آخر الليل، فإن وثق فآخر الليل أفضل.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1140

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل صلاة الضحى وبيان أقلها وأكثرها وأوسطها والحث على المحافظة عليها:
chapter.englishTitle: Merit of the (Optional) Duha (Forenoon) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "In the morning, charity is due on every joint bone of the body of everyone of you. Every utterance of Allah's Glorification (i.e., saying Subhan Allah) is an act of charity, and every utterance of His Praise (i.e., saying Al-hamdu lillah) is an act of charity and every utterance of declaration of His Greatness (i.e., saying La ilaha illAllah) is an act of charity; and enjoining M'aruf (good) is an act of charity, and forbidding Munkar (evil) is an act of charity, and two Rak'ah Duha prayers which one performs in the forenoon is equal to all this (in reward)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "In the morning, charity is due on every joint bone of the body of everyone of you. Every utterance of Allah's Glorification (i.e., saying Subhan Allah) is an act of charity, and every utterance of His Praise (i.e., saying Al-hamdu lillah) is an act of charity and every utterance of declaration of His Greatness (i.e., saying La ilaha illAllah) is an act of charity; and enjoining M'aruf (good) is an act of charity, and forbidding Munkar (evil) is an act of charity, and two Rak'ah Duha prayers which one performs in the forenoon is equal to all this (in reward)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "يصبح على كل سلامى من أحدكم صدقة: فكل تسبيحة صدقة، وكل تهليلة صدقة، وكل تكبيرة صدقة، وأمر بالمعروف صدقة، ونهي عن المنكر صدقة، ويجزئ من ذلك ركعتان يركعهما من الضحى". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1141

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل صلاة الضحى وبيان أقلها وأكثرها وأوسطها والحث على المحافظة عليها:
chapter.englishTitle: Merit of the (Optional) Duha (Forenoon) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform four Rak'ah of Duha prayer (at the forenoon) and would add to them whatever Allah wished.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform four Rak'ah of Duha prayer (at the forenoon) and would add to them whatever Allah wished.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: كان رسول الله ﷺ يصلي الضحى أربعًا ويزيد ما شاء الله . ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1142

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل صلاة الضحى وبيان أقلها وأكثرها وأوسطها والحث على المحافظة عليها:
chapter.englishTitle: Merit of the (Optional) Duha (Forenoon) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Hani, daughter of Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the conquest of Makkah. He was taking a bath at that time. When he finished the bath, he performed eight Rak'ah (of optional) prayers. This was during the Duha (forenoon).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Hani, daughter of Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the conquest of Makkah. He was taking a bath at that time. When he finished the bath, he performed eight Rak'ah (of optional) prayers. This was during the Duha (forenoon).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم هانئ فاختة بنت أبي طالب رضي الله عنها قالت: ذهبت إلى رسول الله ﷺ عام الفتح فوجدته يغتسل فلما فرغ من غسله صلى ثمان ركعات، وذلك ضحى" ((متفق عليه وهذا مختصر لفظ إحدى روايات مسلم))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1143

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل صلاة الضحى وبيان أقلها وأكثرها وأوسطها والحث على المحافظة عليها:
chapter.englishTitle: Merit of the (Optional) Duha (Forenoon) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Zaid bin Arqam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I saw some people performing Duha (prayers) in the early forenoon and warned them (saying): These people must know that performing Salat a little later is better. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The Salat of the penitent is to be observed when the young ones of camels feel the heat of the sun (i.e., when it becomes very hot)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Zaid bin Arqam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw some people performing Duha (prayers) in the early forenoon and warned them (saying): These people must know that performing Salat a little later is better. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The Salat of the penitent is to be observed when the young ones of camels feel the heat of the sun (i.e., when it becomes very hot)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن زيد بن أرقم رضي الله عنه أنه رأى قومًا يصلون من الضحى، فقال: أما لقد علموا أن الصلاة في غير هذه الساعة أفضل، إن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "صلاة الأوابين حين ترمض الفصال". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1144

chapter.arabicTitle: باب: تجويز صلاة الضحى من ارتفاع الشمس إلى زوالها والأفضل أن تصلى عند اشتداد الحر وارتفاع الضحى:
chapter.englishTitle: Time for the Duha (Forenoon Optional) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When anyone of you enters the mosque, he should perform two Rak'ah (of voluntary prayer) before sitting."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When anyone of you enters the mosque, he should perform two Rak'ah (of voluntary prayer) before sitting."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي قتادة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: " إذا دخل أحدكم المسجد فلا يجلس حتى يصلي ركعتين". ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1145

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة تحية المسجد بركعتين وكراهية الجلوس قبل أن يصلي ركعتين في أي وقت دخل سواء صلى ركعتين بنية التحية أو صلاة فريضة أو سنة راتبة أو غيرها:
chapter.englishTitle: Inducement to Perform Tahiyyat-ul-Masjid (Upon Entering the Mosque)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I came to the Prophet ﷺ when he was in the mosque, and he said to me, "Perform two Rak'ah prayer."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I came to the Prophet ﷺ when he was in the mosque, and he said to me, "Perform two Rak'ah prayer."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر، رضي الله عنه قال: أتيت النبي ﷺ وهو في المسجد فقال: "صلِ ركعتين" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1146

chapter.arabicTitle: باب الحث على صلاة تحية المسجد بركعتين وكراهية الجلوس قبل أن يصلي ركعتين في أي وقت دخل سواء صلى ركعتين بنية التحية أو صلاة فريضة أو سنة راتبة أو غيرها:
chapter.englishTitle: Inducement to Perform Tahiyyat-ul-Masjid (Upon Entering the Mosque)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him) "Tell me about the most hopeful act (i.e., one which you deem the most rewarding with Allah) you have done since your acceptance of Islam because I heard the sound of the steps of your shoes in front of me in Jannah." Bilal said: "I do not consider any act more hopeful than that whenever I make Wudu' (or took a bath) in an hour of night or day, I would immediately perform Salat (prayer) for as long as was destined for me to perform."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Bilal (May Allah be pleased with him) "Tell me about the most hopeful act (i.e., one which you deem the most rewarding with Allah) you have done since your acceptance of Islam because I heard the sound of the steps of your shoes in front of me in Jannah." Bilal said: "I do not consider any act more hopeful than that whenever I make Wudu' (or took a bath) in an hour of night or day, I would immediately perform Salat (prayer) for as long as was destined for me to perform."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال لبلال: يا بلال حدثني بأرجى عمل عملته في الإسلام، فإني سمعت دف نعليك بين يدي في الجنة، قال: ما عملت عملا أرجى عندي من أني لم أتطهر طهورًا في ساعة من ليل أو نهار إلا صليت بذلك الطهور ما كتب لي أن أصلي. ((متفق عليه وهذا لفظ البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1147

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب ركعتين بعد الوضوء:
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Performing two Rak'ah of Voluntary Prayer after Ablution

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On that day Adam was created, he was admitted to Jannah, and he was expelled therefrom."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On that day Adam was created, he was admitted to Jannah, and he was expelled therefrom."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: " خير يوم طلعت عليه الشمس يوم الجمعة: فيه خلق آدم، وفيه أدخل الجنة، وفيه أخرج منها". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1148

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone performs Wudu' properly, then comes to the Friday prayer, listens to the Khutbah (religious talk) attentively and keeps silent, his (minor) sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven, with the addition of three more days; but he who touches pebbles has caused an interruption. "

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone performs Wudu' properly, then comes to the Friday prayer, listens to the Khutbah (religious talk) attentively and keeps silent, his (minor) sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven, with the addition of three more days; but he who touches pebbles has caused an interruption. "

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله، ﷺ : "من توضأ فأحسن الوضوء ثم أتي الجمعة، فاستمع وأنصت، غفر له ما بينه وبين الجمعة وزيادة ثلاثة أيام، ومن مس الحصى،  فقد لغا" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1149

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The five daily (prescribed) Salat, and Friday (prayer) to the next Friday (prayer), and the fasting of Ramadan to the next Ramadan, is expiation of the sins committed in between them, so long as major sins are avoided."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The five daily (prescribed) Salat, and Friday (prayer) to the next Friday (prayer), and the fasting of Ramadan to the next Ramadan, is expiation of the sins committed in between them, so long as major sins are avoided."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن النبي، ﷺ قال: "الصلوات الخمس والجمعة إلى الجمعة، ورمضان إلى رمضان، مكفرات ما بينهن إذا اجتنبت الكبائر" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1150

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar and Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 We heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying (while delivering Khutbah on his wooden pulpit), "Either some people (i.e., hypocrites) stop neglecting the Friday prayers, or Allah will seal their hearts and they will be among the heedless."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar and Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
We heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying (while delivering Khutbah on his wooden pulpit), "Either some people (i.e., hypocrites) stop neglecting the Friday prayers, or Allah will seal their hearts and they will be among the heedless."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه وعن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهم، أنهما سمعا رسول الله ﷺ ، يقول على أعواد منبره: "لينتهين أقوام عن وَدعهم الجمعات، أو ليختمن الله على قلوبهم، ثم ليكونن من الغافلين" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1151

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you intends to come for the Friday prayer, he should take a bath."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you intends to come for the Friday prayer, he should take a bath."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، أن رسول الله ﷺ ، قال: "إذا جاء أحدكم الجمعة، فليغتسل" ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1152

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Taking a bath (before coming to Friday prayers) is obligatory on every adult."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Taking a bath (before coming to Friday prayers) is obligatory on every adult."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري، رضي الله عنه، أن رسول الله ﷺ ، قال: "غسل الجمعة واجب على كل محتلم" ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1153

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It suffices to perform Wudu' properly for the Friday prayer; but it is better to take a bath."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It suffices to perform Wudu' properly for the Friday prayer; but it is better to take a bath."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سمرة،  رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من توضأ يوم الجمعة، فبها ونعمت، ومن اغتسل فالغسل أفضل" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1154

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salman (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a man takes bath on Friday, (or) purifies himself as much as he can with Wudu', oils his hair, applies whatever perfume available in his house, sets forth for the mosque, does not separate two people (to make a seat for himself), performs Salat what is prescribed for him, remains silent when the Imam speaks, his (minor) sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Salman (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a man takes bath on Friday, (or) purifies himself as much as he can with Wudu', oils his hair, applies whatever perfume available in his house, sets forth for the mosque, does not separate two people (to make a seat for himself), performs Salat what is prescribed for him, remains silent when the Imam speaks, his (minor) sins between that Friday and the following Friday will be forgiven."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: - وعن سلمان، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا يغتسل رجل يوم الجمعة، ويتطهر ما استطاع من طهر، ويدهن من دهنه، أو يمس من طيب بيته، ثم يخرج فلا يفرق بين اثنين، ثم يصلي ما كتب له، ثم ينصت إذا تكلم الإمام، إلا غفر له ما بينه وبين الجمعة الأخرى" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1155

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who takes a bath on Friday, like the bath for ceremonial purity, and then goes (to the mosque), he is like one who offers a camel as a sacrifice to seek the Pleasure of Allah; and he who comes at the second hour is like one who offers a cow to win the Pleasure of Allah; and he who comes at the third hour is like one who offers a ram with horns (in sacrifice), and he who comes at the fourth hour is like one who offers a hen; and he who comes at the fifth hour is like one who offers an egg. And when the Imam ascends the pulpit, the angels (who write the names of those who come to the mosque before the coming of the Imam) close (their record) in order to listen to the Khutbah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who takes a bath on Friday, like the bath for ceremonial purity, and then goes (to the mosque), he is like one who offers a camel as a sacrifice to seek the Pleasure of Allah; and he who comes at the second hour is like one who offers a cow to win the Pleasure of Allah; and he who comes at the third hour is like one who offers a ram with horns (in sacrifice), and he who comes at the fourth hour is like one who offers a hen; and he who comes at the fifth hour is like one who offers an egg. And when the Imam ascends the pulpit, the angels (who write the names of those who come to the mosque before the coming of the Imam) close (their record) in order to listen to the Khutbah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه، أن رسول الله ﷺ ، قال: "من اغتسل يوم الجمعة غسل الجنابة، ثم راح في الساعة الأولى فكأنما قرب بدنة، ومن راح في الساعة الثانية، فكأنما قرب بقرة، ومن راح في الساعة الثالثة، فكأنما قرب كبشًا أقرن، ومن راح في الساعة الرابعة، فكأنما قرب دجاجة، ومن راح في الساعة الخامسة، فكأنما قرب بيضة، فإذا خرج الإمام، حضرت الملائكة يستمعون الذكر" ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1156

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said while talking about the merits of Friday, "There is a time on Friday at which a Muslim, while he (or she) is performing Salat and is supplicating, will be granted whatever he (or she) is supplicating for." And he ﷺ pointed with his hand to indicate that this period of time is very short.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said while talking about the merits of Friday, "There is a time on Friday at which a Muslim, while he (or she) is performing Salat and is supplicating, will be granted whatever he (or she) is supplicating for." And he ﷺ pointed with his hand to indicate that this period of time is very short.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن رسول الله ﷺ ، ذكر يوم الجمعة، فقال: "فيها ساعة لا يوافقها عبد مسلم، وهو قائم يصلي يسأل الله شيئًا، إلا أعطاه إياه" وأشار بيده يقللها، ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1157

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Burdah bin Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said to me: "Did you hear your father narrating something from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the special moment during Friday?" I said: "Yes, I heard him report from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: 'It occurs between the time when the Imam sits down (on the pulpit after the first Khutbah) and the time Salat is over."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Burdah bin Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
'Abdullah bin 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said to me: "Did you hear your father narrating something from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the special moment during Friday?" I said: "Yes, I heard him report from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: 'It occurs between the time when the Imam sits down (on the pulpit after the first Khutbah) and the time Salat is over."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي بردة بن أبي موسى الأشعري، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال عبد الله بن عمر رضي الله عنهما: أسمعت أباك يحدث عن رسول الله ﷺ ، في شأن ساعة الجمعة؟ قال: قلت: نعم، سمعته يقول: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ ، يقول: "هي ما بين أن يجلس الإمام إلى أن تقضى الصلاة" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1158

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Aus bin Aus (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Among the best of your days is Friday. On that day pray to Allah to exalt my mention frequently, for your such supplications are presented to me."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Aus bin Aus (May Allah be pleased with him)reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Among the best of your days is Friday. On that day pray to Allah to exalt my mention frequently, for your such supplications are presented to me."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أوس بن أوس، رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "إن من أفضل أيامكم يوم الجمعة، فأكثروا علي من الصلاة فيه، فإن صلاتكم معروضة علي" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1159

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل يوم الجمعة ووجوبها والاغتسال لها، والطيب والتبكير إليها والدعاء يوم الجمعة، والصلاة على النبي، ﷺ، وفيه بيان ساعة الإجابة واستحباب إكثار ذكر الله تعالى بعد الجمعة
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Friday Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 We left Makkah with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for Al-Madinah, and when we were near 'Azwara,' he ﷺ alighted (from his riding-camel) raised his hands in supplication to Allah for a while and prostrated himself. He remained for a long time in prostration. Then he stood up and raised his hands for a while, after which he prostrated himself (again), and remained for a long time in prostration. Then he stood up and raised his hands for a while, after which he prostrated himself for the third time. Then he ﷺ said, "I supplicated my Rubb and made intercession for my Ummah, and He granted me one-third of them. So I again prostrated myself in gratitude to my Rubb. Then I raised my head and supplicated my Rubb for my Ummah, and He granted me another third of them. Again I raised my head and supplicated my Rubb for my Ummah and He granted me the last third of them. So I fell into prostration out of gratitude before my Rubb."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
We left Makkah with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for Al-Madinah, and when we were near 'Azwara,' he ﷺ alighted (from his riding-camel) raised his hands in supplication to Allah for a while and prostrated himself. He remained for a long time in prostration. Then he stood up and raised his hands for a while, after which he prostrated himself (again), and remained for a long time in prostration. Then he stood up and raised his hands for a while, after which he prostrated himself for the third time. Then he ﷺ said, "I supplicated my Rubb and made intercession for my Ummah, and He granted me one-third of them. So I again prostrated myself in gratitude to my Rubb. Then I raised my head and supplicated my Rubb for my Ummah, and He granted me another third of them. Again I raised my head and supplicated my Rubb for my Ummah and He granted me the last third of them. So I fell into prostration out of gratitude before my Rubb."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن سعد بن أبي وقاص، رضي الله عنه، قال: خرجنا مع رسول الله ﷺ من مكة نريد المدينة، فلما كنا قريبًا من عزوراء نزل ثم رفع يديه، فدعا الله ساعة، ثم خر ساجدًا، فمكث طويلا، ثم قام فرفع يديه ساعة، ثم خر ساجدًا- فعله- ثلاثًا- وقال: "إني سألت ربي، وشفعت لأمتي، فأعطاني ثلث أمتي، فخررت ساجدًا لربي شكرًا، ثم رفعت رأسي، فسألت ربي لأمتي، فأعطاني ثلث أمتي، فخررت ساجدًا لربي شكرًا، ثم رفعت رأسي، فسألت ربي لأمتي، فأعطاني الثلث الآخر، فخررت ساجدًا لربي" ((رواه أبو داود)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1160

chapter.arabicTitle: باب استحباب سجود الشكر عند حصول نعمة ظاهرة أو اندفاع بلية ظاهرة:
chapter.englishTitle: The Desirability of Prostrating out of Gratitude

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ kept standing (in prayer) so long that the skin of his feet would crack. I asked him: "Why do you do this, while you have been forgiven of your former and latter sins?" He said, "Should I not be a grateful slave of Allah?"

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ kept standing (in prayer) so long that the skin of his feet would crack. I asked him: "Why do you do this, while you have been forgiven of your former and latter sins?" He said, "Should I not be a grateful slave of Allah?"

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها، قالت: كان النبي ﷺ ، يقوم من الليل حتى تتفطر قدماه، فقلت له: لم تصنع هذا يا رسول الله، وقد غفر لك ما تقدم من ذنبك وما تأخر؟ قال: "أفلا أكون عبدًا شكورًا". ((متفق عليه وعن المغيرة بن شعبة نحوه، متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1161

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ visited me and Fatimah (May Allah be pleased with her) one night and said, "Do you not observe prayer (at night)?"

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ visited me and Fatimah (May Allah be pleased with her) one night and said, "Do you not observe prayer (at night)?"

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن علي رضي الله عنه، أن النبي ﷺ، طرقه وفاطمة ليلا، فقال: "ألا تصليان؟" ((متفق عليه)). (20)

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1162

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salim bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with them) reported, on the authority of his father, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "What an excellent man 'Abdullah is! If only he could perform optional prayers at night." Salim said that after this, (his father) 'Abdullah slept very little at night.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.body:
Salim bin 'Abdullah bin 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with them) reported, on the authority of his father, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "What an excellent man 'Abdullah is! If only he could perform optional prayers at night." Salim said that after this, (his father) 'Abdullah slept very little at night.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سالم بن عبد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب، رضي الله عنهم، عن أبيه: أن رسول الله ﷺ ، قال: "نعم الرجل عبد الله لو كان يصلي من الليل" قال سالم: فكان عبد الله بعد ذلك لا ينام إلا قليلا. ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1163

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "Do not be like so-and-so O 'Abdullah! He used to pray during the night, then stopped the practice."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "Do not be like so-and-so O 'Abdullah! He used to pray during the night, then stopped the practice."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص، رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "يا عبد الله لا تكن مثل فلان: كان يقوم الليل فترك قيام الليل" ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1164

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Mention was made before the Prophet ﷺ of a man who slept throughout the night till morning. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ remarked, "He is a man in whose ears Satan urinated."

[Al- Bukhari and Muslim]
.n
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Mention was made before the Prophet ﷺ of a man who slept throughout the night till morning. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ remarked, "He is a man in whose ears Satan urinated."

[Al- Bukhari and Muslim]
.n
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه ، قال: ذكر عند النبي، ﷺ رجل نام ليلة حتى أصبح! قال: "ذاك رجل بال الشيطان في أذنيه- أو قال: في أذنه-" ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1165

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When any one of you sleeps, Satan ties three knots at the back of his neck. He recites this incantation at every knot: 'You have a long night, so sleep.' If he awakes and remembers Allah, one knot is loosened. If he performs Wudu', the (second) knot is loosened; and if he performs prayer, (all) knots are loosened. He begins his morning in a happy and refreshed mood; otherwise, he gets up in bad spirits and sluggish state."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When any one of you sleeps, Satan ties three knots at the back of his neck. He recites this incantation at every knot: 'You have a long night, so sleep.' If he awakes and remembers Allah, one knot is loosened. If he performs Wudu', the (second) knot is loosened; and if he performs prayer, (all) knots are loosened. He begins his morning in a happy and refreshed mood; otherwise, he gets up in bad spirits and sluggish state."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه، أن رسول الله ﷺ ، قال: "يعقد الشيطان على قافية، رأس أحدكم، إذا هو نام، ثلاث عقد، يضرب على كل عقدة: عليك ليل طويل فارقد، فإن استيقظ أحدكم، فذكر الله تعالى انحلت عقدة، فإن توضأ انحلت عقدة، فإن صلى انحلت عقدة، فأصبح نشيطًا طيب النفس، وإلا أصبح خبيث النفس كسلان" ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1166

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Salam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "O people, promote the greetings, feed (the poor and needy) and perform Salat when others are asleep so that you will enter Jannah safely."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Salam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "O people, promote the greetings, feed (the poor and needy) and perform Salat when others are asleep so that you will enter Jannah safely."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن سلام، رضي الله عنه ، أن النبي، ﷺ ،قال: "أيها الناس أفشوا السلام، وأطعموا الطعام، وصلوا بالليل والناس نيام، تدخلوا الجنة بسلام" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1167

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best month for observing Saum (fasting) after Ramadan is Muharram, and the best Salat after the prescribed Salat is Salat at night."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best month for observing Saum (fasting) after Ramadan is Muharram, and the best Salat after the prescribed Salat is Salat at night."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة، رضي الله عنه، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "أفضل الصيام بعد رمضان شهر الله المحرم، وأفضل الصلاة بعد الفريضة صلاة الليل". ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1168

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Salat during the night should consist of pairs of but if you fear that morning is near, then pray one Rak'ah as Witr."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Salat during the night should consist of pairs of but if you fear that morning is near, then pray one Rak'ah as Witr."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، أن النبي ﷺ ، قال: "صلاة الليل مثنى مثنى، فإذا خفت الصبح فأوتر بواحدة". ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1169

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ performed the night prayer in pairs (i.e., Rak'ah) and made it odd number by observing one Rak'ah (as Witr).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ performed the night prayer in pairs (i.e., Rak'ah) and made it odd number by observing one Rak'ah (as Witr).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: كان النبي ﷺ ، يصلي من الليل مثنى مثنى، ويوتر بركعة. ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1170

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل قيام الليل:
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Standing in Prayer at Night

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to leave off observing Saum (fasting) during a month until we thought that he would not observe Saum at all during it; and (sometimes) he would observe Saum till we began to think that he would not omit any day of that month. If one wished to see him performing Salat during the night, he could do that; and if one wished to see him sleeping at night, he could do that.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to leave off observing Saum (fasting) during a month until we thought that he would not observe Saum at all during it; and (sometimes) he would observe Saum till we began to think that he would not omit any day of that month. If one wished to see him performing Salat during the night, he could do that; and if one wished to see him sleeping at night, he could do that.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
