hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي بكر بن أبي موسى الأشعري، قال: سمعت أبي رضي الله عنه وهو بحضرة العدو، يقول قال رسول الله ﷺ "إن أبواب الجنة تحت ظلال السيوف" فقام رجل رث الهيئة فقال يا أبا موسى أأنت سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول هذا؟ قال: نعم، فرجع إلى أصحابه، فقال: "اقرأ عليكم السلام" ثم كسر جفن سيفه فألقاه، ثم مشى بسيفه إلى العدو فضرب به حتى قتل" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1303

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu 'Abs 'Abdur-Rahman bin Jabr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It will not happen that the feet soiled with dust while (doing Jihad) in the way of Allah, will be touched by the fire (of Hell)."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu 'Abs 'Abdur-Rahman bin Jabr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It will not happen that the feet soiled with dust while (doing Jihad) in the way of Allah, will be touched by the fire (of Hell)."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي عبس عبد الرحمن بن جبير، رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "ما اغبرت قدما عبد في سبيل الله فتمسه النار" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1304

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one who weeps out of Fear of Allah will enter Hell until milk recedes to the udder, and the dust endured while striving in the Cause of Allah and the smoke of Hell will never subsist together."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one who weeps out of Fear of Allah will enter Hell until milk recedes to the udder, and the dust endured while striving in the Cause of Allah and the smoke of Hell will never subsist together."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "لا يلج النار رجل بكي من خشية الله حتى يعود اللبن في الضرع، ولا يجتمع على عبد غبار في سبيل الله ودخان جهنم" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1305

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Two eyes will never be touched by the fire of Hell; an eye which weeps out of Fear of Allah and an eye which spends the night in guarding in the Cause of Allah  ."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Two eyes will never be touched by the fire of Hell; an eye which weeps out of Fear of Allah and an eye which spends the night in guarding in the Cause of Allah  ."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس، رضي الله عنهما قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: “عينان لا تمسهما النار عين بكت من خشية الله، وعين باتت تحرس في سبيل الله" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن. )).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1306

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who equips a Ghazi (fighter) in the way of Allah is as if he has taken part in the fighting himself; and he who looks after the dependants of a Ghazi in his absence, is as if he has taken part in the fighting himself."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who equips a Ghazi (fighter) in the way of Allah is as if he has taken part in the fighting himself; and he who looks after the dependants of a Ghazi in his absence, is as if he has taken part in the fighting himself."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن زيد بن خالد، رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "من جهز غازيًا في سبيل الله فقد غزا ومن خلف غازيا في أهله بخير فقد غزا" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1307

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of charities is to provide canopy in the Cause of Allah, to pay wages to a servant in the way of Allah, and to provide a camel in the way of Allah (to be used by a Mujahid)."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of charities is to provide canopy in the Cause of Allah, to pay wages to a servant in the way of Allah, and to provide a camel in the way of Allah (to be used by a Mujahid)."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أمامة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "أفضل الصدقات ظل فسطاط في سبيل الله، ومنيحة خادم في سبيل الله، أو طروقة فحل في سبيل الله" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1308

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A young man from the Aslam tribe said: "O Messenger of Allah! I would very much like to fight in the way of Allah but I do not have anything with which to equip myself for fighting." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Go to so-and-so, for he had equipped himself (for fighting) but he fell ill." So, he (the young man) went to him and said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sends you his greetings and says that you should hand over to me the equipment that you have procured." The man said to his wife: "Give him the equipment which I have collected for myself and do not withhold anything from him. By Allah! Allah won't bless something you withheld (in this respect)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A young man from the Aslam tribe said: "O Messenger of Allah! I would very much like to fight in the way of Allah but I do not have anything with which to equip myself for fighting." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Go to so-and-so, for he had equipped himself (for fighting) but he fell ill." So, he (the young man) went to him and said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sends you his greetings and says that you should hand over to me the equipment that you have procured." The man said to his wife: "Give him the equipment which I have collected for myself and do not withhold anything from him. By Allah! Allah won't bless something you withheld (in this respect)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن فتى من أسلم قال: يا رسول الله إني أريد الغزو وليس معي ما أتجهز به، قال: "ائت فلانًا، قد كان تجهز فمرض فأتاه فقال: إن رسول الله ﷺ يقرئك السلام ويقول: أعطني الذي تجهزت به قال: يا فلانة أعطيه، الذي كنت تجهزت به ولاتحبسي منه شيئًا فوالله لا تحبسي منه شيئًا فيبارك لك  فيه ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1309

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent an expedition to Banu Lahyan and said, "One man from every two should join the fighting force, and the reward will be shared amongst them equally."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration in Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Let one of every two men go forth", and added: "Whoever stays behind (and looks well after the family and the property of those who have joined the expedition) will get half the reward of the warrior."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent an expedition to Banu Lahyan and said, "One man from every two should join the fighting force, and the reward will be shared amongst them equally."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration in Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Let one of every two men go forth", and added: "Whoever stays behind (and looks well after the family and the property of those who have joined the expedition) will get half the reward of the warrior."
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ بعث إلى بني لحيان، فقال: "لا ينبعث من كل رجلين أحدهما، والأجر بينهما" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1310

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Bara (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man equipped with arms came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked: "O Messenger of Allah! Should I go and fight or should I embrace Islam first?" He ﷺ replied, "Enter in the fold of Islam and then fight." He embraced Islam and fought until he was killed. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He accepted Islam for a short time but was rewarded much."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Bara (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man equipped with arms came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked: "O Messenger of Allah! Should I go and fight or should I embrace Islam first?" He ﷺ replied, "Enter in the fold of Islam and then fight." He embraced Islam and fought until he was killed. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He accepted Islam for a short time but was rewarded much."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن البراء رضي الله عنه قال أتى النبي ﷺ رجل مقنع بالحديد، فقال يا رسول الله أقاتل أو أسلم؟ قال: "أسلم، ثم قاتل" فأسلم، ثم قاتل فقتل، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : عمل قليلا وأُجر كثيرًا" ((متفق عليه وهذا لفظ البخاري)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1311

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "No one who has entered Jannah will desire to return to this world even if he should be given all that the world contains, except a martyr. For he will yearn that he should return to the world and be killed ten times on account of the dignity that he will experience by virtue of his martyrdom."

Another narration is: "On account of the excellence and distinction, he will experience as a result of martyrdom."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "No one who has entered Jannah will desire to return to this world even if he should be given all that the world contains, except a martyr. For he will yearn that he should return to the world and be killed ten times on account of the dignity that he will experience by virtue of his martyrdom."

Another narration is: "On account of the excellence and distinction, he will experience as a result of martyrdom."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ قال: "ما أحد يدخل الجنة يحب أن يرجع إلى الدنيا وله ما على الأرض من شيء إلا الشهيد، يتمنى أن يرجع إلى الدنيا فيقتل عشر مرات لما يرى من الكرامة”

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1312

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah forgives every sin of a martyr, except his debt."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration in Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Being martyred in the Cause of Allah expiates for everything, except debt."
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah forgives every sin of a martyr, except his debt."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration in Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Being martyred in the Cause of Allah expiates for everything, except debt."
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "يغفر الله للشهيد كل شيء إلا الدين" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1313

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up among his Companions and said, "Jihad in the way of Allah and belief in Allah (with all His Attributes) are the most meritorious of actions." A man stood up and said: "O Messenger of Allah! Inform me if I am killed in the way of Allah, will my sins be blotted out?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Yes, in case you are killed in the way of Allah and you remained patient, hopeful of reward, and advancing forward without retracing back (i.e., while fighting)." Then he said, "What was your question?" He inquired again: "Inform me, if I am killed in the way of Allah, will all my sins be blotted out?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "If you remained patient, hopeful of reward and always fought without turning your back upon enemy, everything, except debt, will be forgiven. Jibril has told me this."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up among his Companions and said, "Jihad in the way of Allah and belief in Allah (with all His Attributes) are the most meritorious of actions." A man stood up and said: "O Messenger of Allah! Inform me if I am killed in the way of Allah, will my sins be blotted out?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Yes, in case you are killed in the way of Allah and you remained patient, hopeful of reward, and advancing forward without retracing back (i.e., while fighting)." Then he said, "What was your question?" He inquired again: "Inform me, if I am killed in the way of Allah, will all my sins be blotted out?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "If you remained patient, hopeful of reward and always fought without turning your back upon enemy, everything, except debt, will be forgiven. Jibril has told me this."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي قتادة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قام فيهم فذكر أن الجهاد في سبيل الله والإيمان بالله أفضل الأعمال فقام رجل فقال يا رسول الله أرأيت إن قتلت في سبيل الله أتكفر عني خطاياي؟ فقال رسول الله ﷺ: "نعم إن قتلت في سبيل الله وأنت صابر محتسب مقبل غير مدبر" ثم قال رسول الله ﷺ: "كيف قلت؟" قال: أرأيت إن قتلت في سبيل الله أتكفر عني خطاياي؟ فقال رسول الله ﷺ "نعم وأنت صابر محتسب مقبل غير مدبر إلا الدين فإن جبريل عليه السلام قال لي ذلك" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1314

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Tell me where I will be if I am killed while fighting in the way of Allah?" He ﷺ replied, "In Jannah." The man threw away the few dates which he had in his hand, jumped into the battlefield and fought on till he was killed.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: "Tell me where I will be if I am killed while fighting in the way of Allah?" He ﷺ replied, "In Jannah." The man threw away the few dates which he had in his hand, jumped into the battlefield and fought on till he was killed.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: قال رجل: أين أنا يا رسول الله إن قتلت؟ قال: “في الجنة" فألقى تمرات كن في يده ثم قاتل حتى قتل" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1315

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his Companions reached Badr before the polytheists, and when they arrived, he ﷺ directed: "Let no one of you advance ahead of me." When the polytheists came near, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Now stand up and proceed towards Jannah which is as wide as are the heavens and the earth." 'Umair bin Al-Humam (May Allah be pleased with him) asked: "Is Jannah as wide as are the heaven and the earth?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied in the affirmative. 'Umair remarked: "Great!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him what had urged him to say so. He replied: "Nothing, O Messenger of Allah! But hope that I might become one of the inhabitants of Jannah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You will definitely be among them." 'Umair then took some dates out of his quiver and began to eat them, but after a short time he said: "If I survive till I eat my dates, it will mean a long life." So he threw away the dates which he had with him and then fought with the enemy till he was killed.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his Companions reached Badr before the polytheists, and when they arrived, he ﷺ directed: "Let no one of you advance ahead of me." When the polytheists came near, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Now stand up and proceed towards Jannah which is as wide as are the heavens and the earth." 'Umair bin Al-Humam (May Allah be pleased with him) asked: "Is Jannah as wide as are the heaven and the earth?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied in the affirmative. 'Umair remarked: "Great!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him what had urged him to say so. He replied: "Nothing, O Messenger of Allah! But hope that I might become one of the inhabitants of Jannah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You will definitely be among them." 'Umair then took some dates out of his quiver and began to eat them, but after a short time he said: "If I survive till I eat my dates, it will mean a long life." So he threw away the dates which he had with him and then fought with the enemy till he was killed.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال انطلق رسول الله ﷺ وأصحابه حتى سبقوا المشركين إلى بدر وجاء المشركون، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا يقدمن أحد منكم إلى شيء حتى أكون أنا دونه" فدنا المشركون، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "قوموا إلى جنة عرضها السماوات والأرض" قال: يقول عمير بن الحمام الأنصاري رضي الله عنه: يا رسول الله جنة عرضها السماوات والأرض؟ قال: "نعم" قال: بخ بخ! فقال رسول الله ﷺ: “ما يحملك على قولك بخ بخ" قال فإنك من أهلها فأخرج تمرات من قرنه فجعل يأكل منهن، ثم قال لئن أنا حييت حتى آكل تمراتي هذه إنها لحياة طويلة! فرمى بما كان معه من التمر، ثم قاتلهم حتى قتل" ((رواه مسلم)). (4)

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1316

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Some people came to the Prophet ﷺ and said to him: "Send with us some men who may teach us the Qur'an and the Sunnah." He ﷺ sent seventy men from the Ansar. They were called Al-Qurra' (the reciters) and among them was my maternal uncle, Haram. They used to recite the Qur'an, ponder over its meaning and learn (its wisdom) at night. In the day, they used to bring water and pour it in pitchers in the mosque, then they would collect wood and sell it; and with the sale proceeds, they would buy food for the people of As-Suffah and the needy. The Prophet ﷺ sent the reciters with these people but these (treacherous people) fell upon them and killed them before they reached their destination. (While dying) they supplicated: "O Allah convey from us the news to our Prophet that we have met You (in a way), that we are pleased with You and You are pleased with us." (The narrator said:) A man attacked Haram from behind and smote him with a spear which pierced him. Whereupon Haram said: "By the Rubb of Ka'bah, I have met with success. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to his Companions, "Your brethren have been slain and they were saying: "O Allah! Convey from us to our Prophet the news that we have met You (in a way) that we are pleased with You and You are pleased with us."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Some people came to the Prophet ﷺ and said to him: "Send with us some men who may teach us the Qur'an and the Sunnah." He ﷺ sent seventy men from the Ansar. They were called Al-Qurra' (the reciters) and among them was my maternal uncle, Haram. They used to recite the Qur'an, ponder over its meaning and learn (its wisdom) at night. In the day, they used to bring water and pour it in pitchers in the mosque, then they would collect wood and sell it; and with the sale proceeds, they would buy food for the people of As-Suffah and the needy. The Prophet ﷺ sent the reciters with these people but these (treacherous people) fell upon them and killed them before they reached their destination. (While dying) they supplicated: "O Allah convey from us the news to our Prophet that we have met You (in a way), that we are pleased with You and You are pleased with us." (The narrator said:) A man attacked Haram from behind and smote him with a spear which pierced him. Whereupon Haram said: "By the Rubb of Ka'bah, I have met with success. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to his Companions, "Your brethren have been slain and they were saying: "O Allah! Convey from us to our Prophet the news that we have met You (in a way) that we are pleased with You and You are pleased with us."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: جاء ناس إلى النبي ﷺ أن ابعث معنا رجالا يعلمونا القرآن والسنة فبعث إليهم سبعين رجلا من الأنصار يقال لهم: القراء، فيهم خالي حرام، يقرءون القرآن ويتدارسونه بالليل يتعلمون، وكانوا بالنهار يجيئون بالماء فيضعونه في المسجد، ويحتطبون فيبيعونه، ويشترون به الطعام لأهل الصفة، وللفقراء فبعثهم ﷺ فعرضوا لهم فقتلوهم قبل أن يبلغوا المكان، فقالوا: اللهم بلغ عنا نبينا أن قد لقيناك فرضينا عنك ورضيت عنا، وأتى رجل حراما خال أنس من خلف فطعنه برمح حتى أنفذه، فقال حرام: فزت ورب الكعبة، فقال رسول الله ﷺ "إن إخوانكم قد قتلوا وإنهم قالوا: اللهم بلغ عنا نبينا أنا قد لقيناك فرضينا عنك ورضيت عنا" ((متفق عليه وهذا لفظ مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1317

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 My uncle Anas bin An- Nadr (May Allah be pleased with him) was absent from the battle of Badr. He said: "O Messenger of Allah! I was absent from the first battle you fought against the pagans. (By Allah!) if Allah gives me a chance to fight against the pagans, no doubt, Allah will see how (bravely) I will fight." On the Day of Uhud, when the Muslims turned their backs and fled, he said, "O Allah! I apologize to You for what these (i.e., his companions) have done, and I denounce what these (i.e., the pagans) have done." Then he advanced and Sa'd bin Mu'adh met him. He said: "O Sa'd bin Mu'adh! By the Rubb of An-Nadr, Jannah! I am smelling its aroma coming from before (the mountain of) Uhud," Later on, Sa'd said: "O Messenger of Allah! I cannot achieve or do what he (i.e., Anas bin An-Nadr) did. We found more than eighty wounds by swords, spears and arrows on his body. We found him dead and his body was mutilated so badly that none except his sister could recognise him by his finger." We used to think that the following Ayah was revealed concerning him and other men of his sort: "Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah (i.e., they have gone out for Jihad, and showed not their backs to the disbelievers), of them some have fulfilled their obligations (i.e., have been martyred)." (33:23).
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body: My uncle Anas bin An- Nadr (May Allah be pleased with him) was absent from the battle of Badr. He said: "O Messenger of Allah! I was absent from the first battle you fought against the pagans. (By Allah!) if Allah gives me a chance to fight against the pagans, no doubt, Allah will see how (bravely) I will fight." On the Day of Uhud, when the Muslims turned their backs and fled, he said, "O Allah! I apologize to You for what these (i.e., his companions) have done, and I denounce what these (i.e., the pagans) have done." Then he advanced and Sa'd bin Mu'adh met him. He said: "O Sa'd bin Mu'adh! By the Rubb of An-Nadr, Jannah! I am smelling its aroma coming from before (the mountain of) Uhud," Later on, Sa'd said: "O Messenger of Allah! I cannot achieve or do what he (i.e., Anas bin An-Nadr) did. We found more than eighty wounds by swords, spears and arrows on his body. We found him dead and his body was mutilated so badly that none except his sister could recognise him by his finger." We used to think that the following Ayah was revealed concerning him and other men of his sort: "Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with Allah (i.e., they have gone out for Jihad, and showed not their backs to the disbelievers), of them some have fulfilled their obligations (i.e., have been martyred)." (33:23).
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: غاب عمي أنس بن النضر رضي الله عنه عن قتال بدر، فقال: يا رسول الله غبت عن أول قتال قاتلت الشركين لئن الله أشهدني قتال المشركين ليرين الله ما أصنع. فلما كان يوم أحد انكشف المسلمون، فقال اللهم إني اعتذر إليك مما صنع هؤلاء - يعني الصحابة- وأبرأ إليك مما صنع هؤلاء يعني المشركين- ثم تقدم فاستقبله سعد بن معاذ فقال: يا سعد بن معاذ الجنة ورب النضر، إني أجد ريحها من دون أحد! قال سعد: فما استطعت يا رسول الله ما صنع! قال أنس: فوجدنا به بضعًا وثمانين ضربة بالسيف، أو طعنة برمح أو رمية بسهم، ووجدناه قد قتل ومثل به المشركون، فما عرفه أحد إلا أخته ببنانه، قال أنس: كنا نرى -أو نظن- أن هذه الآية نزلت فيه وفي أشباهه: {من المؤمنين رجال صدقوا ما عاهدوا الله عليه فمنهم من قضى نحبه} إلى آخره ((الأحزاب 23)). ((متفق عليه)) وقد سبق في باب المجاهدة.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1318

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Last night two men (angels) came to me (in a dream) and made me ascend a tree and then admitted me into a nice and excellent house, the like of which I have never seen before. One of them said: 'This house is the house of martyrs'."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Last night two men (angels) came to me (in a dream) and made me ascend a tree and then admitted me into a nice and excellent house, the like of which I have never seen before. One of them said: 'This house is the house of martyrs'."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سمرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : “رأيت الليلة رجلين أتياني فصعدا بي الشجرة وأدخلاني دارًا هي أحسن وأفضل، لم أر قط أحسن منها، قال أما هذه الدار فدار الشهداء" (5)

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1319

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Umm Ar-Rubaiy'i bint Al-Bara', who was the mother of Harithah bin Suraqah, came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah! Will you not tell me about Harithah? (He was killed in the battle of Badr). If he is in Jannah I shall show endurance, but if he has met another fate, I may exert myself in weeping for him." He ﷺ replied, "O mother of Harithah, in in the gardens of Jannah there are many ranks, and your son has attained Al-Firdaus, the highest."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Umm Ar-Rubaiy'i bint Al-Bara', who was the mother of Harithah bin Suraqah, came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah! Will you not tell me about Harithah? (He was killed in the battle of Badr). If he is in Jannah I shall show endurance, but if he has met another fate, I may exert myself in weeping for him." He ﷺ replied, "O mother of Harithah, in in the gardens of Jannah there are many ranks, and your son has attained Al-Firdaus, the highest."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن أم الربيع بنت البراء وهي أم حارثة بن سراقة أتت النبي ﷺ فقالت: يا رسول الله ألا تحدثني عن حارثة. وكان قتل يوم بدر، فإن كان في الجنة صبرت، وإن كان غير ذلك اجتهدت عليه في البكاء، فقال: "يا أم حارثة إنها جنان في الجنة، وإن ابنك أصاب الفردوس الأعلى" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1320

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The dead body of my father, who was mutilated by the enemy, was brought and placed before the Prophet ﷺ. I got up to uncover his face but the people stopped me, and the Prophet ﷺ said, "The angels continue to cover him with their wings."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The dead body of my father, who was mutilated by the enemy, was brought and placed before the Prophet ﷺ. I got up to uncover his face but the people stopped me, and the Prophet ﷺ said, "The angels continue to cover him with their wings."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما قال: جيء بأبي إلى النبي ﷺ قد مثل به فوضع بين يديه، فذهبت أكشف عن وجهه فنهاني قوم فقال النبي ﷺ: "ما زالت الملائكة تظله بأجنحتها” ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1321

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sahl bin Hunaif (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who supplicates Allah sincerely for martyrdom, Allah will elevate him to the station of the martyrs, even if he dies on his bed."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sahl bin Hunaif (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who supplicates Allah sincerely for martyrdom, Allah will elevate him to the station of the martyrs, even if he dies on his bed."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سهل بن حنيف رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "من سأل الله تعالى الشهادة بصدق بلغه الله منازل الشهداء وإن مات على فراشه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1322

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who supplicates sincerely for martyrdom, it will be granted to him even though he is not killed on the battlefield."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who supplicates sincerely for martyrdom, it will be granted to him even though he is not killed on the battlefield."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "من طلب الشهادة صادقًا أعطيها ولو لم تصبه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1323

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The martyr experiences no more pain in being slain than one of you experiences from the stinging of an ant."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The martyr experiences no more pain in being slain than one of you experiences from the stinging of an ant."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "ما يجد الشهيد من مس القتل إلا كما يجد أحدكم من مس القرصة" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1324

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 On one occasion the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was confronting the enemy. He waited until the sun had declined. Then he stood up to address the people and said, "O people! Do not wish for an encounter with the enemy. Pray to Allah to grant you safety; (but) when you encounter them, show patience, and know that Jannah is under the shades of the swords." Then he ﷺ said: "Allahumma munzilal-kitab, wa mujriyas- sahab, wa hazimal-Ahzab, ihzimhum wansurna alaihim (O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Disperser of the clouds, Defeater of the Confederates, put our enemy to rout and support us against them)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Abu Aufa (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
On one occasion the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was confronting the enemy. He waited until the sun had declined. Then he stood up to address the people and said, "O people! Do not wish for an encounter with the enemy. Pray to Allah to grant you safety; (but) when you encounter them, show patience, and know that Jannah is under the shades of the swords." Then he ﷺ said: "Allahumma munzilal-kitab, wa mujriyas- sahab, wa hazimal-Ahzab, ihzimhum wansurna alaihim (O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Disperser of the clouds, Defeater of the Confederates, put our enemy to rout and support us against them)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن أبي أوفى رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ في بعض أيامه التي لقي فيها العدو انتظر حتى مالت الشمس، ثم قام في الناس فقال: " أيها الناس، لا تتمنوا لقاء العدو، وسلو الله العافية، فإذا لقيتموه فاصبروا، واعلموا أن الجنة تحت ظلال السيوف" ثم قال: "اللهم منزل الكتاب ومجري السحاب، وهازم الأحزاب اهزمهم وانصرنا عليهم" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1325

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Supplications at two times are never turned down (or said, "Are seldom turned down"), a supplication after the Adhan has been proclaimed, and a supplication during the battle combating the enemy."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sahl bin Sa'd (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Supplications at two times are never turned down (or said, "Are seldom turned down"), a supplication after the Adhan has been proclaimed, and a supplication during the battle combating the enemy."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سهل بن سعد رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ "ثنتان لا تردان، أو قلما تردان: الدعاء عند النداء وعند البأس حين يلحم بعضهم بعضًا" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1326

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out to participate in Jihad, he would supplicate: "Allahumma Anta 'adudi wa nasiri, bika ahulu, wa bika asulu, wa bika uqatilu (O Allah, You are my Supporter and my Helper. With Your help I get strength, and with Your help I bounce upon the enemy and defeat it, and with Your help I fight)."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out to participate in Jihad, he would supplicate: "Allahumma Anta 'adudi wa nasiri, bika ahulu, wa bika asulu, wa bika uqatilu (O Allah, You are my Supporter and my Helper. With Your help I get strength, and with Your help I bounce upon the enemy and defeat it, and with Your help I fight)."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا غزا قال: "اللهم أنت عضدي ونصيري، بك أحول وبك أجول وبك أصول، وبك أقاتل" ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1327

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 When the Prophet ﷺ had any fear of an enemy, he used to supplicate: "Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim, wa na'udhu bika min shururihim (O Allah! We put You in front of them, and we seek refuge in You from their evils)."

[Ahmad and Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
When the Prophet ﷺ had any fear of an enemy, he used to supplicate: "Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim, wa na'udhu bika min shururihim (O Allah! We put You in front of them, and we seek refuge in You from their evils)."

[Ahmad and Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسى، رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ كان إذا خاف قومًا قال: اللهم إنا نجعلك في نحورهم، ونعوذ بك من شرورهم". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1328

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is goodness in the forelocks of horses till the Day of Resurrection."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is goodness in the forelocks of horses till the Day of Resurrection."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "الخيل معقود في نواصيها الخير إلى يوم القيامة" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1329

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Urwah Al-Bariqi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Goodness is tied to the foreheads of horses until the Day of Resurrection, i.e., reward (in the Hereafter) and spoils."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Urwah Al-Bariqi (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Goodness is tied to the foreheads of horses until the Day of Resurrection, i.e., reward (in the Hereafter) and spoils."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عروة البارقي رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ قال: الخيل معقود في نواصيها الخير إلى يوم القيامة: الأجر والمغنم" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1330

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who keeps a horse for Jihad purposes, having faith in Allah and relying on His Promise, will find that its fodder, drink, droppings and urine will all be credited to him in his Scales on the Day of Resurrection."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who keeps a horse for Jihad purposes, having faith in Allah and relying on His Promise, will find that its fodder, drink, droppings and urine will all be credited to him in his Scales on the Day of Resurrection."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "من احتبس فرسًا في سبيل الله إيمانًا بالله وتصديقًا بوعده، فإن شبعه، وروثه، وبوله في ميزانه يوم القيامة” ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1331

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man came to the Prophet ﷺ with a she-camel wearing a nose-string and said: "This is (a gift) in the Cause of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "You will have in return for it on the Day of Resurrection seven hundred she-camels and every one of them will be wearing a nose-string."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man came to the Prophet ﷺ with a she-camel wearing a nose-string and said: "This is (a gift) in the Cause of Allah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "You will have in return for it on the Day of Resurrection seven hundred she-camels and every one of them will be wearing a nose-string."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: جار رجل إلى النبي ﷺ بناقة مخطومة فقال: هذه في سبيل الله، فقال رسول الله ﷺ: "لك بها يوم القيامة سبعمائة ناقة كلها مخطومة" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1332

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Uqbah bin 'Amir Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying from the pulpit, "Prepare to meet them (the enemy) with as much strength as you can afford. Verily! Strength is in archery, strength is in archery, strength is in archery."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Uqbah bin 'Amir Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying from the pulpit, "Prepare to meet them (the enemy) with as much strength as you can afford. Verily! Strength is in archery, strength is in archery, strength is in archery."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي حماد- ويقال: أبو سعاد، ويقال: أبو أسد، ويقال: أبو عامر، ويقال: أبو عمرو، ويقال: أبو الأسود، ويقال: أبو عبس- عقبة بن عامر الجهني، رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ وهو على المنبر يقول: “وأعدوا لهم ما استطعتم من قوة ألا إن القوة الرمي، ألا إن القوة الرمي، ألا إن القوة الرمي". ((رواه مسلم)). وعنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "ستفتح عليكم أرضون ويكفيكم الله فلا يعجز أحدكم أن يلهو بأسهمه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1333

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Uqbah bin 'Amir Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Lands shall be laid open to you, and Allah will suffice you (against your enemies), but none of you should neglect practicing his skill in archery."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Uqbah bin 'Amir Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Lands shall be laid open to you, and Allah will suffice you (against your enemies), but none of you should neglect practicing his skill in archery."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "ستفتح عليكم أرضون ويكفيكم الله فلا يعجز أحدكم أن يلهو بأسهمه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1334

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Uqbah bin 'Amir Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who learnt archery and then neglected it, is not from us." (Or said,) "He has been guilty of disobedience (to Messenger of Allah)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Uqbah bin 'Amir Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who learnt archery and then neglected it, is not from us." (Or said,) "He has been guilty of disobedience (to Messenger of Allah)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من عُلم الرمي ثم تركه فليس منا أو فقد عصى" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1335

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Uqbah bin 'Amir Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Allah will admit three persons to Jannah for one arrow; the maker who has a good motive in making it, the one who shoots it, and the one who hands it up for shooting. So shoot and ride, but I like your shooting (more) than your riding. He who gives up archery after becoming adept in it for lack of interest, neglects a (great) blessing." (Or said,) "One who does so is ungrateful."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Uqbah bin 'Amir Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Allah will admit three persons to Jannah for one arrow; the maker who has a good motive in making it, the one who shoots it, and the one who hands it up for shooting. So shoot and ride, but I like your shooting (more) than your riding. He who gives up archery after becoming adept in it for lack of interest, neglects a (great) blessing." (Or said,) "One who does so is ungrateful."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه، رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "إن الله يدخل بالسهم الواحد ثلاثة نفر الجنة: صانعه يحتسب في صنعته الخير، والرامي به ومنبله. وارموا واركبوا، وأن ترموا أحب إلي من أن تركبوا. ومن ترك الرمي بعد ما علمه رغبة عنه فإنها نعمة تركها" أو قال: "كفرها" ((رواه أبو داود)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1336

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Salamah bin Al-Akwa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ happened to pass by a group of people who were having a shooting match. (Upon seeing them, he ﷺ) said, "Shoot, O sons of (Prophet) Isma'il, for your father was an archer."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Salamah bin Al-Akwa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ happened to pass by a group of people who were having a shooting match. (Upon seeing them, he ﷺ) said, "Shoot, O sons of (Prophet) Isma'il, for your father was an archer."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن سلمه بن الأكوع، رضي الله عنه قال: مر النبي ﷺ على نفر ينتضلون، فقال: "ارموا بني إسماعيل فإن أباكم كان راميًا" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1337

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Amr bin 'Abasah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "He who shoots an arrow for the sake of Allah, will have a reward equal to the emancipation of a slave."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Amr bin 'Abasah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "He who shoots an arrow for the sake of Allah, will have a reward equal to the emancipation of a slave."

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عمرو بن عبسة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: من رمى بسهم في سبيل الله فهو له عدل محررة: ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح. )).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1338

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Yahya Khuraim bin Fatik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who makes a contribution in Allah's way, will have his reward seven hundred times recorded to his credit."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Yahya Khuraim bin Fatik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who makes a contribution in Allah's way, will have his reward seven hundred times recorded to his credit."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي يحيي خريم بن فاتك رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من أنفق نفقة في سبيل الله كتب له سبعمائة ضعف" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1339

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every slave of Allah who observes Saum (fasting) for a day in the Cause of Allah, Allah will keep his face from Hell-fire at a distance of seventy years."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every slave of Allah who observes Saum (fasting) for a day in the Cause of Allah, Allah will keep his face from Hell-fire at a distance of seventy years."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "ما من عبد يصوم يومًا في سبيل الله إلا باعد الله بذلك اليوم وجهه عن النار سبعين خريفًا" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1340

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who observes Saum (fasting) for a day in the Cause of Allah, Allah will keep his face from Hell-fire at a distance equivalent to that between heaven and the earth."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who observes Saum (fasting) for a day in the Cause of Allah, Allah will keep his face from Hell-fire at a distance equivalent to that between heaven and the earth."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أمامة، رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "من صام يومًا في سبيل الله جعل الله بينه وبين النار خندقًا كما بين السماء والأرض" ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1341

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who dies without having fought in the Cause of Allah or without having thought of doing so, will die with one characteristic of hypocrisy in him."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who dies without having fought in the Cause of Allah or without having thought of doing so, will die with one characteristic of hypocrisy in him."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من مات ولم يغزُ، ولم يحدث نفسه بالغزو، مات على شعبة من النفاق" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1342

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 We accompanied the Prophet ﷺ in an expedition when he ﷺ said, "Some people have remained behind us in Al-Madinah, and we never cross a valley but they are with us. They share the reward with us because they have been held back by valid excuse."

In another narration the wordings are: "...by any genuine excuse."

In another narration the wordings are: "They are your partners in reward."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
We accompanied the Prophet ﷺ in an expedition when he ﷺ said, "Some people have remained behind us in Al-Madinah, and we never cross a valley but they are with us. They share the reward with us because they have been held back by valid excuse."

In another narration the wordings are: "...by any genuine excuse."

In another narration the wordings are: "They are your partners in reward."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: كنا مع النبي ﷺ في غزاة فقال: "إن بالمدينة لرجالا ما سرتم مسيرًا، ولا قطعتم واديًا إلا كانوا معكم حبسهم المرض"

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1343

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah! One man fights for booty, another fights to win fame, and the third fights for show off." Another narration is: "One fights for displaying his valour, another fights out of his family pride." Another narration is: "One fights out of rage." He asked: "Which of them is fighting in the Cause of Allah?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The one who fights so that Word of Allah (Islam) be exalted, is the one who fights in the Cause of Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah! One man fights for booty, another fights to win fame, and the third fights for show off." Another narration is: "One fights for displaying his valour, another fights out of his family pride." Another narration is: "One fights out of rage." He asked: "Which of them is fighting in the Cause of Allah?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The one who fights so that Word of Allah (Islam) be exalted, is the one who fights in the Cause of Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسى، رضي الله عنه أن أعرابيا أتى النبي ﷺ فقال: يا رسول الله الرجل يقاتل للمغنم، والرجل يقاتل ليذكر، والرجل يقاتل ليرى مكانه؟ وفي رواية: يقاتل شجاعة، ويقاتل حَمِيّة.وفي رواية: ويقاتل غضبًا، فمن في سبيل الله؟ فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "من قاتل لتكون كلمة الله هي العليا، فهو في سبيل الله" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1344

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A detachment of soldiers, large or small, who fights in the way of Allah, gets its share of booty and returns safe and sound, receives in advance two- thirds of its reward (only one-third remaining to its credit will be received in the Hereafter). And a troop of soldiers, large or small, that returns disappointed and is afflicted by misery, will receive its full reward (in the Hereafter)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A detachment of soldiers, large or small, who fights in the way of Allah, gets its share of booty and returns safe and sound, receives in advance two- thirds of its reward (only one-third remaining to its credit will be received in the Hereafter). And a troop of soldiers, large or small, that returns disappointed and is afflicted by misery, will receive its full reward (in the Hereafter)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص، رضي الله عنهما، قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "ما من غازية أو سرية تغزو، فتغنم وتسلم، إلا كانوا قد تعجلوا ثلثي أجورهم، وما من غازية أو سرية تخفق وتصاب إلا تم لهم أجورهم" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1345

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man sought permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to travel in the land. He ﷺ said to him, "Travel for my people is Jihad in the Cause of Allah, glory be to Him."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man sought permission from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to travel in the land. He ﷺ said to him, "Travel for my people is Jihad in the Cause of Allah, glory be to Him."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أمامة، رضي الله عنه أن رجلا قال: يا رسول الله ائذن لي في السياحة. فقال النبي ﷺ : "إن سياحة أمتي الجهاد في سبيل الله، عز وجل" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد جيد)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1346

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The return from an expedition is an act as meritorious as fighting."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The return from an expedition is an act as meritorious as fighting."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما عن النبي ﷺ قال: "قفلة كغزوة" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد جيد)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1347

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 When the Prophet ﷺ returned from the battle of Tabuk, people went out from Al-Madinah to meet him and I also met him with other children at Thaniyah-tul-Wada'.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
When the Prophet ﷺ returned from the battle of Tabuk, people went out from Al-Madinah to meet him and I also met him with other children at Thaniyah-tul-Wada'.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن السائب بن يزيد، رضي الله عنه قال: لما قدم النبي ﷺ من غزوة تبوك تلقاه الناس، فلقيته مع الصبيان على ثنية الوداع.(رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح بهذا اللفظ) ورواه البخاري قال: ذهبنا نتلقى رسول الله ﷺ مع الصبيان إلى ثنية الوداع

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1348

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who neither takes part in fighting nor equips a warrior nor looks after his (the warrior's) family, will be afflicted by severe calamities before the Day of Resurrection."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who neither takes part in fighting nor equips a warrior nor looks after his (the warrior's) family, will be afflicted by severe calamities before the Day of Resurrection."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أمامة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: من لم يغزُ أو يجهز غازيًا، أو يخلف غازيًا في أهله بخير أصابه الله بقارعة قبل يوم القيامة: ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1349

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Fight the polytheists with your wealth, lives and tongues."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Fight the polytheists with your wealth, lives and tongues."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ قال: "جاهدوا المشركين بأموالكم وأنفسكم وألسنتكم" ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1350

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when I witnessed that if he did not begin fighting in the early part of the day, he would postpone fighting till the sun had declined, the blowing of the breeze had blown and the victory from Allah had come.

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: An-Nu'man bin Muqarrin (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when I witnessed that if he did not begin fighting in the early part of the day, he would postpone fighting till the sun had declined, the blowing of the breeze had blown and the victory from Allah had come.

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي عمرو ويقال: أبو حكيم النعمان بن مقرن رضي الله عنه قال: شهدت رسول الله ﷺ إذا لم يقاتل من أول النهار أخر القتال حتى تزول الشمس وتهب الريح وينزل النصر. ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي، وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1351

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not wish for an encounter with the enemy. Pray to Allah to grant you safety; (but) when you encounter them, show patience."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not wish for an encounter with the enemy. Pray to Allah to grant you safety; (but) when you encounter them, show patience."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تتمنوا لقاء العدو، فإذا لقيتموه فاصبروا" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1352

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah and Jabir (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "War is deception."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah and Jabir (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "War is deception."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه وعن جابر، رضي الله عنهما أن النبي ﷺ قال: "الحرب خُدعة" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1353

chapter.arabicTitle: باب وجوب الجهاد وفضل الغدوة والروحة
chapter.englishTitle: Obligation of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The martyrs are of five kinds: One who dies of plague; one who dies of disease of his belly; the drowned; one who dies under the debris (of construction, etc.), and one who dies while fighting in the way of Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The martyrs are of five kinds: One who dies of plague; one who dies of disease of his belly; the drowned; one who dies under the debris (of construction, etc.), and one who dies while fighting in the way of Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "الشهداء خمسة: المطعون والمبطون، والغريق، وصاحب الهدم والشهيد في سبيل الله" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1354

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان جماعة من الشهداء في ثواب الآخرة يغسلون ويصلى عليهم بخلاف القتيل في حرب الكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Martyrdom without Fighting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whom do you reckon to be martyr amongst you?" The Companions replied: "The one who is killed in Allah's way." He said, "In that case, the martyrs among my people would be few." The Companions asked: "O Messenger of Allah! Then who are the martyrs?" He replied, "He who is killed in the way of Allah is a martyr; he who dies naturally in the Cause of Allah is a martyr; he who dies of plague is a martyr; and he who dies of a belly disease is a martyr; and he who is drowned is a martyr."

[Muslim]
.

This Hadith shows the care Allah has for this Ummah, which is the best Ummah of mankind. (Editor's Note)
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whom do you reckon to be martyr amongst you?" The Companions replied: "The one who is killed in Allah's way." He said, "In that case, the martyrs among my people would be few." The Companions asked: "O Messenger of Allah! Then who are the martyrs?" He replied, "He who is killed in the way of Allah is a martyr; he who dies naturally in the Cause of Allah is a martyr; he who dies of plague is a martyr; and he who dies of a belly disease is a martyr; and he who is drowned is a martyr."

[Muslim]
.

This Hadith shows the care Allah has for this Ummah, which is the best Ummah of mankind. (Editor's Note)
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "ما تعدون الشهداء فيكم؟ قالوا: يا رسول الله من قتل في سبيل الله فهو شهيد. قال: "إن شهداء أمتي إذًا لقليل!" قالوا: فمن يا رسول الله ؟ قال: "من قتل في سبيل الله فهو شهيد، ومن مات في سبيل الله فهو شهيد، ومن مات في الطاعون فهو شهيد، ومن مات في البطن فهو شهيد، والغريق شهيد" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1355

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان جماعة من الشهداء في ثواب الآخرة يغسلون ويصلى عليهم بخلاف القتيل في حرب الكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Martyrdom without Fighting

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who is killed while defending his property is a martyr."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who is killed while defending his property is a martyr."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص، رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: “من قتل دون ماله فهو شهيد" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1356

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان جماعة من الشهداء في ثواب الآخرة يغسلون ويصلى عليهم بخلاف القتيل في حرب الكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Martyrdom without Fighting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Sa'id bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail (May Allah be pleased with him) reported, one of the ten Companions who were given the glad tidings of entering Jannah reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "He who dies while defending his property is a martyr; he who dies in defence of his own life is a martyr; and he who dies on defense of his faith is a martyr, he who dies in defence of his family is a martyr."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Sa'id bin Zaid bin 'Amr bin Nufail (May Allah be pleased with him) reported, one of the ten Companions who were given the glad tidings of entering Jannah reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "He who dies while defending his property is a martyr; he who dies in defence of his own life is a martyr; and he who dies on defense of his faith is a martyr, he who dies in defence of his family is a martyr."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي الأعور سعيد بن زيد بن عمرو بن نفيل، أحد العشرة المشهود لهم بالجنة، رضي الله عنهم، قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "من قتل دون ماله فهو شهيد، ومن قتل دون دمه فهو شهيد، ومن قتل دون دينه فهو شهيد، ومن قتل دون عرضه فهو شهيد" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال: حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1357

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان جماعة من الشهداء في ثواب الآخرة يغسلون ويصلى عليهم بخلاف القتيل في حرب الكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Martyrdom without Fighting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked, "O Messenger of Allah! What shall I do if someone comes to me with the intention of taking away my property?" He replied, "Do not hand over it to him." The man asked, "What shall I do if he fights me?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then fight him." "What will be my position in the Hereafter if he has killed me?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "In that case you are a martyr." The man asked: "What if I killed him?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "He will be in the Hell- fire."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked, "O Messenger of Allah! What shall I do if someone comes to me with the intention of taking away my property?" He replied, "Do not hand over it to him." The man asked, "What shall I do if he fights me?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then fight him." "What will be my position in the Hereafter if he has killed me?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "In that case you are a martyr." The man asked: "What if I killed him?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "He will be in the Hell- fire."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: جاء رجل إلى رسول الله ﷺ فقال: يا رسول الله أرأيت إن جاء رجل يريد أخذ مالي؟ قال: "فلا تعطه مالك" قال: أرأيت إن قاتلني؟ قال: "قاتله" قال: أرأيت إن قتلني قال: "فأنت شهيد" قال: أرأيت إن قتلته؟ قال: "هو في النار" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1358

chapter.arabicTitle: باب بيان جماعة من الشهداء في ثواب الآخرة يغسلون ويصلى عليهم بخلاف القتيل في حرب الكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Martyrdom without Fighting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who sets free a Muslim slave, Allah will deliver from the fire of Hell every limb of his body in return for every limb of the slave's body, even his private parts."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who sets free a Muslim slave, Allah will deliver from the fire of Hell every limb of his body in return for every limb of the slave's body, even his private parts."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال لي رسول الله ﷺ : "من أعتق رقبة مسلمة أعتق الله بكل عضو منه عضوًا منه من النار حتى فرجه بفرجه" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1359

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل العتق
chapter.englishTitle: The Merit of Emancipation of Slaves

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "Which deed is most excellent?" He replied, "Faith in Allah and Jihad in His path." I then asked, "Which slaves are most excellent (to set free)?" He replied, "Those who are held in high esteem by their people and whose value is higher."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "Which deed is most excellent?" He replied, "Faith in Allah and Jihad in His path." I then asked, "Which slaves are most excellent (to set free)?" He replied, "Those who are held in high esteem by their people and whose value is higher."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه قال: قلت يا رسول الله أي الأعمال أفضل؟ قال: "الإيمان بالله، والجهاد في سبيل الله" قلت: أي الرقاب أفضل؟ قال: "أنفسها عند أهلها وأكثرها ثمنًا” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1360

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل العتق
chapter.englishTitle: The Merit of Emancipation of Slaves

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Ma'rur bin Suwaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I saw Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) wearing a nice gown, and his slave was also wearing one similar to it. I asked him about it, and he said that he had exchanged harsh words with a person during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and put him to shame by making a reference to his mother. That person came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and made mention of that to him. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah said, "You are a person who has remnants of the 'Days of Ignorance' in you. Your slaves are your brothers. Allah has placed them under your authority. He who has his brother under him, should feed him from whatever he eats, and dress him with whatever he wears, and do not burden them (assign burdensome task to them) beyond their capacity; and if you burden them then help them."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Ma'rur bin Suwaid (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I saw Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) wearing a nice gown, and his slave was also wearing one similar to it. I asked him about it, and he said that he had exchanged harsh words with a person during the lifetime of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and put him to shame by making a reference to his mother. That person came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and made mention of that to him. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah said, "You are a person who has remnants of the 'Days of Ignorance' in you. Your slaves are your brothers. Allah has placed them under your authority. He who has his brother under him, should feed him from whatever he eats, and dress him with whatever he wears, and do not burden them (assign burdensome task to them) beyond their capacity; and if you burden them then help them."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن المعرور بن سويد قال: رأيت أبا ذر رضي الله عنه وعليه حلة وعلى غلامه مثلها، فسألته عن ذلك فذكر أنه ساب رجلا على عهد رسول الله ﷺ فعيره بأمه فقال النبي ﷺ : "إنك امرؤ فيك جاهلية" : هم إخوانكم، وخولكم جعلهم الله تحت أيديكم فمن كان أخوه تحت يده فليطعمه مما يأكل ويلبسه مما يلبس ولا تكلفوهم ما يغلبهم، فإن كلفتموهم فأعينوهم” ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1361

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل الإحسان إلى المملوك
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Kind Attitude towards Slaves

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When your servant brings food for you and you do not seat him with you, you should at least give him a morsel or two out of it because he has prepared it himself."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When your servant brings food for you and you do not seat him with you, you should at least give him a morsel or two out of it because he has prepared it himself."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "إذا أتى أحدكم خادمه بطعامه، فإن لم يجلسه معه فليناوله لقمة أو لقمتين أو أُكلة أو أُكلتين فإنه ولي علاجه" ((رواه البخاري)). (9)

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1362

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل الإحسان إلى المملوك
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Kind Attitude towards Slaves

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When a slave is sincere to his master and worships Allah well, He will have a double reward."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When a slave is sincere to his master and worships Allah well, He will have a double reward."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "إن العبد إذا نصح لسيده، وأحسن عبادة الله، فله أجره مرتين" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1363

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل المملوك الذي يؤدي حق الله وحق مواليه
chapter.englishTitle: The Merit of the Dutiful Slave

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The faithful and diligent slave will have a double reward." (Abu Hurairah added:) By Him in Whose Hand the soul of Abu Hurairah is! but for Jihad in the Cause of Allah, and Hajj and kindness to my mother, I would have preferred to die as a slave.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The faithful and diligent slave will have a double reward." (Abu Hurairah added:) By Him in Whose Hand the soul of Abu Hurairah is! but for Jihad in the Cause of Allah, and Hajj and kindness to my mother, I would have preferred to die as a slave.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "للعبد المملوك المصلح أجران، والذي نفس أبي هريرة بيده لولا الجهاد في سبيل الله والحج، وبر أمي لأحببت أن أموت وأنا مملوك" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1364

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل المملوك الذي يؤدي حق الله وحق مواليه
chapter.englishTitle: The Merit of the Dutiful Slave

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A slave who worships his Rubb (Allah) well and discharges efficiently and faithfully the duties which are assigned to him by his master, will have a double reward."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A slave who worships his Rubb (Allah) well and discharges efficiently and faithfully the duties which are assigned to him by his master, will have a double reward."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسى الأشعري قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "المملوك الذي يحسن عبادة ربه ويؤدي إلى سيده الذي عليه من الحق، والنصيحة والطاعة له أجران" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1365

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل المملوك الذي يؤدي حق الله وحق مواليه
chapter.englishTitle: The Merit of the Dutiful Slave

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Three kinds of people will have a double reward: A man from the People of the Book who believes in his Prophet and (also) believes in Muhammad; a slave who discharges properly the duties towards Allah and towards his master; and a man who possesses a slave-girl and teaches her manners, educates her well, and frees her and then marries her."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Three kinds of people will have a double reward: A man from the People of the Book who believes in his Prophet and (also) believes in Muhammad; a slave who discharges properly the duties towards Allah and towards his master; and a man who possesses a slave-girl and teaches her manners, educates her well, and frees her and then marries her."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "ثلاثة لهم أجران: رجل من أهل الكتاب آمن بنبيه، وآمن بمحمد، والعبد المملوك إذا أدى حق الله، وحق مواليه، ورجل كانت له أمة فأدبها فأحسن تأديبها وعلمها فأحسن تعليمها، ثم أعتقها فتزوجها فله أجران" ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1366

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل المملوك الذي يؤدي حق الله وحق مواليه
chapter.englishTitle: The Merit of the Dutiful Slave

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ma'qil bin Yasar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The reward of worship performed at a time of trials is equal in reward to an emigration to me."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ma'qil bin Yasar (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The reward of worship performed at a time of trials is equal in reward to an emigration to me."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن معقل بن يسار رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "العبادة في الهرج كهجرة إلي" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1367

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل العبادة في الهرج وهو الاختلاط والفتن ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Worship in the time of Tribulations

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 A man demanded of the Prophet ﷺ for repayment of a loan and was harsh to him. His Companions were about to attack him, but he ﷺ said, "Leave him, as the creditor is entitled to make a demand. Give him a camel of the same age as the camel that is due to him." They said: "We find a better camel senior to it in age." He ﷺ said, "Then buy it and give it to him; verily the best of you is the one who is the best in discharging his obligations (repayment of loans)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
A man demanded of the Prophet ﷺ for repayment of a loan and was harsh to him. His Companions were about to attack him, but he ﷺ said, "Leave him, as the creditor is entitled to make a demand. Give him a camel of the same age as the camel that is due to him." They said: "We find a better camel senior to it in age." He ﷺ said, "Then buy it and give it to him; verily the best of you is the one who is the best in discharging his obligations (repayment of loans)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رجلا أتى النبي ﷺ يتقاضاه فأغلظ له فهم به أصحابه، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "دعوه فإن لصاحب الحق مقالا" ثم قال: "أعطوه سنا مثل سنه" قالوا: يا رسول الله لا نجد إلا أمثل من سنه، قال: "أعطوه فإن خيركم أحسنكم قضاء" ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1368

chapter.arabicTitle: باب فضل السماحة في البيع والشراء والأخذ والعطاء وحسن القضاء وإرجاح المكيال والميزان والنهي عن التطفيف، وفضل إنظار الموسر المعسر، والوضع عنه
chapter.englishTitle: Excellence of Fair Bargaining and Matters Relation to it

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "May Allah show mercy to a man who adopts a kind attitude when he sells, buys and demands for the repayment of loans."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
