"We have been prohibited from spying (on Muslims) and finding faults (with them). But we can take to task only and only if the sin is overt.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أنه أتي برجل فقيل له، هذا فلان تقطر لحيته خمرًا، فقال: إنَّا قد نهينا عن التجسس، ولكن إن يظهر لنا شئ، نأخذ به". حديث حسن صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد على شرط البخاري ومسلم.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1573

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التجسس والتسمع لكلام من يكره استماعه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Spying on Muslims and to be Inquisitive about Others

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "إياكم والظن، فإن الظن أكذب الحديث" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1574

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن سوء الظن بالمسلمين من غير ضرورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Suspicion

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is enough evil for a Muslim to look down upon his (Muslim) brother."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is enough evil for a Muslim to look down upon his (Muslim) brother."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "بحسب امرئ من الشر أن يحقر المسلم". ((رواه مسلم، وقد سبق قريبًا بطوله)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1575

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم احتقار المسلمين
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Despising Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The haughty, even with pride equal to a mustard seed in his heart, will not enter Jannah." A man enquired: "What about that a person likes fine dress and fine shoes?" He said: "Allah is Beautiful and likes beauty. Pride amounts to disclaiming truth out of self- esteem, and despising people ."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The haughty, even with pride equal to a mustard seed in his heart, will not enter Jannah." A man enquired: "What about that a person likes fine dress and fine shoes?" He said: "Allah is Beautiful and likes beauty. Pride amounts to disclaiming truth out of self- esteem, and despising people ."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "لا يدخل الجنة من كان في قلبه مثقال ذرة من كبر" فقال رجل: إن الرجل يحب أن يكون ثوبه حسنًا، ونعله حسنة، فقال: "إن الله جميل يحب الجمال، الكبر بَطَر الحق، وغمط الناس".((رواه مسلم)).  ومعنى "بَطَر الحق": دفعه، "وغمطهم": احتقارهم، وقد سبق بيانه أوضح من هذا في باب الكبر.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1576

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم احتقار المسلمين
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Despising Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jundub bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Once someone said: 'By Allah! Allah will not forgive such and such (a person).' Thereupon Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious, said: 'Who is he who takes an oath in My Name that I will not grant pardon to so-and-so? I have granted pardon to so-and-so and rendered your good deeds fruitless."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jundub bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Once someone said: 'By Allah! Allah will not forgive such and such (a person).' Thereupon Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious, said: 'Who is he who takes an oath in My Name that I will not grant pardon to so-and-so? I have granted pardon to so-and-so and rendered your good deeds fruitless."'

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جُندب بن عبد الله رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "قال رجل: والله لا يغفر الله لفلان، فقال الله عز وجل: من ذا الذي يتألى علي أن لا أغفر لفلان! فإني قد غفرت له، وأحبطت عملك" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1577

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم احتقار المسلمين
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Despising Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw:
Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not express pleasure at the misfortune of a (Muslim) brother lest Allah should bestow mercy upon him and make you suffer from a misfortune."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Wathilah bin Al-Asqa' (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not express pleasure at the misfortune of a (Muslim) brother lest Allah should bestow mercy upon him and make you suffer from a misfortune."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن واثلة بن الأسقع رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : " لا تظهر الشماتة لأخيك، فيرحمه الله ويبتليك". ((رواه الترمذي وقال: حديث حسن)) وفي الباب حديث أبي هريرة السابق في باب التجسس: " كل المسلم على المسلم حرام" الحديث.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1578

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن إظهار الشماتة بالمسلم
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Rejoicing over another's Trouble

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Two matters are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Defaming and speaking evil of a person's lineage, and wailing over the dead."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Two matters are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Defaming and speaking evil of a person's lineage, and wailing over the dead."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : " اثنتان في الناس هما بهم كفر: الطعن في النسب، والنياحة على الميت" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1579

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الطعن في الأنساب الثابتة في ظاهر الشرع
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Deriding one's Lineage

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who takes up arms against us is none of us; and he who cheats us is none of us."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration of Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ happened to pass by a heap of corn. He thrust his hand in that (heap) and his fingers felt wetness. He said to the owner of that heap of corn, "What is this?" He replied: "O Messenger of Allah! These have been drenched by rainfall." He remarked, "Why did you not place this (the drenched part of the heap) over the corn so that people might see it? He who deceives is not of us."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who takes up arms against us is none of us; and he who cheats us is none of us."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration of Muslim is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ happened to pass by a heap of corn. He thrust his hand in that (heap) and his fingers felt wetness. He said to the owner of that heap of corn, "What is this?" He replied: "O Messenger of Allah! These have been drenched by rainfall." He remarked, "Why did you not place this (the drenched part of the heap) over the corn so that people might see it? He who deceives is not of us."
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: " من حمل علينا السلاح، فليس منا، ومن غشنا، فليس منا" ((رواه مسلم)). وفي رواية له أن رسول الله ﷺ مر على صبرة طعام، فأدخل يده فيها، فنالت أصابعه بللا، فقال: " ما هذا ياصاحب الطعام؟" قال أصابته السماء يارسول الله، قال: " أفلا جعلته فوق الطعام حتى يراه الناس! من غشنا فليس منا".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1580

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الغش والخداع
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Deceiving others

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not practise Najsh (to cheat)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not practise Najsh (to cheat)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن رسول الله ﷺ ، قال: " لا تناجشوا" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1581

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الغش والخداع
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Deceiving others

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the practice of Najsh.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the practice of Najsh.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، أن النبي ﷺ نهى عن النَجَش، ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1582

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الغش والخداع
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Deceiving others

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 A man mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he was often deceived in dealings. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "When you enter into a transaction you should say: "There should be no deception."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
A man mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he was often deceived in dealings. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "When you enter into a transaction you should say: "There should be no deception."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: ذكر رجل لرسول الله ﷺ أنه يُخدع في البيوع فقال رسول الله ﷺ: "من بايعت؟ فقل : لا خلابة" ((متفق عليه)). "الخِلابة" بخاء معجمة مكسورة، وباء موحدة: وهي الخديعة.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1583

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الغش والخداع
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Deceiving others

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who deceives another's wife or his slave is none of us."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who deceives another's wife or his slave is none of us."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من خبب زوجة امرئ، أو مملوكه، فليس منا". "خَبَب" بخاء معجمة، ثم باء موحدة مكررة: أي: أفسده وخدعه.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1584

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الغش والخداع
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Deceiving others

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whosoever possesses these four characteristics is a sheer hypocrite; and anyone who possesses one of them possesses a characteristic of hypocrisy till he gives it up. These are: when he is entrusted with something, he proves dishonest; when he speaks, he tells a lie; when he makes a covenant, he proves treacherous; and when he quarrels, he behaves in very imprudent, evil, insulting manner."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whosoever possesses these four characteristics is a sheer hypocrite; and anyone who possesses one of them possesses a characteristic of hypocrisy till he gives it up. These are: when he is entrusted with something, he proves dishonest; when he speaks, he tells a lie; when he makes a covenant, he proves treacherous; and when he quarrels, he behaves in very imprudent, evil, insulting manner."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: " أربع من كن فيه، كان منافقًا خالصًا، ومن كانت فيه خصلة منهن، كان فيه خصلة من النفاق حتى يدعها: إذا اؤتمن خان، وإذا حدث كذب، وإذا عاهد غدر، وإذا خاصم فجر" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1585

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الغدر
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of the Treachery and Breaking one's Covenant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud, Ibn 'Umar and Anas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "For every one who breaks his covenant, there will be a (huge) flag on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said: 'This flag proclaims a breach of covenant by so-and-so."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud, Ibn 'Umar and Anas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "For every one who breaks his covenant, there will be a (huge) flag on the Day of Resurrection and it will be said: 'This flag proclaims a breach of covenant by so-and-so."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود، وابن عمر، وأنس رضي الله عنهم قالوا: قال النبي ﷺ : " لكل غادر لواء يوم القيامة، يقال: هذه غدرة فلان" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1586

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الغدر
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of the Treachery and Breaking one's Covenant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Every one who breaks a covenant will have a flag by his buttocks on the Day of Resurrection. It will be raised higher according to the nature of his breach. Behold, there will be no greater a sin with respect to breaking the covenant than that of a ruler who breaks his covenant with the Muslim masses."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Every one who breaks a covenant will have a flag by his buttocks on the Day of Resurrection. It will be raised higher according to the nature of his breach. Behold, there will be no greater a sin with respect to breaking the covenant than that of a ruler who breaks his covenant with the Muslim masses."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ قال : " لكل غادر لواء عند استه يوم القيامة يرفع له بقدر غدره، ألا لا غادر أعظم غدرًا من أمير عامة" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1587

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الغدر
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of the Treachery and Breaking one's Covenant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I will contend on the Day of Resurrection against three (types of) people: One who makes a covenant in My Name and then breaks it; one who sells a free man as a slave and devours his price; and one who hires a workman and having taken full work from him, does not pay him his wages."'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah, the Exalted, says: 'I will contend on the Day of Resurrection against three (types of) people: One who makes a covenant in My Name and then breaks it; one who sells a free man as a slave and devours his price; and one who hires a workman and having taken full work from him, does not pay him his wages."'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: " قال الله تعالى: ثلاثة أنا خصمهم يوم القيامة : رجل أعطى بي ثم غدر، ورجل باع حرًا فأكل ثمنه، ورجل استأجر أجيرًا، فاستوفى منه، ولم يعطه أجره" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1588

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الغدر
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of the Treachery and Breaking one's Covenant

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ observed: "There are three (types of) people to whom Allah will neither speak on the Day of Resurrection nor look at them nor purify them, and they will have a painful chastisement." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ repeated it three times. Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) remarked: "They are ruined. Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?" Upon this, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "One who lets down his lower garments (below his ankels) out of arrogance, one who boasts of his favours done to another; and who sells his goods by taking a false oath."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ observed: "There are three (types of) people to whom Allah will neither speak on the Day of Resurrection nor look at them nor purify them, and they will have a painful chastisement." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ repeated it three times. Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) remarked: "They are ruined. Who are they, O Messenger of Allah?" Upon this, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "One who lets down his lower garments (below his ankels) out of arrogance, one who boasts of his favours done to another; and who sells his goods by taking a false oath."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: " ثلاثة لا يكلمهم الله يوم القيامة ولا ينظر  إليهم، ولا يزكيهم ولهم عذاب أليم" قال: فقرأها رسول الله ﷺ ثلاث مرار. قال أبو ذر: خابوا وخسروا من هم يا رسول الله؟ قال: المسبل، والمنان، والمنفق سلعته بالحلف الكاذب" ((رواه مسلم)). وفي رواية له : " المسبل إزاره" يعني: المسبل إزاره وثوبه أسفل من الكعبين للخُيلاء.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1589

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن المن بالعطية ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Recounting of Favors

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Iyad bin Himar (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah has revealed to me that you should adopt humility. So that no one may wrong another and no one may be disdainful and haughty towards another."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Iyad bin Himar (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah has revealed to me that you should adopt humility. So that no one may wrong another and no one may be disdainful and haughty towards another."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عياض بن حمار رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "إن الله تعالى أوحى إلي أن تواضعوا حتى لا يبغي أحد على أحد، ولا يفخر أحد على أحد" ((رواه مسلم)) قال أهل اللغة: البغي: التعدي والاستطالة.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1590

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الافتخار والبغي
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Arrogance and Oppression

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a person says: 'People have been ruined, he is the one to be ruined the most."'

[Muslim]

In another version: "He himself is the most ruined among them."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a person says: 'People have been ruined, he is the one to be ruined the most."'

[Muslim]

In another version: "He himself is the most ruined among them."
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "إذا قال الرجل: هلك الناس، فهو أهلكهم" ((رواه مسلم)). الرواية المشهورة:  أهلكَُهم  برفع الكاف، وروي بنصبها، وهذا هو الحرام، وأما من قاله ذلك عجبًا بنفسه، وتصاغرا للناس، وارتفاعًا عليهم، فهذا هو الحرام، وأما من قاله لما يرى في الناس من نقص في أمر دينهم، وقاله تحزنًا عليهم، وعلى الدين فلا بأس به. هكذا فسره العلماء وفصلوه، ومن قاله من الأئمة الأعلام: مالك بن أنس، والخطابي، والحميدي وآخرون، وقد أوضحته في كتاب  الأذكار .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1591

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الافتخار والبغي
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Arrogance and Oppression

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not desert (stop talking to) one another, do not nurse hatred towards one another, do not be jealous of one another, and become as fellow brothers and slaves of Allah. It is not lawful for a Muslim to stop talking to his brother (Muslim) for more than three days."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not desert (stop talking to) one another, do not nurse hatred towards one another, do not be jealous of one another, and become as fellow brothers and slaves of Allah. It is not lawful for a Muslim to stop talking to his brother (Muslim) for more than three days."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تقاطعوا ولا تدابروا، ولا تباغضوا، ولا تحاسدوا، وكونوا عباد الله إخوانًا، ولا يحل لمسلم أن يهجر أخاه فوق ثلاث" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1592

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الهجران بين المسلمين فوق ثلاثة أيام إلا لبدعة في المهجور أو تظاهر بفسق أو نحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Breaking ties and Relationships

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim to desert (stop talking to) his brother beyond three nights, the one turning one way and the other turning to the other way when they meet, the better of the two is one who is the first to greet the other."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim to desert (stop talking to) his brother beyond three nights, the one turning one way and the other turning to the other way when they meet, the better of the two is one who is the first to greet the other."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أيوب رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "لا يحل لمسلم أن يهجر أخاه فوق ثلاث ليال: يلتقيان، فيعرض هذا ويعرض هذا، وخيرهما الذي يبدأ بالسلام" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1593

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الهجران بين المسلمين فوق ثلاثة أيام إلا لبدعة في المهجور أو تظاهر بفسق أو نحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Breaking ties and Relationships

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "People's deeds are presented before Allah on Mondays and Thursdays, and then every slave (of Allah) is granted forgiveness (of minor sins) if he does not associate anything with Allah in worship. But the person in whose heart there is rancour against his brother, will not be pardoned. With regard to them, it is said twice: 'Hold these two until they are reconciled'."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "People's deeds are presented before Allah on Mondays and Thursdays, and then every slave (of Allah) is granted forgiveness (of minor sins) if he does not associate anything with Allah in worship. But the person in whose heart there is rancour against his brother, will not be pardoned. With regard to them, it is said twice: 'Hold these two until they are reconciled'."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "تعرض الأعمال في كل اثنين وخميس، فيغفر الله لكل امرئ لا يشرك بالله شيئا، إلا امرءا كانت بينه وبين أخيه شحناء، فيقول: اتركوا هذين حتى يصطلحا" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1594

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الهجران بين المسلمين فوق ثلاثة أيام إلا لبدعة في المهجور أو تظاهر بفسق أو نحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Breaking ties and Relationships

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying, "The Satan has despaired of being worshipped by those who engage in prayer in the Arabian Peninsula but (has not lost hope) in creating dissension among them."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying, "The Satan has despaired of being worshipped by those who engage in prayer in the Arabian Peninsula but (has not lost hope) in creating dissension among them."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "إن الشيطان قد يئس أن يعبده المصلون في جزيرة العرب، ولكن في والتحريش بينهم " ((رواه مسلم)). التحريش: الإفساد وتغيير قلوبهم وتقاطعهم.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1595

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الهجران بين المسلمين فوق ثلاثة أيام إلا لبدعة في المهجور أو تظاهر بفسق أو نحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Breaking ties and Relationships

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim to forsake his (Muslim) brother beyond three days; and whosoever does so for more than three days, and then dies, will certainly enter the Hell."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not lawful for a Muslim to forsake his (Muslim) brother beyond three days; and whosoever does so for more than three days, and then dies, will certainly enter the Hell."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا يحل لمسلم أن يهجر أخاه فوق ثلاث، فمن هجر فوق ثلاث، فمات دخل النار".((رواه أبو داود بإسناد على شرط البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1596

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الهجران بين المسلمين فوق ثلاثة أيام إلا لبدعة في المهجور أو تظاهر بفسق أو نحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Breaking ties and Relationships

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Khirash Hadrad bin Abu Hadrad Al-Aslami (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "Whosoever forsakes his brother for a year is like one who sheds his blood."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Khirash Hadrad bin Abu Hadrad Al-Aslami (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "Whosoever forsakes his brother for a year is like one who sheds his blood."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي خراش حدرد بن أبي حدرد الأسلمي، ويقال السلمي الصحابي رضي الله عنه أنه سمع النبي ﷺ يقول: "من هجر أخاه سنة فهو كسفك دمه".((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1597

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الهجران بين المسلمين فوق ثلاثة أيام إلا لبدعة في المهجور أو تظاهر بفسق أو نحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Breaking ties and Relationships

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not permissible for a believer to forsake his (Muslim) brother for more than three days. If three days have passed, he should meet him and greet him; and if other responds to it they will both share the reward; but if he does not respond, he will bear his sin and the one who (has taken the initiative to) greet (the other) will be absolved of the sin of forsaking (one's brother in Faith)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not permissible for a believer to forsake his (Muslim) brother for more than three days. If three days have passed, he should meet him and greet him; and if other responds to it they will both share the reward; but if he does not respond, he will bear his sin and the one who (has taken the initiative to) greet (the other) will be absolved of the sin of forsaking (one's brother in Faith)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "لا يحل لمؤمن أن يهجر مؤمنًا فوق ثلاث، فإن مرت به ثلاث، فليلقه، وليسلم عليه، فإن رد عليه السلام، فقد اشتركا في الأجر، وإن لم يرد عليه، فقد باء بالإثم، وخرج المسلم من الهجرة". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن قال أبو داود: إذا كانت الهجرة لله تعالى، فليس من هذا في شيء)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1598

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الهجران بين المسلمين فوق ثلاثة أيام إلا لبدعة في المهجور أو تظاهر بفسق أو نحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Breaking ties and Relationships

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "In the presence of three people, two should not hold secret counsel, to the exclusion of the third."

[Al- Bukhari and Muslim]
.

In Abu Dawud, Abu Salih related: I asked Ibn 'Umar: "What if there are four people." He said, "There is no harm in that."

Malik reported in Al-Muwatta that 'Abdullah bin Dinar related: Ibn 'Umar and I were together in Khalid bin 'Uqbah's house which was situated in the market place. A man came to consult Ibn 'Umar. None besides me was present. Ibn 'Umar called another man in and we became four and said to me and the man he had called: Move away a bit because I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The two people should not hold secret counsel together excluding the third."
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "In the presence of three people, two should not hold secret counsel, to the exclusion of the third."

[Al- Bukhari and Muslim]
.

In Abu Dawud, Abu Salih related: I asked Ibn 'Umar: "What if there are four people." He said, "There is no harm in that."

Malik reported in Al-Muwatta that 'Abdullah bin Dinar related: Ibn 'Umar and I were together in Khalid bin 'Uqbah's house which was situated in the market place. A man came to consult Ibn 'Umar. None besides me was present. Ibn 'Umar called another man in and we became four and said to me and the man he had called: Move away a bit because I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The two people should not hold secret counsel together excluding the third."
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "إذا كانوا ثلاثة فلا يتناجى اثنان دون الثالث" ((متفق عليه)). ((ورواه أبو دواد وزاد: قال أبو صالح: قلت لابن عمر: فأربعة؟ قال: لا يضرك. ورواه مالك في الموطأ: عن عبد الله بن دينار قال: كنت أنا وابن عمر عند دار خالد بن عقبة التي في السوق، فجاء رجل يريد أن يناجيه، وليس مع ابن عمر أحد غيري، فدعا ابن عمر رجلا آخر حتى كنا أربعة فقال لي وللرجل الثالث الذي دعا: استأخرا شيئًا، فإني سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "لا يتناجى اثنان دون واحد".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1599

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تناجي اثنين دون الثالث بغير إذنه إلا لحاجة وهو أن يتحدثا سرًا بحيث لا يسمعهما وفي معناه إذا تحدثا بلسان لا يفهمه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of two Holding Secret Counsel to the Exclusion of Conversing together a Third

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When three of you are together, two of you must not converse privately ignoring the third till the number increases, lest the third should be grieved."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When three of you are together, two of you must not converse privately ignoring the third till the number increases, lest the third should be grieved."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "إذا كنتم ثلاثة، فلا يتناجى اثنان دون الآخر حتى تختلطوا بالناس، من أجل أن ذلك يحزنه" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1600

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تناجي اثنين دون الثالث بغير إذنه إلا لحاجة وهو أن يتحدثا سرًا بحيث لا يسمعهما وفي معناه إذا تحدثا بلسان لا يفهمه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of two Holding Secret Counsel to the Exclusion of Conversing together a Third

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A woman was punished in Hell because of a cat which she had confined until it died. She did not give it to eat or to drink when it was confined, nor did she free it so that it might eat the vermin of the earth."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A woman was punished in Hell because of a cat which she had confined until it died. She did not give it to eat or to drink when it was confined, nor did she free it so that it might eat the vermin of the earth."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "عذبت امرأة في هِرة حبستها حتى ماتت، فدخلت فيها النار، لا هي أطعمتها وسقتها، إذ هي حبستها، ولا هي تركتها تأكل من خشاش الأرض" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1601

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 I happened to pass by some lads of the Quraish who had tied a bird at which they have been shooting arrows. Every arrow that they missed came into the possession of the owner of the bird. No sooner had they seen Ibn 'Umar, they dispersed. Thereupon, Ibn 'Umar said: "Who has done this? May Allah curse him who has done so. Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has cursed anyone who makes a live thing the target (of one's marksmanship)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
I happened to pass by some lads of the Quraish who had tied a bird at which they have been shooting arrows. Every arrow that they missed came into the possession of the owner of the bird. No sooner had they seen Ibn 'Umar, they dispersed. Thereupon, Ibn 'Umar said: "Who has done this? May Allah curse him who has done so. Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has cursed anyone who makes a live thing the target (of one's marksmanship)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أنه مر بفتيان من قريش قد نصبوا طيرًا وهم يرمونه، وقد جعلوا لصاحب الطير كل خاطئة من نبلهم، فلما رأوا ابن عمر تفرقوا، فقال ابن عمر: من فعل هذا؟ لعن الله من فعل هذا، إن رسول الله ﷺ لعن من اتخذ شيئًا فيه روح غرضًا. ((متفق عليه)). "الغَرَض" : بفتح الغين المعجمة والراء، وهو الهدف، والشيء الذي يرمى إليه.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1602

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade animals being tied (as targets).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade animals being tied (as targets).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: نهى رسول الله ﷺ أن تُصبر البهائم. ((متفق عليه)).  ومعناه: تحبس للقتل.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1603

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Ali Suwaid bin Muqarrin (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I was the seventh child of Banu Muqarrin and we had only one slave-girl. When the youngest of us once happened to slap her (on the face) the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered us to set her free.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Ali Suwaid bin Muqarrin (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I was the seventh child of Banu Muqarrin and we had only one slave-girl. When the youngest of us once happened to slap her (on the face) the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered us to set her free.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي علي سويد بن مقرن رضي الله عنه قال: لقد رأيتني سابع سبعة من بني مقرن ما لنا خادم إلا واحدة لطمها أصغرنا فأمرنا رسول الله ﷺ أن نعتقها. ((رواه مسلم)). ورواية: "سابع إخوة لي".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1604

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I was beating my slave with a whip when I heard a voice behind me which said: "Abu Mas'ud! Bear in mind..." I did not recognize the voice for the intense anger I was in. Abu Mas'ud added: As he came near me, I found that he was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was saying, "Abu Mas'ud! Bear in mind that Allah has more dominance upon you than you have upon your slave." Then I said: "I will never beat any slave in future."

Another narration is: The whip dropped from my hand in awe of the Prophet ﷺ.

Still another narration is: I said: "He is free for the sake of Allah." He ﷺ said, "If you had not done this, you would have been singed by the Fire."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I was beating my slave with a whip when I heard a voice behind me which said: "Abu Mas'ud! Bear in mind..." I did not recognize the voice for the intense anger I was in. Abu Mas'ud added: As he came near me, I found that he was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was saying, "Abu Mas'ud! Bear in mind that Allah has more dominance upon you than you have upon your slave." Then I said: "I will never beat any slave in future."

Another narration is: The whip dropped from my hand in awe of the Prophet ﷺ.

Still another narration is: I said: "He is free for the sake of Allah." He ﷺ said, "If you had not done this, you would have been singed by the Fire."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي مسعود البدري رضي الله عنه قال: "كنتُ أضرب غلامًا لي بالوسط، فسمعت صوتًا من خلفي: "اعلم أبا مسعود" فلم أفهم الصوت من الغضب، فلما دنا مني إذا هو رسول الله ﷺ فإذا هو يقول: "اعلم أبا مسعود أن الله أقدرُ عليك منك على هذا الغلام" فقلت: لا أضرب مملوكًا بعده أبدًا. ((وفي رواية: فسقط السوط من يدي من هيبته))((وفي رواية: فقلت: يارسول الله هو حر لوجه الله تعالى، فقال: "أما لو لم تفعل، للفحتك النار، أو لمستك النار" ((رواه مسلم بهذه الروايات)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1605

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The expiation for beating or slapping a slave on the face for something he has not done is to set him free."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The expiation for beating or slapping a slave on the face for something he has not done is to set him free."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن النبي ﷺ قال: "من ضرب غلامًا له حدًا لم يأتهِ، أو لطمه، فإن كفارته أن يعتقه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1606

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
It has been narrated that Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam (May Allah be pleased with them) happened to pass by some (non-Arab) farmers of Syria who had been made to stand in the sun, and olive oil was poured on their heads. He said:
 "What is the matter?" He was told that they had been detained for the non-payment of Jizyah. (Another narration says that they were being tortured for not having paid Al-Kharaj). Thereupon Hisham said: "I bear testimony to the fact that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Allah will torment those who torment people in the world."' Then he proceeded towards their Amir and reported this Hadith to him. The Amir then issued orders for their release.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: It has been narrated that Hisham bin Hakim bin Hizam (May Allah be pleased with them) happened to pass by some (non-Arab) farmers of Syria who had been made to stand in the sun, and olive oil was poured on their heads. He said:
hadiths.body:
"What is the matter?" He was told that they had been detained for the non-payment of Jizyah. (Another narration says that they were being tortured for not having paid Al-Kharaj). Thereupon Hisham said: "I bear testimony to the fact that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Allah will torment those who torment people in the world."' Then he proceeded towards their Amir and reported this Hadith to him. The Amir then issued orders for their release.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن هشام بن حكيم بن حزام رضي الله عنه أنه مر بالشام على أناس من الأنباط، وقد أقيموا في الشمس، وصُب على رءوسهم الزيت فقال: ما هذا؟ يُعذبون في الخراج وفي رواية: حُبسوا في الجزية. فقال هشام: أشهد لسمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "إن الله يعذب الذين يعذبون الناس في الدنيا" فدخل على الأمير، فحدثه، فأمر بهم فخلوا" ((رواه مسلم. "الأنباط" الفلاحون من العجم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1607

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw an ass which had been branded on the face. He disapproved of it. Upon this Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said, "By Allah, I shall not brand (the animal) but on a part at a distance from the face." Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) then commanded branding on the hips; he was the first person to brand the animals on hips.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw an ass which had been branded on the face. He disapproved of it. Upon this Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said, "By Allah, I shall not brand (the animal) but on a part at a distance from the face." Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) then commanded branding on the hips; he was the first person to brand the animals on hips.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: رأى رسول الله ﷺ حمارًا موسوم الوجه، فأنكر ذلك؟ فقال: والله لا أسمه إلا أقصى شيء من الوجه، وأمر بحماره، فكوي في جاعرتيه، فهو أول من كوى الجاعرتين. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1608

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 An ass with a brand on the face happened to pass before the Prophet ﷺ. Thereupon he said, "May Allah curse the one who has branded it (on the face)."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration in Muslim is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited us from hitting across the face and branding on the face (of an animal)."
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
An ass with a brand on the face happened to pass before the Prophet ﷺ. Thereupon he said, "May Allah curse the one who has branded it (on the face)."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration in Muslim is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited us from hitting across the face and branding on the face (of an animal)."
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن النبي ﷺ : مر عليه حمار قد وُسم في وجهه، فقال: "لعن الله الذي وسمه" ((رواه مسلم. وفي رواية لمسلم أيضًا: نهى رسول الله ﷺ عن الضرب في الوجه، وعن الوسم في الوجه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1609

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تعذيب العبد والدابة والمرأة والولد بغير سبب شرعي أو زائد على قدر الأدب
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Cruelty

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent us on an expedition and said to us, "If you find so- and-so (he named two persons belonging to the Quraish) commit them to the fire." When we were on the verge of departure, he said to us, "I ordered you to burn so-and-so, but it is Allah Alone Who punishes with the fire. So if you find them put them to death."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent us on an expedition and said to us, "If you find so- and-so (he named two persons belonging to the Quraish) commit them to the fire." When we were on the verge of departure, he said to us, "I ordered you to burn so-and-so, but it is Allah Alone Who punishes with the fire. So if you find them put them to death."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: بعثنا رسول الله ﷺ في بعث فقال: "إن وجدتم فلانًا وفلانًا" لرجلين من قريش سماهما "فأحرقوهما بالنار" ثم قال رسول الله ﷺ حين أردنا الخروج: "إني كنت أمرتكم أن تحرقوا فلانًا وفلانًا، وإن النار لا يعذب بها إلا الله، فإن وجدتموهما فاقتلوهما" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1610

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم التعذيب بالنار في كل حيوان حتى القملة ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Chastisement with Fire

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a journey when he drew apart (to relieve nature). In his absence, we saw a red bird which had two young ones with it. We caught them and the red mother bird came, beating the earth with its wings. In the meantime the Prophet ﷺ returned and said, "Who has put this bird to distress on account of its young? Return them to her." He ﷺ also noticed a mound of ants which we had burnt up. He asked, "Who has set fire to this?" We replied: "We have done so." He ﷺ said, "None can chastise with fire except the Rubb of the fire."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a journey when he drew apart (to relieve nature). In his absence, we saw a red bird which had two young ones with it. We caught them and the red mother bird came, beating the earth with its wings. In the meantime the Prophet ﷺ returned and said, "Who has put this bird to distress on account of its young? Return them to her." He ﷺ also noticed a mound of ants which we had burnt up. He asked, "Who has set fire to this?" We replied: "We have done so." He ﷺ said, "None can chastise with fire except the Rubb of the fire."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: كنا مع رسول الله ﷺ في سفر، فانطلق لحاجته، فرأينا حمرة معها فرخان، فأخذنا فرخيها، فجاءت الحمرة فجعلت تعرش فجاء النبي ﷺ فقال: "من فجع هذه بولدها؟ ردوا ولدها  إليها" ورأى قرية نمل قد حرقناها، فقال: "من حرق هذه؟" قلنا: نحن. قال: "إنه لا ينبغي أن يعذِّب بالنار إلا رب النار".قوله:  قرية نمل  معناه: موضع النمل مع النمل.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1611

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم التعذيب بالنار في كل حيوان حتى القملة ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Chastisement with Fire

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is an act of oppression on the part of a person to procrastinate in fulfilling his obligation; if the repayment of a debt due to any of you is undertaken by a rich person, you should agree to the substitution."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is an act of oppression on the part of a person to procrastinate in fulfilling his obligation; if the repayment of a debt due to any of you is undertaken by a rich person, you should agree to the substitution."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "مطل الغني ظلم وإذا أُتبع أحدكم على مليء فليتبع" ((متفق عليه. معنى "أتبع": أحيل)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1612

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم مطل الغني بحق طلبه صاحبه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Procrastinating by a Rich Person to Fulfill his Obligation

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who gives something (to someone) as a gift and then gets it back (from him or her) is like a dog which eats its own vomit."

Another narration is: "He who gets back his charity is like a dog which vomits and then returns to that and eats it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who gives something (to someone) as a gift and then gets it back (from him or her) is like a dog which eats its own vomit."

Another narration is: "He who gets back his charity is like a dog which vomits and then returns to that and eats it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "الذي يعود في هبته كالكلب يرجع في قيئه" ((متفق عليه)). ((وفي رواية: "مثل الذي يرجع في صدقته، كمثل الكلب يقيء، ثم يعود في قيئه فيأكله". وفي رواية: "العائد في هبته كالعائد في قيئه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1613

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهية عودة الإنسان في هبة لم يسلمها إلى الموهوب له وفي هبة وهبها لولده وسلمها أو لم يسلمها إلى الموهوب له وفي هبة وهبها لولده وسلمها أو لم يسلمها  وكراهة شرائه شيئًا تصدق به من الذي تصدق عليه أو أخرجه عن زكاة أو كفارة ونحوها ولا بأس بشرائه من شخص آخر قد انتقل  إليه
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of giving a Gift and then ask back for it

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I donated a horse in the way of Allah. Its new possessor did not treat it properly. I made my mind to buy it because I thought that he would sell it at a cheap price (now that it became weak and emaciated). I asked the Prophet ﷺ about it, whereupon he said, "Do not buy it and do not get back your charity, for one who gets back the charity is like a dog that eats its own vomit."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I donated a horse in the way of Allah. Its new possessor did not treat it properly. I made my mind to buy it because I thought that he would sell it at a cheap price (now that it became weak and emaciated). I asked the Prophet ﷺ about it, whereupon he said, "Do not buy it and do not get back your charity, for one who gets back the charity is like a dog that eats its own vomit."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه قال: حملت على فرس في سبيل الله فأضاعه الذي كان عنده، فأردت أن أشتريه، وظننت أنه يبيعه برخص، فسألت النبي ﷺ فقال: "لا تشتره ولا تعد في صدقتك وإن أعطاكه بدرهم، فإن العائد في صدقته كالعائد في قيئه" ((متفق عليه)). قوله: "حملت على فرس في سبيل الله" معناه: تصدقت به على بعض المجاهدين.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1614

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهية عودة الإنسان في هبة لم يسلمها إلى الموهوب له وفي هبة وهبها لولده وسلمها أو لم يسلمها إلى الموهوب له وفي هبة وهبها لولده وسلمها أو لم يسلمها  وكراهة شرائه شيئًا تصدق به من الذي تصدق عليه أو أخرجه عن زكاة أو كفارة ونحوها ولا بأس بشرائه من شخص آخر قد انتقل  إليه
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of giving a Gift and then ask back for it

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Keep away from the seven fatalities." It was asked: "What are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He ﷺ replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship (i.e., committing an act of Shirk), sorcery, killing of one whom Allah has declared inviolable without a just cause, devouring the property of an orphan, the eating of usury (Riba), fleeing from the battlefield and accusing chaste believing women, who never even think of anything touching their chastity."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Keep away from the seven fatalities." It was asked: "What are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He ﷺ replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship (i.e., committing an act of Shirk), sorcery, killing of one whom Allah has declared inviolable without a just cause, devouring the property of an orphan, the eating of usury (Riba), fleeing from the battlefield and accusing chaste believing women, who never even think of anything touching their chastity."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ قال: "اجتنبوا السبع الموبقات" قالوا: يا رسول الله وما هن؟ قال: "الشرك بالله، والسحر وقتل النفس التي حرم الله إلا بالحق، وأكل الربا، وأكل مال اليتيم، والتولي يوم الزحف، وقذف المحصنات المؤمنات الغافلات" ((متفق عليه. "الموبقات" المهلكات)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1615

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تأكيد تحريم مال اليتيم
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of devouring the Property of an Orphan

hadiths.englishRaw:
`Abdullah bin Mas`ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who accepts Ar-Riba (the usury) and the one who pays it.

[Muslim]
.

The narration in At-Tirmidhi adds: And the one who records it, and the two persons who stand witness to it.
hadiths.narrator: `Abdullah bin Mas`ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who accepts Ar-Riba (the usury) and the one who pays it.

[Muslim]
.

The narration in At-Tirmidhi adds: And the one who records it, and the two persons who stand witness to it.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: " لعن رسول الله ﷺ آكل الربا وموكله" ((رواه مسلم)). زاد الترمذي وغيره:   وشاهديه، وكاتبه

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1616

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تغليظ تحريم الربا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of taking Ar-Riba (The Usury)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Almighty Allah says, 'I am the One Who is most free from want of partners. He who does a thing for the sake of someone else beside Me, I discard him and his polytheism.."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Almighty Allah says, 'I am the One Who is most free from want of partners. He who does a thing for the sake of someone else beside Me, I discard him and his polytheism.."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: " قال الله تعالى: أنا أغنى الشركاء عن الشرك، من عمل عملا أشرك فيه معي غيري، تركته وشركه" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1617

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الرياء
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Show-off

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The first to be judged on the Day of Resurrection will be a man who had died as a martyr. He will be brought forward. Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. Then He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I fought for Your Cause till I was martyred.' Allah will say: 'You have lied. You fought so that people might call you courageous; and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell. Next a man who had acquired and imparted knowledge and read the Qur'an will be brought forward, Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. Then He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I acquired knowledge and taught it, and read the Qur'an for Your sake.' Allah will say to him: 'You have lied. You acquired knowledge so that people might call you a learned (man), and you read the Qur'an so that they might call you a reciter, and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him, and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell. Next a man whom Allah had made affluent and to whom Allah had given plenty of wealth, will be brought forward, Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I did not neglect any of the ways You liked wealth to be spend liberally for Your sake'. Allah will say to him: 'You have lied. You did it so that people might call you generous, and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The first to be judged on the Day of Resurrection will be a man who had died as a martyr. He will be brought forward. Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. Then He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I fought for Your Cause till I was martyred.' Allah will say: 'You have lied. You fought so that people might call you courageous; and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell. Next a man who had acquired and imparted knowledge and read the Qur'an will be brought forward, Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. Then He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I acquired knowledge and taught it, and read the Qur'an for Your sake.' Allah will say to him: 'You have lied. You acquired knowledge so that people might call you a learned (man), and you read the Qur'an so that they might call you a reciter, and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him, and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell. Next a man whom Allah had made affluent and to whom Allah had given plenty of wealth, will be brought forward, Allah will remind him of the favours He had bestowed upon him and the man will acknowledge them. He will ask him: 'What did you do to express gratitude for it?' The man will reply: 'I did not neglect any of the ways You liked wealth to be spend liberally for Your sake'. Allah will say to him: 'You have lied. You did it so that people might call you generous, and they have done so.' Command will then be issued about him and he will be dragged on his face and thrown into Hell."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: " إن أول الناس يقضى يوم القيامة عليه رجل اسُتشهد، فأتي به، فعرفه نعمته، فعرفها، قال: فما عملت فيها؟ قال: قاتلت فيك حتى اسُتشهدت، قال: كذبت، ولكنك قاتلت لأن يقال: جريء، فقد قيل، ثم أمر به، فسحب على وجهه حتى ألقي في النار. ورجل تعلم العلم وعلمه، وقرأ القرآن، فأتي به، فعرفه نعمه فعرفها. قال فما عملت فيها؟ قال تعلمت العلم وعلمته وقرأت فيك القرآن. قال كذبت، ولكنك تعلمت ليقال: عالم. وقرأت القرآن ليقال: هو قارئ، فقد قيل: ثم أُمر به، فسُحب على وجهه حتى ألقي في النار، ورجل وسع الله عليه، وأعطاه من أصناف المال، فأتي به فعرفه نعمه، فعرفها. قال: فما عملت فيها ؟ قال: ما تركت من سبيل تحب أن ينفق فيها إلا أنفقت فيها لك، قال: كذبت، ولكنك فعلت ليقال: جواد، فقد قيل، ثم أُمر به فسُحب على وجهه ثم ألقي في النار" ((رواه مسلم)). جَريء  بفتح الجيم وكسر الراء وبالمد، أي: شجاع حاذق

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1618

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الرياء
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Show-off

hadiths.englishRaw:
`Abdullah bin `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 Some people told me, "We visit our rulers and we tell them things contrary to those which we say when we depart from them."
`Abdullah bin `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) replied: "In the era of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we considered this to be an act of hypocrisy."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: `Abdullah bin `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
Some people told me, "We visit our rulers and we tell them things contrary to those which we say when we depart from them."
`Abdullah bin `Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) replied: "In the era of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we considered this to be an act of hypocrisy."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن ناسًا قالوا له: إنا ندخل على سلاطيننا فنقول لهم بخلاف ما نتكلم إذا خرجنا من عندهم؟ قال ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما: كنا نعد هذا نفاقًا على عهد رسول الله ﷺ ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1619

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الرياء
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Show-off

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jundub (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who so acts to show off, Allah will disgrace him on the Day of Resurrection, and he who does good deeds so that people (may hold him in high esteem), Allah will expose his hidden evil intentions before the people on the Day of Resurrection."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jundub (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who so acts to show off, Allah will disgrace him on the Day of Resurrection, and he who does good deeds so that people (may hold him in high esteem), Allah will expose his hidden evil intentions before the people on the Day of Resurrection."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جُندب بن عبد الله بن سفيان رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ : "من سمَّع سمَّع الله به، ومن يرائي الله يرائي به" ((متفق عليه)). ((رواه مسلم أيضًا من رواية ابن عباس رضي الله عنه)). "سمَّع" بتشديد الميم، ومعناه: أظهر عمله للناس رياء " سمَّع الله به" أي فضحه يوم القيامة، ومعنى: " من راءى" أي: من أظهر للناس العمل الصالح ليعظم عندهم "راءى الله به" أي: أظهر سريرته على رءوس الخلائق.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1620

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الرياء
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Show-off

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A person who acquires (religious) knowledge, which is (normally) acquired to gain the Pleasure of Allah, (for the sole reason) to secure worldly comforts will not even smell the fragrance of Jannah on the Day of Resurrection (i.e., will not enter Jannah)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A person who acquires (religious) knowledge, which is (normally) acquired to gain the Pleasure of Allah, (for the sole reason) to secure worldly comforts will not even smell the fragrance of Jannah on the Day of Resurrection (i.e., will not enter Jannah)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ " من تعلم علمًا مما يبتغى به وجه الله عز وجل لا يتعلمه إلا ليصيب به عرضًا من الدنيا، لم يجد عَرف الجنة يوم القيامة"  يعني ريحها. رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1621

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الرياء
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Show-off

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: "Tell us about a person who does some good deed and people praise him, will this be considered as showing off?" He replied, "This is the glad tidings which a believer receives (in this life)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: "Tell us about a person who does some good deed and people praise him, will this be considered as showing off?" He replied, "This is the glad tidings which a believer receives (in this life)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه قال: قيل لرسول الله ﷺ : أرأيت الرجل يعمل العمل من الخير، ويحمده الناس عليه؟ قال: " تلك عاجل بشرى المؤمن" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1622

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ما يُتوهم أنه رياء وليس هو رياء
chapter.englishTitle: Things not to be Considered as Showing off

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah has written the very portion of Zina which a man will indulge in. There will be no escape from it. The Zina of the eye is the (lustful) look, the Zina of the ears is the listening (to voluptuous songs or talk), the Zina of the tongue is (the licentious) speech, the Zina of the hand is the (lustful) grip, the Zina of the feet is the walking (to the place where he intends to commit Zina), the heart yearns and desires and the private parts approve all that or disapprove it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

This is the wording in Muslim; Al-Bukhari wording is a bit short.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah has written the very portion of Zina which a man will indulge in. There will be no escape from it. The Zina of the eye is the (lustful) look, the Zina of the ears is the listening (to voluptuous songs or talk), the Zina of the tongue is (the licentious) speech, the Zina of the hand is the (lustful) grip, the Zina of the feet is the walking (to the place where he intends to commit Zina), the heart yearns and desires and the private parts approve all that or disapprove it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

This is the wording in Muslim; Al-Bukhari wording is a bit short.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ قال: "كُتب على ابن آدم نصيبه من الزنا مدرك ذلك لا محالة: العينان زناهما النظر، والأذنان زناهما الاستماع، واللسان زناه الكلام، واليد زناها البطش، والرجل زناها الخطا، والقلب يهوى ويتمنى، ويصدق ذلك الفرج أو يكذبه". ((متفق عليه. وهذا لفظ مسلم، ورواية البخاري مختصرة)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1623

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النظر إلى المرأة الأجنبية والأمرد الحسن لغير حاجة شرعية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gazing at women and Beardless Handsome Boys except in Exigency

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Avoid sitting on roadsides." His Companions said: "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, there is no other alternative but to sit there to talk." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If you have to sit at all, then fulfill the rights of the road." They asked: "What are their rights?" Thereupon he said, "Lowering the gaze (so that you may not stare at unlawful things), refraining from doing some harm to others, responding to greeting (i.e., saying 'Wa'alaikumus- salam' to one another) and commanding the good and forbidding the evil."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Avoid sitting on roadsides." His Companions said: "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, there is no other alternative but to sit there to talk." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If you have to sit at all, then fulfill the rights of the road." They asked: "What are their rights?" Thereupon he said, "Lowering the gaze (so that you may not stare at unlawful things), refraining from doing some harm to others, responding to greeting (i.e., saying 'Wa'alaikumus- salam' to one another) and commanding the good and forbidding the evil."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد الخُدري رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "إياكم والجلوس في الطرقات". قالوا: يا رسول الله ما لنا من مجالسنا بُد نتحدث فيها. فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "فإذا أبيتم إلا المجلس، فأعطوا الطريق حقه" قالوا: وما حق الطريق يا رسول الله؟ قال: "غض البصر،  وكف الأذى، ورد السلام، والأمر المعروف والنهي عن المنكر" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1624

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النظر إلى المرأة الأجنبية والأمرد الحسن لغير حاجة شرعية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gazing at women and Beardless Handsome Boys except in Exigency

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Talhah Zaid bin Sahl (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 We were sitting and talking on a platform in front of our house when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stopped by us and said, "Why do you sit on roads? Avoid sitting in them." We replied: "We sit there intending no harm. We only sit and discuss (religious) knowledge and talk." He said, "If you have to sit, you should fulfill the rights of the road: Lower your gaze, respond to greetings and talk in a good manner."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Talhah Zaid bin Sahl (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
We were sitting and talking on a platform in front of our house when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stopped by us and said, "Why do you sit on roads? Avoid sitting in them." We replied: "We sit there intending no harm. We only sit and discuss (religious) knowledge and talk." He said, "If you have to sit, you should fulfill the rights of the road: Lower your gaze, respond to greetings and talk in a good manner."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي طلحة زيد بن سهل رضي الله عنه قال: كنا قعودًا بالأفنية نتحدث فيها فجاء رسول الله ﷺ  فقالم علينا فقال: "ما لكم ولمجالس الصعدات؟ فقلنا: إنما قعدنا لغير ما بأس، قعدنا نتذاكر، ونتحدث. قال: "إما لا فأدوا حقها: غض البصر، ورد السلام، وحسن الكلام" ((رواه مسلم)). "الصُّعُدات" بضم الصاد والعين، أي: الطرقات.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1625

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النظر إلى المرأة الأجنبية والأمرد الحسن لغير حاجة شرعية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gazing at women and Beardless Handsome Boys except in Exigency

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jarir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about (the Islamic ruling on) accidental glance (i.e., at a woman one is not Islamically allowed to look at) and he ordered me to turn my eyes away.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jarir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about (the Islamic ruling on) accidental glance (i.e., at a woman one is not Islamically allowed to look at) and he ordered me to turn my eyes away.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جرير رضي الله عنه قال: سألت رسول الله ﷺ  عن نظر الفجأة فقال: "اصرف بصرك" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1626

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النظر إلى المرأة الأجنبية والأمرد الحسن لغير حاجة شرعية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gazing at women and Beardless Handsome Boys except in Exigency

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ along with Maimunah (May Allah be pleased with her) when Ibn Umm Maktum (May Allah be pleased with him) (who was blind) came to visit him. (This incident took place after the order of Hijab). The Prophet ﷺ told us to hide ourselves from him (i.e., observe Hijab). We said: "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he is blind and is unable to see us, nor does he know us." He replied; "Are you also blind and unable to see him?"

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ along with Maimunah (May Allah be pleased with her) when Ibn Umm Maktum (May Allah be pleased with him) (who was blind) came to visit him. (This incident took place after the order of Hijab). The Prophet ﷺ told us to hide ourselves from him (i.e., observe Hijab). We said: "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he is blind and is unable to see us, nor does he know us." He replied; "Are you also blind and unable to see him?"

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت: كنت عند رسول الله ﷺ وعنده ميمونة، فأقبل ابن أم مكتوم، وذلك بعد أن أُمرنا بالحجاب فقال النبي ﷺ : "احتجبا منه" فقلنا: يا رسول الله إلىس هو أعمى لا يبصرنا، ولا يعرفنا؟ فقال النبي ﷺ : "أفعمياوان أنتما ألستما تبصرانه؟!" ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي: وقال حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1627

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النظر إلى المرأة الأجنبية والأمرد الحسن لغير حاجة شرعية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gazing at women and Beardless Handsome Boys except in Exigency

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A man must not look at a man's private parts nor must a woman look at a woman's private parts; neither should two men lie naked under one cover, nor should two women lie naked under the same cover."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A man must not look at a man's private parts nor must a woman look at a woman's private parts; neither should two men lie naked under one cover, nor should two women lie naked under the same cover."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي سعيد رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "لا ينظر الرجل إلى عورة الرجل، ولا المرأة إلى عورة المرأة، ولا يفضي الرجل إلى الرجل في ثوب واحد، ولا تفضي المرأة إلى المرأة في ثوب واحد" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1628

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النظر إلى المرأة الأجنبية والأمرد الحسن لغير حاجة شرعية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of gazing at women and Beardless Handsome Boys except in Exigency

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Uqbah bin 'Amir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Avoid (entering a place) in which are women (uncovered or simply to mix with them in seclusion)." A man from the Ansar said, "Tell me about the brother of a woman's husband." He replied, "The brother of a woman's husband is death."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Uqbah bin 'Amir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Avoid (entering a place) in which are women (uncovered or simply to mix with them in seclusion)." A man from the Ansar said, "Tell me about the brother of a woman's husband." He replied, "The brother of a woman's husband is death."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عقبة بن عامر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "إياكم والدخول على النساء"، فقال رجل من الأنصار: أفرأيت الحمو؟ قال: "الحمو الموت" ((متفق عليه)). الحمو  قريب الزوج كأخيه، وابن أخيه، وابن عمه.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1629

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الخلوة بالأجنبية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Meeting a non-Mahram Woman in Seclusion

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one of you should meet a woman in privacy unless she is accompanied by a Mahram (i.e., a relative within the prohibited degrees)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one of you should meet a woman in privacy unless she is accompanied by a Mahram (i.e., a relative within the prohibited degrees)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "لا يخلون أحدكم بامرأة إلا مع ذي محرم" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1630

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الخلوة بالأجنبية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Meeting a non-Mahram Woman in Seclusion

hadiths.englishRaw:
Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The sanctity of the wives of Mujahidun (i.e., those who strive hard and fight in the way of Allah) for those who remain at home (i.e., those who do not go to the battlefield to fight Jihad) is like the sanctity of their own mothers. Anyone who remains behind to look after the family of a Mujahid and betrays his trust, will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection before the Mujahid who will take away from his meritorious deeds whatever he likes till he is satisfied." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned toward us and said, "Now, what do you think (i.e., will he leave anything with him)?"

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The sanctity of the wives of Mujahidun (i.e., those who strive hard and fight in the way of Allah) for those who remain at home (i.e., those who do not go to the battlefield to fight Jihad) is like the sanctity of their own mothers. Anyone who remains behind to look after the family of a Mujahid and betrays his trust, will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection before the Mujahid who will take away from his meritorious deeds whatever he likes till he is satisfied." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned toward us and said, "Now, what do you think (i.e., will he leave anything with him)?"

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "حرمة نساء المجاهدين على القاعدين كحرمة أمهاتهم، ما من رجل من القاعدين يخلف رجلا من المجاهدين في أهله، فيخونه فيهم إلا وقف له يوم القيامة، فيأخذ من حسناته ما شاء حتى يرضى" ثم التفت إلينا رسول الله ﷺ  وقال: "ما ظنكم؟" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1631

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الخلوة بالأجنبية
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Meeting a non-Mahram Woman in Seclusion

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed those men who are effeminate, and women who imitate men.

Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed men who copy women and cursed women who copy men.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed those men who are effeminate, and women who imitate men.

Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed men who copy women and cursed women who copy men.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: لعن رسول الله ﷺ  المخنثين من الرجال، والمترجلات من النساء. وفي رواية: لعن رسول الله ﷺ المتشبهين من الرجال بالنساء، والمتشبهات من النساء بالرجال. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1632

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تشبه الرجال بالنساء وتشبه النساء بالرجال في لباس وحركة وغير ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition for Men and Women apeing one another

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed a man who puts on the dress of women, and a woman who puts on the dress of men.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed a man who puts on the dress of women, and a woman who puts on the dress of men.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: لعن رسول الله ﷺ  الرجل يلبس لبسة المرأة، والمرأة تلبس لبسة الرجل. ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1633

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تشبه الرجال بالنساء وتشبه النساء بالرجال في لباس وحركة وغير ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition for Men and Women apeing one another

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There are two types of people who will be punished in Hell and whom I have not seen: men having whips like the tails of cows and they will be beating people with them, and, women who will be dressed but appear to be naked, inviting to evil; and they themselves will be inclined to it. Their heads will appear like the humps of the Bactrian camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Jannah and they will not smell its fragrance which is perceptible from such and such a distance."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There are two types of people who will be punished in Hell and whom I have not seen: men having whips like the tails of cows and they will be beating people with them, and, women who will be dressed but appear to be naked, inviting to evil; and they themselves will be inclined to it. Their heads will appear like the humps of the Bactrian camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Jannah and they will not smell its fragrance which is perceptible from such and such a distance."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "صِنفان من أهل النار لم أرهما: قوم معهم سياط كأذناب البقر يضربون بها الناس، ونساء كاسيات عاريات مميلات مائلات، رءوسهن كأسنمة البخت المائلة لا يدخلن الجنة، ولا يجدن ريحها، وإن ريحها ليوجد من مسيرة كذا وكذا" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1634

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تشبه الرجال بالنساء وتشبه النساء بالرجال في لباس وحركة وغير ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition for Men and Women apeing one another

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: "Do not eat with your left hand, because Satan eats and drinks with his left hand."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: "Do not eat with your left hand, because Satan eats and drinks with his left hand."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تأكلوا بالشمال، فإن الشيطان يأكل ويشرب بشماله" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1635

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التشبه بالشيطان والكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of following the Manners of Satan and Disbelievers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
