 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No person should eat and drink with his left hand for Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No person should eat and drink with his left hand for Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله قال: "لا يأكلن أحدكم بشماله، ولا يشربن بها. فإن الشيطان يأكل بشماله ويشرب بها" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1636

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التشبه بالشيطان والكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of following the Manners of Satan and Disbelievers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: "Jews and Christians do not dye their hair, so act differently from them."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: "Jews and Christians do not dye their hair, so act differently from them."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "إن اليهود والنصارى لا يصبغون، فخالفوهم" ((متفق عليه)) .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1637

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التشبه بالشيطان والكفار
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of following the Manners of Satan and Disbelievers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 Abu Quhafah, father of Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with them) was presented to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the conquest of Makkah and his head and beard were snow white. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Change it (i.e., dye it and avoid black colour)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
Abu Quhafah, father of Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with them) was presented to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the day of the conquest of Makkah and his head and beard were snow white. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Change it (i.e., dye it and avoid black colour)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: أتي بأبي قحافة والد أبي بكر الصديق رضي الله عنهما يوم فتح مكة ورأسه ولحيته كالثغامة بياضًا، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "غيروا هذا واجتنبوا السواد" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1638

chapter.arabicTitle: باب نهي الرجل والمرأة عن خضاب شعرهما بسواد
chapter.englishTitle: Forbidding to Dye Hair Black

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade shaving a part of the head.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade shaving a part of the head.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: نهى رسول الله ﷺ  عن القزع. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1639

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن القزع وهو حلق بعض الرأس دون بعض وإباحة حلقه كله للرجل دون المرأة
chapter.englishTitle: On Prohibition of Shaving a part of Head

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a boy, some portion of whose head was shaved and some of it was left out. He prohibited them from that and said, "Shave the whole of it or leave the whole of it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a boy, some portion of whose head was shaved and some of it was left out. He prohibited them from that and said, "Shave the whole of it or leave the whole of it."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: رأى رسول الله ﷺ  صبيًا قد حلق بعض شعر رأسه وترك بعضه فنهاهم عن ذلك وقال: "احلقوه كله، أو اتركوه كله". رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح على شرط البخاري ومسلم.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1640

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن القزع وهو حلق بعض الرأس دون بعض وإباحة حلقه كله للرجل دون المرأة
chapter.englishTitle: On Prohibition of Shaving a part of Head

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin Ja'far (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ gave respite for three days to the family of Ja'far (after his martydom). Then he came and said, "Don't weep for my brother after this day." He said, "Bring all of my nephews to me." We were accordingly brought as if we were chickens. Then he said, "Call for me a barber." He directed him to shave our heads which he did.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin Ja'far (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ gave respite for three days to the family of Ja'far (after his martydom). Then he came and said, "Don't weep for my brother after this day." He said, "Bring all of my nephews to me." We were accordingly brought as if we were chickens. Then he said, "Call for me a barber." He directed him to shave our heads which he did.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن جعفر رضي الله عنهما أن النبي ﷺ  أمهل آل جعفر رضي الله عنه ثلاثًا، ثم أتاهم فقال: "لا تبكوا على أخي بعد اليوم". ثم قال: "ادعوا لي بني أخي" فجيء بنا كأننا أفرخ فقال: "ادعوا لي الحلاق" فأمره، فحلق رءوسنا". رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح على شرط البخاري ومسلم.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1641

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن القزع وهو حلق بعض الرأس دون بعض وإباحة حلقه كله للرجل دون المرأة
chapter.englishTitle: On Prohibition of Shaving a part of Head

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited a woman from shaving her head.

[An- Nasa'i]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited a woman from shaving her head.

[An- Nasa'i]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن علي قال: نهى رسول الله ﷺ  أن تحلق المرأة رأسها. ((رواه النسائي)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1642

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن القزع وهو حلق بعض الرأس دون بعض وإباحة حلقه كله للرجل دون المرأة
chapter.englishTitle: On Prohibition of Shaving a part of Head

hadiths.englishRaw:
Asma' (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah! I have a daughter who had an attack of small pox and her hair fell off. Now I want to celebrate her marriage. Can I get her a wig?" Thereupon the Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah has cursed the maker and wearer of a wig."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Asma' (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: "O Messenger of Allah! I have a daughter who had an attack of small pox and her hair fell off. Now I want to celebrate her marriage. Can I get her a wig?" Thereupon the Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah has cursed the maker and wearer of a wig."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أسماء رضي الله عنها أن امرأة سألت النبي ﷺ  فقالت: يا رسول الله إن ابنتي أصابتها الحصبة، فتمرق شعرها، وإني زوجتها، أفأصلُ فيه؟ فقال: "لعن الله الواصلة والموصولة" ((متفق عليه)). وفي رواية: "الواصلة، والمستوصلة".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1643

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم وصل الشعر والوشم والوشر وهو تحديد الإسنان
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Wearing False Hair, Tattooing and Filling of Teeth

hadiths.englishRaw:
Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman (May Allah be pleased wth him) said:
 I saw Mu'awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) during the Hajj (pilgrimage) standing on the pulpit. He took from the guard a bunch of hair, and said: "O people of Al-Madinah! Where are your scholars? (Why do they do not prohibit you) I heard the Prophet ﷺ prohibiting from using this (false hair) and saying, 'The people of Bani Israel were ruined when their women wore such hair."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Humaid bin 'Abdur-Rahman (May Allah be pleased wth him) said:
hadiths.body:
I saw Mu'awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) during the Hajj (pilgrimage) standing on the pulpit. He took from the guard a bunch of hair, and said: "O people of Al-Madinah! Where are your scholars? (Why do they do not prohibit you) I heard the Prophet ﷺ prohibiting from using this (false hair) and saying, 'The people of Bani Israel were ruined when their women wore such hair."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن حميد بن عبد الرحمن أنه سمع معاوية رضي الله عنه عام حج على المنبر وتناول قصة من شعر كانت في يد حرسي فقال: يا أهل المدينة أين علماؤكم؟! سمعت النبي ﷺ  ينهى عن مثل هذه. ويقول: "إنما هلكت بنو إسرائيل حين اتخذها نساؤهم" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1644

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم وصل الشعر والوشم والوشر وهو تحديد الإسنان
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Wearing False Hair, Tattooing and Filling of Teeth

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the maker and wearer of a wig and the tattooer and the one who is tattooed.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the maker and wearer of a wig and the tattooer and the one who is tattooed.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  لعن الواصلة والمستوصلة والواشمة والمستوشمة ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1645

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم وصل الشعر والوشم والوشر وهو تحديد الإسنان
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Wearing False Hair, Tattooing and Filling of Teeth

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those women who have themselves tattooed, and those women who get their hair removed from their eyebrows and faces (except the beard and the mustache), and those who make artificial spaces between their teeth for beauty, whereby they change Allah's creation. A woman started to argue with him, saying: "What is all this?" He replied: "Why should I not curse those whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed and who are cursed in Allah's Book? Allah, the Exalted, has said in His Book:

"And whatsoever the Messenger (Muhammad ﷺ) gives you, take it; and whatsoever he forbids you, abstain (from it)." (59:7)

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
Allah has cursed those women who practise tattooing and those women who have themselves tattooed, and those women who get their hair removed from their eyebrows and faces (except the beard and the mustache), and those who make artificial spaces between their teeth for beauty, whereby they change Allah's creation. A woman started to argue with him, saying: "What is all this?" He replied: "Why should I not curse those whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed and who are cursed in Allah's Book? Allah, the Exalted, has said in His Book:

"And whatsoever the Messenger (Muhammad ﷺ) gives you, take it; and whatsoever he forbids you, abstain (from it)." (59:7)

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: لعن الله الواشمات والمستوشمات والمتنمصات والمتفلجات بالحسن، المغيرات خلق الله! فقالت له امرأة في ذلك فقال: وما لي لا ألعن من لعنه رسول الله ﷺ وهو في كتاب الله؟! قال الله تعالى: {وما آتاكم الرسول فخذوه وما نهاكم عنه فانتهوا} ((الحشر:7)).((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1646

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم وصل الشعر والوشم والوشر وهو تحديد الإسنان
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Wearing False Hair, Tattooing and Filling of Teeth

hadiths.englishRaw:
Reported 'Amr bin Shu'aib, on the authority of his father and grandfather that the Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not pluck out grey hair, for they are the Muslim's light on the Day of Resurrection."

[Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi and An- Nasa'i]
.
hadiths.body:
Reported 'Amr bin Shu'aib, on the authority of his father and grandfather that the Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not pluck out grey hair, for they are the Muslim's light on the Day of Resurrection."

[Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi and An- Nasa'i]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده رضي الله عنه، عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "لا تنتفوا الشيب؛ فإنه نور المسلم يوم القيامة". حديث حسن.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1647

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم وصل الشعر والوشم والوشر وهو تحديد الإسنان
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Wearing False Hair, Tattooing and Filling of Teeth

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who does something contrary to our way (i.e., Islam) will have it rejected."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who does something contrary to our way (i.e., Islam) will have it rejected."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من عمل عملا ليس عليه أمرنا فهو رد" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1648

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن نتف الشيب من اللحية والرأس وغيرهما  وعن نتف الأمرد شعر لحيته عند أول طلوعه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Plucking Grey Hairs

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not touch your private parts with your right hand while urinating, nor for washing or cleaning (your private parts), and do not breathe into the drinking vessel from which you drink."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not touch your private parts with your right hand while urinating, nor for washing or cleaning (your private parts), and do not breathe into the drinking vessel from which you drink."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي قتادة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "إذا بال أحدكم، فلا يؤخذن ذكره بيمينه، ولا يستنجي بيمينه، ولا يتنفس في الإناء" ((متفق عليه)) وفي الباب أحاديث كثيرة صحيحة.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1649

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الاستنجاء باليمين ومس الفرج باليمين من غير عذر
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of using the right hand for cleaning after toilet without a valid reason

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None of you should walk wearing one shoe; you should either wear them both or take them off both."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None of you should walk wearing one shoe; you should either wear them both or take them off both."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "لا يمشي أحدكم في نعل واحدة لينعلهما جميعًا او ليخلعهما جميعًا".  وفي رواية " أو ليحفهما جميعًا ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1650

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة المشي في نعل واحدة أو خف واحد لغير عذر وكراهة لبس النعل والخف قائمًا لغير عذر
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Wearing one Shoe or Sock

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When the lace of one of the shoes of any one of you is cut off, he should not walk with the other until he has got the lace repaired."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When the lace of one of the shoes of any one of you is cut off, he should not walk with the other until he has got the lace repaired."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "إذا انقطع شسع نعل أحدكم، فلا يمشِ في الأخرى حتى يصلحها" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1651

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة المشي في نعل واحدة أو خف واحد لغير عذر وكراهة لبس النعل والخف قائمًا لغير عذر
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Wearing one Shoe or Sock

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a person wearing (tying up) his shoe while standing.

[Abu Dawud with a good Isnad]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a person wearing (tying up) his shoe while standing.

[Abu Dawud with a good Isnad]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ نهى أن ينتعل الرجل قائمًا".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1652

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة المشي في نعل واحدة أو خف واحد لغير عذر وكراهة لبس النعل والخف قائمًا لغير عذر
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Wearing one Shoe or Sock

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not keep the fire burning in your homes when you go to bed."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not keep the fire burning in your homes when you go to bed."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "لا تتركوا النار في بيوتكم حين تنامون" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1653

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن ترك النار في البيت عند النوم ونحوه سواء كانت في سراج أو غيره
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Leaving the Fire Burning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 A house in Al-Madinah was burnt with its occupants inside it one night. When this was reported to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ he said, "Fire is your enemy. So, put it out before going to bed."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
A house in Al-Madinah was burnt with its occupants inside it one night. When this was reported to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ he said, "Fire is your enemy. So, put it out before going to bed."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسى الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: احترق بيت بالمدينة على أهله من الليل، فلما حدث رسول الله ﷺ  بشأنهم قال: "إن هذه النار عدو لكم، فإذا نمتم فأطفئوها" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1654

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن ترك النار في البيت عند النوم ونحوه سواء كانت في سراج أو غيره
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Leaving the Fire Burning

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Cover up the (kitchen) containers (i.e., pots, pans, etc.), tie up the mouth of the water-skin, lock up the doors and extinguish the lamps, because Satan can neither untie the water-skin nor open the door nor uncover the containers. If one can cover the cooking pot even by placing a piece of wood across it, and pronounce the Name of Allah on it, let him do it. A mouse can sometimes cause a house to burn along its dwellers."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Cover up the (kitchen) containers (i.e., pots, pans, etc.), tie up the mouth of the water-skin, lock up the doors and extinguish the lamps, because Satan can neither untie the water-skin nor open the door nor uncover the containers. If one can cover the cooking pot even by placing a piece of wood across it, and pronounce the Name of Allah on it, let him do it. A mouse can sometimes cause a house to burn along its dwellers."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "غطوا الإناء، وأوكئوا السقاء، وأغلقوا الأبواب، وأطفئوا السراج، فإن الشيطان لا يحل سقاء، ولايفتح بابًا ولايكشف إناءً، إن لم يجد أحدكم إلا أن يعرض على إنائه عودا، ويذكر اسم الله، فليفعل، فإن الفويسقة تضرم على أهل البيت بيتهم" ((رواه مسلم)) "الفويسقة: الفأرة، و"تضرم": تحرق.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1655

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن ترك النار في البيت عند النوم ونحوه سواء كانت في سراج أو غيره
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Leaving the Fire Burning

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 We have been forbidden to go into excess.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
We have been forbidden to go into excess.

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال :"نهينا عن التكلف". ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1656

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التكلف وهو فعل وقول ما لا مصلحة فيه بمشقة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of putting oneself to Undue Hardship

hadiths.englishRaw:
Masruq (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 We visited 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) and he said to us: O people! He who has the knowledge of any matter may convey it to the others. And he who has no knowledge, thereof, should say: "Allahu a'lam (Allah knows better)." It is a part and parcel of knowledge that a man who has no knowledge of a matter should say: "Allah knows better." Allah said to His Prophet ﷺ:

"Say (O Muhammad ﷺ): 'No wage do I ask of you for this (the Qur'an), nor am I one of the Mutakallifun (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist)."' (38:86)

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Masruq (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
We visited 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) and he said to us: O people! He who has the knowledge of any matter may convey it to the others. And he who has no knowledge, thereof, should say: "Allahu a'lam (Allah knows better)." It is a part and parcel of knowledge that a man who has no knowledge of a matter should say: "Allah knows better." Allah said to His Prophet ﷺ:

"Say (O Muhammad ﷺ): 'No wage do I ask of you for this (the Qur'an), nor am I one of the Mutakallifun (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist)."' (38:86)

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن مسروق قال : دخلنا على عبدالله بن مسعود رضي الله عنه فقال : يا أيها الناس من علم شيئا فليقل به، ومن لم يعلم، فليقل :الله أعلم، فإن من العلم أن يقول الرجل لما لا يعلم: الله أعلم . قال الله تعالى لنبيه ﷺ :{قل ما أسألكم عليه من أجر وما أنا من المتكلفين}. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1657

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التكلف وهو فعل وقول ما لا مصلحة فيه بمشقة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of putting oneself to Undue Hardship

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The deceased is tortured in his grave for bewailing over him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Umar bin Al-Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The deceased is tortured in his grave for bewailing over him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ  :"الميت يُعذب في قبره بما نِيح عليه ". ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1658

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who (on befalling a calamity) slaps his cheeks, tears his clothes and follows the ways and traditions of the Days of Ignorance is none of us."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who (on befalling a calamity) slaps his cheeks, tears his clothes and follows the ways and traditions of the Days of Ignorance is none of us."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ  :"ليس منا من ضرب الخدود، وشق الجيوب، ودعا بدعوى الجاهليه" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1659

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Burdah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 (My father) Abu Musa got seriously ill and lost his consciousness. His head was in the lap of a woman of the family and she began to wail. When Abu Musa recovered his consciousness, he said: "I am innocent of those from whom Messenger of Allah ﷺ is innocent. Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ declared himself free of (the responsibility) for a woman who wails, shaves her head and tears up her clothes."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Burdah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
(My father) Abu Musa got seriously ill and lost his consciousness. His head was in the lap of a woman of the family and she began to wail. When Abu Musa recovered his consciousness, he said: "I am innocent of those from whom Messenger of Allah ﷺ is innocent. Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ declared himself free of (the responsibility) for a woman who wails, shaves her head and tears up her clothes."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي بردة قال: وجع أبو موسى، فغشي عليه، ورأسه في حجر امرأة من أهله، فأقبلت تصيح برنة فلم يستطع أن يرد عليها شيئًا، فلما أفاق ،قال : أنا بريء ممن برئ منه رسول الله ﷺ ، إن رسول الله ﷺ  برئ من الصالقة، والحالقة، والشاقة.((متفق عليه)) "الصالقة": التي ترفع صوتها بالنياحة والندب. والحالقة : التي تحلق رأسها عند المصيبة  الشاقة  :التي تشق ثوبها.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1660

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "He who allows (others) to wail over his death, will be punished for it on the Day of Resurrection."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "He who allows (others) to wail over his death, will be punished for it on the Day of Resurrection."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن المغيرة بن شعبة رضي الله عنه قال :سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول "من نِيح عليه، فإنه يُعذب بما نِيح عليه يوم القيامة" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1661

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm 'Atiyyah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 At the time of giving the pledge of allegiance, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took from us an oath that we would not wail.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm 'Atiyyah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
At the time of giving the pledge of allegiance, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took from us an oath that we would not wail.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم عطية نَُسيبة -بضم النون وفتحها- رضي الله عنها قالت : أخذ علينا رسول الله ﷺ  عند البيعة أن لا ننوح. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1662

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, his sister began to weep and shout: "Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! for such and such (mentioning his virtuous qualities)." When he recovered his consciousness, he said: "I was asked (disapprovingly, by the angels) about everything you said concerning me whether I am as you said."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
When 'Abdullah bin Rawahah (May Allah be pleased with him) became unconscious, his sister began to weep and shout: "Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! for such and such (mentioning his virtuous qualities)." When he recovered his consciousness, he said: "I was asked (disapprovingly, by the angels) about everything you said concerning me whether I am as you said."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنه قال: أغمي على عبد الله بن رواحة رضي الله عنه فجعلت أخته تبكي، وتقول: واجبلاه، وا كذا وا كذا: تعدد عليه  فقال حين أفاق: ما قلت شيئًا ألا قيل لي :أنت كذلك؟! ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1663

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). When they entered his house, they found him unconscious. The Messenger of Allah asked, "Has he died?" They replied: "No, O Messenger of Allah." Hearing this the Messenger of Allah ﷺ began to weep. When his Companions saw this, they also began to weep too. He said, "Listen attentively: Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but takes to task or show mercy because of the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited Sa'd bin 'Ubadah during his illness. He was accompanied by 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf, Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas and 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with them). When they entered his house, they found him unconscious. The Messenger of Allah asked, "Has he died?" They replied: "No, O Messenger of Allah." Hearing this the Messenger of Allah ﷺ began to weep. When his Companions saw this, they also began to weep too. He said, "Listen attentively: Allah does not punish for the shedding of tears or the grief of the heart, but takes to task or show mercy because of the utterances of this (and he pointed to his tongue)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: اشتكى سعد بن عبادة رضي الله عنه شكوى فأتاه رسول الله ﷺ  يعوده مع عبد الرحمن بن عوف، وسعد بن أبي وقاص، وعبد الله بن مسعود رضي الله عنهم، فلما دخل عليه، وجده في غشية فقال: "أقضي؟" قالوا: لا يا رسول الله فبكى رسول الله ﷺ  فلما رأى القوم بكاء النبي ﷺ  بكوا، قال: "ألا تسمعون؟ إن الله لا يُعذب بدمع العين، ولا بحزن القلب، ولكن يعذب بهذا" وأشار إلى لسانه "أو يرحم" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1664

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a garment of scabies (Allah knows the nature thereof)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Malik Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If the wailing woman does not repent before she dies, she will be made to stand on the Day of Resurrection wearing a garment of pitch and a garment of scabies (Allah knows the nature thereof)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي مالك الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "النائحة إذا لم تتب قبل موتها تقام يوم القيامة وعليها سربال من قطران، ودرع من جرب" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1665

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Asid bin Abu Usaid reported:
 A woman who had taken a pledge of allegiance at the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Among the matters in respect of which we gave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the pledge not to disobey him in any Ma'ruf 
[i.e., all that Islam ordains (V:60:12)]
 was that we should not slap our faces, bewail, tear our clothes up and tear out our hair (in grief)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Asid bin Abu Usaid reported:
hadiths.body:
A woman who had taken a pledge of allegiance at the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Among the matters in respect of which we gave the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the pledge not to disobey him in any Ma'ruf 
[i.e., all that Islam ordains (V:60:12)]
 was that we should not slap our faces, bewail, tear our clothes up and tear out our hair (in grief)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أسيد بن أبي أسيد التابعي عن امرأة من المبايعات قالت: كان فيما أخذ علينا رسول الله ﷺ، في المعروف الذي أخذ علينا أن لا نعصيه فيه: أن لا نخمش وجهًا، ولا ندعو ويلا، ولا نشق جيبًا، وأن لا ننشر شعرًا".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1666

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ...' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' "

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone dies and the mourner gets up and says: 'Alas! For the mountain among men. Alas! For the chief ...' and such like, Allah will put two angels in charge of him who will beat on the breast and ask him (disapproving): 'Were you like that?' "

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "ما من ميت يموت، فيقوم باكيهم، فيقول: واجبلاه، وأسيداه، أو نحو ذلك إلا وكل به ملكان يلهزانه: أهكذا كنت؟!". رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1667

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Slandering one's lineage and wailing over the dead."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Two things are signs of disbelief on the part of those who indulge in them: Slandering one's lineage and wailing over the dead."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "اثنان في الناس هما بهم كفر: الطعن في النسب، والنياحة على الميت" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1668

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم النياحة على الميت ولطم الخد وشق الجيب ونتف الشعر وحلقه، والدعاء بالويل والثبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Bewailing the Deceased

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 Some people asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about soothsayers. He ﷺ said, "They are of no account." Upon this they said to him, "O Messenger of Allah! But they sometimes make true predictions." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches (from the angels) and whispers into the ears of his friend (the soothsayers) who will then mix more than a hundred lies with it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

The narration in Al-Bukhari is: "The angels descend in the clouds and mention matters which has been decreed in heaven; Satan steals a hearing (listens to it stealthily) and communicates it to the soothsayers who tell along with it a hundred lies."
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
Some people asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about soothsayers. He ﷺ said, "They are of no account." Upon this they said to him, "O Messenger of Allah! But they sometimes make true predictions." Thereupon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "That is a word pertaining to truth which a jinn snatches (from the angels) and whispers into the ears of his friend (the soothsayers) who will then mix more than a hundred lies with it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

The narration in Al-Bukhari is: "The angels descend in the clouds and mention matters which has been decreed in heaven; Satan steals a hearing (listens to it stealthily) and communicates it to the soothsayers who tell along with it a hundred lies."
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: سأل رسول الله ﷺ  أناس عن الكهان، فقال: "ليسوا بشيء" فقالوا: يا رسول الله إنهم يحدثونا أحيانًا بشيء، فيكون حقًا؟ فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "تلك الكلمة من الحق يخطفها الجني. فيقرها في أذن وليه، فيخلطون معها مائة كذبة" ((متفق عليه)).  وفي رواية للبخاري عن عائشة رضي الله عنها أنها سمعت رسول الله ﷺ يقول: "إن الملائكة تنزل في العَنان -وهو السحاب-. فتذكر الأمر قضي في السماء، فيسترق الشيطان السمع، فيسمعه، فيوحيه إلى الكهان، فيكذبون معها مائة كذبة من عند أنفسهم"

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1669

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن إتيان الكهان والمنجمين والعراف وأصحاب الرمل والطوارق بالحصى وبالشعير ونحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Consultation with Soothsayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ who said, "He who goes to one who claims to tell about matters of the Unseen and believes in him, his Salat (prayers) will not be accepted for forty days."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.body:
Narrated Safiyyah, daughter of Abu 'Ubaid, on the authority of some of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ who said, "He who goes to one who claims to tell about matters of the Unseen and believes in him, his Salat (prayers) will not be accepted for forty days."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن قبيصة بنت أبي عبيد، عن بعض أزواج النبي ﷺ، ورضي الله عنها، عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "من أتي عرافًا فسأله عن شيء، فصدقه، لم تقبل له صلاة أربعين يومًا" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1670

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن إتيان الكهان والمنجمين والعراف وأصحاب الرمل والطوارق بالحصى وبالشعير ونحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Consultation with Soothsayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Qabisah bin Al-Mukhariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The practice of 'Iyafah, the interpretation of omens from the flight of birds, the practice of divination by drawing lines on the ground and taking evil omens are all practices of Al-Jibt (the idol, the diviner, or sorcerer)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Qabisah bin Al-Mukhariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The practice of 'Iyafah, the interpretation of omens from the flight of birds, the practice of divination by drawing lines on the ground and taking evil omens are all practices of Al-Jibt (the idol, the diviner, or sorcerer)."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن قبيصة بن المخارق رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "العِيافة، والطِّيَرة، والطرق، من الجبت".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1671

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن إتيان الكهان والمنجمين والعراف وأصحاب الرمل والطوارق بالحصى وبالشعير ونحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Consultation with Soothsayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who acquires a branch of the knowledge of astrology, learns a branch of magic (of which he acquires more as long as) he continues to do so."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who acquires a branch of the knowledge of astrology, learns a branch of magic (of which he acquires more as long as) he continues to do so."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من اقتبس علمًا من النجوم، اقتبس شعبة من السحر زاد ما زاد". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1672

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن إتيان الكهان والمنجمين والعراف وأصحاب الرمل والطوارق بالحصى وبالشعير ونحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Consultation with Soothsayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah has favoured me with Islam. There are still some men among us who visit the soothsayers to consult them (on matters relating to the future)." He ﷺ replied, "Do not visit them." I said: "There are some men who are guided by omens." He replied, "These are the ideas which come up in their minds but you should not be influenced by them (i.e., these things) should not prevent them from pursuing their works." I said: "There are some men who practise divination by drawing lines on the ground." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "There was a Prophet who drew lines, the line which agrees with the line drawn by that Prophet would be correct."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Mu'awiyah bin Al-Hakam (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
I said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have recently emerged from ignorance and Allah has favoured me with Islam. There are still some men among us who visit the soothsayers to consult them (on matters relating to the future)." He ﷺ replied, "Do not visit them." I said: "There are some men who are guided by omens." He replied, "These are the ideas which come up in their minds but you should not be influenced by them (i.e., these things) should not prevent them from pursuing their works." I said: "There are some men who practise divination by drawing lines on the ground." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "There was a Prophet who drew lines, the line which agrees with the line drawn by that Prophet would be correct."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن معاوية بن الحكم رضي الله عنه قال: قلت يا رسول الله إني حديث عهد بجاهلية، وقد جاء الله تعالى بالإسلام، وإن منا رجالا يأتون الكهان؟ قال: "فلا تأتهم" قلت: ومنا رجال يتطيرون؟ قال: "ذلك شيء يجدونه في صدورهم، فلا يصدهم" قلت: ومنا رجال يخطون؟ قال: "كان نبي من الأنبياء يخط، فمن وافق خطه، فذاك" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1673

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن إتيان الكهان والمنجمين والعراف وأصحاب الرمل والطوارق بالحصى وبالشعير ونحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Consultation with Soothsayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the price of a dog, the earning of an prostitute, and the money given to a soothsayer.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Mas'ud Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the price of a dog, the earning of an prostitute, and the money given to a soothsayer.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي مسعود البدري رضي الله عنه قال: إن رسول الله ﷺ  "نهى عن ثمن الكلب، ومهر البغي وحُلوان الكاهن" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1674

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن إتيان الكهان والمنجمين والعراف وأصحاب الرمل والطوارق بالحصى وبالشعير ونحو ذلك
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Consultation with Soothsayers

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I am pleased with good omens." He was asked: "What is good omen?" He replied, "A good word."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Not the transmission of disease of one person to another and no evil omen, but I am pleased with good omens." He was asked: "What is good omen?" He replied, "A good word."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا عدوى ولا طِيَرة ويعجبني الفأل" قالوا: وما الفأل؟ قال: "كلمة طيبة" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1675

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التطير
chapter.englishTitle: Forbiddance of Believing in Ill Omens

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no infection and no evil omen; but if there is anything (that may be a source of trouble) then it could be a house, a horse, and a woman."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no infection and no evil omen; but if there is anything (that may be a source of trouble) then it could be a house, a horse, and a woman."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا عدوى ولا طِيَرة، وإن كان الشؤم في شيء ففي الدار والمرأة، والفرس" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1676

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التطير
chapter.englishTitle: Forbiddance of Believing in Ill Omens

hadiths.englishRaw:
Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet never took ill omens.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet never took ill omens.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ  كان لا يتطير. ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1677

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التطير
chapter.englishTitle: Forbiddance of Believing in Ill Omens

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Urwah bin 'Amir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 When talking of omens was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ he said, "The best type of omen is the good omen." He added, "A Muslim should not refrain from anything because of an omen." He ﷺ told them, "When any of you sees anything which he dislikes, he should say: 'Allahuma la ya'ti bil-hasanati illa Anta, wa la yadfa'us- sayyi'ati illa Anta, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Bika (O Allah ! You Alone bring good things; You Alone avert evil things, and there is no might or power but in You)."'

[Abu Dawud with Sahih Isnad]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Urwah bin 'Amir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
When talking of omens was mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ he said, "The best type of omen is the good omen." He added, "A Muslim should not refrain from anything because of an omen." He ﷺ told them, "When any of you sees anything which he dislikes, he should say: 'Allahuma la ya'ti bil-hasanati illa Anta, wa la yadfa'us- sayyi'ati illa Anta, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa Bika (O Allah ! You Alone bring good things; You Alone avert evil things, and there is no might or power but in You)."'

[Abu Dawud with Sahih Isnad]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عروة بن عامر رضي الله عنه قال: ذكرت الطِيَرة عند رسول الله ﷺ  فقال: "أحسنها الفأل، ولا ترد مسلمًا فإذا رأى أحدكم ما يكره، فليقل: اللهم لا يأتي بالحسنات إلا أنت، ولا يدفع السيئات إلا أنت، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بك".((حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح))
hadiths.notes:
\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eComments by Amrayn.com\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\
\u003cp\u003eAlthough it says in text that Abu Dawud narrated it with Sahih Isnad, this was classified as weak (da`eef) by Sheikh Al-Albāni\u003c/p\u003e
hadiths.notesArabic: \u003cp\u003eاللهم لا يأتي بالحسنات إلا أنت، ولا يدفع السيئات إلا أنت، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بك\u003c/p\u003e

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1678

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التطير
chapter.englishTitle: Forbiddance of Believing in Ill Omens

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Those who draw pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection; and it will be said to them: 'Breathe soul into what you have created."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Those who draw pictures will be punished on the Day of Resurrection; and it will be said to them: 'Breathe soul into what you have created."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "إن الذين يصنعون هذه الصور يعذبون يوم القيامة، يقال لهم: أحيوا ما خلقتم" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1679

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hanging over it and on which there were portraits. When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited me after returning from a journey, and I had a shelf with a thin cloth curtain hanging over it and on which there were portraits. When he saw it, the colour of his face changed (because of anger) and he said, "O 'Aishah! the most grievous torment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be for those who imitate (Allah) in the act of His creation." 'Aishah said: We tore it into pieces and made a cushion or two cushions out of that.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: قدم رسول الله ﷺ  من سفر وقد سترت سهوة لي بقرام فيه تماثيل فلما رآه رسول الله ﷺ، تلون وجهه، وقال: "يا عائشة، أشد الناس عذابًا عن الله يوم القيامة الذين يضاهون بخلق الله" قالت: فقطعناه، فجعلنا منه وسادة أو وسادتين. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1680

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Every painter will go to Hell, and for every portrait he has made, there will be appointed one who will chastise him in the Hell." Ibn 'Abbas said: If you have to do it, draw pictures of trees and other inanimate things.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Every painter will go to Hell, and for every portrait he has made, there will be appointed one who will chastise him in the Hell." Ibn 'Abbas said: If you have to do it, draw pictures of trees and other inanimate things.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "كل مصور في النار يجعل له بكل صورة صورها نفس فيعذبه في جهنم" قال ابن عباس: فإن كنت لابد فاعلا، فاصنع الشجر وما لا ورح فيه" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1681

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Whosoever makes a picture, will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and will be asked to infuse soul therein, which he will not be able to do."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Whosoever makes a picture, will be punished on the Day of Resurrection, and will be asked to infuse soul therein, which he will not be able to do."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "من صور في الدنيا، كُلف أن يَنفخ فيها الروح يوم القيامة وليس بنافخ" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1682

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Those who will receive the most severe punishment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be painters (of living objects)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Those who will receive the most severe punishment from Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be painters (of living objects)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "إن أشد الناس عذابًا يوم القيامة المصورون" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1683

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The Almighty Allah said: 'Who is more an oppressor than him who goes to create like My creation? Let him make an ant or a grain of corn or a grain of barley."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The Almighty Allah said: 'Who is more an oppressor than him who goes to create like My creation? Let him make an ant or a grain of corn or a grain of barley."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "قال الله تعالى: {ومن أظلم ممن ذهب يخلق كخلقي! فليخلقوا ذرة أو ليخلقوا حبة، أو ليخلقوا شعيرة" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1684

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Talhah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي طلحة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "لا تدخل الملائكة بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1685

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Messenger of Allah ﷺ but delayed and this grieved him very much. When he came out of his house, Jibril met him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him about the reason of delay, and he replied: "We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
Jibril (Gabriel) promised to visit the Messenger of Allah ﷺ but delayed and this grieved him very much. When he came out of his house, Jibril met him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him about the reason of delay, and he replied: "We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a portrait."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: وعد رسول الله ﷺ  جبريل أن يأتيه فراث عليه حتى اشتد على رسول الله ﷺ، فخرج فلقيه جبريل فشكا إليه، فقال: إنا لا ندخل بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة. ((رواه البخاري)) (("راث": أبطأ، وهو بالثاء المثلثة)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1686

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 Jibril (Gabriel) ﷺ made a promise with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. There was a staff in the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He threw it from his hand and said, "Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers." Then he noticed a puppy under his bed and said, "O 'Aishah, when did this dog enter?" She said: "By Allah, I don't know." He then commanded that it should be turned out. No sooner than had they expelled it, Jibril came and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "You promised to visit me. I waited for you but you did not come." Whereupon he said: "The dog kept me from coming. We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
Jibril (Gabriel) ﷺ made a promise with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to come at a definite hour; that hour came but he did not visit him. There was a staff in the hand of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He threw it from his hand and said, "Never does Allah back out of His Promise, nor do His messengers." Then he noticed a puppy under his bed and said, "O 'Aishah, when did this dog enter?" She said: "By Allah, I don't know." He then commanded that it should be turned out. No sooner than had they expelled it, Jibril came and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "You promised to visit me. I waited for you but you did not come." Whereupon he said: "The dog kept me from coming. We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or a picture."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: واعد رسول الله ﷺ  جبريل عليه السلام في ساعة أن يأتيه، فجاءت تلك الساعة ولم يأته! قالت: وكان بيده عصًا، فطرحها من يده وهو يقول: "ما يخلف الله وعده ولا رسله" ثم التفت، فإذا جرو كلب تحت سريره. فقال: "متى دخل هذا الكلب؟" فقلت: والله ما دريت به، فأمر به فأخرج، فجاءه جبريل عليه السلام: فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "وعدتني، فجلست لك ولم تأتني" فقال: منعني الكلب الذي كان في بيتك، إنا لا ندخل بيتًا فيه كلب ولا صورة" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1687

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abul-Haiyaj Haiyan bin Husain said:
 'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Shall I not send you to do a task that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had assigned to me? Spare no portrait unwiped out, and leave not a high grave unlevelled."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abul-Haiyaj Haiyan bin Husain said:
hadiths.body:
'Ali bin Abu Talib (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Shall I not send you to do a task that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had assigned to me? Spare no portrait unwiped out, and leave not a high grave unlevelled."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي الهياج حيان بن حصين قال: قال لي علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه: ألا أبعثك على ما بعثني عليه رسول الله ﷺ ؟ أن لا تدع صورة إلا طمستها، ولا قبرًا مشرفًا إلا سويته. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1688

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم تصوير الحيوان في بساط أو حجر أو ثوب أو درهم أو مخدة أو دينار أو وسادة وغير ذلك وتحريم اتخاذ الصور في حائط وسقف وستر وعمامة وثوب ونحوها والأمر بإتلاف الصورة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Drawing Portraits

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding the fields or herds or hunting, will lose two Qirat every day out of his rewards."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who keeps a dog other than one for guarding the fields or herds or hunting, will lose two Qirat every day out of his rewards."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "من اقتنى كلبًا إلا كلب صيد أو ماشية فإنه ينقص فإنه ينقص من أجره كل يوم قيراطان" ((متفق عليه)). وفي رواية:  قيراط.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1689

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم اتخاذ الكلب إلا لصيد أو ماشية أو زرع
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Keeping a Dog except as a Watchdog or Hunting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good deeds equal to one Qirat every day, except one who keeps it for guarding the fields or the herd."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

In a narration of Muslim, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is reported to have said: "He who keeps a dog for any reason other than to guard his property (lands) or his flock of sheep, his good deeds equal to two Qirat will be deducted every day."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who keeps a dog, will lose out of his good deeds equal to one Qirat every day, except one who keeps it for guarding the fields or the herd."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

In a narration of Muslim, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is reported to have said: "He who keeps a dog for any reason other than to guard his property (lands) or his flock of sheep, his good deeds equal to two Qirat will be deducted every day."
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من أمسك كلبًا فإنه ينقص كل يوم من عمله قيراط إلا كلب حرث أو ماشية" ((متفق عليه)).  وفي رواية لمسلم: "من اقتنى كلبًا ليس بكلب صيد، ولا ماشية ولا أرض، فإنه ينقص من أجره قيراطان كل يوم".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1690

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم اتخاذ الكلب إلا لصيد أو ماشية أو زرع
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Keeping a Dog except as a Watchdog or Hunting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog or a bell."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog or a bell."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تصحب الملائكة رفقة كلب أو جرس".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1691

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة تعليق الجرس في البعير وغيره من الدواب وكراهية استصحاب الكلب والجرس في السفر
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Hanging Bells round the Necks of Animals

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The bell is one of the musical instruments of Satan."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The bell is one of the musical instruments of Satan."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن النبي ﷺ  قال: "الجرس مزامير الشيطان". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح على شرط مسلم))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1692

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة تعليق الجرس في البعير وغيره من الدواب وكراهية استصحاب الكلب والجرس في السفر
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Hanging Bells round the Necks of Animals

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited riding a camel which eats dung, or animal or human waste.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited riding a camel which eats dung, or animal or human waste.

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: نهى رسول الله ﷺ  عن الجلالة في الإبل أن يركب عليها.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1693

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة ركوب الجلالة وهي البعير أو الناقة التي تأكل العذرة فإن أكلت علفًا طاهرًا فطاب لحمها زالت الكراهة
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Riding a Camel which eats Animals' waste

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that the spittle should be buried in earth."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its expiation is that the spittle should be buried in earth."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ : "البصاق في المسجد خطيئة، وكفارتها دفنها" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1694

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن البصاق في المسجد والأمر بإزالته منه إذا وجد فيه، والأمر بتنزيه المسجد عن الأقذار
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Spitting in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qiblah and scratched it off.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw spittle or snot or sputum, sticking to the wall towards Qiblah and scratched it off.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها أن رسول الله ﷺ رأى في جدار القبلة مخاطا أو بزاقا أو نخامة فحكه ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1695

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن البصاق في المسجد والأمر بإزالته منه إذا وجد فيه، والأمر بتنزيه المسجد عن الأقذار
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Spitting in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not proper to use the mosque for urinating or easing oneself. They are merely built for the remembrance of Allah and the recitation of the Qur'an", or as he stated.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not proper to use the mosque for urinating or easing oneself. They are merely built for the remembrance of Allah and the recitation of the Qur'an", or as he stated.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "إن هذه المساجد لا تصلح لشيء من البول ولا القذر، إنما هي لذكر الله تعالى، وقراءة القرآن" أو كما قال رسول الله ﷺ . ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1696

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن البصاق في المسجد والأمر بإزالته منه إذا وجد فيه، والأمر بتنزيه المسجد عن الأقذار
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Spitting in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: 'La raddaha Allahu 'alaika (May Allah not restore it to you),' for mosques are not built for this purpose."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone hears a man inquiring in the mosque about something he has lost, he should say: 'La raddaha Allahu 'alaika (May Allah not restore it to you),' for mosques are not built for this purpose."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "من سمع رجلا ينشد ضالة في المسجد فليقل: لا ردها الله عليك، فإن المساجد لم تبنَ لهذا" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1697

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الخصومة في المسجد ورفع الصوت فيه ونشد الضالة والبيع والشراء والإجارة ونحوها من المعاملات
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Quarrelling or Raising voices in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah said, "When you see someone buying or selling in the mosque, say to him: 'La arbaha-Allahu tijarataka (May Allah not make your bargain profitable)!' When you see someone announcing something lost in it, say: 'May Allah not restore it to you!"'

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah said, "When you see someone buying or selling in the mosque, say to him: 'La arbaha-Allahu tijarataka (May Allah not make your bargain profitable)!' When you see someone announcing something lost in it, say: 'May Allah not restore it to you!"'

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "إذا رأيتم من يبيع أو يبتاع في المسجد، فقولوا: لا أربح الله تجارتك، وإذا رأيتم من ينشد ضالة فقولوا: لا ردها الله عليك".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1698

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الخصومة في المسجد ورفع الصوت فيه ونشد الضالة والبيع والشراء والإجارة ونحوها من المعاملات
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Quarrelling or Raising voices in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Has any one seen my red camel?" Upon this the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant to be (i.e., prayer, remembrance of Allah, acquiring knowledge, etc.)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
A man announced (the loss of his camel) in the mosque, uttering these words: "Has any one seen my red camel?" Upon this the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "May it not be restored to you! The mosques are built for what they are meant to be (i.e., prayer, remembrance of Allah, acquiring knowledge, etc.)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن رجلا نشد في المسجد فقال: من دعا إلى الجمل الأحمر، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا وجدت، إنما بنيت المساجد لم بنيت له" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1699

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الخصومة في المسجد ورفع الصوت فيه ونشد الضالة والبيع والشراء والإجارة ونحوها من المعاملات
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Quarrelling or Raising voices in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his grandfather (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited (us) from buying and selling in the mosque; (he also prohibited us from) making announcement in it about something lost and from reciting poems in it.

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Amr bin Shu'aib on the authority of his grandfather (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited (us) from buying and selling in the mosque; (he also prohibited us from) making announcement in it about something lost and from reciting poems in it.

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  نهى عن الشراء والبيع في المسجد، وأن تنشد فيه ضالة، أو ينشد فيه شعر. ((رواه أبو داود، والترمذي وقال حديث حسن))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1700

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الخصومة في المسجد ورفع الصوت فيه ونشد الضالة والبيع والشراء والإجارة ونحوها من المعاملات
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Quarrelling or Raising voices in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I saw that it was 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, who said: "Go and call me these two men." I brought them and 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) asked them: "Where are you from?" On their replying that they belonged to At-Taif, he said: "Had you been the inhabitants of Al-Madinah, I would have given you a beating for raising your voices in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: As-Sa'ib bin Yazid (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
While I was in the mosque, someone threw a pebble at me, and when I looked up, I saw that it was 'Umar bin Al-Khattab, who said: "Go and call me these two men." I brought them and 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) asked them: "Where are you from?" On their replying that they belonged to At-Taif, he said: "Had you been the inhabitants of Al-Madinah, I would have given you a beating for raising your voices in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن السائب بن زيد الصحابي رضي الله عنه قال: كنت في المسجد فحصبني رجل، فنظرت فإذا عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه فقال: اذهب فائتني بهذين، فجئته بهما، فقال: من أين أنتما؟ فقالا: من أهل الطائف، فقال: لو كنتما من أهل البلد، لأوجعتكما، ترفعان أصواتكما في مسجد رسول الله ﷺ  ! ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1701

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الخصومة في المسجد ورفع الصوت فيه ونشد الضالة والبيع والشراء والإجارة ونحوها من المعاملات
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Quarrelling or Raising voices in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosque."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosques."
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosque."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten garlic should not come to our mosques."
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ  قال: "من أكل من هذه الشجرة -يعني الثوم- فلا يقربن مسجدنا" ((متفق عليه)). وفي رواية لمسلم: "مساجدنا".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1702

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي من أكل ثومًا أو بصلا أو كراثًا أو غيره مما له رائحة كريهة عن دخول المسجد قبل زوال رائحته إلا لضرورة
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Entering the Mosque after Eating raw Onion or Garlic

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who has eaten from this plant (i.e., garlic) should not approach us and should not offer Salat (prayer) along with us."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who has eaten from this plant (i.e., garlic) should not approach us and should not offer Salat (prayer) along with us."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ : "من أكل من هذه الشجرة، فلا يقربنا، ولا يصلين معنا" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1703

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي من أكل ثومًا أو بصلا أو كراثًا أو غيره مما له رائحة كريهة عن دخول المسجد قبل زوال رائحته إلا لضرورة
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Entering the Mosque after Eating raw Onion or Garlic

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten onion or garlic or leek should not approach our mosque, because the angels are also offended by the strong smells) that offend the children of Adam."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who has eaten garlic or onion should keep away from us or our mosques."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

The narration in Muslim is: "He who has eaten onion or garlic or leek should not approach our mosque, because the angels are also offended by the strong smells) that offend the children of Adam."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: قال النبي ﷺ : "من أكل ثومًا أو بصلا فليعتزلنا، أو فليعتزل مسجدنا" ((متفق عليه)).  وفي رواية لمسلم: "من أكل البصل، والثوم، الكراث، فلا يقربن مسجدنا، فإن الملائكة تتأذى مما يتأذى منه بنو آدم".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1704

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي من أكل ثومًا أو بصلا أو كراثًا أو غيره مما له رائحة كريهة عن دخول المسجد قبل زوال رائحته إلا لضرورة
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Entering the Mosque after Eating raw Onion or Garlic

hadiths.englishRaw:
It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said in the sermon of Friday prayer:
 "O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odour of these to be very offensive. I saw that if the Messenger of Allah ﷺ happened to find a man with such offensive odour in the mosque, he would order him to be taken out of the mosque and sent to Al-Baqi'. He who wants to eat any of these, should cook them till their odour dies out.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: It has been narrated that 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said in the sermon of Friday prayer:
hadiths.body:
"O you people! You eat garlic and onion. I think the odour of these to be very offensive. I saw that if the Messenger of Allah ﷺ happened to find a man with such offensive odour in the mosque, he would order him to be taken out of the mosque and sent to Al-Baqi'. He who wants to eat any of these, should cook them till their odour dies out.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه أنه خطب يوم الجمعة فقال في خطبته: ثم إنكم أيها الناس تأكلون شجرتين ما أراهما إلا خبيثتين: البصل، والثوم -لقد رأيت رسول الله ﷺ  إذا وجد ريحهما من الرجل في المسجد أمر به، فأخرج إلى البقيع، فمن أكلهما، فليمتهما طبخًا. ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1705

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي من أكل ثومًا أو بصلا أو كراثًا أو غيره مما له رائحة كريهة عن دخول المسجد قبل زوال رائحته إلا لضرورة
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Entering the Mosque after Eating raw Onion or Garlic

hadiths.englishRaw:
Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ forbade (us) from sitting with our legs drawn up to our belly (Ihtiba') during the Friday Khutbah (religious talk before the prayer).

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Mu'adh bin Anas Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ forbade (us) from sitting with our legs drawn up to our belly (Ihtiba') during the Friday Khutbah (religious talk before the prayer).

[Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن معاذ بن أنس الجهني، رضي الله عنه، أن النبي ﷺ نهى عن الحبوة يوم الجمعة والإمام يخطب ((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقالا: حديث حسن))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1706

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الاحتباء يوم الجمعة والإمام يخطب لأنه يجلب النوم فيفوت استماع الخطبة ويخاف انتقاض الوضوء
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Sitting with Erected Legs during Friday Sermon

hadiths.englishRaw:
Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the animal and enter in the month of Dhul-Hijjah, he should not get his hair cut or nails pared till he has offered his sacrifice."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When anyone of you intends to sacrifice the animal and enter in the month of Dhul-Hijjah, he should not get his hair cut or nails pared till he has offered his sacrifice."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها قالت قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من كان له ذبح يذبحه، فإذا أهل هلال ذي الحجة، فلا  يأخذن من شعره ولا من أظفاره شيئًا حتى يضحي" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1707

chapter.arabicTitle: باب نهي من دخل عليه عشر ذي الحجة وأراد أن يضحي عن أخذ شيء من شعره أو أظفاره حتى يضحي
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of having a Hair cut or paring one's nail during the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah for one who intends to Sacrifice an Animal

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oath, may do so by swearing in the Name of Allah or he should remain silent."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
