The Prophet ﷺ said, "Allah has prohibited you from taking an oath by your fathers. He who must take an oath, may do so by swearing in the Name of Allah or he should remain silent."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر، رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي ﷺ ، قال: "إن الله تعالى ينهاكم أن تحلفوا بآبائكم، فمن كان حالفًا، فليحلف بالله، أو ليصمت" ((متفق عليه)).  وفي رواية في الصحيح "فمن كان حالفًا فلا يحلف إلا بالله أو ليسكت".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1708

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الحلف بمخلوق كالنبي والكعبة والملائكة والسماء والآباء والحياة والروح والرأس ونعمة السلطان وتربة فلان والأمانة، وهي من أشدها نهيًا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Swearing in the name of anything besides Allah

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, false leaders, etc.) nor by your fathers."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Swear neither by the name of Taghut (i.e., false deities, false leaders, etc.) nor by your fathers."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الرحمن بن سَمُرَة، رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تحلفوا بالطواغي، ولا بآبائكم". ((رواه مسلم)). "الطواغي": جمع طاغية، وهي الأصنام، ومنه الحديث: "هذه طاغية دوس": أي: صنمهم ومعبودهم، وروي في غير مسلم: "بالطواغيت" جمع طاغوت، وهو الشيطان والصنم.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1709

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الحلف بمخلوق كالنبي والكعبة والملائكة والسماء والآباء والحياة والروح والرأس ونعمة السلطان وتربة فلان والأمانة، وهي من أشدها نهيًا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Swearing in the name of anything besides Allah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who swears by Amanah (trust) is not one of us."

[Abu Dawud with authentic Isnad]
.
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who swears by Amanah (trust) is not one of us."

[Abu Dawud with authentic Isnad]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن بريدة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ قال: "من حلف بالأمانة، فليس منا". ((حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1710

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الحلف بمخلوق كالنبي والكعبة والملائكة والسماء والآباء والحياة والروح والرأس ونعمة السلطان وتربة فلان والأمانة، وهي من أشدها نهيًا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Swearing in the name of anything besides Allah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone swears that in such and such case he will be free from Islam and afterwards he turns out to be a liar, he will be as he has sworn; but if he is speaking the truth, he will not revert safely to Islam."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If anyone swears that in such and such case he will be free from Islam and afterwards he turns out to be a liar, he will be as he has sworn; but if he is speaking the truth, he will not revert safely to Islam."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من حلف فقال: إني بريء من الإسلام، فإن كان كاذبًا، فهو كما قال، وإن كان صادقًا، فلن يرجع إلى الإسلام سالمًا". ((رواه أبو داود))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1711

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الحلف بمخلوق كالنبي والكعبة والملائكة والسماء والآباء والحياة والروح والرأس ونعمة السلطان وتربة فلان والأمانة، وهي من أشدها نهيًا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Swearing in the name of anything besides Allah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah." I admonished him: "Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah, has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk'."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.

[Some 'Ulama' are of the opinion that the words of the Prophet ﷺ that "He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk," are in the nature of extreme admonition. And in fact, it is not Shirk. The same applies to the saying of the Prophet ﷺ, who said, "showing off is Shirk."]
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard a man saying: "No, by the Ka'bah." I admonished him: "Do not swear by any thing besides Allah, for I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah, has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk'."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.

[Some 'Ulama' are of the opinion that the words of the Prophet ﷺ that "He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk," are in the nature of extreme admonition. And in fact, it is not Shirk. The same applies to the saying of the Prophet ﷺ, who said, "showing off is Shirk."]
boldSegments: [Some 'Ulama' are of the opinion that the words of the Prophet ﷺ that "He who swears by anyone or anything other than Allah has indeed committed an act of Kufr or Shirk," are in the nature of extreme admonition. And in fact, it is not Shirk. The same applies to the saying of the Prophet ﷺ, who said, "showing off is Shirk."]
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أنه سمع رجلا يقول: لا والكعبة، قال ابن عمر: لا تحلف بغير الله، فإني سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "من حلف بغير الله، فقد كفر أو أشرك".(( رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن))	وفسر بعض العلماء قوله: "كفر أو أشرك" على التغليظ، كما روي أن النبي ﷺ  قال: "الرياء شرك".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1712

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الحلف بمخلوق كالنبي والكعبة والملائكة والسماء والآباء والحياة والروح والرأس ونعمة السلطان وتربة فلان والأمانة، وهي من أشدها نهيًا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Swearing in the name of anything besides Allah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muslim unjustly will meet Allah and He will be angry with him" then he recited:

"Verily, those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter. Neither will Allah speak to them nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection nor will He purify them, and they shall have a painful torment." (3:77)

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who takes oath to acquire the property of a Muslim unjustly will meet Allah and He will be angry with him" then he recited:

"Verily, those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's Covenant and their oaths, they shall have no portion in the Hereafter. Neither will Allah speak to them nor look at them on the Day of Resurrection nor will He purify them, and they shall have a painful torment." (3:77)

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ  قال: "من خلف على مال امرئ مسلم بغير حقه، لقي الله وهو عليه غضبان" قال: ثم قرأ علينا رسول الله ﷺ  مصداقه من كتاب الله عز وجل: {إن الذين يشترون بعهد الله وأيمانهم ثمنًا قليلا} ((آل عمران: 77)) إلى آخر الآية: ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1713

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تغليظ اليمين الكاذبة عمدًا
chapter.englishTitle: Illegality of Swearing Falsely

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim by taking a false oath, Allah will condemn him to the fire of Hell and will forbid Jannah for him." A person asked: "O Messenger of Allah, even if it is something insignificant?" He replied, "Yes, even if it is the twig of the Arak tree."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Umamah Iyas bin Tha'labah Al-Harithi (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He who misappropriates the right of a Muslim by taking a false oath, Allah will condemn him to the fire of Hell and will forbid Jannah for him." A person asked: "O Messenger of Allah, even if it is something insignificant?" He replied, "Yes, even if it is the twig of the Arak tree."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي أُمامة إياس بن ثعلبة الحارثي رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "من اقتطع حق امرئ مسلم بيمينه، فقد أوجب الله له النار. -وحرم عليه الجنة" فقال له رجل: وإن كان شيئًا يسيرًا يا رسول الله؟ قال: "وإن كان قضيبًا من أراك" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1714

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تغليظ اليمين الكاذبة عمدًا
chapter.englishTitle: Illegality of Swearing Falsely

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship with Allah, disobedience to the parents, killing without justification and taking a false oath (intentionally)."

[Al-Bukhari]
.

Another narration is: A bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him: "O Messenger of Allah, what are the cardinal sins?" He ﷺ replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship." The man asked: "(What is) next?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus." He asked: "What do you mean by Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Swearing falsely to usurp the property of a Muslim."
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Of the major sins are: Associating anything in worship with Allah, disobedience to the parents, killing without justification and taking a false oath (intentionally)."

[Al-Bukhari]
.

Another narration is: A bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked him: "O Messenger of Allah, what are the cardinal sins?" He ﷺ replied, "Associating anything with Allah in worship." The man asked: "(What is) next?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus." He asked: "What do you mean by Al-Yamin Al-Ghamus?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Swearing falsely to usurp the property of a Muslim."
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "الكبائر: الإشراك بالله، وعقوق الوالدين، وقتل النفس، واليمين الغموس" ((رواه البخاري)). وفي رواية: أن أعرابيًا جاء إلى النبي ﷺ  فقال: يا رسول الله ما الكبائر؟ قال:  الإشراك بالله  قال: ثم ماذا؟ قال:  اليمين الغموس  قلت: وما اليمين الغموس؟ قال:  الذي يقتطع مال امرئ مسلم  يعني بيمين هو فيها كاذب

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1715

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تغليظ اليمين الكاذبة عمدًا
chapter.englishTitle: Illegality of Swearing Falsely

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "When you take an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and choose the better alternative."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdur-Rahman bin Samurah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "When you take an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and choose the better alternative."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عبد الرحمن بن سَمُرَة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "وإذا حلفت على يمين، فرأيت غيرها خيرًا منها، فائت الذي هو خير، وكفر عن يمينك" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1716

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ندب من حلف على يمين فرأى غيرها خيرًا منها أن يفعل ذلك المحلوف عليه ثم يكفر عن يمينه
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Expiating the Oath taken by a Person who afterwards Breaks it for a better Alternative

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you swear an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and do the thing that is better."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you swear an oath and consider something else to be better than it, make expiation for your oath and do the thing that is better."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "من حلف على يمين، فرأى غيرها خيرًا منها، فليكفر عن يمينه، وليفعل الذي هو خير" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1717

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ندب من حلف على يمين فرأى غيرها خيرًا منها أن يفعل ذلك المحلوف عليه ثم يكفر عن يمينه
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Expiating the Oath taken by a Person who afterwards Breaks it for a better Alternative

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I shall not swear to do something but that if I consider something else to be better than it, then I shall make expiation for my oath and adopt the thing that is better."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Musa (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, I swear by Allah, if Allah wills, I shall not swear to do something but that if I consider something else to be better than it, then I shall make expiation for my oath and adopt the thing that is better."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي موسى رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "إني والله إن شاء الله لا أحلف على يمين، ثم أرى خيرًا منها إلا كفرت عن يميني، وأتيت الذي هو خير". ((متفق عليه))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1718

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ندب من حلف على يمين فرأى غيرها خيرًا منها أن يفعل ذلك المحلوف عليه ثم يكفر عن يمينه
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Expiating the Oath taken by a Person who afterwards Breaks it for a better Alternative

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with Allah than the payment of its expiation prescribed by Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Persistence in respect of his oath about his family is more sinful with Allah than the payment of its expiation prescribed by Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لأن يلج أحدكم في يمينه في أهله آثم له عند الله تعالى من أن يعطي كفارته التي فرض الله عليه". ((متفق عليه)) قوله: "يلَجّ" بفتح اللام، وتشديد الجيم: أي يتمادى فيها، ولا يكفر، قوله: "آثم" هو بالثاء المثلثة، أي: أكثر إثمًا.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1719

chapter.arabicTitle: باب ندب من حلف على يمين فرأى غيرها خيرًا منها أن يفعل ذلك المحلوف عليه ثم يكفر عن يمينه
chapter.englishTitle: Desirability of Expiating the Oath taken by a Person who afterwards Breaks it for a better Alternative

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Ayah: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths ..." was revealed in respect of those persons who are in the habit of repeating: 'No, by Allah'; and 'Yes, by Allah.'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Ayah: "Allah will not punish you for what is unintentional in your oaths ..." was revealed in respect of those persons who are in the habit of repeating: 'No, by Allah'; and 'Yes, by Allah.'

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: أنزلت هذه الآية: {لا يؤاخذكم الله باللغو في أيمانكم} في قول الرجل: لا والله، وبلى والله. ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1720

chapter.arabicTitle: باب العفو عن لغو اليمين وأنَّه لا كفَّارة فِيهِ وَهُوَ مَا يجري عَلَى اللسان بغير قصد اليمين كقوله عَلَى العادة: لا والله، وبلى والله، ونحو ذَلِكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Expiation of Oaths

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Swearing produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "الحلف منفقة للسلعة، ممحقة للكسب" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1721

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الحلف في البيع وإن كان صادقًا
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Swearing in Transaction

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Beware of excessive swearing in sale, because it may promote trade but this practice will eliminate the blessing."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Qatadah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Beware of excessive swearing in sale, because it may promote trade but this practice will eliminate the blessing."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي قتادة رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "إياكم وكثرة الحلف في البيع، فإنه ينفق ثم يمحق" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1722

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الحلف في البيع وإن كان صادقًا
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Swearing in Transaction

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one should ask in the Face of Allah for anything except Jannah."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one should ask in the Face of Allah for anything except Jannah."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا يسأل بوجه الله إلا الجنة" ((رواه أبو داود)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1723

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة أن يسأل الإنسان بوجه الله عز وجل غير الجنة وكراهة منع من سأل بالله تعالى وتشفع به
chapter.englishTitle: About Begging in the Name of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Grant shelter to him who begs for it in the Name of Allah, give to him who begs in the Name of Allah, accept the invitation of him who invites you, and requite him who does a favour to you, but if you are unable to requite him, go on praying for him till you are sure that you have requited him adequately."

[Abu Dawud and An- Nasa'i]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Grant shelter to him who begs for it in the Name of Allah, give to him who begs in the Name of Allah, accept the invitation of him who invites you, and requite him who does a favour to you, but if you are unable to requite him, go on praying for him till you are sure that you have requited him adequately."

[Abu Dawud and An- Nasa'i]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "من استعاذ بالله فأعيذوه، ومن سأل بالله، فأعطوه، ومن دعاكم فأجيبوه، ومن صنع إليكم معروفًا فكافئوه، فإن لم تجدوا ما تكافئونه به، فادعوا له حتى تروا أنكم قد كافأتموه". ((حديث صحيح رواه أبو داود والنسائي بأسانيد الصحيحين))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1724

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة أن يسأل الإنسان بوجه الله عز وجل غير الجنة وكراهة منع من سأل بالله تعالى وتشفع به
chapter.englishTitle: About Begging in the Name of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "The most disgraceful man near Allah is a man who calls himself (or likes others to call him) Malikul-Amlak (i.e., king of kings)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "The most disgraceful man near Allah is a man who calls himself (or likes others to call him) Malikul-Amlak (i.e., king of kings)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه النبي ﷺ  قال: "إن أخنع اسم عند الله عز وجل رجل تسمى ملك الأملاك" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1725

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم قول شاهنشاه للسلطان وغيره لأن معناه ملك الملوك، ولا يوصف بذلك غير الله سبحانه وتعالى
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Addressing somebody as 'The King of Kings'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not address a hypocrite with the title of chief, (or similar titles of respect) for even if he deserves this title you will invite Allah's Wrath by using it for him."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Buraidah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not address a hypocrite with the title of chief, (or similar titles of respect) for even if he deserves this title you will invite Allah's Wrath by using it for him."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن بريدة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تقولوا للمنافق سيد، فإنه إن يكن سيدًا، فقد أسخطتم ربكم عز وجل". ((رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1726

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن مخاطبة الفاسق والمبتدع ونحوهما بسيد ونحوه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Conferring a Title of Honor upon a Sinner, a Hypocrite, and the Like

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab) and asked her, "What ails you O Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab)? You are shivering." She replied: "It is a fever, may Allah not bless it!" He said to her, "Do not revile fever, for it cleanses out the sins of the sons of Adam in the same way that a furnace removes the dirt of iron."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ visited Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab) and asked her, "What ails you O Umm Sa'ib (or Umm Musaiyyab)? You are shivering." She replied: "It is a fever, may Allah not bless it!" He said to her, "Do not revile fever, for it cleanses out the sins of the sons of Adam in the same way that a furnace removes the dirt of iron."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن جابر رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  دخل على أم السائب، أو أم المسيب فقال: "مالك يا أم السائب -أو يا أم المسيب- تزفزفين؟ " قالت: الحمى لا بارك الله فيها، فقال: "لا تسبي الحمى، فإنها تذهب خطايا بني آدم، كما يذهب الكير خبث الحديد" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1727

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة سب الحمى
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Reviling Fever

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abominable (about it), supplicate: 'Allahumma inna nas'aluka min khairi hadhihir-rihi, wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma umirat bihi. Wa na'udhu bika min sharri hadhihir-rihi, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma umirat bihi. (O Allah, we beg of You the good of this wind and the good of that which it contains and the good of that which it has been commanded; and we seek refuge in you from the evil of this wind and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of that which it has been commanded)."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abul-Mundhir Ubaiy bin Ka'b (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not revile the wind. When you experience something abominable (about it), supplicate: 'Allahumma inna nas'aluka min khairi hadhihir-rihi, wa khairi ma fiha, wa khairi ma umirat bihi. Wa na'udhu bika min sharri hadhihir-rihi, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma umirat bihi. (O Allah, we beg of You the good of this wind and the good of that which it contains and the good of that which it has been commanded; and we seek refuge in you from the evil of this wind and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of that which it has been commanded)."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي المنذر أبي بن كعب رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تسبوا الريح، فإذا رأيتم ما تكرهون، فقولوا: اللهم إنا نسألك من خير هذه الريح وخير ما فيها وخير ما أُمرت به، ونعوذ بك من شر هذه الريح وشر ما فيها وشر ما أُمرت به".((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن صحيح))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1728

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن سب الريح وبيان ما يقال عند هبوبها
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Reviling the Wind

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The wind is the Blessing of Allah. Sometimes it brings His Mercy and sometimes it brings His Chastisement. When you experience it, do not revile it but beg of Allah its good; and seek Allah's Refuge against its evil."

[Abu Dawud with good Isnad]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "The wind is the Blessing of Allah. Sometimes it brings His Mercy and sometimes it brings His Chastisement. When you experience it, do not revile it but beg of Allah its good; and seek Allah's Refuge against its evil."

[Abu Dawud with good Isnad]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "الريح من روح الله، تأتي بالرحمة، وتأتي بالعذاب، فإذا رأيتموها فلا تسبوها، وسلوا الله خيرها، واستعيذوا بالله من شرها".((رواه أبو داود بإسناد حسن))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1729

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن سب الريح وبيان ما يقال عند هبوبها
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Reviling the Wind

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 Whenever the wind blew strongly, The Prophet ﷺ would say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha, wa khaira ma fiha, wa khaira ma ursilat bihi. Wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bihi. (O Allah, I beg of You its good and the good of that which it contains and the good of the purpose for which it has been sent; and I seek Your Refuge from its evil and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of the purpose for which it has been sent)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
Whenever the wind blew strongly, The Prophet ﷺ would say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha, wa khaira ma fiha, wa khaira ma ursilat bihi. Wa a'udhu bika min sharriha, wa sharri ma fiha, wa sharri ma ursilat bihi. (O Allah, I beg of You its good and the good of that which it contains and the good of the purpose for which it has been sent; and I seek Your Refuge from its evil and the evil of that which it contains and the evil of the purpose for which it has been sent)."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: كان النبي ﷺ  إذا عصفت الريح قال: اللهم إني أسألك خيرها، وخير ما فيها، وخير ما أُرسلت به، وأعوذ بك من شرها، وشر ما فيها، وشر ما أُرسلت به" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1730

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن سب الريح وبيان ما يقال عند هبوبها
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Reviling the Wind

hadiths.englishRaw:
Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not revile the rooster for it wakes you up for prayer."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.narrator: Zaid bin Khalid Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not revile the rooster for it wakes you up for prayer."

[Abu Dawud]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن زيد بن خادل الجهني رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تسبوا الديك، فإنه يوقظ للصلاة".(( رواه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1731

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة سب الديك
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Reviling the Rooster

hadiths.englishRaw:
Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led the Fajr prayer at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of prayer, he turned towards the people and said, "Do you know what your Rubb has said?" They replied: "Allah and His Messenger know better." Upon this he remarked, "He has said: 'Some of My slaves have entered the morning as My believers and some as unbelievers. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Grace and Mercy of Allah, believes in Me and disbelieves in the stars; and he who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such star, disbelieves in Me and affirms his faith in the stars."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Zaid bin Khalid (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led the Fajr prayer at Al-Hudaibiyyah after a rainfall during the night. At the conclusion of prayer, he turned towards the people and said, "Do you know what your Rubb has said?" They replied: "Allah and His Messenger know better." Upon this he remarked, "He has said: 'Some of My slaves have entered the morning as My believers and some as unbelievers. He who said: We have had a rainfall due to the Grace and Mercy of Allah, believes in Me and disbelieves in the stars; and he who said: We have had a rainfall due to the rising of such and such star, disbelieves in Me and affirms his faith in the stars."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن زيد بن خالد رضي الله عنه قال: صلى بنا رسول الله ﷺ  صلاة الصبح بالحديبية في أثر سماء كانت من الليل، فلما انصرف أقبل على الناس، فقال: "هل تدرون ماذا قال ربكم؟ " قالوا: الله ورسوله أعلم. قال:  قال: "أصبح من عبادي مؤمن بي وكافر بي ، فأما من قال: مُطِرْنَا بفضل الله ورحمته، فذلك مؤمن بي كافر بالكواكب، وأما من قال: مُطِرْنَا بنوء كذا وكذا، فذلك كافر بي مؤمن بالكواكب" ((متفق عليه)).والسماء هنا: المطر.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1732

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن قول الإنسان: مطرنا بنوء كذا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Attributing Rain to the Stars

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a disbeliever, one of them will certainly deserve the title. If the addressee is so as he has asserted, the disbelief of the man is confirmed, but if it is untrue, then it will revert to him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a person calls his brother (in Islam) a disbeliever, one of them will certainly deserve the title. If the addressee is so as he has asserted, the disbelief of the man is confirmed, but if it is untrue, then it will revert to him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "إذا قال رجل لأخيه: يا كافر، فقد باء بها أحدهما، فإن كان كما قال وإلا رجعت عليه" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1733

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم قوله لمسلم: يا كافر
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Calling a Muslim an Infidel

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "If somebody accuses another of disbelief or calls him the enemy of Allah, such an accusation will revert to him (the accuser) if the accused is innocent."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "If somebody accuses another of disbelief or calls him the enemy of Allah, such an accusation will revert to him (the accuser) if the accused is innocent."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "من دعا رجلا بالكفر، أو قال: عدو الله، وليس كذلك إلا حار عليه" ((متفق عليه)).حار  رجع.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1734

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم قوله لمسلم: يا كافر
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Calling a Muslim an Infidel

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A true believer does not taunt or curse or abuse or talk indecently."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A true believer does not taunt or curse or abuse or talk indecently."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "ليس المؤمن بالطعان، ولا اللعان، ولا الفاحش، ولا البذي". ((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1735

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الفحش وبذاء اللسان
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Obscenity

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indecency does not leave anything untainted and decency does not leave anything ungraced and embellished."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indecency does not leave anything untainted and decency does not leave anything ungraced and embellished."

[At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "ما كان الفحش في شيء إلا شانه، وما كان الحياء في شيء إلا زانه".((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1736

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الفحش وبذاء اللسان
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Obscenity

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Ruined are Al-Mutanatti'un." He repeated this thrice.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Ruined are Al-Mutanatti'un." He repeated this thrice.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ  قال: "هلك المتنطعون"، قالها ثلاثًا. ((رواه مسلم."المتنطعون": المبالغون في الأمور)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1737

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة التقعير في الكلام والتشدق فيه وتكلف الفصاحة واستعمال وحشي اللغة ودقائق الإعراب في مخاطبة العوام ونحوهم
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Pretentiousness and Exaggeration during Conversation

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah dislikes an eloquent person who rolls his tongue as a cow rolls its tongue (while eating)."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-As (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah dislikes an eloquent person who rolls his tongue as a cow rolls its tongue (while eating)."

[Abu Dawud and At- Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "إن الله يبغض البليغ من الرجال الذي يتخلل بلسانه كما تتخلل البقرة".((رواه أبو داود والترمذي وقال حديث حسن)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1738

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة التقعير في الكلام والتشدق فيه وتكلف الفصاحة واستعمال وحشي اللغة ودقائق الإعراب في مخاطبة العوام ونحوهم
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Pretentiousness and Exaggeration during Conversation

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The dearest and the closest of you to me on the Day of Resurrection will be those who are the best in behaviour; and the most hateful and the farthest from me on the Day of Resurrection will be the talkative and the most pretentious and the most rhetorical."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The dearest and the closest of you to me on the Day of Resurrection will be those who are the best in behaviour; and the most hateful and the farthest from me on the Day of Resurrection will be the talkative and the most pretentious and the most rhetorical."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "إن من أحبكم إلي، وأقربكم مني مجلسًا يوم القيامة، أحاسنكم أخلاقًا، وإن أبغضكم إلي وأبعدكم مني يوم القيامة، والثرثارون، والمتشدقون، والمتفيهقون".((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن)). وقد سبق شرحه في باب حسن الخلق.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1739

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة التقعير في الكلام والتشدق فيه وتكلف الفصاحة واستعمال وحشي اللغة ودقائق الإعراب في مخاطبة العوام ونحوهم
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Pretentiousness and Exaggeration during Conversation

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "None of you should say: 'My soul has become evil.' He should say: 'My soul is in bad shape."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "None of you should say: 'My soul has become evil.' He should say: 'My soul is in bad shape."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "لا يقولن أحدكم خبثت نفسي، ولكن ليقل: لقست نفسي" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1740

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة قوله: خبثت نفسي
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Self-Condemnation

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None of you should use the word Al-Karm for grapes, for Al-Karm is a Muslim (worthy of respect)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

Another narration is: "Verily, Al-Karm is the heart of a true believer."

Another narration is: "People have named grapes as Al-Karm; verily, only the heart of a believer is Al-Karm."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None of you should use the word Al-Karm for grapes, for Al-Karm is a Muslim (worthy of respect)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

Another narration is: "Verily, Al-Karm is the heart of a true believer."

Another narration is: "People have named grapes as Al-Karm; verily, only the heart of a believer is Al-Karm."
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تسموا العنب الكَرْم، فإن الكَرْم المسلم" ((متفق عليه)). ((وهذا لفظ مسلم)). وفي رواية: "فإنما الكرم قلب المؤمن" وفي رواية للبخاري ومسلم: "يقولون الكرم، إنما الكرم قلب المؤمن".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1741

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهية تسمية العنب كَرْمًا
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Calling Grapes 'Al-Karm'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Wa'il bin Hujr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not say Al-Karm when talking about grapes but say Al-'Inab or Al-Habalah."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Wa'il bin Hujr (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not say Al-Karm when talking about grapes but say Al-'Inab or Al-Habalah."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن وائل بن حجر رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "لا تقولوا: الكَرْم، ولكن قولوا: العنب، والحَبَْلة"

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1742

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهية تسمية العنب كَرْمًا
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Calling Grapes 'Al-Karm'

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No woman should touch another woman's body and then describe the details of her figure to her husband in such a manner as if he was looking at her."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No woman should touch another woman's body and then describe the details of her figure to her husband in such a manner as if he was looking at her."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لا تباشر المرأة المرأة، فتصفها لزوجها كأنه ينظر إليها" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1743

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن وصف محاسن المرأة لرجل إلا أن يحتاج إلى ذلك لغرض شرعي كنكاحها ونحوه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Describing the Charms of a Woman to a man without a valid reason approved by the Shari'ah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You must not supplicate: 'O Allah! forgive me if You wish; O Allah bestow mercy on me if You wish.' But beg from Allah with certitude for no one has the power to compel Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

Another narration of Muslim is: "A supplication should be made in full confidence and one should persistently express his desire (before Allah) in his supplication, for no bounty is too great for Allah to bestow (upon his slaves)."
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You must not supplicate: 'O Allah! forgive me if You wish; O Allah bestow mercy on me if You wish.' But beg from Allah with certitude for no one has the power to compel Allah."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]

Another narration of Muslim is: "A supplication should be made in full confidence and one should persistently express his desire (before Allah) in his supplication, for no bounty is too great for Allah to bestow (upon his slaves)."
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "لا يقولن أحدكم: اللهم اغفر لي إن شئت: اللهم ارحمني إن شئت، ليعزم المسألة، فإنه لا مكره له" ((متفق عليه)). ((وفي رواية لمسلم: "ولكن ليعزم، وليعظم الرغبة، فإن الله تعالى، لا يتعاظمه شيء أعطاه")).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1744

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة قول الإنسان: «اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي إنْ شِئْتَ»، بل يجزم بالطلب
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of saying: "Forgive me if you wish, O Allah!"

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you supplicates, let him be decisive and he should not say: 'O Allah, bestow upon me such and such if You wish', because no one has the power to compel Him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you supplicates, let him be decisive and he should not say: 'O Allah, bestow upon me such and such if You wish', because no one has the power to compel Him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "إذا دعا أحدكم، فليعزم المسألة، ولا يقولن: اللهم إن شئت، فأعطني، فإنه لا مستكره له" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1745

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة قول الإنسان: «اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي إنْ شِئْتَ»، بل يجزم بالطلب
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of saying: "Forgive me if you wish, O Allah!"

hadiths.englishRaw:
Hudhaifah bin Yaman (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Say not: 'What Allah wills and so-and-so wills', but say: 'What Allah wills, and then what so-and-so wills."'

[Abu Dawud with authentic Isnad]
.
hadiths.narrator: Hudhaifah bin Yaman (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Say not: 'What Allah wills and so-and-so wills', but say: 'What Allah wills, and then what so-and-so wills."'

[Abu Dawud with authentic Isnad]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن حذيفة بن اليمان رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "لا تقولوا: ما شاء الله وشاء فلان، ولكن قولوا: ما شاء الله، ثم شاء فلان".

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1746

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة قول: ما شاء الله وشاء فلان
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of saying: "What Allah Wills and so-and-so Wills"

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Barzah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ disliked going to bed before the 'Isha' (night) prayer and indulging in conversation after it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Barzah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ disliked going to bed before the 'Isha' (night) prayer and indulging in conversation after it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي برزة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  كان يكره النوم قبل العشاء والحديث بعدها. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1747

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الحديث بعد العشاء الآخرة
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Holding Conversation after 'Isha' (Night) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 Once, towards the end of his life, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concluded the 'Isha' (night) prayer and said, "After one hundred years from tonight none of the people on the surface of the earth will survive."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
Once, towards the end of his life, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ concluded the 'Isha' (night) prayer and said, "After one hundred years from tonight none of the people on the surface of the earth will survive."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما أن رسول الله ﷺ  صلى العشاء في آخر حياته، فلما سلم، قال: "أرأيتكم ليلتكم هذه؟ فإن على رأس مائة سنة لا يبقي ممن هو على ظهر الأرض اليوم أحد" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1748

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الحديث بعد العشاء الآخرة
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Holding Conversation after 'Isha' (Night) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 Once the Prophet ﷺ delayed the 'Isha' (night) prayer till midnight. He ﷺ turned to us after the prayer and said, "All the people slept after offering their prayers, but you who waited, will be accounted as if you were engaged in your prayer throughout the period."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
Once the Prophet ﷺ delayed the 'Isha' (night) prayer till midnight. He ﷺ turned to us after the prayer and said, "All the people slept after offering their prayers, but you who waited, will be accounted as if you were engaged in your prayer throughout the period."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه أنهم انتظروا النبي ﷺ ، فجاءهم قريبًا من شطر الليل فصلى بهم، يعني العشاء، قال: ثم خطبنا فقال: "ألا إن الناس قد صلوا. ثم رقدوا، وإنكم لن تزالوا في صلاة ما انتظرتم الصلاة" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1749

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الحديث بعد العشاء الآخرة
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Holding Conversation after 'Isha' (Night) Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a man calls his wife to his bed and she refuses, and thus he spends the night angry with her, the angels continue cursing her till the morning."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a man calls his wife to his bed and she refuses, and thus he spends the night angry with her, the angels continue cursing her till the morning."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "إذا دعا الرجل امرأته إلى فراشه فأبت، فبات غضبان عليها، لعنتها الملائكة حتى تصبح" ((متفق عليه)). وفي رواية: حتى:  ترجع.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1750

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم امتناع المرأة من فراش زوجها إذا دعاها ولم يكن لها عذر شرعي
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Refusal by a Woman when her Husband calls her to his Bed

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not lawful for a woman to observe an optional Saum (fast) without the permission of her husband when he is at home. Nor should she allow anyone to enter his house without his permission."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is not lawful for a woman to observe an optional Saum (fast) without the permission of her husband when he is at home. Nor should she allow anyone to enter his house without his permission."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: "لا يحل للمرأة أن تصوم وزوجها شاهد إلا بإذنه، ولا تأذن في بيته إلا بإذنه" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1751

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم صوم المرأة وزوجها حاضر إلا بإذنه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Observing an Optional Saum (Fast) by a Woman without the Permission of her Husband

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Does he who raises up his head before the Imam not fear that Allah will make his head that of a donkey or make his appearance similar to that of donkey?"

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Does he who raises up his head before the Imam not fear that Allah will make his head that of a donkey or make his appearance similar to that of donkey?"

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ  قال: "أما يخشى أحدكم إذا رفع رأسه قبل الإمام أن يجعل الله رأسه رأس حمار! أو يجعل الله صورته صورة حمار" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1752

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم رفع المأموم رأسه من الركوع أو السجود قبل الإمام
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of raising one's Head before the Imam

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 We are prohibited from placing the hand on the side during As-Salat (the prayer).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
We are prohibited from placing the hand on the side during As-Salat (the prayer).

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ: نهى عن الخصر في الصلاة. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1753

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة وضع اليد على الخاصرة في الصلاة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Placing the hands on the sides during As-Salat (The Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "No Salat (prayer) should be performed when the food has been served, nor should it be performed when a person is in need of relieving himself."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "No Salat (prayer) should be performed when the food has been served, nor should it be performed when a person is in need of relieving himself."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ " لاَ صَلاَةَ بِحَضْرَةِ الطَّعَامِ وَلاَ وَهُوَ يُدَافِعُهُ الأَخْبَثَانِ " ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1754

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الصلاة بحضرة الطعام  ونفسه تتوق إليه أو مع مدافعة الأخبثين: وهما البول والغائط
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Joining As-Salat (The Prayer) when the Food is ready or when one is in desperate need to answer the call of Nature

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "How is it that some people raise their eyes towards the sky during As-Salat (the prayer)?" He stressed (this point) and added, "People must refrain from raising their eyes towards heaven in Salat (prayer), or else their sights will certainly be snatched away."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "How is it that some people raise their eyes towards the sky during As-Salat (the prayer)?" He stressed (this point) and added, "People must refrain from raising their eyes towards heaven in Salat (prayer), or else their sights will certainly be snatched away."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أنس بن مالك قَالَ : قَالَ رسولُ اللهِ : « مَا بَالُ أقْوامٍ يَرْفَعُونَ أبْصَارَهُمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ في صَلاَتِهِمْ » ! فَاشْتَدَّ قَولُهُ في ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَالَ : « لَيَنْتَهُنَّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ، أَوْ لَتُخطفَنَّ أَبْصَارُهُمْ » ! . رواه البخاري

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1755

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن رفع البَصَر إِلَى السماء في الصلاة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of raising one's Eyes towards the sky during As-Salat (The Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
 I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about random looks in Salat (prayer), and he replied, "It is something which Satan snatches from the slave's Salat."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:
hadiths.body:
I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about random looks in Salat (prayer), and he replied, "It is something which Satan snatches from the slave's Salat."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها قالت: سألت رسول الله ﷺ  عن الالتفات في الصلاة فقال: "هو اختلاس يختلسه الشيطان من صلاة العبد" ((رواه البخاري)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1756

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الالتفات في الصلاة لغير عذر
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Glancing in one Direction of the other during Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "Beware of looking around in Salat (prayer), because random looks in Salat are a cause of destruction. If there should be no help from it, it is permissible in the voluntary and not in obligatory Salat."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, "Beware of looking around in Salat (prayer), because random looks in Salat are a cause of destruction. If there should be no help from it, it is permissible in the voluntary and not in obligatory Salat."

[At-Tirmidhi]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: قال لي رسول الله ﷺ : "إياك والالتفات في الصلاة، فإن الالتفات في الصلاة هلكة، فإن كان لابد، ففي التطوع لا في الفريضة".((رواه الترمذي وقال حديث حسن صحيح)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1757

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة الالتفات في الصلاة لغير عذر
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Glancing in one Direction of the other during Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Marthad Kannaz bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "Do not offer Salat (prayer) facing the graves and do not sit on them."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Marthad Kannaz bin Husain (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "Do not offer Salat (prayer) facing the graves and do not sit on them."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي مرثد كناز بن الحصين رضي الله عنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "لا تصلوا إلى القبور، ولا تجلسوا عليها" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1758

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن الصلاة إلى القبور
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of facing the Graves during Salat (Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abul-Juhaim 'Abdullah bin Al-Harith (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If the person who passes in front of a praying person, realizes the enormity of the sinfulness of this act, it will have been better for him to wait forty than to pass in front of him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

[The narrator was not sure whether the Prophet ﷺ said forty days, months or years.]
hadiths.narrator: Abul-Juhaim 'Abdullah bin Al-Harith (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If the person who passes in front of a praying person, realizes the enormity of the sinfulness of this act, it will have been better for him to wait forty than to pass in front of him."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

[The narrator was not sure whether the Prophet ﷺ said forty days, months or years.]
boldSegments: [The narrator was not sure whether the Prophet ﷺ said forty days, months or years.]
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي الجهيم عبد الله بن الحارث بن الصمة الأنصاري رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : "لو يعلم المار بين المصلي ماذا عليه لكان أن يقف أربعين خيرًا له من أن يمر بين يديه" ((قال الراوي: لا أدري قال أربعين يومًا، أو أربعين شهرًا، أو أربعين سنة)). ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1759

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم المرور بين يدي المصلي
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of passing in front of a Worshipper while he is offering Salat (Prayer)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "When the Iqamah is called, no prayer should be performed except the obligatory prayer."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "When the Iqamah is called, no prayer should be performed except the obligatory prayer."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "إذا أقيمت الصلاة، فلا صلاة إلا المكتوبة" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1760

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة شروع المأموم في نافلة بعد شروع المؤذن في إقامة الصلاة سواء كانت النافلة سنة تلك الصلاة أو غيرها
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of offering optional Prayer after the announcement of Iqamah

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not choose the Friday night among all other nights for standing in (Tahajjud) prayer, and do not choose Friday among all other days for Saum (fasting) except that one you have accustomed to."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not choose the Friday night among all other nights for standing in (Tahajjud) prayer, and do not choose Friday among all other days for Saum (fasting) except that one you have accustomed to."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي ﷺ  قال: "لا تخصوا ليلة الجمعة بقيام من بين الليالي، ولا تخصوا يوم الجمعة بصيام من بين الأيام إلا أن يكون في صوم يصومه أحدكم" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1761

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة تخصيص يوم الجمعة بصيام أو ليلته بصلاة من بين الليالي
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Selecting Friday for Fasting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: "None of you should observe fast on Friday except that he should observe fast either one day before it or one day after it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: "None of you should observe fast on Friday except that he should observe fast either one day before it or one day after it."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعنه قال: سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول: "لا يصومن أحدكم يوم الجمعة إلا يومًا قبله أو بعده" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1762

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة تخصيص يوم الجمعة بصيام أو ليلته بصلاة من بين الليالي
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Selecting Friday for Fasting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Muhammad bin 'Abbad (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 I asked Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him). Did the Prophet ﷺ prohibit fasting on Friday?" He said, "Yes."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Muhammad bin 'Abbad (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
I asked Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him). Did the Prophet ﷺ prohibit fasting on Friday?" He said, "Yes."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن محمد بن عباد قال: سألت جابرًا رضي الله عنه: أنهى النبي ﷺ  عن صوم يوم الجمعة؟ قال: نعم ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1763

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة تخصيص يوم الجمعة بصيام أو ليلته بصلاة من بين الليالي
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Selecting Friday for Fasting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Juwairiyah bint Al-Harith (May Allah be pleased with her), the Mother of the Believers, said that the Prophet ﷺ visited her on a Friday and she was observing fast. He asked, "Did you observe fast yesterday?" She said, "No." He asked, "Do you intend to observe fast tomorrow?" She said, "No." He said, "In that case, give up your fast today."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.body:
Juwairiyah bint Al-Harith (May Allah be pleased with her), the Mother of the Believers, said that the Prophet ﷺ visited her on a Friday and she was observing fast. He asked, "Did you observe fast yesterday?" She said, "No." He asked, "Do you intend to observe fast tomorrow?" She said, "No." He said, "In that case, give up your fast today."

[Al-Bukhari]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أم المؤمنين جويرة بنت الحارس رضي الله عنها أن النبي ﷺ  دخل عليها يوم الجمعة وهي صائمة، فقال: " أصمت أمس؟" قالت: لا، قال: " تريدين أن تصومي غدا " قالت: لا، قال : "فأفطري" ((رواه البخاري))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1764

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة تخصيص يوم الجمعة بصيام أو ليلته بصلاة من بين الليالي
chapter.englishTitle: Abomination of Selecting Friday for Fasting

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah and 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ prohibited observing continuous voluntary fasts beyond one day.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah and 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ prohibited observing continuous voluntary fasts beyond one day.

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة وعائشة رضي الله عنهما أن النبي ﷺ  نهى عن الوصال. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1765

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الوصال في الصوم وهو أن يصوم يومين أو أكثر، ولا يأكل ولا يشرب بينهما
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Extending Fast beyond one Day

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited observing continuous fasts beyond one day. The Companions submitted: "But you do it." He replied, "I am not like you. I am given to eat and to drink (from Allah)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited observing continuous fasts beyond one day. The Companions submitted: "But you do it." He replied, "I am not like you. I am given to eat and to drink (from Allah)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما قال: نهى رسول الله ﷺ  عن الوصال. قالوا :إنك تواصل؟ قال: "إني لست مثلكم، إني أُطعم وأُسقى" ((متفق عليه)). ، وهذا لفظ البخاري.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1766

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الوصال في الصوم وهو أن يصوم يومين أو أكثر، ولا يأكل ولا يشرب بينهما
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Extending Fast beyond one Day

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is much better for one of you to sit on a live coal, which will burn his clothes and get to his skin than to sit on a grave."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is much better for one of you to sit on a live coal, which will burn his clothes and get to his skin than to sit on a grave."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ  :" لأن يجلس أحدكم على جمرة، فتحرق ثيابه، فتخلص على جلده خير له من أن يجلس على قبر" ((رواه مسلم))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1767

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الجلوس على قبر
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Sitting on the Graves

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that the graves should be plastered (made into permanent structures), used as sitting places (for the people) or building over them.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that the graves should be plastered (made into permanent structures), used as sitting places (for the people) or building over them.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: نهى رسول الله ﷺ أن يجصص القبر، وأن يقعد عليه، وأن يبنى عليه. ((رواه مسلم))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1768

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن تجصيص القبر والبناء عليه
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Plastering and Building over the Graves

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jarir bin Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a slave runs away from his master, his responsibility to him is absolved."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jarir bin Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a slave runs away from his master, his responsibility to him is absolved."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن جرير بن عبد الله رضي الله عنه قال : قال رسول الله ﷺ  :"أيما عبد أبق، فقد برئت منه الذمة " ((رواه مسلم))

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1769

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تغليظ تحريم إباق العبد من سيده
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition for a Slave to run away from his Master

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jarir bin Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Prophet ﷺ said, "When the slave runs away from his master, his Salat (prayer) will not be accepted."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration is: "He is guilty of disbelief (i.e., in case he believes in the lawfulness of doing so)."
hadiths.narrator: Jarir bin Abdullah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Prophet ﷺ said, "When the slave runs away from his master, his Salat (prayer) will not be accepted."

[Muslim]
.

Another narration is: "He is guilty of disbelief (i.e., in case he believes in the lawfulness of doing so)."
hadiths.arabic: وعنه عن النبي ﷺ  : "إذا أبق العبد، لم تقبل له صلاة " ((رواه مسلم)) . وفي رواية: "فقد كفر " .

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1770

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تغليظ تحريم إباق العبد من سيده
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition for a Slave to run away from his Master

hadiths.englishRaw:
'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
 The Quraish were anxious about a woman from Banu Makhzum who had committed theft and asked : "Who will speak to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her?" Then they said: "No one will be bold enough to do so except Usamah bin Zaid, the (Companion who was) dearly loved by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." So Usamah (May Allah be pleased with him) spoke to him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (angrily) said, "Are you interceding regarding one of the punishments prescribed by Allah?" He then got up and delivered an address in which he said, "Indeed what destroyed the people before you was just that when a person of high rank among them committed a theft, they spared him; but if the same crime was done by a poor person they inflicted the prescribed punishment on him. I swear by Allah that if Fatimah daughter of Muhammad should steal, I would have her hand cut off."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

In another narration 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: (Upon hearing the intercession of Usamah), the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed color (because of anger) and he said, "Do you dare to intercede in matters prescribed by Allah?" Usamah pleaded: "O Messenger of Allah! Pray for my forgiveness." 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) added: Thereafter the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave orders to have that woman's hand cut off.
hadiths.narrator: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
hadiths.body:
The Quraish were anxious about a woman from Banu Makhzum who had committed theft and asked : "Who will speak to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her?" Then they said: "No one will be bold enough to do so except Usamah bin Zaid, the (Companion who was) dearly loved by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." So Usamah (May Allah be pleased with him) spoke to him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (angrily) said, "Are you interceding regarding one of the punishments prescribed by Allah?" He then got up and delivered an address in which he said, "Indeed what destroyed the people before you was just that when a person of high rank among them committed a theft, they spared him; but if the same crime was done by a poor person they inflicted the prescribed punishment on him. I swear by Allah that if Fatimah daughter of Muhammad should steal, I would have her hand cut off."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.

In another narration 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: (Upon hearing the intercession of Usamah), the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed color (because of anger) and he said, "Do you dare to intercede in matters prescribed by Allah?" Usamah pleaded: "O Messenger of Allah! Pray for my forgiveness." 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) added: Thereafter the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave orders to have that woman's hand cut off.
hadiths.arabic: وعن عائشة رضي الله عنها، أن قريشًا أهمهم شأن المرأة المخزومية التي سرقت فقالوا: من يكلم فيها رسول الله ﷺ ؟ فقالوا: ومن يجترئ عليه إلا أسامة بن زيد، حب رسول الله ﷺ :، فكلمه أسامة فقال ﷺ :“أتشفع في حد من حدود الله تعالى؟ “ثم قام فاختطب، ثم قال: “إنما أهلك الذين قبلكم أنهم كانوا إذا سرق فيهم الشريف تركوه، وإذا سرق فيهم الضعيف، أقاموا عليه الحد، وايم الله لو أن فاطمة بنت محمد سرقت لقطعت يدها” ((متفق عليه)).  وفي رواية فتلون وجه رسول الله ﷺ " فقال: "أتشفع في حد من حدود الله؟" قال أسامة: استغفر لي يا رسول الله قال: ثم أمر بتلك المرأة فقطعت يدها.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1771

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم الشفاعة في الحدود
chapter.englishTitle: Undesirability of Intercession in Hudud

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Avoid two habits which provoke cursing." The Companions said: "What are those things which provoke cursing?" He said, "Relieving on the thoroughfares or under the shades where people take shelter and rest."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Avoid two habits which provoke cursing." The Companions said: "What are those things which provoke cursing?" He said, "Relieving on the thoroughfares or under the shades where people take shelter and rest."

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله ﷺ  قال: “اتقوا اللاعنين” قالوا: وما اللاعنان؟ قال: "الذي يتخلى في طريق الناس أو في ظلهم" ((رواه مسلم)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1772

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن التغوط في طريق الناس وظلهم وموارد الماء ونحوها
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Relieving Nature on the Paths

hadiths.englishRaw:
Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade urinating into stagnant water.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade urinating into stagnant water.

[Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن جابر رضي الله عنه : أن رسول الله ﷺ  نهى أن يبال في الماء الراكد.

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1773

chapter.arabicTitle: باب النهي عن البول ونحوه في الماء الراكد
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Urinating into Stagnant Water

hadiths.englishRaw:
An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 My father took me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said to him: "I have gifted one of my slaves to this son of mine." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Have you given such gift to every son of yours?" He replied, "No." Thereupon he said, "Take this gift back."

Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Be mindful of your obligation to Allah and do justice in respect of your children." My father came back and revoked his gift.

Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "Have you other children besides this one?" He said, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "Have you awarded a gift like this to all of them." He said, "No." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I am not going to bear witness to this act of injustice."

Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "Do you not except goodness from all of them as you except from him?" He said, "Yes, of course." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then don't do this (i.e., do not give a gift to one son only)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: An-Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
My father took me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said to him: "I have gifted one of my slaves to this son of mine." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Have you given such gift to every son of yours?" He replied, "No." Thereupon he said, "Take this gift back."

Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Be mindful of your obligation to Allah and do justice in respect of your children." My father came back and revoked his gift.

Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "Have you other children besides this one?" He said, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "Have you awarded a gift like this to all of them." He said, "No." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I am not going to bear witness to this act of injustice."

Another narration is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "Do you not except goodness from all of them as you except from him?" He said, "Yes, of course." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then don't do this (i.e., do not give a gift to one son only)."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن النعمان بن بشير رضي الله عنهما أن أبًا له أتي به رسول الله ﷺ  فقال: إني نحلت ابني هذا غلامًا كان لي، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "أكل ولدك نحلته مثل هذا؟" فقال: لا، فقال رسول الله ﷺ  فأرجعه". وفي رواية: فقال رسول الله ﷺ : "أفعلت هذا بولدك كلهم؟" قال: لا، قال: "اتقوا الله واعدلوا بين أولادكم" فرجع أبي، فرد تلك الصدقة.وفي رواية: فقال رسول الله ﷺ : “يا بشير ألك ولد سوى هذا؟” قال: نعم، قال: “أكلهم وهبت له مثل هذا؟" قال: لا، قال: "فلا تشهدني إذًا فإني لا أشهد على جور" وفي رواية "لا تشهدني على جور"وفي رواية: "أشهد على هذا غيري" ثم قال: "أيسرك أن يكونوا إليك في البر سواء؟" قال" بلى، قال: "فلا إذًا" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1774

chapter.arabicTitle: باب كراهة تفضيل الوالد بعض أولاده على بعض في الهبة
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of giving preference to Children over one another in giving Gifts, etc.

hadiths.englishRaw:
Zainab bint Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 I went to Umm Habibah (May Allah be pleased with her) the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, when her father Abu Sufyan bin Harb (May Allah be pleased with him) died. Umm Habibah (May Allah be pleased with her) sent for a yellow coloured perfume or something else like it, and she applied it to a slave-girl and then rubbed it on her own cheeks and said: "By Allah, I have no need for perfume, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying from the pulpit, 'It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for the dead beyond three days, except for the death of her husband; in which case the period of mourning is of four months and ten days."' Zainab said: I then visited Zainab, daughter of Jahsh (May Allah be pleased with her) when her brother died; she sent for perfume and applied it and then said: "Beware! By Allah, I don't feel any need of perfume but I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying from the pulpit, 'It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn the dead beyond three days except in case of her husband (for whom the period is) four months and ten days."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Zainab bint Abu Salamah (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
I went to Umm Habibah (May Allah be pleased with her) the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, when her father Abu Sufyan bin Harb (May Allah be pleased with him) died. Umm Habibah (May Allah be pleased with her) sent for a yellow coloured perfume or something else like it, and she applied it to a slave-girl and then rubbed it on her own cheeks and said: "By Allah, I have no need for perfume, I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying from the pulpit, 'It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for the dead beyond three days, except for the death of her husband; in which case the period of mourning is of four months and ten days."' Zainab said: I then visited Zainab, daughter of Jahsh (May Allah be pleased with her) when her brother died; she sent for perfume and applied it and then said: "Beware! By Allah, I don't feel any need of perfume but I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying from the pulpit, 'It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn the dead beyond three days except in case of her husband (for whom the period is) four months and ten days."'

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن زينب بنت أبي سلمة رضي الله عنهما قالت: دخلت على أم حبيبة رضي الله عنه زوج النبي ﷺ  حين توفي أبوها أبو سفيان بن حرب رضي الله عنه، فدعت بطيب فيه صفرة خلوق أو غيره، فدهنت منه جارية، ثم مست بعارضيها. ثم قالت: والله مالي بالطيب من حاجة، غير أني سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول على المنبر: "لا يحل لامرأة تؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر أن تحد على ميت فوق ثلاث ليال، إلا على زوج أربعة أشهر وعشرا" قالت زينب: ثم دخلت على زينب بنت جحش رضي الله عنها حين توفي أخوها، فدعت بطيب، فمست منه، ثم قالت: أما والله مالي بالطيب من حاجة، غير أني سمعت رسول الله ﷺ  يقول على المنبر: “لا يحل لامرأة تؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر أن تحد على ميت فوق ثلاث إلا على زوج أربعة أشهر وعشرًا” ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1775

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم إحداد المرأة على ميت فوق ثلاثة أيام إلا على زوج أربعة أشهر وعشرة أيام
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Mourning beyond Three Days (For Women)

hadiths.englishRaw:
Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a person in the city should make a deal on behalf of a villager on commission even if he is his real brother."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that a person in the city should make a deal on behalf of a villager on commission even if he is his real brother."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: عن أنس رضي الله عنه قال: نهى رسول الله ﷺ  أن يبيع حاضر لباد وإن كان أخاه لأبيه وأمه. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1776

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم بيع الحاضر للبادي وتلقي الركبان والبيع على بيع أخيه والخطبة على خطبته إلا أن يأذن أو يرد
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Malpractices in Commerce

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not meet the merchandise till they arrive in the market."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not meet the merchandise till they arrive in the market."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عمر قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ :”لا تتلقوا السلع حتى يهبط بها إلى الأسواق" ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1777

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم بيع الحاضر للبادي وتلقي الركبان والبيع على بيع أخيه والخطبة على خطبته إلا أن يأذن أو يرد
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Malpractices in Commerce

hadiths.englishRaw:
Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
 The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The caravans carrying merchandise should not be met on the way to purchase from them; a man in the city should not sell for a man of the desert."

Tawus asked him (Ibn 'Abbas): "What do these words really imply?" He said: "He should not work as an agent on his behalf."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.narrator: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) said:
hadiths.body:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The caravans carrying merchandise should not be met on the way to purchase from them; a man in the city should not sell for a man of the desert."

Tawus asked him (Ibn 'Abbas): "What do these words really imply?" He said: "He should not work as an agent on his behalf."

[Al-Bukhari and Muslim]
.
hadiths.arabic: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ : “لا تتلقوا الركبان، ولا يبع حاضر لباد" فقال له طاوس: ما قوله: لا بيع حاضر لباد؟ قال: لا يكون له سمسارًا. ((متفق عليه)).

hadiths.title: Riyad as-Saliheen 1778

chapter.arabicTitle: باب تحريم بيع الحاضر للبادي وتلقي الركبان والبيع على بيع أخيه والخطبة على خطبته إلا أن يأذن أو يرد
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Malpractices in Commerce

hadiths.englishRaw:
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
